## vite.config.js

```js
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    react(),
    tailwindcss()
  ],
  server: {
    host: '0.0.0.0',
    port: 3000,
    open: false
  },
  build: {
    outDir: 'dist',
    sourcemap: false,
    chunkSizeWarningLimit: 750,
    rollupOptions: {
      output: {
        manualChunks(id) {
          if (id.includes('node_modules/react/') || id.includes('node_modules/react-dom/')) {
            return 'vendor-react';
          }
          if (id.includes('node_modules/lucide-react/')) {
            return 'vendor-icons';
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
});
```

## src/index.css

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));

@theme {
  /* Tipografía Oficial Lato */
  --font-sans: 'Lato', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-display: 'Lato', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;

  /* Colores Principales Oficiales Neblina 105.5 FM */
  --color-neblina-navy: #001E4D;          /* Azul Marino Profundo (HEX: #001E4D | RGB: 0, 30, 77) */
  --color-neblina-deep: #001438;          /* Azul Marino Nocturno */
  --color-neblina-turquesa: #00DD9E;      /* Cian / Verde Turquesa Brillante (HEX: #00DD9E | RGB: 0, 221, 158) */
  --color-neblina-cyan: #00DD9E;          /* Alias Oficial */
  --color-neblina-teal: #00DD9E;          /* Alias Oficial */
  --color-neblina-white: #FFFFFF;         /* Blanco Puro (HEX: #FFFFFF | RGB: 255, 255, 255) */

  /* Colores Secundarios Oficiales (Tonos Pastel) */
  --color-neblina-sky-pastel: #B9EBFF;     /* Azul Celeste Pastel (RGB: 185, 235, 255) */
  --color-neblina-lavender-pastel: #EBE1FA;/* Lavanda / Lila Suave (RGB: 235, 225, 250) */

  /* Colores de Apoyo y Legibilidad */
  --color-true-black: #000000;
  --color-fog-white: #FFFFFF;
  --color-pure-white: #ffffff;
  --color-obsidian: #001E4D;
  --color-charcoal: #001E4D;
  --color-smoke: #1f2d42;
  --color-graphite: #324461;
  --color-ash-gray: #6b7f9e;
  --color-pale-mist: #d6e2ee;
  --color-apple-blue: #00DD9E;
  --color-link-blue: #00DD9E;
  --color-deep-link: #001E4D;
}

:root {
  --verde-agua: #00dd9e;
  --azul-marino: #001e4d;
  --fondo-base: #eef2f5;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

html.dark {
  --verde-agua: #00dd9e;
  --azul-marino: #001e4d;
  --fondo-base: #001433;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

html.light {
  --verde-agua: #00dd9e;
  --azul-marino: #001e4d;
  --fondo-base: #eef2f5;
  color-scheme: light;
}

body {
  font-family: 'Lato', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  user-select: none;
  background-color: var(--fondo-base);
  transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 0.3s ease;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overscroll-behavior-y: none;
}

/* Modo Oscuro: Canvas Azul Marino Profundo Corporativo con Textos Blanco Puro */
html.dark body {
  background-color: #001433;
  color: #FFFFFF;
}

/* Modo Claro: Canvas Base Suave Oficial con Textos Azul Marino Profundo Corporativo */
html.light body {
  background-color: #eef2f5;
  color: #001E4D;
}

/* Tipografía de Títulos y Encabezados */
.font-display {
  font-family: 'Lato', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  font-optical-sizing: auto;
}

/* ========================================================================= */
/* TIPOGRAFÍA ÓPTICA DINÁMICA APPLE (WWDC "The Details of UI Typography")     */
/* Calibración inversa: grande = tracking negativo cerrado; micro = abierto  */
/* ========================================================================= */

/* Títulos Grandes (Display / Hero / Modales): Tracking Negativo y Leading Compacto */
h1, 
.font-display-hero, 
.text-3xl.font-display, 
.text-4xl.font-display, 
.text-5xl.font-display {
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

/* Títulos Medianos (Secciones y Destacados) */
h2, 
.text-2xl.font-display {
  letter-spacing: -0.020em;
  line-height: 1.22;
}

/* Títulos Secundarios */
h3, 
.text-xl.font-display {
  letter-spacing: -0.012em;
  line-height: 1.28;
}

/* Encabezados Pequeños y Subtítulos */
h4, 
h5, 
.text-base.font-display, 
.text-lg.font-display {
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  line-height: 1.38;
}

/* Micro-Títulos y Etiquetas de Texto */
.text-sm.font-display, 
.text-xs.font-display {
  letter-spacing: 0em;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

/* Compensación Positiva Óptica para Micro-Etiquetas, Badges y Mayúsculas */
.tracking-wider,
.uppercase.tracking-wider,
.badge-optical {
  letter-spacing: 0.055em !important;
}

.tracking-widest,
.uppercase.tracking-widest {
  letter-spacing: 0.08em !important;
}

/* Apple iOS Squircle Shape */
.squircle-ios {
  border-radius: 22.37%;
}

/* Barras de scroll con el Cian / Verde Turquesa Oficial (#00DD9E) */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.4);
  border-radius: 9999px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #00DD9E;
}

/* ========================================================================= */
/* 1. LOGOTIPO OFICIAL NEBLINA 105.5 FM: VECTOR PURO, NÍTIDO Y SIN HALOS IA  */
/* ========================================================================= */

.anim-logo-halo {
  display: none !important;
}

.anim-logo-glow,
.anim-logo-reflect {
  filter: none !important;
  animation: none !important;
}

/* 2. Transición Fluida Estilo Apple con Resorte Críticamente Amortiguado (Damping 1.0) */
@keyframes tabEnter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(4px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

.anim-tab-enter,
.animate-fadeIn {
  animation: tabEnter 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .anim-float-1,
  .anim-float-2,
  .anim-rotate-slow,
  .anim-mist-1,
  .anim-mist-2,
  .anim-logo-halo,
  .anim-logo-glow,
  .anim-tab-enter,
  .anim-drawer-in {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* ========================================================================= */
/* APPLE AEROGLASS / LIQUID GLASS DESIGN SYSTEM (macOS & iOS HIG)            */
/* ========================================================================= */

/* 1. Cabecera Flotante Aeroglass (Floating Header Capsule) */
.aeroglass-nav {
  backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(190%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(190%);
}

html.dark .aeroglass-nav {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.76) 0%, rgba(0, 18, 48, 0.84) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30);
  box-shadow: 
    0 16px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70),
    0 4px 14px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.40),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
}

html.light .aeroglass-nav {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82) 0%, rgba(245, 250, 255, 0.76) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.90);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1);
  box-shadow: 
    0 16px 36px -10px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.12),
    0 4px 12px -2px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.05),
    inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1);
}

/* 2. Tarjetas y Módulos Aeroglass (Apple Cards con Refracción Líquida Calibrada) */
.aeroglass-card,
.glass-card,
.aeroglass-container {
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(160%);
  border-radius: 16px;
  contain: layout style paint;
  transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 
              box-shadow 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 
              border-color 0.22s ease;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .aeroglass-card,
  .glass-card,
  .aeroglass-container {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(145%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(145%);
  }
}

html.dark .aeroglass-card,
html.dark .glass-card,
html.dark .aeroglass-container {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.65) 0%, rgba(0, 16, 44, 0.78) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  box-shadow: 
    0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

html.light .aeroglass-card,
html.light .glass-card,
html.light .aeroglass-container {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86) 0%, rgba(246, 250, 255, 0.80) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  border-top-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 
    0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.07),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1);
}

/* Elevación Física Natural estilo Apple (Sin halos de neón) */
html.dark .aeroglass-card:hover,
html.dark .glass-card:hover,
html.dark .aeroglass-container:hover:not(.no-hover-lift) {
  transform: translateY(-2px) translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
  box-shadow: 
    0 20px 48px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72),
    0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.40),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
}

html.light .aeroglass-card:hover,
html.light .glass-card:hover,
html.light .aeroglass-container:hover:not(.no-hover-lift) {
  transform: translateY(-2px) translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  border-color: rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.10);
  border-top-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 
    0 20px 44px -10px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.12),
    0 6px 14px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.04),
    inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 #ffffff;
}

/* Sub-contenedores internos, tarjetas secundarias y bloques de formularios en modo Aeroglass */
.aeroglass-subcard,
.subpanel-aeroglass {
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(150%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(150%);
  border-radius: 14px;
}

html.dark .aeroglass-subcard,
html.dark .subpanel-aeroglass {
  background: rgba(0, 20, 52, 0.65);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
}

html.light .aeroglass-subcard,
html.light .subpanel-aeroglass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  border-top-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.90);
}

/* Modales y Diálogos Superpuestos (iOS Sheets y Modales) */
.fixed.inset-0.z-\[99999\] > div,
.fixed.inset-0.z-50 > div {
  backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(190%) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(190%) !important;
}

html.dark .fixed.inset-0.z-\[99999\] > div,
html.dark .fixed.inset-0.z-50 > div {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.88) 0%, rgba(0, 16, 44, 0.95) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 60px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) !important;
}

html.light .fixed.inset-0.z-\[99999\] > div,
html.light .fixed.inset-0.z-50 > div {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) 0%, rgba(246, 250, 255, 0.88) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) !important;
  border-top-color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 60px -15px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.14), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 #ffffff !important;
}

/* 3. Paneles de Sistema, Modales y Diálogos Aeroglass */
.aeroglass-panel,
.glass-panel,
.aeroglass-dialog,
.aeroglass-sheet {
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
  contain: layout style;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .aeroglass-panel,
  .glass-panel,
  .aeroglass-dialog,
  .aeroglass-sheet {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(160%);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(160%);
  }
}

html.dark .aeroglass-panel,
html.dark .glass-panel,
html.dark .aeroglass-dialog,
html.dark .aeroglass-sheet {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.85) 0%, rgba(0, 16, 42, 0.92) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  box-shadow: 
    0 24px 60px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
}

html.light .aeroglass-panel,
html.light .glass-panel,
html.light .aeroglass-dialog,
html.light .aeroglass-sheet {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) 0%, rgba(246, 250, 255, 0.88) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  border-top-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 
    0 24px 60px -15px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.12),
    inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 #ffffff;
}

/* ========================================================================= */
/* REGLA MAESTRA AUTOMÁTICA: ELEVACIÓN DE CONTENEDORES A ESTILO AEROGLASS    */
/* Todo bloque o panel con clases opacas o grises se convierte en vidrio     */
/* líquido de alta fidelidad iOS, manteniendo contraste y legibilidad        */
/* ========================================================================= */
html.dark div[class*="bg-slate-100"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark div[class*="bg-slate-50"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark div[class*="bg-[#1c2633]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark div[class*="bg-[#19222e]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark div[class*="bg-[#151f2e]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark div[class*="bg-[#141b24]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark div[class*="bg-[#0c141f]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark div[class*="bg-[#0b1320]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark div[class*="bg-[#1d1d1f]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.dark article[class*="border"],
html.dark div[class*="rounded-2xl"][class*="border"]:not(button):not(input):not(header):not(aside) {
  background-color: rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.65) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10) !important;
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50), inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

html.light div[class*="bg-slate-100"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light div[class*="bg-slate-50"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light div[class*="bg-[#1c2633]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light div[class*="bg-[#19222e]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light div[class*="bg-[#151f2e]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light div[class*="bg-[#141b24]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light div[class*="bg-[#0c141f]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light div[class*="bg-[#0b1320]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light div[class*="bg-[#1d1d1f]"]:not(button):not(input):not(span),
html.light article[class*="border"],
html.light div[class*="rounded-2xl"][class*="border"]:not(button):not(input):not(header):not(aside) {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(160%);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) !important;
  border-top-color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.08), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 #ffffff;
}

/* Modales y Diálogos Superpuestos (iOS Sheets y Modales) */
.fixed.inset-0.z-\[99999\] > div,
.fixed.inset-0.z-50 > div {
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%) !important;
}

html.dark .fixed.inset-0.z-\[99999\] > div,
html.dark .fixed.inset-0.z-50 > div {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.88) 0%, rgba(0, 16, 44, 0.94) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 60px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20) !important;
}

html.light .fixed.inset-0.z-\[99999\] > div,
html.light .fixed.inset-0.z-50 > div {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94) 0%, rgba(246, 250, 255, 0.90) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) !important;
  border-top-color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 0 25px 60px -15px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.14), inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 #ffffff !important;
}

/* ========================================================================= */
/* 4. SISTEMA GLOBAL DE BOTONES AEROGLASS / LIQUID GLASS (macOS & iOS HIG)   */
/* Transforma todos los botones de la página y el sistema en vidrio líquido  */
/* refractivo con reflejo especular superior y respuesta física táctil       */
/* ========================================================================= */

/* Base Universal para TODOS los botones */
button,
[role="button"],
.aeroglass-btn,
.btn-aeroglass {
  position: relative;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(150%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(150%);
  touch-action: manipulation;
  transition: transform 0.20s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
              box-shadow 0.20s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
              background 0.20s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
              border-color 0.20s ease,
              opacity 0.20s ease;
}

/* Respuesta Física Táctil Apple (Physical Click Feedback) */
button:active:not(:disabled),
[role="button"]:active:not(:disabled),
.aeroglass-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: scale(0.962) translate3d(0, 0, 0) !important;
}

/* Elevación física sutil en hover */
button:hover:not(:disabled):not(.no-hover-lift),
[role="button"]:hover:not(:disabled):not(.no-hover-lift),
.aeroglass-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-1.5px) translate3d(0, 0, 0);
}

/* Botones Deshabilitados */
button:disabled,
[role="button"][aria-disabled="true"],
.aeroglass-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45 !important;
  cursor: not-allowed !important;
  transform: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* --- CLASE A: BOTONES PRIMARIOS AEROGLASS (VERDE TURQUESA / CIAN #00DD9E) --- */
.btn-aeroglass-primary,
button.bg-emerald-500,
button.bg-emerald-400,
button[class*="bg-[#00DD9E]"] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.88) 0%, rgba(0, 195, 140, 0.94) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.60) !important;
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) !important;
  box-shadow: 
    0 8px 24px -4px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.40),
    0 2px 6px -1px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.20),
    inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
  color: #001E4D !important;
}

.btn-aeroglass-primary:hover,
button.bg-emerald-500:hover,
button.bg-emerald-400:hover,
button[class*="bg-[#00DD9E]"]:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 240, 170, 0.96) 0%, rgba(0, 210, 150, 0.98) 100%) !important;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.80) !important;
  border-top-color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 
    0 12px 32px -4px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.55),
    0 4px 10px -1px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.30),
    inset 0 1px 2px 0 #ffffff !important;
}

/* --- CLASE B: BOTONES CORPORATIVOS AZUL MARINO (NAVY AEROGLASS #001E4D) --- */
.btn-aeroglass-navy,
button.bg-gradient-to-r[class*="from-[#001E4D]"],
button[class*="bg-[#001E4D]"] {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.86) 0%, rgba(0, 18, 48, 0.92) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.40) !important;
  border-top-color: rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.80) !important;
  box-shadow: 
    0 8px 25px -4px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.45),
    0 2px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25),
    inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30) !important;
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
}

.btn-aeroglass-navy:hover,
button.bg-gradient-to-r[class*="from-[#001E4D]"]:hover,
button[class*="bg-[#001E4D]"]:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 42, 107, 0.92) 0%, rgba(0, 26, 68, 0.96) 100%) !important;
  border-color: rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.65) !important;
  border-top-color: #00DD9E !important;
  box-shadow: 
    0 12px 32px -4px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.60),
    0 4px 12px -2px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.25),
    inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45) !important;
}

/* --- CLASE C: BOTONES NEUTROS, SECUNDARIOS Y FONDOS CLAROS/OSCUROS --- */
html.light button:not([class*="bg-emerald-"]):not([class*="bg-[#00DD9E]"]):not([class*="from-"]):not([class*="bg-rose-"]):not([class*="bg-red-"]):not([class*="bg-transparent"]):not([class*="text-"]):not([class*="hover:bg-transparent"]),
html.light .btn-aeroglass-secondary {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) 0%, rgba(240, 246, 255, 0.55) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.90);
  border-top-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 
    0 4px 16px -2px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.08),
    0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.04),
    inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
  color: #001E4D;
}

html.light button:not([class*="bg-emerald-"]):not([class*="bg-[#00DD9E]"]):not([class*="from-"]):not([class*="bg-rose-"]):not([class*="bg-red-"]):not([class*="bg-transparent"]):hover,
html.light .btn-aeroglass-secondary:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) 0%, rgba(242, 248, 255, 0.75) 100%);
  border-color: rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.14);
  border-top-color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 
    0 8px 24px -4px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.14),
    0 2px 6px -1px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.06),
    inset 0 1px 2px 0 #ffffff;
}

html.dark button:not([class*="bg-emerald-"]):not([class*="bg-[#00DD9E]"]):not([class*="from-"]):not([class*="bg-rose-"]):not([class*="bg-red-"]):not([class*="bg-transparent"]):not([class*="hover:bg-transparent"]),
html.dark .btn-aeroglass-secondary {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
  box-shadow: 
    0 4px 18px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50),
    0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.30),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
  color: #ffffff;
}

html.dark button:not([class*="bg-emerald-"]):not([class*="bg-[#00DD9E]"]):not([class*="from-"]):not([class*="bg-rose-"]):not([class*="bg-red-"]):not([class*="bg-transparent"]):hover,
html.dark .btn-aeroglass-secondary:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09) 100%);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.26);
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  box-shadow: 
    0 8px 28px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70),
    0 2px 8px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.40),
    inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
}

/* --- CLASE D: BOTONES DESTRUCTIVOS O DE ALERTA (ROSE AEROGLASS) --- */
.btn-aeroglass-danger,
button.bg-rose-500,
button.bg-rose-600,
button.bg-red-500,
button.bg-red-600 {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.88) 0%, rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.94) 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40) !important;
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
  box-shadow: 
    0 8px 24px -4px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.45),
    0 2px 6px -1px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.20),
    inset 0 1px 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) !important;
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
}

.btn-aeroglass-danger:hover,
button.bg-rose-500:hover,
button.bg-rose-600:hover,
button.bg-red-500:hover,
button.bg-red-600:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.94) 0%, rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.98) 100%) !important;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.60) !important;
  border-top-color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow: 
    0 12px 30px -4px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.60),
    inset 0 1px 2px 0 #ffffff !important;
}

/* --- CLASE E: BOTONES PLANOS / SIN CONTENEDOR (HIG BORDERLESS / PLAIN) --- */
/* Pestañas de navegación, controles segmentados, cierres e iconos utilitarios */
button.btn-plain,
button.border-0,
button[class*="bg-transparent"],
nav button:not(.btn-aeroglass-primary):not(.btn-aeroglass-secondary),
.btn-plain {
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  border-color: transparent !important;
}

button.btn-plain:hover,
button.border-0:hover,
button[class*="bg-transparent"]:hover,
nav button:not(.btn-aeroglass-primary):not(.btn-aeroglass-secondary):hover,
.btn-plain:hover {
  transform: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* --- CLASE E: BOTONES TINTADOS TRASLÚCIDOS (CHIPS, FILTROS Y BADGES) --- */
button[class*="bg-sky-500/"],
button[class*="bg-purple-500/"],
button[class*="bg-amber-500/"],
button[class*="bg-emerald-500/"],
button[class*="bg-rose-500/"] {
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.50) !important;
  box-shadow: 
    0 4px 14px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40) !important;
}

html.dark button[class*="bg-sky-500/"],
html.dark button[class*="bg-purple-500/"],
html.dark button[class*="bg-amber-500/"],
html.dark button[class*="bg-emerald-500/"],
html.dark button[class*="bg-rose-500/"] {
  border-top-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30) !important;
  box-shadow: 
    0 4px 16px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.40),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20) !important;
}

/* --- CLASE F: BOTONES CIRCULARES Y SQUIRCLES DE ICONO --- */
button.rounded-full,
button.rounded-xl,
button.rounded-2xl {
  box-shadow: 
    0 4px 14px -2px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.10),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
}

html.dark button.rounded-full,
html.dark button.rounded-xl,
html.dark button.rounded-2xl {
  box-shadow: 
    0 4px 16px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50),
    inset 0 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
}

/* --- REGLA DE CONTRASTE VECTORIAL: ICONOS DENTRO DE BOTONES --- */
/* Garantiza que todos los iconos SVG dentro de botones hereden exactamente el mismo color del texto del botón */
button svg:not(.icon-keep-color),
button [role="img"]:not(.icon-keep-color),
button [role="img"]:not(.icon-keep-color) svg,
a[class*="px-"][class*="py-"] svg:not(.icon-keep-color),
a[class*="px-"][class*="h-"] svg:not(.icon-keep-color),
a[class*="rounded-"][class*="bg-"] svg:not(.icon-keep-color),
[role="button"] svg:not(.icon-keep-color) {
  color: currentColor !important;
}

/* 5. Tipografía Corporativa Oficial de Alto Contraste (Sin Degradados Artificiales en Texto) */
.brand-corporate-gradient {
  background: #001E4D;
}

.brand-corporate-gradient-text {
  color: #001E4D;
}

html.dark .brand-corporate-gradient-text {
  color: #FFFFFF;
}

.brand-accent-text {
  color: #00DD9E;
}

/* Degradados Sutiles de Marca Neblina 105.5 FM */
.ios-gradient-teal-subtle {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.15) 0%, rgba(185, 235, 255, 0.08) 100%);
}
.ios-gradient-gold-subtle {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.18) 0%, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.08) 100%);
}
.ios-gradient-cerulean-subtle {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.15) 0%, rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.08) 100%);
}

/* 6. Incrustaciones de Redes Sociales (Instagram, X/Twitter, Threads, YouTube, Facebook, TikTok) */
.news-article-content .wp-block-embed {
  margin: 1.5rem 0 !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

.news-article-content .wp-block-embed__wrapper {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Redimensionamiento adaptable y bordes iOS para Instagram */
.news-article-content blockquote.instagram-media,
.news-article-content iframe.instagram-media,
.news-article-content iframe.instagram-media-rendered {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 540px !important;
  min-width: unset !important;
  margin: 1rem auto !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

/* Modo oscuro: suavizar el fondo del blockquote mientras carga el iframe */
html.dark .news-article-content blockquote.instagram-media {
  background: #001E4D !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.25) !important;
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
}

html.dark .news-article-content blockquote.instagram-media a {
  color: #00DD9E !important;
}

/* Twitter / X Tweet Embed */
.news-article-content blockquote.twitter-tweet,
.news-article-content .twitter-tweet-rendered {
  margin: 1.5rem auto !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  max-width: 550px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Enlaces e Hipervínculos dentro de Notas de Prensa */
.news-article-content a {
  color: #001E4D;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
  word-break: break-word;
}

html.dark .news-article-content a {
  color: #00DD9E;
}

.news-article-content a:hover {
  opacity: 0.85;
  color: #00DD9E;
  text-decoration-thickness: 2px;
}

/* 7. Animación Sutil y Serena para Patrocinantes y Aliados (HIG Motion Restraint) */
@keyframes marqueeScroll {
  0% {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }
}

.anim-marquee {
  display: flex;
  width: max-content;
  animation: marqueeScroll 110s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

/* Teleprompters secundarios para widgets de TV (BCV y Clima) */
.anim-marquee-tv-bcv {
  display: flex;
  width: max-content;
  animation: marqueeScroll 22s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.anim-marquee-tv-weather {
  display: flex;
  width: max-content;
  animation: marqueeScroll 25s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.anim-marquee:hover,
.anim-marquee:focus-within,
.anim-marquee:active,
.anim-marquee-tv-bcv:hover,
.anim-marquee-tv-weather:hover {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .anim-marquee {
    animation: none;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
}

/* Gradientes difuminados Apple a los bordes del carrusel de logos */
.marquee-mask {
  mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, black 6%, black 94%, transparent 100%);
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, black 6%, black 94%, transparent 100%);
}

/* 8. Animación Teleprompter de Titulares (Resorte Sutil y Estable) */
@keyframes teleprompterSlideIn {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(3px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

.animate-teleprompter {
  animation: teleprompterSlideIn 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

/* 8.1. Ondas Concéntricas Expansivas de la Carátula Smart TV (Hardware-Accelerated) */
@keyframes tvCoverPulseWave {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.96) translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    opacity: 0.85;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.55), inset 0 0 15px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.3);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.50;
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1.48) translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    opacity: 0;
    box-shadow: 0 0 35px 25px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0), inset 0 0 25px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0);
  }
}

@keyframes tvCoverGlowBreathing {
  0%, 100% {
    box-shadow: 
      0 0 30px 4px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.45),
      0 12px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70),
      inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
    border-color: rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.75);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow: 
      0 0 50px 10px rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.75),
      0 16px 50px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85),
      inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
    border-color: #00DD9E;
  }
}

.anim-tv-pulse-wave-1 {
  animation: tvCoverPulseWave 3.2s cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 1) infinite;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.anim-tv-pulse-wave-2 {
  animation: tvCoverPulseWave 3.2s cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 1) infinite 1.05s;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.anim-tv-pulse-wave-3 {
  animation: tvCoverPulseWave 3.2s cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 1) infinite 2.1s;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.anim-tv-glow-breathe {
  animation: tvCoverGlowBreathing 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  will-change: box-shadow, border-color;
}

/* 9. Animación Cajón Móvil Full-Screen (Aparición Fluida y Amortiguada) */
@keyframes mobileDrawerIn {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.985) translateY(-4px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  }
}

.anim-drawer-in {
  animation: mobileDrawerIn 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

/* ========================================================================= */
/* 10. FONDO ANIMADO OFICIAL (AROS CONIC-GRADIENT VIAJEROS & AEROGLASS)      */
/* ========================================================================= */

/* Capa profunda: Contenedor del fondo animado aislado en GPU */
.background-animado {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  contain: strict;
  isolation: isolate;
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

/* Envoltorios de movimiento: Controlan la trayectoria y el tamaño con aceleración GPU */
.mover {
  position: absolute;
  width: 380px;
  height: 380px;
  filter: blur(32px);
  opacity: 0.65;
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ARO 1 */
.mover-1 {
  top: -10%;
  left: -10%;
  animation: viajeEsquinas1 26s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite alternate;
}

/* ARO 2 */
.mover-2 {
  bottom: -10%;
  right: -10%;
  animation: viajeEsquinas2 32s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite alternate;
}

/* ARO 3 (Temporal/Fantasma) */
.mover-3 {
  top: 30%;
  left: 40%;
  animation: 
    viajeEsquinas3 22s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite alternate,
    aparecerFantasma 16s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* Elemento visual: Luz ambiental orgánica estilo Apple (Nebulosa Suave) */
.aro {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.55) 0%, rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.40) 50%, transparent 75%);
  filter: blur(36px);
  animation: giroColor 36s linear infinite;
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

/* Pausa inteligente de aros durante desplazamiento para 120 FPS fluidos */
body.is-scrolling .mover-1,
body.is-scrolling .mover-2,
body.is-scrolling .mover-3,
body.is-scrolling .aro {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* Capa frontal: El panel Aeroglass / Glassmorfismo ADAPTATIVO */
.panel-aeroglass {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 800px; /* Ensanchado para computadoras */
  height: auto;     /* Adaptativo: crece con el contenido */
  min-height: 250px;
  padding: 40px;    /* Espacio interno para que el contenido no pegue a los bordes */
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 10vh auto; /* Centrado en pantalla con margen superior e inferior */
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); /* Blanco casi transparente */
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); /* Reflejo sutil del borde */
  border-radius: 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.15);
  max-height: 80vh;  /* Evita que desborde la pantalla si hay texto excesivo */
  overflow-y: auto;  /* Habilita scroll interno si es necesario */
}

html.dark .panel-aeroglass {
  background: rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.45);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

/* --- DEFINICIÓN DE ANIMACIONES COMPUESTAS POR GPU --- */

/* Rotación infinita del degradado a velocidad serena Apple */
@keyframes giroColor {
  0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* Opacidad del tercer aro para que aparezca y desaparezca */
@keyframes aparecerFantasma {
  0%, 20% { opacity: 0; }
  45%, 65% { opacity: 0.65; }
  85%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
}

/* Trayectorias con hardware 3D compositing */
@keyframes viajeEsquinas1 {
  0% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  33% { transform: translate3d(55vw, 25vh, 0) scale(0.65); }
  66% { transform: translate3d(18vw, 65vh, 0) scale(1.15); }
  100% { transform: translate3d(75vw, 85vh, 0) scale(0.8); }
}

@keyframes viajeEsquinas2 {
  0% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1.1); }
  33% { transform: translate3d(-45vw, -35vh, 0) scale(0.6); }
  66% { transform: translate3d(-75vw, -18vh, 0) scale(1.2); }
  100% { transform: translate3d(-25vw, -75vh, 0) scale(0.5); }
}

@keyframes viajeEsquinas3 {
  0% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(0.6); }
  50% { transform: translate3d(35vw, -25vh, 0) scale(1.25); }
  100% { transform: translate3d(-25vw, 18vh, 0) scale(0.85); }
}

/* Ajustes de escala para pantallas móviles */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .mover {
    width: 260px;
    height: 260px;
    filter: blur(24px); 
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
  .panel-aeroglass {
    margin: 15vh auto;
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 25px;
  }
}

/* Respeto a Accesibilidad de Movimiento Reducido (Apple HIG › motion.md & accessibility.md) */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mover-1,
  .mover-2,
  .mover-3,
  .aro {
    animation: none !important;
  }
  .mover-1 {
    transform: translate3d(15vw, 15vh, 0) scale(0.8);
  }
  .mover-2 {
    transform: translate3d(-15vw, -15vh, 0) scale(0.9);
  }
  .mover-3 {
    opacity: 0.35 !important;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(0.7);
  }
  button:hover:not(:disabled):not(.no-hover-lift),
  [role="button"]:hover:not(:disabled):not(.no-hover-lift),
  .aeroglass-btn:hover:not(:disabled),
  .aeroglass-card:hover,
  .glass-card:hover {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}

/* ========================================================================= */
/* 10.5. ACCESIBILIDAD APPLE HIG: TRANSPARENCIA REDUCIDA, ALTO CONTRASTE,    */
/*       FOCUS RING VISIBLE Y ESCALA TIPOGRÁFICA MÍNIMA LEGIBLE (11px+)      */
/* ========================================================================= */

/* Elevación automática de micro-textos (< 11px) al mínimo legible de Apple HIG (11pt / 11px) */
.text-\[8px\],
.text-\[9px\],
.text-\[10px\] {
  font-size: 0.6875rem !important; /* 11px mínimo según typography.md › Best practices */
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
}

/* Números tabulares en contadores, divisas BCV, relojes y estadísticas (typography.md) */
.tabular-nums,
input[type="number"] {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* Indicador de Foco por Teclado Visible (accessibility.md › Keyboard navigation) */
button:focus-visible,
a:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible,
select:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible,
[role="button"]:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #00DD9E !important;
  outline-offset: 2px !important;
}

/* Respeto a Preferencia de Transparencia Reducida (liquid-glass.md & accessibility.md › Blur and transparency) */
@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
  html.dark .aeroglass-nav,
  html.dark .aeroglass-card,
  html.dark .glass-card,
  html.dark .aeroglass-panel,
  html.dark .glass-panel,
  html.dark .panel-aeroglass {
    background: #00183D !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) !important;
  }

  html.light .aeroglass-nav,
  html.light .aeroglass-card,
  html.light .glass-card,
  html.light .aeroglass-panel,
  html.light .glass-panel,
  html.light .panel-aeroglass {
    background: #FFFFFF !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    border-color: rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.22) !important;
  }
}

/* Respeto a Preferencia de Mayor Contraste (color.md & accessibility.md › Color and effects) */
@media (prefers-contrast: more) {
  html.dark .aeroglass-nav,
  html.dark .aeroglass-card,
  html.dark .glass-card,
  html.dark .aeroglass-panel,
  html.dark .glass-panel {
    border-color: rgba(0, 221, 158, 0.55) !important;
  }

  html.light .aeroglass-nav,
  html.light .aeroglass-card,
  html.light .glass-card,
  html.light .aeroglass-panel,
  html.light .glass-panel {
    border-color: rgba(0, 30, 77, 0.38) !important;
  }
}

/* ========================================================================= */
/* 11. SISTEMA DE OPTIMIZACIÓN DE RENDIMIENTO APPLE (60 / 120 FPS FLUID)     */
/* ========================================================================= */

/* Contención Inteligente de Renderizado para Secciones Fuera de Pantalla */
.cv-auto {
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: 1px 400px;
}

/* Aceleración por Hardware para Elementos Dinámicos */
.gpu-layer {
  transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  perspective: 1000px;
}

/* ============================================================== */
/* ESTILOS DE IMPRESIÓN OFICIAL PARA INFORMES PUBLICITARIOS (PDF) */
/* ============================================================== */
@media print {
  /* Ocultar el resto de la web */
  body * {
    visibility: hidden;
  }

  /* Mostrar exclusivamente el contenedor del informe */
  #client-ad-report-printable,
  #client-ad-report-printable * {
    visibility: visible;
  }

  #client-ad-report-printable {
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 24px;
    background: #ffffff !important;
    color: #0f172a !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    z-index: 999999;
  }

  .no-print {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, Suspense, lazy } from 'react';
import Navbar from './components/Navbar';

// Carga Dinámica (Code-Splitting) para Máxima Velocidad en Móviles y Reducción del Bundle Inicial

const NewsSection = lazy(() => import('./components/NewsSection'));
const RankingSection = lazy(() => import('./components/RankingSection'));

export default function App() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('live');
  const [historyModalOpen, setHistoryModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [adminOpen, setAdminOpen] = useState(false);
  const [clientPortalOpen, setClientPortalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [staffPortalOpen, setStaffPortalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [journalistPortalOpen, setJournalistPortalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [smartTvOpen, setSmartTvOpen] = useState(false);

  // Escuchar apertura del Portal de Clientes o ruta #clientes / #portal / #aliados
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpenClientPortal = () => {
      window.location.hash = '#clientes';
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_open_client_portal', handleOpenClientPortal);

    const checkPortalRoute = () => {
      const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
      const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const isClientRoute = (
        hash === '#clientes' ||
        hash === '#portal' ||
        hash === '#cliente' ||
        hash === '#aliados' ||
        path === '/clientes' ||
        path === '/aliados' ||
        params.get('portal') === 'clientes'
      );
      setClientPortalOpen(isClientRoute);
    };
    checkPortalRoute();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', checkPortalRoute);
    window.addEventListener('popstate', checkPortalRoute);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_open_client_portal', handleOpenClientPortal);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', checkPortalRoute);
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', checkPortalRoute);
    };
  }, []);

  // Escuchar apertura del Portal de Locutores & Ventas o ruta #locutores / #staff
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpenStaffPortal = () => {
      window.location.hash = '#locutores';
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_open_staff_portal', handleOpenStaffPortal);

    const checkStaffRoute = () => {
      const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
      const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const isStaffRoute = (
        hash === '#locutores' ||
        hash === '#staff' ||
        hash === '#comercial' ||
        hash === '#locutor' ||
        path === '/locutores' ||
        params.get('portal') === 'locutores'
      );
      setStaffPortalOpen(isStaffRoute);
    };
    checkStaffRoute();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', checkStaffRoute);
    window.addEventListener('popstate', checkStaffRoute);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_open_staff_portal', handleOpenStaffPortal);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', checkStaffRoute);
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', checkStaffRoute);
    };
  }, []);

  // Escuchar apertura del Portal de Periodistas o ruta #periodistas / #redaccion / #prensa / /periodistas
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpenJournalistPortal = () => {
      window.location.hash = '#periodistas';
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_open_journalist_portal', handleOpenJournalistPortal);

    const checkJournalistRoute = () => {
      const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
      const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const isJournalistRoute = (
        hash === '#periodistas' ||
        hash === '#redaccion' ||
        hash === '#prensa-portal' ||
        hash === '#periodista' ||
        path === '/periodistas' ||
        path === '/redaccion' ||
        params.get('portal') === 'periodistas' ||
        params.get('app') === 'periodistas'
      );
      setJournalistPortalOpen(isJournalistRoute);
    };
    checkJournalistRoute();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', checkJournalistRoute);
    window.addEventListener('popstate', checkJournalistRoute);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_open_journalist_portal', handleOpenJournalistPortal);
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', checkJournalistRoute);
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', checkJournalistRoute);
    };
  }, []);

  // Escuchar ruta para la App de Smart TV (#tv, /tv, ?tv=true)
  useEffect(() => {
    const checkTvRoute = () => {
      const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
      const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const isTvRoute = (
        hash === '#tv' ||
        hash === '#smart-tv' ||
        hash === '#smarttv' ||
        hash === '#television' ||
        path === '/tv' ||
        path === '/smart-tv' ||
        params.get('tv') === 'true' ||
        params.get('app') === 'smart-tv'
      );
      setSmartTvOpen(isTvRoute);
    };
    checkTvRoute();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', checkTvRoute);
    window.addEventListener('popstate', checkTvRoute);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', checkTvRoute);
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', checkTvRoute);
    };
  }, []);

  // Detección de link privado para el Sistema Interno (#admin, #panel, /admin, ?admin=true)
  useEffect(() => {
    const checkAdminRoute = () => {
      const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
      const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
      const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const isAdminRoute = (
        hash === '#admin' || 
        hash === '#panel' || 
        hash === '#sistema' || 
        path === '/admin' ||
        path === '/panel' ||
        params.get('admin') === 'true' || 
        params.get('admin') === '1'
      );
      if (isAdminRoute) {
        setAdminOpen(true);
      } else {
        setAdminOpen(false);
      }
    };

    checkAdminRoute();
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', checkAdminRoute);
    window.addEventListener('popstate', checkAdminRoute);

    // Atajo discreto de teclado para administradores (Ctrl + Shift + A o Alt + A)
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'A' || e.key === 'a')) ||
          (e.altKey && (e.key === 'A' || e.key === 'a'))) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setAdminOpen(prev => !prev);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', checkAdminRoute);
      window.removeEventListener('popstate', checkAdminRoute);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, []);

  // Intercambiar dinámicamente el Web App Manifest y Título para las apps independientes
  useEffect(() => {
    let manifestUrl = '/manifest.json';
    let appTitle = 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM - Contigo en la Cima';

    if (smartTvOpen) {
      manifestUrl = '/manifest-tv.json';
      appTitle = 'Neblina 105.5 · Smart TV';
    } else if (adminOpen) {
      manifestUrl = '/manifest-admin.json';
      appTitle = 'Neblina 105.5 · Sistema Interno';
    } else if (clientPortalOpen) {
      manifestUrl = '/manifest-clientes.json';
      appTitle = 'Neblina 105.5 · Portal Aliados Comerciales';
    } else if (staffPortalOpen) {
      manifestUrl = '/manifest-locutores.json';
      appTitle = 'Neblina 105.5 · Portal Locutores & Ventas';
    } else if (journalistPortalOpen) {
      manifestUrl = '/manifest-periodistas.json';
      appTitle = 'Neblina 105.5 · Portal Periodistas & Redacción';
    }

    document.title = appTitle;

    let link = document.querySelector('link[rel="manifest"]');
    if (!link) {
      link = document.createElement('link');
      link.rel = 'manifest';
      document.head.appendChild(link);
    }
    link.href = manifestUrl;
  }, [smartTvOpen, adminOpen, clientPortalOpen, staffPortalOpen, journalistPortalOpen]);

  // Optimización de Fluidez Apple: Pausar animaciones pesadas durante scroll para 120 FPS continuos
  useEffect(() => {
    let scrollTimeout;
    const handleScroll = () => {
      if (!document.body.classList.contains('is-scrolling')) {
        document.body.classList.add('is-scrolling');
      }
      clearTimeout(scrollTimeout);
      scrollTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.classList.remove('is-scrolling');
      }, 150);
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
      clearTimeout(scrollTimeout);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleCloseAdmin = () => {
    setAdminOpen(false);
    const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
    const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
    if (hash === '#admin' || hash === '#panel' || hash === '#sistema' || path === '/admin' || path === '/panel') {
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
    }
  };

  const handleCloseClientPortal = () => {
    setClientPortalOpen(false);
    const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
    const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
    if (hash === '#clientes' || hash === '#portal' || hash === '#cliente' || hash === '#aliados' || path === '/clientes' || path === '/aliados') {
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
    }
  };

  const handleCloseStaffPortal = () => {
    setStaffPortalOpen(false);
    const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
    const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
    if (hash === '#locutores' || hash === '#staff' || hash === '#comercial' || hash === '#locutor' || path === '/locutores') {
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
    }
  };

  const handleCloseJournalistPortal = () => {
    setJournalistPortalOpen(false);
    const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
    const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
    if (hash === '#periodistas' || hash === '#redaccion' || hash === '#prensa-portal' || hash === '#periodista' || path === '/periodistas' || path === '/redaccion') {
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
    }
  };

  const handleCloseSmartTv = () => {
    setSmartTvOpen(false);
    const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
    const path = (window.location.pathname || '').toLowerCase();
    if (hash === '#tv' || hash === '#smart-tv' || hash === '#smarttv' || path === '/tv') {
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/');
    }
  };

  // VISTA DEDICADA E INDEPENDIENTE: App Smart TV (10-foot UI para Televisores)
  if (smartTvOpen) {
    return (
      <ThemeProvider>
        <Suspense fallback={<TabLoadingFallback />}>
          <SmartTvPage onExit={handleCloseSmartTv} />
        </Suspense>
      </ThemeProvider>
    );
  }

  // VISTA DEDICADA E INDEPENDIENTE: Si estamos en el Sistema Administrativo,
  // se presenta como página completa autónoma (sin reproductor ni web pública debajo)
  if (adminOpen) {
    return (
      <ThemeProvider>
        <div className="min-h-screen relative flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-[#00DD9E] selection:text-[#001E4D] overflow-x-hidden transition-colors duration-300">
          {/* Fondo Animado Oficial (Aros Conic-Gradient) en el Sistema Interno */}
          <AnimatedBackground />

          <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col flex-1">
            <Suspense fallback={<TabLoadingFallback />}>
              <AdminPage 
                onClose={handleCloseAdmin}
                onBackToWeb={handleCloseAdmin} 
              />
            </Suspense>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ThemeProvider>
    );
  }

  // VISTA DEDICADA E INDEPENDIENTE: Portal para Aliados Comerciales (Clientes)
  // Se presenta en página independiente sin superposición sobre la web pública
  if (clientPortalOpen) {
    return (
      <ThemeProvider>
        <div className="min-h-screen relative flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-[#00DD9E] selection:text-[#001E4D] overflow-x-hidden transition-colors duration-300">
          <AnimatedBackground />
          <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col flex-1">
            <Suspense fallback={<TabLoadingFallback />}>
              <ClientPortalModal 
                isOpen={true} 
                isStandalonePage={true}
                onClose={handleCloseClientPortal} 
              />
            </Suspense>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ThemeProvider>
    );
  }

  // VISTA DEDICADA E INDEPENDIENTE: Portal para Locutores & Equipo Comercial
  // Se presenta en página independiente sin superposición sobre la web pública
  if (staffPortalOpen) {
    return (
      <ThemeProvider>
        <div className="min-h-screen relative flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-[#00DD9E] selection:text-[#001E4D] overflow-x-hidden transition-colors duration-300">
          <AnimatedBackground />
          <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col flex-1">
            <Suspense fallback={<TabLoadingFallback />}>
              <StaffPortalModal 
                isOpen={true} 
                isStandalonePage={true}
                onClose={handleCloseStaffPortal} 
              />
            </Suspense>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ThemeProvider>
    );
  }

  // VISTA DEDICADA E INDEPENDIENTE: Portal para Periodistas & Redacción
  // Se presenta en página independiente sin superposición sobre la web pública
  if (journalistPortalOpen) {
    return (
      <ThemeProvider>
        <div className="min-h-screen relative flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-[#00DD9E] selection:text-[#001E4D] overflow-x-hidden transition-colors duration-300">
          <AnimatedBackground />
          <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col flex-1">
            <Suspense fallback={<TabLoadingFallback />}>
              <JournalistPortalModal 
                isOpen={true} 
                isStandalonePage={true}
                onClose={handleCloseJournalistPortal} 
              />
            </Suspense>
          </div>
        </div>
      </ThemeProvider>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <div className="min-h-screen relative flex flex-col font-sans selection:bg-[#00DD9E] selection:text-[#001E4D] pb-28 overflow-x-hidden transition-colors duration-300">
        
        {/* Fondo Hipnotizante Sutil con Transición de Tema Apple */}
        <AnimatedBackground />

        {/* Capa de Contenido Principal */}
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col flex-1">
          
          {/* Menú Superior con Logo Oficial Vectorial y Selector de Tema */}
          <Navbar activeTab={activeTab} setActiveTab={setActiveTab} />

          {/* Contenido Central */}
          <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl mx-auto px-3 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 w-full">
            
            {/* Pestaña INICIO (Estructura Limpia y Ágil según Requerimientos) */}
            {activeTab === 'live' && (
              <div className="anim-tab-enter space-y-3 sm:space-y-3.5 lg:space-y-3.5 pt-5 sm:pt-6 lg:pt-7">
                {/* 1. Espacio Publicitario Horizontal */}
                <AdCarousel variant="header" />

                {/* 2. Banner Climático Mínimo por Ubicación */}
                <WeatherBanner />

                {/* 3. Carrusel con las 6 Últimas Noticias Destacadas */}
                <NewsCarousel />

                {/* 4. Carrusel Continuo de Patrocinantes y Aliados Comerciales */}
                <SponsorsCarousel setActiveTab={setActiveTab} />

                {/* 4.5. Banner Oficial de Tasas BCV (Dólar, Euro y Calculadora Rápida) antes de las Últimas Noticias */}
                <HomeBcvBanner />

                {/* 5. Últimas 9 Noticias de la Emisora (neblina105fm.com) */}
                <NewsSection 
                  isHome={true} 
                  limit={9} 
                  onSeeAllNews={() => {
                    setActiveTab('news');
                    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                  }}
                />

                {/* 6. Banner de Denuncia Ciudadana (Ubicado estratégicamente debajo de Noticias) */}
                <div className="cv-auto">
                  <CitizenReportBanner />
                </div>

                {/* 7. Canal y Grupos Oficiales de WhatsApp */}
                <div className="cv-auto">
                  <WhatsAppCommunitySection />
                </div>

                {/* 8. Acceso Rápido al Ranking & Lo Más Sonado (Con Carátula HD, Título y Artista) */}
                <div className="cv-auto">
                  <HomeRankingBanner 
                    onOpenRanking={() => { 
                      setActiveTab('ranking'); 
                      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); 
                    }} 
                  />
                </div>

                {/* 9. Shorts de YouTube de @neblina105fm */}
                <div className="cv-auto">
                  <YouTubeShortsSection />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Pestañas Secundarias con Carga Bajo Demanda (Suspense) */}
            <Suspense fallback={<TabLoadingFallback />}>
              {/* Pestaña NOTICIAS (Independiente) */}
              {activeTab === 'news' && (
                <div className="anim-tab-enter pt-4 cv-auto">
                  <NewsSection />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pestaña RANKING (Independiente) */}
              {activeTab === 'ranking' && (
                <div className="anim-tab-enter pt-4 cv-auto">
                  <RankingSection />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pestaña EVENTOS Y CARTELERA (Inspirada en Caturem) */}
              {activeTab === 'events' && (
                <div className="anim-tab-enter pt-4 cv-auto">
                  <EventsSection />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pestaña ALIADOS COMERCIALES (Directorio Inspirado en Caturem) */}
              {activeTab === 'sponsors' && (
                <div className="anim-tab-enter pt-4 cv-auto">
                  <SponsorsDirectorySection />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pestaña PROGRAMACIÓN (Independiente) */}
              {activeTab === 'schedule' && (
                <div className="anim-tab-enter pt-4 cv-auto">
                  <ScheduleSection />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pestaña NUESTROS TALENTOS (Locutores & Staff) */}
              {activeTab === 'talents' && (
                <div className="anim-tab-enter pt-4 cv-auto">
                  <TalentsSection />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pestaña PODCASTS (Independiente) */}
              {activeTab === 'podcasts' && (
                <div className="anim-tab-enter pt-4 cv-auto">
                  <PodcastsSection />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Pestaña CONTACTO (Independiente con Comunidad WhatsApp) */}
              {activeTab === 'contact' && (
                <div className="anim-tab-enter pt-4 space-y-6 cv-auto">
                  <WhatsAppCommunitySection />
                  <ContactSection />
                </div>
              )}
            </Suspense>

          </main>

          {/* Modal Historial de Canciones ("Ya Sonó") con Carga Bajo Demanda */}
          {historyModalOpen && (
            <Suspense fallback={null}>
              <SongHistoryModal 
                isOpen={historyModalOpen} 
                onClose={() => setHistoryModalOpen(false)} 
              />
            </Suspense>
          )}

          {/* Banner Sutil de Privacidad con Aceptación Directa (3 Segundos) */}
          <PrivacyConsentModal />

          {/* Ventana Emergente Universal de Instalación (Android, iOS, Smart TV, PC) */}
          <UniversalInstallModal />

          {/* Reproductor Unificado estilo Apple / Mix Radio al ras del pie de página */}
          <MixStylePlayer onOpenHistory={() => setHistoryModalOpen(true)} />

          {/* Pie de página Limpio con Enlaces, Redes Sociales y Acceso Administrativo Seguro */}
          <Footer setActiveTab={setActiveTab} onOpenAdmin={() => setAdminOpen(true)} />

        </div>
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

```jsx
export default function Navbar({ activeTab, setActiveTab }) {
  const { isPlaying, playbackType } = useAudioPlayer();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [moreMenuOpen, setMoreMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [installed, setInstalled] = useState(false);
  const [device, setDevice] = useState({ isApple: false, isAndroid: false, isSmartTV: false });
  const moreMenuRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setInstalled(isAppInstalled());
    setDevice(detectDevice());
  }, []);

  // Cerrar menú "Más" al hacer clic fuera o pulsar Escape
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e) => {
      if (moreMenuRef.current && !moreMenuRef.current.contains(e.target)) {
        setMoreMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setMoreMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    if (moreMenuOpen) {
      document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.addEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);
      window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    }
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [moreMenuOpen]);

  // Bloqueo de scroll en el body cuando el menú móvil está desplegado
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mobileMenuOpen) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [mobileMenuOpen]);

  // Navegación Primaria (Destinos Principales de Acceso Inmediato)
  const primaryNavItems = [
    { id: 'live', label: 'Inicio', icon: Radio },
    { id: 'news', label: 'Noticias', icon: Newspaper },
    { id: 'ranking', label: 'Ranking', fullLabel: 'Ranking de Neblina', icon: Trophy },
    { id: 'schedule', label: 'Programación', icon: Clock },
    { id: 'talents', label: 'Talentos', icon: Mic }
  ];

  // Navegación Secundaria (Agrupada bajo Menú "Más" en Desktop)
  const secondaryNavItems = [
    { id: 'events', label: 'Eventos', icon: Calendar },
    { id: 'sponsors', label: 'Aliados', icon: Store },
    { id: 'podcasts', label: 'Podcasts', icon: Headphones },
    { id: 'contact', label: 'Contacto', icon: Phone }
  ];

  const allNavItems = [...primaryNavItems, ...secondaryNavItems];
  const isSecondaryActive = secondaryNavItems.some(item => item.id === activeTab);

  const handleOpenInstall = () => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_open_install_modal'));
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Cabecera Superpuesta Aeroglass Estilo Apple macOS / iOS (Sin caja contenedora flotante) */}
      <header className="sticky lg:fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 w-full aeroglass-nav border-x-0 border-t-0 border-b border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/10 transition-colors duration-300">
        <div className="max-w-[1440px] mx-auto px-3.5 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 h-14 sm:h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
            
            {/* ========================================================================= */}
            {/* 1. VISTA MÓVIL Y TABLET (SIMÉTRICA 3 ELEMENTOS: MENÚ · LOGO · TEMA) */}
            {/* ========================================================================= */}
            <div className="flex lg:hidden items-center justify-between h-full w-full">
              
              {/* Columna Izquierda: Botón Circular de Menú */}
              <button
                onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(true)}
                className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full border border-white/40 dark:border-white/15 bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex-shrink-0"
                aria-label="Abrir Menú"
              >
                <Menu className="w-5 h-5 stroke-[2.2]" />
              </button>

              {/* Columna Central: Logotipo Oficial Neblina 105.5 FM Centrado */}
              <div 
                className="relative flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer py-1 select-none mx-auto active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150" 
                onClick={() => { setActiveTab('live'); window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); }}
                title="Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM"
              >
                <img 
                  src="/logo-tight.svg" 
                  alt="Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM" 
                  width="130"

                />
              </div>

              {/* Columna Derecha: Botón Circular de Modo Oscuro / Claro */}
              <button
                onClick={toggleTheme}
                className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full border border-white/40 dark:border-white/15 bg-black/5 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer flex-shrink-0"
                title={theme === 'dark' ? 'Cambiar a modo claro' : 'Cambiar a modo oscuro'}
                aria-label="Cambiar tema"
              >
                {theme === 'dark' ? (

            </div>

            {/* ========================================================================= */}
            {/* 2. VISTA ESCRITORIO SUPERPUESTA SIN CAJA INTERNA */}
            {/* ========================================================================= */}
            <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center justify-between h-full w-full gap-3">
              
              {/* Logo Oficial Neblina 105.5 FM */}
              <div 
                className="relative flex items-center cursor-pointer py-1 select-none flex-shrink-0 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150" 
                onClick={() => { setActiveTab('live'); window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); }}
                title="Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM - Inicio"
              >
                <img 
                  src="/logo-tight.svg" 
                  alt="Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM" 
                  width="170"
                  height="46"

                />
              </div>

              {/* Menú de Navegación Desktop sin caja contenedora */}
              <nav className="flex items-center gap-1 justify-center min-w-0">
                {allNavItems.map((item) => {
                  const isActive = activeTab === item.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={item.id}
                      onClick={() => setActiveTab(item.id)}
                      aria-current={isActive ? 'page' : undefined}
                      className={`px-3 xl:px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs xl:text-[13px] font-semibold transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap active:scale-95 ${
                        isActive
                          ? 'bg-[#001E4D]/85 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/20 text-white dark:text-[#00DD9E] backdrop-blur-md border border-[#001E4D]/30 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/40 font-bold shadow-xs'
                          : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-white/85 hover:text-[#001E4D] dark:hover:text-[#00DD9E] hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {item.label}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </nav>

              {/* Lado Derecho Desktop: Tema · Cabina · Portal para Aliados · Instalar App (Translúcidos Aero Glass) */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-shrink-0">

                {/* Botón de elección del tema (translúcido Aero Glass) */}
                <button
                  onClick={toggleTheme}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center bg-[#001E4D]/12 hover:bg-[#001E4D]/22 dark:bg-white/12 dark:hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md text-[#001E4D] dark:text-white w-9 h-8 rounded-lg border border-[#001E4D]/20 dark:border-white/20 active:scale-95 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                  title={theme === 'dark' ? 'Cambiar a modo claro' : 'Cambiar a modo oscuro'}
                  aria-label={theme === 'dark' ? 'Cambiar a modo claro' : 'Cambiar a modo oscuro'}
                >
                  {theme === 'dark' ? <Sun className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Moon className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
                
                {/* Botón WhatsApp Cabina Translúcido con icono de WhatsApp */}
                <a
                  href={STATION_INFO.whatsappUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500/30 backdrop-blur-md active:scale-95 text-emerald-900 dark:text-[#00DD9E] px-3 h-8 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border border-emerald-500/35 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/35 transition-all shadow-xs whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer"
                  title="Escribir a Cabina de Transmisión por WhatsApp"
                >
                  <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" alt="WhatsApp Cabina" />
                  <span>Cabina</span>
                </a>

                {/* Botón Portal para Aliados (Translúcido Aero Glass) */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => { window.location.hash = '#clientes'; }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#001E4D]/12 hover:bg-[#001E4D]/22 dark:bg-white/12 dark:hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md active:scale-95 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-white px-3 h-8 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border border-[#001E4D]/20 dark:border-white/20 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
                  title="Acceso al Portal para Aliados"
                >
                  <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span>Portal para Aliados</span>
                </button>

                {/* Botón Universal de Instalar App con icono según sistema operativo (Windows, Apple/Mac/iOS, Android) */}
                <button
                  onClick={handleOpenInstall}
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#001E4D]/12 hover:bg-[#001E4D]/22 dark:bg-white/12 dark:hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md active:scale-95 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-white px-3 h-8 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border border-[#001E4D]/20 dark:border-white/20 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap"
                  title="Instalar App Oficial en tu Dispositivo"
                >
                  {device.isAndroid ? (
                    <GooglePlayStoreIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                  ) : device.isApple ? (
                    <AppleLogoIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                  ) : (
                    <WindowsIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                  )}
                  <span>Instalar App</span>
                </button>

              </div>

            </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      {/* Espaciador en escritorio para compensar el header fijo superpuesto */}
      <div className="hidden lg:block h-16" aria-hidden="true" />

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 3. CAJÓN DE MENÚ MÓVIL DESPLEGABLE (PANTALLA COMPLETA) */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {mobileMenuOpen && (
        <div 
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] lg:hidden flex flex-col bg-white/98 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/98 backdrop-blur-2xl anim-drawer-in overflow-y-auto h-[100dvh] w-full"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-label="Menú principal de navegación"
        >
          {/* Cabecera del Cajón Móvil */}
          <div className="sticky top-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/20 bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#001438]/95 backdrop-blur-md">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#00DD9E] shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,221,158,0.6)]" />
              <span className="font-display font-black text-sm tracking-wide text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Neblina 105.5 FM
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Botón Circular de Cerrar */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
              className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full border border-slate-300 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/30 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
              aria-label="Cerrar Menú"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5 stroke-[2.2]" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Lista Vertical de Navegación */}
          <div className="flex-1 p-6 space-y-2 pb-24">
            {allNavItems.map((item) => {
              const isActive = activeTab === item.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={item.id}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setActiveTab(item.id);
                    setMobileMenuOpen(false);
                    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
                  }}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-between ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D] font-black shadow-sm'
                      : 'text-slate-800 dark:text-white/90 hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                    {item.icon && <item.icon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 flex-shrink-0 opacity-80" />}
                    <span>{item.fullLabel || item.label}</span>
                  </div>
                  {isActive && (
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#00DD9E] dark:bg-[#001E4D]" />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}

            {/* Botones de Acción en el Menú Móvil */}
            <div className="pt-4 space-y-2.5 border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/20">
              {/* WhatsApp Cabina */}
              <a
                href={STATION_INFO.whatsappUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(false)}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm"
              >
                <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-4.5 h-4.5 flex-shrink-0" alt="WhatsApp" />
                <span>Escribir a Cabina (+58 424 745 9774)</span>
              </a>

              {/* Botón Universal Instalar */}
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setMobileMenuOpen(false);
                  handleOpenInstall();
                }}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 bg-[#00DD9E]/85 backdrop-blur-md text-[#001E4D] py-3.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-black shadow-md cursor-pointer hover:brightness-105 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all border border-[#00DD9E]/50"
              >
                {device.isAndroid ? (
                  <GooglePlayStoreIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 flex-shrink-0" />
                ) : device.isApple ? (
                  <AppleLogoIcon className="w-4.5 h-4.5 flex-shrink-0 text-[#001E4D]" />
                ) : (
                  <WindowsIcon className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 text-[#001E4D]" />
                )}
                <span>
                  {device.isAndroid ? 'Instalar App (Google Play Store)' : device.isApple ? 'Instalar App (Apple)' : 'Instalar App en este Dispositivo'}
                </span>
              </button>

              {/* Botón Móvil Portal para Aliados */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setMobileMenuOpen(false);
                  window.location.hash = '#clientes';
                }}
                className="w-full flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-800 dark:text-white py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10"
              >
                <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Portal para Aliados</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Estado de Transmisión al pie */}
            <div className="pt-6 text-center text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#00DD9E] shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,221,158,0.6)]" />
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">Transmitiendo en Vivo HD · 105.5 MHz FM</span>
              </div>
              <p>Santo Domingo - Mérida, Venezuela</p>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```
