## src/components/admin/AdminContactsTab.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Users, 
  Search, 
  Phone, 
  MessageCircle, 
  MapPin, 
  Calendar, 
  Plus, 
  Download, 
  Upload, 
  Trash2, 
  RotateCcw, 
  Edit3, 
  Check, 
  Clock, 
  FileSpreadsheet, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  Sparkles,
  X,
  Send,
  History
} from 'lucide-react';
import SectionTrashToggle from './SectionTrashToggle';
import {
  getAllUnifiedContacts,
  getActiveUnifiedContacts,
  getTrashedUnifiedContacts,
  addUnifiedContact,
  trashContact,
  restoreContact,
  deleteContactPermanently,
  emptyContactsTrash,
  updateContactNotes,
  exportContactsCSV,
  exportContactsJSON
} from '../../services/unifiedContactsService';

export default function AdminContactsTab({ triggerToast = () => {} }) {
  const [contacts, setContacts] = useState([]);
  const [isTrashView, setIsTrashView] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [originFilter, setOriginFilter] = useState('Todas');
  
  // Modal de Crear / Editar contacto manual
  const [isFormOpen, setIsFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingContact, setEditingContact] = useState(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    phone: '',
    cedula: '',
    location: '',
    origin: 'Registro Administrativo',
    details: '',
    notes: ''
  });

  // Modal de Historial de Interacciones de un contacto
  const [viewingHistoryContact, setViewingHistoryContact] = useState(null);

  // Carga reactiva de contactos
  const reloadContacts = () => {
    setContacts(getAllUnifiedContacts());
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    reloadContacts();
    const handleUpdate = () => reloadContacts();
    window.addEventListener('neblina_contacts_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('neblina_contacts_updated', handleUpdate);
  }, []);

  // Conteos
  const activeContacts = contacts.filter(c => !c.trashed);
  const trashedContacts = contacts.filter(c => c.trashed);

  // Filtrado
  const displayedContacts = (isTrashView ? trashedContacts : activeContacts).filter(c => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    const matchOrigin = originFilter === 'Todas' || (c.origin || '').toLowerCase().includes(originFilter.toLowerCase());
    
    if (!q) return matchOrigin;

    const matchQuery = 
      (c.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.phone || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.cedula || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.location || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.details || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (c.notes || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);

    return matchOrigin && matchQuery;
  });

  // Acciones de Formulario
  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingContact(null);
    setFormData({
      name: '',
      phone: '',
      cedula: '',
      location: '',
      origin: 'Registro Administrativo',
      details: '',
      notes: ''
    });
    setIsFormOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (contact) => {
    setEditingContact(contact);
    setFormData({
      name: contact.name || '',
      phone: contact.phone || '',
      cedula: contact.cedula || '',
      location: contact.location || '',
      origin: contact.origin || 'Registro Administrativo',
      details: contact.details || '',
      notes: contact.notes || ''
    });
    setIsFormOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveContact = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.name.trim() && !formData.phone.trim()) {
      alert('Por favor introduce al menos el nombre o el teléfono del contacto.');
      return;
    }

    addUnifiedContact(formData);
    reloadContacts();
    setIsFormOpen(false);
    triggerToast(editingContact ? 'Contacto actualizado correctamente' : 'Nuevo contacto guardado en la base de datos');
  };

  // Acciones de Papelera
  const handleTrash = (id, name) => {
    trashContact(id);
    reloadContacts();
    triggerToast(`"${name}" movido a la papelera`);
  };

  const handleRestore = (id, name) => {
    restoreContact(id);
    reloadContacts();
    triggerToast(`"${name}" restaurado a la lista activa`);
  };

  const handlePermanentDelete = (id, name) => {
    if (window.confirm(`¿Eliminar definitivamente a "${name}" de la base de datos? Esta acción es irreversible.`)) {
      deleteContactPermanently(id);
      reloadContacts();
      triggerToast('Contacto eliminado definitivamente');
    }
  };

  const handleEmptyTrash = () => {
    if (window.confirm('¿Deseas vaciar la papelera de contactos? Se eliminarán definitivamente todos los registros.')) {
      emptyContactsTrash();
      reloadContacts();
      triggerToast('Papelera de contactos vaciada');
    }
  };

  // Exportaciones
  const handleExportCSV = () => {
    const csvData = exportContactsCSV();
    const blob = new Blob([csvData], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `Neblina_Base_Contactos_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    triggerToast('Base de datos exportada en formato Excel (CSV)');
  };

  const handleExportJSON = () => {
    const jsonData = exportContactsJSON();
    const blob = new Blob([jsonData], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `Neblina_Base_Contactos_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    triggerToast('Base de datos exportada en formato JSON');
  };

  // Métricas rápidas
  const totalComments = activeContacts.filter(c => (c.origin || '').includes('Comentario')).length;
  const totalReports = activeContacts.filter(c => (c.origin || '').includes('Denuncia')).length;
  const totalCabina = activeContacts.filter(c => (c.origin || '').includes('Cabina')).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-fadeIn">
      
      {/* TARJETAS DE MÉTRICAS GENERALES */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold mb-1">
            <span>Total Contactos</span>
            <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{activeContacts.length}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Audiencia registrada</p>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold mb-1">
            <span>Denuncias</span>
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">{totalReports}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Vecinos con reportes</p>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold mb-1">
            <span>Cabina WhatsApp</span>
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E]">{totalCabina}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Mensajes y peticiones</p>
        </div>

        <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold mb-1">
            <span>Lectores Prensa</span>
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-sky-500" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">{totalComments}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Comentarios de noticias</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* BARRA DE PAPELERA SECCIONAL */}
      <SectionTrashToggle 
        isTrashView={isTrashView}
        onToggleView={setIsTrashView}
        activeCount={activeContacts.length}
        trashCount={trashedContacts.length}
        onEmptyTrash={handleEmptyTrash}
        activeLabel="Contactos Activos"
        trashLabel="Papelera de Contactos"
      />

      {/* BARRA DE HERRAMIENTAS Y BÚSQUEDA */}
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-stretch lg:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#19222e] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
        
        {/* Buscador y Filtro por Canal de Origen */}
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[220px]">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Buscar por nombre, teléfono, cédula, sector o notas..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#0c131c] border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/15 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
            />
          </div>

          <select
            value={originFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setOriginFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="text-xs font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#0c131c] border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/15 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="Todas">Todos los Orígenes</option>
            <option value="Denuncia">Denuncias Ciudadanas</option>
            <option value="Cabina">Contacto a Cabina</option>
            <option value="Comentario">Comentarios de Noticias</option>
            <option value="Formulario">Formulario Web</option>
            <option value="Administrativo">Registro Administrativo</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Botones de Acción (Exportar y Agregar) */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleExportCSV}
            className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-white/5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 transition cursor-pointer"
            title="Exportar base completa a formato Excel (CSV con UTF-8 BOM)"
          >
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Excel (CSV)</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={handleExportJSON}
            className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-white/5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 transition cursor-pointer"
            title="Exportar respaldo completo en formato JSON"
          >
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-500" />
            <span>JSON</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={handleOpenCreate}
            className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#00DD9E] hover:bg-[#00c98f] text-[#001E4D] font-black text-xs transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Nuevo Contacto</span>
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* MODAL / FORMULARIO PARA REGISTRAR O EDITAR CONTACTO MANUAL */}
      {isFormOpen && (
        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#1c2633] border-2 border-emerald-500/40 shadow-xl space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 pb-3">
            <h4 className="font-display font-black text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00DD9E]" />
              <span>{editingContact ? 'Editar Datos del Contacto' : 'Registrar Nuevo Contacto u Oyente'}</span>
            </h4>
            <button 
              onClick={() => setIsFormOpen(false)}
              className="p-1 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleSaveContact} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Nombre y Apellido *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="Ej: Carlos Ramírez"
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Teléfono / WhatsApp *</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="Ej: +58 414 756 8890"
                  value={formData.phone}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, phone: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Cédula de Identidad</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Ej: V-18.452.910"
                  value={formData.cedula}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, cedula: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Ubicación / Sector / Municipio</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Ej: Sector El Arbolito, Santo Domingo - Mérida"
                  value={formData.location}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, location: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Canal de Entrada / Origen</label>
                <select
                  value={formData.origin}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, origin: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                >
                  <option value="Registro Administrativo">Registro Administrativo</option>
                  <option value="Denuncia Ciudadana">Denuncia Ciudadana</option>
                  <option value="Contacto a Cabina">Contacto a Cabina</option>
                  <option value="Comentario de Noticia">Comentario de Noticia</option>
                  <option value="Formulario Web">Formulario Web</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Detalle del Mensaje o Motivo de Contacto</label>
              <textarea
                rows="2"
                placeholder="Detalle o resumen de la última interacción..."
                value={formData.details}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, details: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Notas Internas Confidenciales (Solo visibles para la Dirección)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Ej: Líder comunitario de la zona alta, colaborador habitual..."
                value={formData.notes}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, notes: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end space-x-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsFormOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancelar
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-6 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#00DD9E] hover:bg-[#00c98f] text-[#001E4D] font-black text-xs transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              >
                Guardar Contacto
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* LISTA DE CONTACTOS EN TARJETAS RESPONSIVAS */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {displayedContacts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-10 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e] rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10">
            <Users className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-30 text-[#00DD9E]" />
            <p className="text-sm font-bold">No se encontraron contactos en esta sección.</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
              {isTrashView ? 'La papelera de contactos está limpia.' : 'Cualquier persona que comente, denuncie o escriba por la web aparecerá aquí automáticamente.'}
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          displayedContacts.map((c) => {
            const rawDigits = (c.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
            const waUrl = rawDigits ? `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=${rawDigits}` : null;
            const telUrl = rawDigits ? `tel:${rawDigits}` : null;

            return (
              <div
                key={c.id}
                className="p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-xs flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4 hover:border-[#00DD9E]/40 transition"
              >
                {/* Información Principal del Contacto */}
                <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <h4 className="font-display font-black text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                      {c.name || 'Sin Nombre'}
                    </h4>
                    {c.cedula && c.cedula !== 'No especificada' && (
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/5">
                        {c.cedula}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className={`text-[11px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border ${
                      (c.origin || '').includes('Denuncia')
                        ? 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-500/25'
                        : (c.origin || '').includes('Cabina')
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/25'
                        : 'bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 border-sky-500/25'
                    }`}>
                      {c.origin || 'Web'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 text-slate-500">
                      {c.interactionCount || 1} {c.interactionCount === 1 ? 'contacto' : 'contactos'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Teléfono y Ubicación */}
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                    <span className="flex items-center space-x-1 font-bold">
                      <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                      <span>{c.phone || 'Sin teléfono'}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                      <span>{c.location || 'Santo Domingo - Mérida'}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                      Último: {new Date(c.lastContactDate || c.firstContactDate).toLocaleDateString('es-VE')}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Último Mensaje o Detalle */}
                  {c.details && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 italic bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/20 p-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5">
                      "{c.details}"
                    </p>
                  )}

                  {/* Notas Internas Confidenciales */}
                  {c.notes && (
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-semibold flex items-center space-x-1">
                      <span>Nota:</span>
                      <span>{c.notes}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Botones de Comunicación y Gestión */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 self-end md:self-auto shrink-0">
                  {/* WhatsApp directo */}
                  {waUrl && !isTrashView && (
                    <a
                      href={waUrl}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold border border-emerald-500/25 transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Abrir chat directo en WhatsApp"
                    >
                      <MessageCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span className="hidden sm:inline">WhatsApp</span>
                    </a>
                  )}

                  {/* Llamar por teléfono */}
                  {telUrl && !isTrashView && (
                    <a
                      href={telUrl}
                      className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Llamar directamente"
                    >
                      <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </a>
                  )}

                  {/* Ver Historial de Interacciones */}
                  {Array.isArray(c.history) && c.history.length > 0 && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setViewingHistoryContact(c)}
                      className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Ver historial de interacciones de este ciudadano"
                    >
                      <History className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {/* Editar */}
                  {!isTrashView && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(c)}
                      className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 hover:bg-sky-500 hover:text-white text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Editar datos y notas"
                    >
                      <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {/* Acciones de Papelera */}
                  {isTrashView ? (
                    <>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleRestore(c.id, c.name)}
                        className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold border border-emerald-500/30 transition cursor-pointer"
                        title="Restaurar a la lista activa"
                      >
                        <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Restaurar</span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => handlePermanentDelete(c.id, c.name)}
                        className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 hover:bg-rose-500 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
                        title="Eliminar definitivamente de la base de datos"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleTrash(c.id, c.name)}
                      className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 hover:bg-rose-500 hover:text-white text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Mover contacto a la papelera"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      {/* MODAL DE HISTORIAL DE INTERACCIONES DE UN CONTACTO */}
      {viewingHistoryContact && (
        <div 
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md animate-fadeIn"
          onClick={() => setViewingHistoryContact(null)}
        >
          <div 
            className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e] rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 space-y-4 max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <History className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                <h4 className="font-display font-black text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Historial: {viewingHistoryContact.name}
                </h4>
              </div>
              <button 
                onClick={() => setViewingHistoryContact(null)}
                className="p-1 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              {(viewingHistoryContact.history || []).map((h, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/5 space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <span className="font-bold text-[#00DD9E]">{h.origin || 'Interacción'}</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-400">{new Date(h.date).toLocaleString('es-VE')}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{h.details}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 text-right">
              <button
                onClick={() => setViewingHistoryContact(null)}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 dark:bg-white text-white dark:text-slate-900 text-xs font-bold"
              >
                Cerrar
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Users,

  TrendingUp, 
  Key, 
  Lock,

  Clock,

  Eye, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Megaphone, 
  Radio, 
  MessageSquare, 
  Calendar,

  Award,

  ChevronDown, 
  ChevronUp,
  CreditCard,
  Share2,
  Phone,
  Upload,
  X
} from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from '../Emoji3D';
import { 
  getAllStaffUsers, 
  saveStaffUser, 
  toggleStaffActive, 
  deleteStaffUser,

  setStaffSession,
  getAllStaffTasks,
  saveStaffTask,
  updateStaffTaskStatus,
  deleteStaffTask,
  getAllStaffInterviews,
  deleteStaffInterview,
  getAllStaffMessages,
  sendStaffMessage,
  markStaffMessagesAsRead,
  getStaffSalesMetrics
} from '../../services/staffPortalService';
import { getAllClients, getAllPayments } from '../../services/radioClientsService';
import { getCachedBcvRates } from '../../services/bcvService';

export default function AdminStaffPortalManager({ onShowToast, onOpenStaffPortalAs, mode = 'full' }) {
  const DAYS_OF_WEEK = ['Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miércoles', 'Jueves', 'Viernes', 'Sábado', 'Domingo'];

  // Scroll suave para sub-paneles inline
  const scrollToSubpanel = (id) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }, 60);
  };

  // Subir foto de perfil de locutor
  const handleAvatarFileUpload = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast('La foto debe ser menor a 2.5 MB');
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      setStaffForm(prev => ({ ...prev, avatar: event.target.result }));
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Foto de perfil cargada');
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  // Sub-pestañas: 'rendimiento' | 'accesos' | 'tareas' | 'entrevistas' | 'mensajeria'
  const [subTab, setSubTab] = useState(mode === 'team_only' ? 'accesos' : 'rendimiento');

  const [staffUsers, setStaffUsers] = useState(() => getAllStaffUsers());
  const [clients, setClients] = useState(() => getAllClients().filter(c => !c.trashed));
  const [payments, setPayments] = useState(() => getAllPayments());
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(() => getAllStaffTasks());
  const [interviews, setInterviews] = useState(() => getAllStaffInterviews());
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState(() => getAllStaffMessages());
  const [bcvRates, setBcvRates] = useState(() => getCachedBcvRates());

  // Búsqueda y filtros
  const [searchStaff, setSearchStaff] = useState('');
  const [selectedStaffDetailId, setSelectedStaffDetailId] = useState(null);
  const [copiedKeyId, setCopiedKeyId] = useState(null);

  // Modal para Crear / Editar Acceso de Locutor
  const [isStaffModalOpen, setIsStaffModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingStaff, setEditingStaff] = useState(null);
  const [staffForm, setStaffForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    role: 'Locutor & Productor',
    programName: '',
    programSchedule: '',
    assignedDays: ['Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miércoles', 'Jueves', 'Viernes'],
    phone: '',
    username: '',
    password: '',
    commissionRate: 20,
    avatar: '',
    accessActive: true
  });

  // Modal para Asignar Nueva Tarea / Pauta
  const [isTaskModalOpen, setIsTaskModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [taskForm, setTaskForm] = useState({
    staffId: '',
    type: 'publicitaria', // 'publicitaria' | 'programacion'
    title: '',
    description: '',
    programName: '',
    scheduledDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 16),
    priority: 'alta'
  });

  // Chat con Locutores
  const [chatStaffId, setChatStaffId] = useState(() => staffUsers[0]?.id || '');
  const [chatText, setChatText] = useState('');
  const chatBottomRef = useRef(null);

  // Escuchar actualizaciones
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleUpdate = () => {
      setStaffUsers(getAllStaffUsers());
      setClients(getAllClients().filter(c => !c.trashed));
      setPayments(getAllPayments());
      setTasks(getAllStaffTasks());
      setInterviews(getAllStaffInterviews());
      setMessages(getAllStaffMessages());
    };

    window.addEventListener('neblina_staff_updated', handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('neblina_clients_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_staff_updated', handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_clients_updated', handleUpdate);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (subTab === 'mensajeria') {
      chatBottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  }, [messages, subTab, chatStaffId]);

  // Cálculos consolidados globales
  const totalStaffCount = staffUsers.length;
  const activeStaffCount = staffUsers.filter(s => s.accessActive).length;

  // Totalizar ventas sumando todos los clientes de locutores
  const staffClients = clients.filter(c => c.locutorId);
  const totalBilledUsd = staffClients.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (Number(c.amountUsd) || 0), 0);
  const totalBilledBs = totalBilledUsd * (bcvRates.usd || 884.75);

  const totalCollectedUsd = staffClients
    .filter(c => c.paymentStatus === 'paid')
    .reduce((acc, c) => acc + (Number(c.amountUsd) || 0), 0);
  const totalCollectedBs = totalCollectedUsd * (bcvRates.usd || 884.75);

  const totalPendingUsd = staffClients
    .filter(c => c.paymentStatus === 'pending' || c.paymentStatus === 'overdue')
    .reduce((acc, c) => acc + (Number(c.amountUsd) || 0), 0);

  // Guardar Locutor / Acceso
  const handleSaveStaffSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!staffForm.name.trim() || !staffForm.username.trim()) {
      alert('Por favor ingrese el nombre del locutor y el usuario.');
      return;
    }

    saveStaffUser({
      ...staffForm,
      id: editingStaff?.id || undefined,
      commissionRate: Number(staffForm.commissionRate) || 20
    });

    setStaffUsers(getAllStaffUsers());
    setIsStaffModalOpen(false);
    setEditingStaff(null);
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast(editingStaff ? 'Locutor actualizado' : 'Nuevo locutor registrado con acceso');
  };

  const openNewStaffModal = () => {
    setEditingStaff(null);
    setStaffForm({

      assignedDays: ['Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miércoles', 'Jueves', 'Viernes'],
      phone: '+58 ',
      username: '',
      password: 'neblina105',
      commissionRate: 20,
      avatar: '',
      accessActive: true
    });
    setIsStaffModalOpen(true);
    scrollToSubpanel('staff-form-inline');
  };

  const openEditStaffModal = (staff) => {
    setEditingStaff(staff);
    setStaffForm({
      name: staff.name || '',
      role: staff.role || 'Locutor & Productor',
      programName: staff.programName || '',
      programSchedule: staff.programSchedule || '',
      assignedDays: Array.isArray(staff.assignedDays) && staff.assignedDays.length > 0
        ? staff.assignedDays
        : ['Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miércoles', 'Jueves', 'Viernes'],
      phone: staff.phone || '',
      username: staff.username || '',
      password: staff.password || '',
      commissionRate: staff.commissionRate || 20,
      avatar: staff.avatar || '',
      accessActive: staff.accessActive !== false
    });
    setIsStaffModalOpen(true);
    scrollToSubpanel('staff-form-inline');
  };

  const toggleDayInStaffForm = (day) => {
    setStaffForm(prev => {
      const current = Array.isArray(prev.assignedDays) ? prev.assignedDays : [];
      const exists = current.includes(day);
      const next = exists ? current.filter(d => d !== day) : [...current, day];
      return {
        ...prev,
        assignedDays: next.length > 0 ? next : [day]
      };
    });
  };

  const handleCopyWhatsApp = (staff) => {
    const text = generateStaffWhatsAppMessage(staff);
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedKeyId(staff.id);
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast(`Datos de acceso para ${staff.name} copiados para WhatsApp`);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedKeyId(null), 2500);
  };

  // Asignar Tarea
  const handleSaveTaskSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!taskForm.title.trim() || !taskForm.staffId) {
      alert('Por favor complete el título de la tarea y seleccione al locutor.');
      return;
    }

    const selectedStaff = staffUsers.find(s => s.id === taskForm.staffId);

    saveStaffTask({
      ...taskForm,
      staffName: selectedStaff?.name || 'Locutor',
      programName: taskForm.programName || selectedStaff?.programName || 'Programación General',
      status: 'pendiente'
    });

    setTasks(getAllStaffTasks());
    setIsTaskModalOpen(false);
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Tarea y pauta asignada al locutor');
  };

  // Enviar mensaje de Director a Locutor
  const handleSendDirectorMessage = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!chatText.trim() || !chatStaffId) return;

    sendStaffMessage({
      staffId: chatStaffId,
      sender: 'director',
      text: chatText
    });

    setChatText('');
    setMessages(getAllStaffMessages());
  };

  // Entrar al portal como este locutor (en pestaña independiente)
  const handleEnterAsStaff = (staff) => {
    setStaffSession(staff);
    if (onOpenStaffPortalAs) {
      onOpenStaffPortalAs(staff);
    } else {
      window.open(`${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}#locutores`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    }
  };

  const activeChatMessages = messages.filter(m => m.staffId === chatStaffId);
  const activeChatStaff = staffUsers.find(s => s.id === chatStaffId);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      
      {/* Banner Superior de Métricas Consolidadas por Locutor (Adaptable a Modo Claro y Oscuro con Alto Contraste) */}
      <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl aeroglass-card border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/10 bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden transition-colors duration-300">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-72 h-72 bg-[#00DD9E]/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        
        <div className="relative flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E]">Gestión Comercial de Cabina</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-emerald-500/20">
                {activeStaffCount} Locutores Activos
              </span>
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-1">Control de Ventas & Pautas por Locutor</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mt-1 max-w-xl">
              Monitorea los clientes ingresados por cada locutor, las cobranzas recibidas, comisiones calculadas y asignación de pautas en vivo.
            </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-white/[0.07] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md">
              <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"><Users className="inline w-3 h-3 mr-1 -mt-0.5 text-[#00DD9E]" />Clientes Totales</span>

              <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"><TrendingUp className="inline w-3 h-3 mr-1 -mt-0.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />Ventas ($)</span>
              <span className="text-lg font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">${totalBilledUsd}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-white/[0.07] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md">
              <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"><CheckCircle2 className="inline w-3 h-3 mr-1 -mt-0.5 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-300" />Cobrado ($)</span>
              <span className="text-lg font-black text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-300">${totalCollectedUsd}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-white/[0.07] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md">
              <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"><Clock className="inline w-3 h-3 mr-1 -mt-0.5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300" />Pendiente ($)</span>
              <span className="text-lg font-black text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300">${totalPendingUsd}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Navegación por Sub-Pestañas del Director */}
      {mode !== 'sales_only' && (
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 p-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 overflow-x-auto">
          {mode !== 'team_only' && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSubTab('rendimiento')}
              className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                subTab === 'rendimiento'
                  ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] shadow-sm dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D]'
                  : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
              }`}
            >
              <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Ventas & Ingresos por Locutor</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSubTab('accesos')}
            className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              subTab === 'accesos'
                ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] shadow-sm dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D]'
                : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            <Key className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Accesos & Credenciales</span>
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md bg-white/20 text-[11px] font-black">{staffUsers.length}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSubTab('tareas')}
            className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              subTab === 'tareas'
                ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] shadow-sm dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D]'
                : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            <Megaphone className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Asignar Tareas & Pautas</span>
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md bg-white/20 text-[11px] font-black">{tasks.length}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSubTab('entrevistas')}
            className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              subTab === 'entrevistas'
                ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] shadow-sm dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D]'
                : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            <Mic className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Bitácora de Entrevistas</span>
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md bg-white/20 text-[11px] font-black">{interviews.length}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSubTab('mensajeria')}
            className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              subTab === 'mensajeria'
                ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] shadow-sm dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D]'
                : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Chat con Locutores</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =========================================================================
          SUB-PESTAÑA 1: VENTAS & RENDIMIENTO POR LOCUTOR
      ========================================================================= */}
      {subTab === 'rendimiento' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">

          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {staffUsers.map(staff => {
              const metrics = getStaffSalesMetrics(staff.id, clients, payments, bcvRates.usd);
              const isSelected = selectedStaffDetailId === staff.id;
              const staffClientsList = clients.filter(c => String(c.locutorId) === String(staff.id));

              return (
                <div
                  key={staff.id}
                  className="rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm overflow-hidden"

                  <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                    {/* Información del Locutor */}
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-3.5">
                      <img
                        src={staff.avatar || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80'}

                        className="w-13 h-13 rounded-2xl object-cover border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm"
                      />
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          <h4 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{staff.name}</h4>
                          <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg ${
                            staff.accessActive ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E]' : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600'
                          }`}>
                            {staff.accessActive ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          {staff.programName || 'Sin programa asignado'} • Comisión: {staff.commissionRate || 20}%

                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Resumen de Ventas del Locutor */}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center lg:w-1/2">
                      <div className="p-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5">
                        <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase">Clientes</span>
                        <span className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{metrics.totalClientsCount}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="p-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5">
                        <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase">Facturado</span>
                        <span className="text-sm font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">${metrics.totalBilledUsd}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="p-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5">
                        <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase">Cobrado</span>
                        <span className="text-sm font-black text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400">${metrics.totalCollectedUsd}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="p-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5">
                        <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase">Comisión Est.</span>
                        <span className="text-sm font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">${metrics.estimatedCommissionUsd.toFixed(1)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Botones de Acción */}
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleEnterAsStaff(staff)}

                      >
                        <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Ver Portal</span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setSelectedStaffDetailId(isSelected ? null : staff.id)}

                      >
                        {isSelected ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Detalle Desplegable de Clientes del Locutor */}
                  {isSelected && (
                    <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-white/[0.01] space-y-3">

                      {staffClientsList.length === 0 ? (

                              className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/5 text-xs shadow-xs"

                              <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                                <h6 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{c.businessName}</h6>
                                <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg ${
                                  c.paymentStatus === 'paid' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600' : 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600'
                                }`}>
                                  {c.paymentStatus === 'paid' ? 'Al Día' : 'Pendiente'}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">{c.ownerName} • {c.ownerPhone}</p>
                              <div className="mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between font-bold">
                                <span>Pauta: ${c.amountUsd} / {c.paymentFrequency || 'mes'}</span>
                                <span className="text-emerald-600">
                                  {((Number(c.amountUsd) || 0) * (bcvRates.usd || 884.75)).toLocaleString('es-VE', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} Bs.
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =========================================================================
          SUB-PESTAÑA 2: ACCESOS Y CREDENCIALES DEL PERSONAL
      ========================================================================= */}
      {subTab === 'accesos' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">

            </h4>

            <button

              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Crear Nuevo Acceso</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* SUB-PANEL INLINE: CREAR / EDITAR ACCESO DE LOCUTOR */}
          {isStaffModalOpen && (

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
                  <Key className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      {editingStaff ? `Editar Acceso: ${editingStaff.name}` : 'Crear Nuevo Acceso de Locutor'}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Configura credenciales, programa asignado y días de transmisión al aire
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { setIsStaffModalOpen(false); setEditingStaff(null); }}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <form onSubmit={handleSaveStaffSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Nombre Completo *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={staffForm.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setStaffForm({ ...staffForm, name: e.target.value })}

                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Rol en la Emisora</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={staffForm.role}
                      onChange={(e) => setStaffForm({ ...staffForm, role: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="Locutor & Productor"
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Teléfono / WhatsApp</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={staffForm.phone}
                      onChange={(e) => setStaffForm({ ...staffForm, phone: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="+58 414-0000000"
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Nombre del Programa Radial</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={staffForm.programName}
                      onChange={(e) => setStaffForm({ ...staffForm, programName: e.target.value })}

                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Horario del Programa</label>
                    <input

                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">% Comisión por Ventas</label>
                    <input

                      onChange={(e) => setStaffForm({ ...staffForm, commissionRate: e.target.value })}

                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Días Asignados de Programación */}
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-black/20 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 space-y-2">
                  <label className="block font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px]">
                    Días Asignados a su Programa (Sincroniza con Guion y Programación Diaria del Locutor)
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {DAYS_OF_WEEK.map(day => {
                      const active = (staffForm.assignedDays || []).includes(day);
                      return (
                        <button

                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => toggleDayInStaffForm(day)}
                          className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer border ${
                            active
                              ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] border-[#00DD9E]/40 dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D] shadow-xs'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">{active && <Check className="w-3 h-3" />}{day}</span>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">

                  <div>

                    <input

                    />
                  </div>

                    <label className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer hover:border-[#00DD9E]">
                      <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>{staffForm.avatar ? 'Cambiar Foto' : 'Subir Foto'}</span>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-end space-x-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">

                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Cancelar
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-[#00DD9E] text-[#001E4D] font-black shadow-md hover:brightness-105 transition cursor-pointer"

                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>

                        className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl object-cover border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10"
                      />
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{staff.name}</h4>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{staff.role}</p>

                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => toggleStaffActive(staff.id)}
                      className={`text-[11px] font-black px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition ${
                        staff.accessActive
                          ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/20'
                          : 'bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-600 border border-rose-500/20 hover:bg-rose-500/20'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {staff.accessActive ? '• Acceso Activo' : '• Pausado'}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Credenciales */}
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 font-bold">Usuario:</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-white dark:bg-white/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                        {staff.username}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 font-bold">Contraseña:</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white bg-white dark:bg-white/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                        {staff.password}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 font-bold">Programa:</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-medium">
                        {staff.programName || 'General'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {Array.isArray(staff.assignedDays) && staff.assignedDays.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="pt-1 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-white/5 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {staff.assignedDays.map(d => (
                          <span key={d} className="text-[11px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#00DD9E]">
                            {d}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Acciones */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-3 mt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                    <button

                    <button

                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                    <button

                        }
                      }}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-xl hover:bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-500 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Eliminar"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =========================================================================
          SUB-PESTAÑA 3: ASIGNAR TAREAS Y PAUTAS A LOCUTORES
      ========================================================================= */}
      {subTab === 'tareas' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Pautas Publicitarias y Actividades de Programación Asignadas
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">

              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setTaskForm({
                  staffId: staffUsers[0]?.id || '',
                  type: 'publicitaria',
                  title: '',
                  description: '',
                  programName: '',
                  scheduledDate: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 16),
                  priority: 'alta'
                });
                setIsTaskModalOpen(true);
                scrollToSubpanel('task-form-inline');
              }}
              className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs shadow-sm transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Asignar Nueva Pauta</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* INLINE SUB-PANEL: ASIGNAR TAREA */}
```
