```jsx
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
                  <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      Asignar Nueva Tarea o Pauta al Locutor
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Pautas publicitarias, menciones en vivo o actividades pautadas
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsTaskModalOpen(false)}
                  className="p-1 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <form onSubmit={handleSaveTaskSubmit} className="space-y-3.5 text-xs">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Locutor Responsable *</label>
                    <select
                      value={taskForm.staffId}
                      onChange={(e) => setTaskForm({ ...taskForm, staffId: e.target.value })}
                      required
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    >
                      {staffUsers.map(s => (
                        <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.name} ({s.programName || s.role})</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Tipo de Actividad</label>
                    <select
                      value={taskForm.type}
                      onChange={(e) => setTaskForm({ ...taskForm, type: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    >
                      <option value="publicitaria">Pauta Publicitaria / Mención Comercial</option>
                      <option value="programacion">Actividad de Programación / Producción</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Título de la Actividad *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={taskForm.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setTaskForm({ ...taskForm, title: e.target.value })}
                    required
                    placeholder="Ej. Transmisión especial Fogón Andino"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Descripción / Instrucciones de la Pauta</label>
                  <textarea
                    rows={3}
                    value={taskForm.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setTaskForm({ ...taskForm, description: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="Detalles de la pauta, mención, número de pases en vivo, indicaciones específicas..."
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Fecha y Hora Programada</label>
                    <input
                      type="datetime-local"
                      value={taskForm.scheduledDate}
                      onChange={(e) => setTaskForm({ ...taskForm, scheduledDate: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Prioridad</label>
                    <select
                      value={taskForm.priority}
                      onChange={(e) => setTaskForm({ ...taskForm, priority: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white"
                    >
                      <option value="alta">Alta (Prioritaria)</option>
                      <option value="media">Media</option>
                      <option value="baja">Baja</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center justify-end space-x-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setIsTaskModalOpen(false)}
                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold hover:bg-slate-300 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Cancelar
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-500 to-[#00DD9E] text-[#001E4D] font-black shadow-md hover:brightness-105 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Asignar Pauta al Locutor
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          )}


          <div className="space-y-3">
            {tasks.map(task => {
              const isPub = task.type === 'publicitaria';
              const isDone = task.status === 'completada';

              return (
                <div
                  key={task.id}
                  className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm"
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <span className={`text-[11px] font-black px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg flex items-center space-x-1 ${
                        isPub ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E]' : 'bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600'
                      }`}>
                        {isPub ? <Megaphone className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Radio className="w-3 h-3" />}
                        <span>{isPub ? 'Pauta Publicitaria' : 'Programación'}</span>
                      </span>

                      <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                        Para: {task.staffName}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg ${
                        isDone ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600' : 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600'
                      }`}>
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">{isDone ? <><CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Emitida / Completada</> : <><Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> Pendiente de emisión</>}</span>
                      </span>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          deleteStaffTask(task.id);
                          setTasks(getAllStaffTasks());
                        }}
                        className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 cursor-pointer"
                        title="Eliminar tarea"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <h5 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-1">{task.title}</h5>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2">{task.description}</p>

                  <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5">
                    <span>Pautado para: {new Date(task.scheduledDate).toLocaleString('es-VE')}</span>
                    {task.locutorNotes && (
                      <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-medium">
                        Nota del locutor: "{task.locutorNotes}"
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =========================================================================
          SUB-PESTAÑA 4: BITÁCORA GENERAL DE ENTREVISTAS
      ========================================================================= */}
      {subTab === 'entrevistas' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h4 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Registro de Entrevistas Realizadas en la Emisora
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                Historial completo de invitados, autoridades y emprendedores entrevistados al aire por cada programa.
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
              {interviews.length} entrevistas archivadas
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {interviews.map(intw => (
              <div
                key={intw.id}
                className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E]">
                        {intw.date} • {intw.time}
                      </span>
                      <h5 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-1">
                        {intw.intervieweeName}
                      </h5>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                        {intw.intervieweeRoleOrg || 'Sin cargo especificado'}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (confirm('¿Eliminar esta entrevista?')) {
                          deleteStaffInterview(intw.id);
                          setInterviews(getAllStaffInterviews());
                        }
                      }}
                      className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="p-3 my-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5">
                    <span className="block text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-1">
                      Tema Tratado:
                    </span>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed">
                      {intw.topic}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {intw.observations && (
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 italic">
                      Obs: {intw.observations}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="pt-2 mt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>Locutor: <strong>{intw.staffName}</strong></span>
                  <span>Programa: {intw.programName}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* =========================================================================
          SUB-PESTAÑA 5: CHAT CON LOCUTORES
      ========================================================================= */}
      {subTab === 'mensajeria' && (
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row h-[500px] rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden">
          {/* Lista de Locutores */}
          <div className="w-full md:w-72 border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-white/[0.02] flex flex-col">
            <div className="p-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 text-xs font-black uppercase text-slate-500">
              Personal de Cabina
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-white/5">
              {staffUsers.map(s => (
                <button
                  key={s.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setChatStaffId(s.id);
                    markStaffMessagesAsRead(s.id, 'director');
                  }}
                  className={`w-full p-3 flex items-center space-x-3 text-left transition cursor-pointer ${
                    chatStaffId === s.id ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-l-4 border-emerald-500' : 'hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5'
                  }`}
                >
                  <img
                    src={s.avatar || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80'}
                    alt={s.name}
                    className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl object-cover"
                  />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <h6 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">{s.name}</h6>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 truncate">{s.programName || s.role}</p>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Conversación */}
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between bg-white dark:bg-transparent">
            <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Chat con {activeChatStaff?.name || 'Locutor'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">{activeChatStaff?.programName}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-3">
              {activeChatMessages.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                  No hay mensajes intercambiados aún con este locutor.
                </div>
              ) : (
                activeChatMessages.map(msg => {
                  const isMe = msg.sender === 'director';
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={msg.id}
                      className={`flex flex-col ${isMe ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}`}
                    >
                      <div className={`max-w-[75%] p-3 rounded-2xl text-xs ${
                        isMe
                          ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] rounded-br-none shadow-sm'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white rounded-bl-none'
                      }`}>
                        <p>{msg.text}</p>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1 px-1">
                        {new Date(msg.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
              )}
              <div ref={chatBottomRef} />
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSendDirectorMessage} className="p-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={chatText}
                onChange={(e) => setChatText(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={`Escribe un mensaje para ${activeChatStaff?.name || 'el locutor'}...`}
                className="flex-1 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 text-xs font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="p-2 rounded-2xl bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] hover:brightness-110 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

</div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  Printer, 
  Copy, 
  Check, 
  Send, 
  Download, 
  Building2, 
  UserCheck,
  Radio,
  Globe,
  Phone, 
  MapPin, 
  Calendar, 
  Eye, 
  MousePointer, 
  TrendingUp, 
  Sparkles, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  Film, 
  Layers, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Clock, 
  Share2, 
  ExternalLink,
  MessageCircle,
  FileText,
  BarChart3,
  Mic,
  Repeat,
  Camera
} from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from '../Emoji3D';
import { getAllClients, getAllGenres } from '../../services/radioClientsService';
import { getAllBanners, getBannersByClient } from '../../services/adBannerService';

export default function ClientAdReportModal({ 
  isOpen, 
  onClose, 
  clientId = null, 
  onShowToast 
}) {
  const [clients, setClients] = useState(() => getAllClients().filter(c => !c.trashed));
  const [genres, setGenres] = useState(() => getAllGenres());
  const [allBanners, setAllBanners] = useState(() => getAllBanners());
  const [selectedClientId, setSelectedClientId] = useState(clientId || (clients[0]?.id || ''));
  const [copiedText, setCopiedText] = useState(false);
  const [copiedSummary, setCopiedSummary] = useState(false);

  // Estados opcionales para métricas de Fase 2 (Redes Sociales & Radio en Vivo)
  const [socialMetrics, setSocialMetrics] = useState({
    radioMentions: 120, // Menciones en vivo en cabina
    instagramViews: 450, // Vistas en Instagram
    facebookReach: 680,  // Alcance en Facebook
    tiktokViews: 320     // Vistas en TikTok
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    setClients(getAllClients().filter(c => !c.trashed));
    setGenres(getAllGenres());
    setAllBanners(getAllBanners());
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (clientId) {
      setSelectedClientId(clientId);
    } else if (!selectedClientId && clients.length > 0) {
      setSelectedClientId(clients[0].id);
    }
  }, [clientId, clients]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Cliente activo
  const currentClient = clients.find(c => String(c.id) === String(selectedClientId)) || clients[0];
  const clientGenre = genres.find(g => g.id === currentClient?.genreId);

  // Banners asociados al cliente
  const clientBanners = allBanners.filter(b => 
    String(b.clientId) === String(currentClient?.id) || 
    (currentClient?.businessName && b.clientName && b.clientName.toLowerCase() === currentClient.businessName.toLowerCase())
  );

  // Métricas agregadas de los banners del cliente
  const totalViews = clientBanners.reduce((acc, b) => acc + (b.viewsCount || 0), 0);
  const totalClicks = clientBanners.reduce((acc, b) => acc + (b.clicksCount || 0), 0);
  const avgCtr = totalViews > 0 ? ((totalClicks / totalViews) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';
  const activeBannersCount = clientBanners.filter(b => b.active).length;

  const totalImages = clientBanners.reduce((acc, b) => acc + (b.images?.length || (b.mediaUrl && b.type !== 'video' ? 1 : 0)), 0);
  const totalVideos = clientBanners.reduce((acc, b) => acc + (b.videos?.length || (b.mediaUrl && b.type === 'video' ? 1 : 0)), 0);

  // Distribución de visualizaciones por ubicación
  const homeBanners = clientBanners.filter(b => b.placements === 'home' || b.placements === 'all');
  const newsBanners = clientBanners.filter(b => b.placements === 'news' || b.placements === 'all');
  const homeViews = Math.round(totalViews * 0.62); // 62% en home
  const newsViews = totalViews - homeViews;        // 38% en notas de prensa

  // Generar texto para WhatsApp
  const generateWhatsAppMessage = () => {
    if (!currentClient) return '';
    const now = new Date();
    const dateStr = now.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });
    
    const s = currentClient.services;
    const servicesList = [];
    if (s?.enVivo || currentClient.packageType?.includes('en_vivo') || currentClient.packageType?.includes('combo')) {
      servicesList.push('• 🎙️ *Radio en Vivo:* Menciones del locutor en programas');
    }
    if (s?.rotativa || currentClient.packageType?.includes('rotativas') || currentClient.packageType?.includes('combo')) {
      servicesList.push('• 🔁 *Radio Rotativa:* Cuñas comerciales rotativas diarias');
    }
    if (s?.redes?.whatsapp?.difusion || s?.redes?.whatsapp?.publicitarios || s?.redes?.whatsapp?.historias) {
      const parts = [];
      if (s.redes.whatsapp.difusion) parts.push('Grupos de Difusión');
      if (s.redes.whatsapp.publicitarios) parts.push('Grupos Publicitarios (no informativos)');
      if (s.redes.whatsapp.historias) parts.push('Historias');
      servicesList.push(`• 💬 *WhatsApp:* ${parts.join(', ')}`);
    }
    if (s?.redes?.instagram?.historias) {
      servicesList.push('• 📸 *Instagram:* Historias en @neblina105fm');
    }
    if (s?.redes?.facebook?.historias) {
      servicesList.push('• 👥 *Facebook:* Historias en página oficial');
    }
    if (s?.redes?.tiktok?.historias) {
      servicesList.push('• 🎵 *TikTok:* Historias en cuenta oficial');
    }
    if (s?.web?.imagenes || (!s && (currentClient.packageType?.includes('web') || currentClient.packageType?.includes('combo')))) {
      servicesList.push('• 🖼️ *Página Web:* Banners de imágenes rotativos');
    }
    if (s?.web?.videos) {
      servicesList.push('• 🎬 *Página Web:* Banners de videos en alta definición');
    }

    if (servicesList.length === 0 && Array.isArray(currentClient.packageType)) {
      currentClient.packageType.forEach(p => {
        if (p === 'en_vivo') servicesList.push('• 🎙️ Menciones en vivo en programas');
        if (p === 'rotativas') servicesList.push('• 🔁 Cuñas rotativas');
        if (p === 'web') servicesList.push('• 🌐 Banners en página web');
        if (p === 'redes') servicesList.push('• 📱 Difusión en redes sociales');
      });
    }

    return `📊 *INFORME DE RENDIMIENTO PUBLICITARIO*
📻 *Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM — Tu Radio en la Cima*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🏢 *Comercio:* ${currentClient.businessName}
👤 *Titular:* ${currentClient.ownerName || 'Cliente'}
📄 *RIF:* ${currentClient.businessRif || 'N/A'}
📅 *Fecha de Emisión:* ${dateStr}
📌 *Vigencia:* ${currentClient.startDate || 'Activa'} al ${currentClient.endDate || 'Renovación automática'}

📈 *MÉTRICAS EN NUESTRA WEB APP & STREAMING:*
• 👁️ *Impresiones Totales:* ${totalViews.toLocaleString('es-VE')} visualizaciones
• 🎯 *Contactos a WhatsApp / Web:* ${totalClicks.toLocaleString('es-VE')} clics directos
• ⚡ *Tasa de Conversión (CTR):* ${avgCtr}%
• 🖼️ *Materiales en Pantalla:* ${totalImages} imágenes y ${totalVideos} videos en bucle
• 📍 *Ubicaciones Activas:* Página de Inicio y Sala de Notas de Prensa

🎙️ *CANALES Y MEDIOS CONTRATADOS:*
${servicesList.length > 0 ? servicesList.join('\n') : '• ⭐ Plan Comercial Integral'}

🚀 *PRÓXIMAMENTE (FASE 2):*
Conexión de métricas de Instagram, Facebook y TikTok en tiempo real.

*¡Gracias por confiar en Neblina 105.5 FM para potenciar tu marca!*
_Para cambios en sus artes o pautas, comuníquese con la gerencia comercial._`;
  };

  // Acción: Imprimir / Guardar como PDF
  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  // Acción: Enviar por WhatsApp
  const handleSendWhatsApp = () => {
    const text = generateWhatsAppMessage();
    const rawPhone = currentClient?.ownerPhone || currentClient?.adminContactPhone || '';
    const cleanPhone = rawPhone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
    const url = cleanPhone 
      ? `https://wa.me/${cleanPhone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`
      : `https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
    window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Redirigiendo a WhatsApp con el informe oficial');
  };

  // Acción: Copiar resumen
  const handleCopySummary = () => {
    const text = generateWhatsAppMessage();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
      setCopiedSummary(true);
      if (onShowToast) onShowToast('¡Informe formateado copiado al portapapeles!');
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedSummary(false), 3000);
    });
  };

  // Acción: Exportar JSON
  const handleExportJSON = () => {
    const reportData = {
      reportId: `REP-${currentClient?.id?.toUpperCase()}-${Date.now()}`,
      station: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
      generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      client: currentClient,
      metrics: {
        totalViews,
        totalClicks,
        avgCtr,
        activeBannersCount,
        totalImages,
        totalVideos,
        homeViews,
        newsViews
      },
      banners: clientBanners,
      phase2Multichannel: socialMetrics
    };

    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(reportData, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `reporte-publicidad-${currentClient?.businessName?.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_') || 'cliente'}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    if (onShowToast) onShowToast('Reporte JSON descargado exitosamente');
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100000] flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-fadeIn">
      
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001E4D] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/30 rounded-2xl shadow-lg my-auto max-h-[94vh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden">
        
        {/* ============================================================== */}
        {/* BARRA SUPERIOR DE CONTROL (NO SE IMPRIME) */}
        {/* ============================================================== */}
        <div className="no-print p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/30">

            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">

                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Neblina 105.5 FM</span>
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-black text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-0.5">
                Rendimiento Publicitario & Estadísticas Oficiales
              </h3>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Selector de Cliente & Acciones */}
          <div className="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
            <select
              value={selectedClientId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedClientId(e.target.value)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e] border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/15 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00DD9E] cursor-pointer"
            >
              {clients.map(c => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {c.businessName}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>

            <button
              onClick={handleSendWhatsApp}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold text-xs transition flex items-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
              title="Enviar informe formateado al WhatsApp del cliente"
            >
              <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" alt="WhatsApp" />
              <span>Enviar WhatsApp</span>
            </button>

            <button

              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold text-xs transition flex items-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
              title="Imprimir o guardar como PDF"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Imprimir / PDF</span>
            </button>

            <button

              title="Copiar resumen de texto"
            >
              {copiedSummary ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Cerrar modal"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* ============================================================== */}
        {/* CUERPO DEL INFORME (ÁREA IMPRIMIBLE #client-ad-report-printable) */}
        {/* ============================================================== */}
        <div id="client-ad-report-printable" className="p-6 sm:p-8 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between pb-6 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 gap-4">

              <div>

            <div className="text-left sm:text-right font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 space-y-0.5">

              <p><strong>Fecha de Emisión:</strong> {new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' })}</p>
              <p><strong>Estado:</strong> <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-bold">Campaña Activa en Emisión</span></p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* FICHA TÉCNICA DEL CLIENTE COMERCIAL */}
          {currentClient && (

              {/* Canales y Servicios Contratados */}

                </span>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {(currentClient.services?.enVivo || currentClient.packageType?.includes('en_vivo') || currentClient.packageType?.includes('combo')) && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">

                      <span>Web: Imágenes</span>
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {currentClient.services?.web?.videos && (

                      <Film className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-500" />
                      <span>Web: Videos</span>
                    </span>

              {currentClient.address && (

                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-white/5 bg-white dark:bg-[#19222e]">

                      const bImgs = b.images?.length || (b.mediaUrl && b.type !== 'video' ? 1 : 0);
                      const bVids = b.videos?.length || (b.mediaUrl && b.type === 'video' ? 1 : 0);

                      return (
                        <tr key={b.id || idx} className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-white/[0.02]">

                            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-500">

                            {bCtr}%

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                <h4 className="font-display font-black text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Ecosistema Multicanal & Redes Sociales
                </h4>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20">
                <span>Fase 2 • En Preparación para Conexión API</span>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">

            </p>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3 pt-1 text-xs">
              
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400 font-bold">
                  <Emoji3D name="instagram" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" alt="Instagram" />
```

## src/components/admin/SectionTrashToggle.jsx

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import { Trash2, CheckCircle2, RotateCcw, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';

/**
 * SectionTrashToggle
 * Barra de control de Papelera Seccional estilo Apple para módulos administrativos.
 * Permite alternar entre los elementos activos y la papelera temporal, con opción
 * de vaciado masivo permanente.
 */
export default function SectionTrashToggle({
  isTrashView,
  onToggleView,
  activeCount = 0,
  trashCount = 0,
  onEmptyTrash,
  activeLabel = 'Publicados',
  trashLabel = 'Papelera'
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
      {/* Botones de Selección Activos vs Papelera */}
      <div className="inline-flex p-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-300/60 dark:border-white/5 space-x-1">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onToggleView(false)}
          className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
            !isTrashView
              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-[#00DD9E] text-slate-900 dark:text-[#001E4D] shadow-sm font-black'
              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>{activeLabel}</span>
          <span className={`text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-lg font-black ${
            !isTrashView
              ? 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-[#001E4D]'
              : 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'
          }`}>
            {activeCount}
          </span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onToggleView(true)}
          className={`flex items-center space-x-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
            isTrashView
              ? 'bg-rose-500 text-white shadow-sm font-black'
              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500'
          }`}
        >
          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          <span>{trashLabel}</span>
          <span className={`text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-lg font-black ${
            isTrashView
              ? 'bg-white/20 text-white'
              : trashCount > 0
              ? 'bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-extrabold'
              : 'bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'
          }`}>
            {trashCount}
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Acciones de Papelera cuando está activa */}
      {isTrashView && (
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hidden sm:inline">
            Los elementos en papelera pueden ser restaurados o eliminados definitivamente.
          </span>
          {trashCount > 0 && onEmptyTrash && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onEmptyTrash}
              className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 hover:bg-rose-500 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold border border-rose-500/25 transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Eliminar permanentemente todos los elementos de esta papelera"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Vaciar Papelera</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/AnimatedBackground.jsx

```jsx
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';

/**
 * AnimatedBackground - Fondo Dinámico Oficial con Aros Conic-Gradient & Luces Ambientales Apple
 * Optimizado con aceleración por GPU (Zero Frame Drop / 60-120 FPS) y pausas de scroll inteligentes.
 */
function AnimatedBackground() {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const isDark = theme === 'dark';

  return (
    <div 
      className="background-animado fixed inset-0 w-screen h-screen z-0 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden select-none"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {/* 1. Lienzo Base Adaptativo (--fondo-base) */}
      <div 
        className={`absolute inset-0 transition-colors duration-700 ${
          isDark 
            ? 'bg-[#001026]' 
            : 'bg-[#eef2f5]'
        }`}
      />

      {/* 2. Luces Ambientales Difusas Estilo Apple (Cero Costo de Pintado por GPU) */}
      <div 
        className={`absolute inset-0 transition-opacity duration-1000 ${
          isDark 
            ? 'bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_85%_15%,rgba(0,221,158,0.15),transparent_55%),radial-gradient(circle_at_15%_80%,rgba(0,30,77,0.45),transparent_60%)]' 
            : 'bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_85%_15%,rgba(0,221,158,0.12),transparent_55%),radial-gradient(circle_at_15%_80%,rgba(185,235,255,0.40),transparent_60%)]'
        }`}
      />

      {/* 3. ARO 1: Recorrido diagonal superior con rotación serena */}
      <div className="mover mover-1">
        <div className="aro" />
      </div>

      {/* 4. ARO 2: Recorrido diagonal inferior cruzado */}
      <div className="mover mover-2">
        <div className="aro" />
      </div>

      {/* 5. ARO 3: Aro temporal / fantasma central */}
      <div className="mover mover-3">
        <div className="aro" />
      </div>

      {/* 6. Velo sutil translúcido para integración óptica de capas */}
      <div 
        className={`absolute inset-0 transition-opacity duration-700 ${
          isDark 
            ? 'bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-[#001026]/10 to-[#001026]/30' 
            : 'bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-white/10 to-white/20'
        }`}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default memo(AnimatedBackground);

```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
import { X, Send, Megaphone, Camera, MapPin, Calendar, Clock, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck, Upload, Trash2, Film, Image as ImageIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { getCitizenReportUrl, STATION_INFO } from '../services/api';
import { addCitizenReport } from '../services/reportsService';
import { upsertCitizenContact } from '../services/citizensDirectoryService';
import { addUnifiedContact } from '../services/unifiedContactsService';

export default function CitizenReportModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    citizenName: '',
    citizenId: '',
    phone: '',
    residenceSector: '',
    eventLocation: '',
    referencePoint: '',
    eventDate: new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-VE'),
    eventTime: new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-VE', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
    description: ''
  });
  const [evidenceFiles, setEvidenceFiles] = useState([]);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = (originalOverflow && originalOverflow !== 'hidden') ? originalOverflow : '';
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  };

  const handleEvidenceUpload = (e) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (files.length === 0) return;
    setUploadError('');

    files.slice(0, 4).forEach((file) => {
      const isVideo = file.type.startsWith('video/');
      const isImage = file.type.startsWith('image/');
      if (!isVideo && !isImage) {
        setUploadError('Solo se permiten fotografías (JPG, PNG, WEBP) o videos (MP4, WEBM, MOV).');
        return;
      }
      // Límite razonable para guardar en el sistema interno (localStorage)
      if (file.size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
        setUploadError(`El archivo "${file.name}" supera los 8 MB. Elige una foto o video más corto.`);
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (ev) => {
        const dataUrl = ev.target?.result;
        if (!dataUrl) return;
        setEvidenceFiles((prev) => [
          ...prev.slice(0, 3),
          {
            id: `ev_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
            name: file.name,
            type: isVideo ? 'video' : 'image',
            mimeType: file.type,
            sizeKb: Math.round(file.size / 1024),
            dataUrl
          }
        ]);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const handleRemoveEvidence = (id) => {
    setEvidenceFiles((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
  };

  const handleSend = () => {
    const reportPayload = {
      ...formData,
      hasMedia: evidenceFiles.length > 0,
      evidenceFiles
    };
    try {
      addCitizenReport(reportPayload);
      upsertCitizenContact(reportPayload);
      addUnifiedContact({
        name: formData.citizenName,
        phone: formData.phone,
        cedula: formData.citizenId,
        location: formData.residenceSector || formData.eventLocation,
        origin: 'Denuncia Ciudadana',
        details: formData.description
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Error registrando reporte internamente:', e);
    }
    const url = getCitizenReportUrl(reportPayload);
    window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    setEvidenceFiles([]);
    onClose();
  };

  const modalContent = (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-28 sm:pb-32 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl max-h-[calc(100dvh-130px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-140px)] bg-white dark:bg-[#1d1d1f] border border-[#e6e6e8] dark:border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-lg transition-colors duration-300 my-auto">
        
        {/* Cabecera del Modal */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-[#e6e6e8] dark:border-white/10 bg-[#f5f5f7]/95 dark:bg-[#1d1d1f]/95">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <Emoji3D name="siren" className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 object-contain drop-shadow-[0_8px_16px_rgba(244,63,94,0.35)] flex-shrink-0" alt="Denuncia" />
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 bg-rose-500/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/20">
                  SALA DE REDACCIÓN 105.5 FM
                </span>
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-[#f5f5f7] mt-0.5">
                Reporte de Denuncia Ciudadana
              </h3>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-black/10 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Cerrar modal"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Contenido scrolleable del formulario */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
          
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 leading-relaxed flex items-start space-x-2.5">
            <Emoji3D name="warning" className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 drop-shadow-sm mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-bold">Tu reporte llega directamente a nuestros periodistas y locutores al número oficial <span className="font-mono">{STATION_INFO.whatsapp}</span>.</p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] opacity-90">Al pulsar "Enviar Denuncia", tu reporte y evidencia se registran en la Sala de Prensa y se abrirá WhatsApp automáticamente.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Nota Oficial de Privacidad y Confidencialidad Estricta */}
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/25 text-xs text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 leading-relaxed flex items-start space-x-2.5 shadow-sm">
            <Emoji3D name="shield" className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 drop-shadow-sm mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <p className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                <span>Garantía de Confidencialidad y Privacidad</span>
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 leading-normal">
                Tus datos de identidad, número de teléfono y residencia <strong>no serán difundidos públicamente</strong>; son única y exclusivamente para la recepción, verificación y seguimiento de la denuncia por parte de nuestra sala interna de redacción. <strong>Estos datos no serán compartidos con ninguna persona ni con ninguna autoridad.</strong> Tu privacidad y anonimato al aire están 100% garantizados.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Datos del Ciudadano */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center space-x-1.5">
              <Emoji3D name="user" className="w-4 h-4 drop-shadow-xs" />
              <span>1. Identificación del Denunciante</span>
            </h4>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Nombre y Apellido</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="citizenName"
                  placeholder="Ej: Juan Pérez"
                  value={formData.citizenName}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#001E4D] dark:focus:border-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Cédula de Identidad</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="citizenId"
                  placeholder="Ej: V-12.345.678"
                  value={formData.citizenId}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#001E4D] dark:focus:border-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Número de Teléfono / WhatsApp</label>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  name="phone"
                  placeholder="Ej: +58 412 1234567 o 0412 1234567"
                  value={formData.phone}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#001E4D] dark:focus:border-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Sector o Comunidad donde resides</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="residenceSector"
                  placeholder="Ej: Sector Las Piedras, Santo Domingo"
                  value={formData.residenceSector}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#001E4D] dark:focus:border-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Lugar y Fecha */}
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center space-x-1.5">
              <Emoji3D name="pin" className="w-4 h-4 drop-shadow-xs" />
              <span>2. Lugar y Momento del Acontecimiento</span>
            </h4>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Lugar exacto del hecho</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="eventLocation"
                  placeholder="Ej: Carretera Trasandina, km 4"
                  value={formData.eventLocation}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#001E4D] dark:focus:border-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Punto de referencia</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="referencePoint"
                  placeholder="Ej: Cerca del puente o la escuela"
                  value={formData.referencePoint}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#001E4D] dark:focus:border-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Fecha</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="eventDate"
                  value={formData.eventDate}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Hora aproximada</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  name="eventTime"
                  value={formData.eventTime}
                  onChange={handleChange}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Descripción y Evidencia Fotográfica / Video */}
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center space-x-1.5">
              <Emoji3D name="megaphone" className="w-4 h-4 drop-shadow-xs" />
              <span>3. Descripción de la Denuncia</span>
            </h4>

            <textarea
              rows="3"
              name="description"
              placeholder="Explica qué ocurrió, qué servicios están fallando, derrumbes, averías o situación que amerite atención..."
              value={formData.description}
              onChange={handleChange}
              className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-black/40 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#001E4D] dark:focus:border-[#00DD9E]"
            ></textarea>

            {/* Carga de Evidencia Fotográfica o en Video para el Sistema Interno */}
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-white/[0.04] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                  <Emoji3D name="camera" className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 drop-shadow-xs" />
                  <span>4. Anexar Evidencia Fotográfica o en Video (Opcional)</span>
                </div>

                <label className="inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#001E4D]/85 hover:bg-[#001E4D] dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/20 dark:hover:bg-[#00DD9E]/30 text-white dark:text-[#00DD9E] text-xs font-bold border border-[#001E4D]/25 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/40 cursor-pointer transition shadow-2xs">
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Subir Foto o Video</span>
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*,video/*"
                    multiple
                    onChange={handleEvidenceUpload}
                    className="hidden"
                  />
                </label>
              </div>

              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-snug">
                La evidencia subida se guardará de forma confidencial en el sistema interno de la Sala de Prensa y también podrás adjuntarla en WhatsApp al enviar.
              </p>

              {uploadError && (
                <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                  {uploadError}
                </p>
              )}

              {evidenceFiles.length > 0 && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 pt-1">
                  {evidenceFiles.map((ev) => (
                    <div
                      key={ev.id}
                      className="relative group rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/15 bg-black aspect-video flex flex-col justify-end"
                    >
                      {ev.type === 'video' ? (
                        <video
                          src={ev.dataUrl}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                          muted
                          playsInline
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <img
                          src={ev.dataUrl}
                          alt={ev.name}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                      )}
                      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-black/70 px-2 py-1 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-white">
                        <span className="truncate flex items-center gap-1">
                          {ev.type === 'video' ? <Film className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E] shrink-0" /> : <ImageIcon className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E] shrink-0" />}
                          <span className="truncate">{ev.name}</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleRemoveEvidence(ev.id)}
                        className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 p-1 rounded-full bg-rose-600 text-white hover:bg-rose-500 shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                        title="Quitar archivo"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* Único Botón de Acción: Enviar Denuncia (Guarda en sistema interno y abre WhatsApp +584247459774) */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-t border-[#e6e6e8] dark:border-white/10 bg-[#f5f5f7]/95 dark:bg-[#1d1d1f]/95 flex items-center justify-end">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleSend}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-600/85 hover:bg-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-600/80 dark:hover:bg-rose-500 backdrop-blur-xl text-white text-xs sm:text-sm font-black border border-rose-400/50 transition shadow-md shadow-rose-600/20 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" alt="WhatsApp" />
            <span>Enviar Denuncia</span>
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined'
    ? ReactDOM.createPortal(modalContent, document.body)
    : modalContent;
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  MessageCircle, 
  Radio, 
  MapPin, 
  Phone, 
  Send, 
  Sparkles,
  Heart
} from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { STATION_INFO, WHATSAPP_CONFIG, getSongRequestUrl, getCitizenReportUrl } from '../services/api';
import { addUnifiedContact } from '../services/unifiedContactsService';
import { trackConversionAction } from '../services/analyticsLogger';

export default function ContactSection() {
  const [userName, setUserName] = useState('');
  const [userPhone, setUserPhone] = useState('');
  const [userLocation, setUserLocation] = useState('');
  const [selectedTopic, setSelectedTopic] = useState('Pedir Canción');
  const [userMessage, setUserMessage] = useState('');

  const handleRecordContact = () => {
    try {
      addUnifiedContact({
        name: userName,
        phone: userPhone,
        location: userLocation,
        origin: `Contacto Cabina: ${selectedTopic}`,
        details: userMessage || selectedTopic
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Error registrando contacto:', e);
    }
  };

  const generateWhatsAppUrl = () => {
    handleRecordContact();
    trackConversionAction('whatsapp_cabina', 'Mensaje a Cabina');
    if (selectedTopic === 'Denuncia Ciudadana') {
      return getCitizenReportUrl({
        citizenName: userName,
        phone: userPhone,
        residenceSector: userLocation,
        eventLocation: userLocation,
        description: userMessage
      });
    }

    if (selectedTopic === 'Pedir Canción' || selectedTopic === 'Reporte de Sintonía') {
      return getSongRequestUrl(userMessage, '', userName, userLocation);
    }

    // Caso publicidad o saludo general
    let msg = `¡Hola, Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM! 🎙️\n\n`;
    if (userName) msg += `Mi nombre es: ${userName}\n`;
    if (userLocation) msg += `Los escucho desde: ${userLocation}\n`;
    msg += `Motivo: ${selectedTopic}\n`;
    if (userMessage) msg += `Mensaje: ${userMessage}\n`;
    msg += `\n(Enviado desde la Web App Oficial)`;
    return `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=${WHATSAPP_CONFIG.phoneRaw}&text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`;
  };

  return (
    <section className="py-8">
      {/* Encabezado */}
      <div className="mb-8">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">
          <Emoji3D name="chat" className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Interacción con la Cabina</span>
        </div>
        <h2 className="font-display font-extrabold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
          Contáctanos y Envía tu Mensaje
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
          Comunícate directamente con nuestros locutores en Santo Domingo - Mérida y sé parte de la programación en vivo.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8">
        
        {/* Formulario rápido para WhatsApp Cabina con Alto Contraste */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 glass-panel rounded-2xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-slate-200 dark:border-neblina-border">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3.5 mb-6">
            <Emoji3D name="chat" className="w-10 h-10 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 drop-shadow-md flex-shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Mensaje Directo a Cabina</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Llega al instante al teléfono en vivo de los locutores</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">Tu Nombre o Apodo</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Ej: Carlos Márquez"
                  value={userName}
                  onChange={(e) => setUserName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full aeroglass-subcard border border-white/30 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">¿Desde dónde nos escuchas?</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Ej: Santo Domingo, Mérida, Ejido..."
                  value={userLocation}
                  onChange={(e) => setUserLocation(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full aeroglass-subcard border border-white/30 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="sm:col-span-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">Tu Número de Teléfono o WhatsApp (Opcional)</label>
                <input
                  type="tel"
                  placeholder="Ej: 0414 756 8890"
                  value={userPhone}
                  onChange={(e) => setUserPhone(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full aeroglass-subcard border border-white/30 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">Motivo del Mensaje</label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                {['Pedir Canción', 'Reporte de Sintonía', 'Denuncia Ciudadana', 'Publicidad'].map((topic) => (
                  <button
                    key={topic}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedTopic(topic)}
                    className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition cursor-pointer ${
                      selectedTopic === topic
                        ? 'bg-[#00DD9E] text-[#001E4D] border-white/60 font-bold shadow-sm'
                        : 'aeroglass-subcard text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {topic}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1.5">
                {selectedTopic === 'Pedir Canción' ? 'Canción y Dedicatoria' : selectedTopic === 'Denuncia Ciudadana' ? 'Detalle de la Denuncia' : 'Mensaje o Comentario'}
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows="3"
                placeholder={selectedTopic === 'Pedir Canción' ? 'Escribe aquí el tema que deseas solicitar y para quién va dedicado...' : selectedTopic === 'Denuncia Ciudadana' ? 'Describe detalladamente la situación o acontecimiento (recuerda adjuntar fotos en WhatsApp)...' : 'Escribe aquí tu saludo o comentario...'}
                value={userMessage}
                onChange={(e) => setUserMessage(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full aeroglass-subcard border border-white/30 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
              ></textarea>
            </div>

            <a
              href={generateWhatsAppUrl()}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-extrabold py-3.5 px-6 rounded-lg shadow-lg shadow-emerald-900/40 transition duration-300 transform hover:scale-[1.01]"
            >
              <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0" alt="WhatsApp" />
              <span>Enviar por WhatsApp a Cabina</span>
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tarjetas de Redes Sociales y Datos de la Radio */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6">
          
          {/* Ficha de Transmisión con Contraste */}
          <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200 dark:border-neblina-border">
            <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-4 flex items-center space-x-2.5">
              <Emoji3D name="radio" className="w-6 h-6 flex-shrink-0" alt="Radio" />
              <span>Datos de Transmisión</span>
            </h4>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/5">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Frecuencia Modulada:</span>
                <span className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-black/40 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10">105.5 MHz</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/5">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Ubicación Central:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E]">Santo Domingo - Mérida</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/5">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Cobertura:</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                  <Emoji3D name="pin" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Ubicación" />
                  <span>Andes venezolanos & Streaming Global</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2">
                <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">WhatsApp Oficial:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">+58 424 745 9774</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Redes Sociales Oficiales en Formato 3D Estilo iOS */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <a
              href={STATION_INFO.instagram}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              onClick={() => trackConversionAction('social_instagram', 'Perfil Instagram')}
              className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 rounded-2xl glass-card border border-slate-200 dark:border-neblina-border hover:bg-pink-500/10 transition group shadow-sm"
            >
              <Emoji3D name="instagram" className="w-10 h-10 drop-shadow-md group-hover:scale-115 transition" />
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-2">Instagram</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">@neblina105fm</span>
            </a>

            <a
              href={STATION_INFO.facebook}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              onClick={() => trackConversionAction('social_facebook', 'Página Facebook')}
              className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 rounded-2xl glass-card border border-slate-200 dark:border-neblina-border hover:bg-blue-500/10 transition group shadow-sm"
            >
              <Emoji3D name="facebook" className="w-10 h-10 drop-shadow-md group-hover:scale-115 transition" />
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-2">Facebook</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Neblina Stereo</span>

            <a

            </a>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## src/components/Emoji3D.jsx

```jsx
import React from 'react';

/**
 * MiniIcon & Emoji3D (Apple Design System - Precision Vector Icons)
 * Sistema unificado de micro-iconos vectoriales SVG limpios, de trazo elegante (1.8px),
 * diseñados para corresponder de forma precisa y contextual al texto y función que acompañan.
 */

export const SVG_ICONS = {
  // ==========================================
  // CLIMA & METEOROLOGÍA (ESTRICTAMENTE CONTEXTUAL)
  // ==========================================

  // Sol / Soleado / Despejado
  sun: (props) => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" {...props}>
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
      <path d="M12 2v2" />
      <path d="M12 20v2" />
      <path d="m4.93 4.93 1.41 1.41" />
      <path d="m17.66 17.66 1.41 1.41" />
      <path d="M2 12h2" />
      <path d="M20 12h2" />
      <path d="m6.34 17.66-1.41 1.41" />
      <path d="m19.07 4.93-1.41 1.41" />
    </svg>
  ),

  // Nube / Nublado
  cloud: (props) => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" {...props}>
      <path d="M17.5 19H9a7 7 0 1 1 6.71-9h1.79a4.5 4.5 0 1 1 0 9Z" />
    </svg>
  ),

  // Parcialmente Nublado (Sol tras la nube)
  'cloud-sun': (props) => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" {...props}>
      <path d="M12 2v2" />
      <path d="m4.93 4.93 1.41 1.41" />

export default function MiniIcon({
  name = 'sparkles',
  className = 'w-4 h-4',
  alt = '',
  style = {},
  ...props
}) {
  const cleanKey = (name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const resolvedKey = ICON_ALIASES[cleanKey] || cleanKey;
  const IconComponent = SVG_ICONS[resolvedKey] || SVG_ICONS.sparkles;

  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 select-none align-middle ${className}`}
      style={{
        display: 'inline-flex',
        verticalAlign: '-0.125em',
        ...style
      }}
      aria-label={alt || name}
      role="img"
      {...props}
    >
      <IconComponent className="w-full h-full object-contain" />
    </span>
  );
}

export { MiniIcon as Emoji3D };
```
