## src/components/EventDetailModal.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
import { 
  X, 
  Calendar, 
  Clock, 
  MapPin, 
  Share2, 
  Check, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Sparkles, 
  Ticket, 
  User, 
  Phone,
  Radio,
  Navigation
} from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';

export default function EventDetailModal({ event, onClose }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // Bloqueo controlado de scroll del fondo (body) mientras el modal esté abierto
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!event) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = (originalOverflow && originalOverflow !== 'hidden') ? originalOverflow : '';
    };
  }, [event]);

  // Atajo de teclado Escape para cerrar
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!event) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [event, onClose]);

  if (!event) return null;

  const handleShare = async (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const currentUrl = window.location.href;
    const shareData = {
      title: event.title,
      text: `${event.title} • ${event.dateDisplay || event.date} en ${event.location}. ¡Cartelera oficial de Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM!`,
      url: currentUrl
    };

    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share(shareData);
      } catch (err) {}
    } else {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${shareData.text} ${shareData.url}`);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
    }
  };

  const coordinatorWaUrl = event.coordinatorWhatsApp
    ? `https://wa.me/${event.coordinatorWhatsApp.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')}?text=${encodeURIComponent(
        `¡Hola! Vi el evento "${event.title}" en Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM y deseo información detallada / comprar entradas.`
      )}`
    : null;

  const modalContent = (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-28 sm:pb-32 bg-slate-950/70 dark:bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="event-detail-title"
    >
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001438] border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/15 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-lg transition-colors duration-300 my-auto max-h-[calc(100dvh-120px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-130px)]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        {/* CABECERA DE LA FICHA TÉCNICA DEL EVENTO */}
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        <div className="relative px-4 sm:px-7 pt-4 sm:pt-5 pb-3.5 sm:pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-white/[0.02] flex items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:gap-3">
          
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 sm:space-x-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 sm:space-x-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/30 min-w-0">
              <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E] flex-shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate max-w-[140px] sm:max-w-xs">{event.category || 'Evento Regional'}</span>
            </span>

            <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 flex-shrink-0">
              <Ticket className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{event.isFree ? 'Entrada Libre' : (event.admissionPrice || 'Con Boleto')}</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Botones de acción rápida: Compartir & Cerrar */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 flex-shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={handleShare}
              className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Compartir evento"
              aria-label="Compartir evento"
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Cerrar ficha de evento"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ================================================================= */}
        {/* CUERPO CON SCROLL INTERNO */}
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-7 space-y-5">

          {/* 1. Flyer Oficial del Evento */}
          {event.flyer && (
            <div className="relative w-full aspect-[16/9] sm:aspect-[21/9] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/10 shadow-lg bg-slate-950 group select-none">
              <img 
                src={event.flyer} 
                alt={event.title}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-102"
                loading="eager"
              />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-950/70 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
              
              <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between text-white text-xs">
                <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 font-bold text-[11px] text-[#00DD9E]">
                  Cartelera Oficial
                </span>
                <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-300">
                  Santo Domingo · Mérida
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 2. Título Principal */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex sm:hidden items-center space-x-2 mb-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
                <Ticket className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>{event.isFree ? 'Entrada Libre' : (event.admissionPrice || 'Con Boleto')}</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <h2 id="event-detail-title" className="font-display font-black text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight leading-tight">
              {event.title}
            </h2>
          </div>

          {/* 3. Ficha Clave de Datos: Fecha, Horario y Ubicación */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/[0.04] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="block font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider">Fecha del Evento</span>
                <span className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">
                  {event.dateDisplay || event.date}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {event.time && (
              <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-[#FEDC01] flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="block font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider">Horario de Actividades</span>
                  <span className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">
                    {event.time}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="sm:col-span-2 flex items-start space-x-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-white/5">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-red-500/15 text-red-500 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                <MapPin className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <span className="block font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider">Lugar & Dirección</span>
                <p className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs sm:text-sm mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                  {event.location}
                </p>
                {event.googleMapsUrl && (
                  <a
                    href={event.googleMapsUrl}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] hover:underline mt-1 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Navigation className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Abrir ubicación en Google Maps</span>
                    <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </a>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 4. Descripción Completa */}
          {event.description && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Detalles y Descripción del Evento
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line font-medium bg-slate-50/60 dark:bg-white/[0.02] p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-white/5">
                {event.description}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 5. Coordinador y Organización */}
          {(event.coordinatorName || coordinatorWaUrl) && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl aeroglass-subcard border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Coordinación & Información Oficial</span>
                </p>
                <p className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm mt-0.5 truncate">
                  {event.coordinatorName || 'Comité Organizador'}
                </p>
                {event.coordinatorPhone && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5 font-mono">
                    Tel: {event.coordinatorPhone}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {coordinatorWaUrl && (
                <a
                  href={coordinatorWaUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer flex-shrink-0"
                >
                  <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" alt="WhatsApp" />
                  <span>Contactar Coordinador</span>
                </a>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 6. Enlaces Oficiales (Boletería / Sitio Web) */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-2">
            {event.eventUrl && (
              <a
                href={event.eventUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white dark:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-100 dark:text-slate-950 text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>Sitio Web / Boletería Oficial</span>
                <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </a>
            )}

            {event.googleMapsUrl && (
              <a
                href={event.googleMapsUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-500" />
                <span>Cómo Llegar (GPS)</span>
              </a>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="ml-auto px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cerrar
            </button>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* Sello de Autenticidad en el Pie */}
        <div className="px-5 sm:px-7 py-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-black/20 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          <span className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
            <Radio className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00DD9E]" />
            <span>Cartelera Oficial · Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM</span>
          </span>
          <span>Santo Domingo - Mérida</span>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined'
    ? ReactDOM.createPortal(modalContent, document.body)
    : modalContent;
}
```

## src/components/EventsSection.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Calendar, 
  Clock, 
  MapPin, 
  Tag, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Share2, 
  Search, 
  X, 
  Sparkles, 
  Ticket, 
  User, 
  Phone,
  MessageCircle,
  Radio,
  Check
} from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { getActiveEvents, EVENT_CATEGORIES } from '../services/eventsData';
import EventDetailModal from './EventDetailModal';

function formatCalendarDate(dateString) {
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateString + 'T00:00:00');
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return { day: '--', month: '---' };
    const day = d.getDate();
    const month = d.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { month: 'short' }).toUpperCase().replace('.', '');
    return { day, month };
  } catch (e) {
    return { day: '--', month: '---' };
  }
}

export default function EventsSection() {
  const [events, setEvents] = useState([]);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('Todas');
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState(null);
  const [copiedEventId, setCopiedEventId] = useState(null);

  const reloadEvents = () => {
    setEvents(getActiveEvents());
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    reloadEvents();
    const handleUpdate = () => reloadEvents();
    window.addEventListener('neblina_events_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('neblina_events_updated', handleUpdate);
  }, []);

  const handleShare = async (e, event) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const shareData = {
      title: event.title,
      text: `${event.title} • ${event.dateDisplay || event.date} en ${event.location}. ¡Conoce más en Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM!`,
      url: window.location.href
    };

    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share(shareData);
      } catch (err) {}
    } else {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${shareData.text} ${shareData.url}`);
      setCopiedEventId(event.id);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedEventId(null), 2500);
    }
  };

  const filteredEvents = events.filter((evt) => {
    const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'Todas' || evt.category === selectedCategory;
    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
    const matchesSearch = !term || (
      evt.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      (evt.location && evt.location.toLowerCase().includes(term)) ||
      (evt.description && evt.description.toLowerCase().includes(term)) ||
      (evt.coordinatorName && evt.coordinatorName.toLowerCase().includes(term))
    );
    return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <section className="py-4 space-y-6">
      
      {/* 1. Cabecera Inspirada en CATUREM Eventos y Apple UI */}
      <div className="relative rounded-2xl glass-card p-6 sm:p-10 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute -bottom-24 -left-24 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-[#FEDC01]/08 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="max-w-2xl">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#00DD9E] text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider mb-3 border border-emerald-500/20">
              <Emoji3D name="calendar" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Cartelera" />
              <span>Cartelera Oficial & Agenda Regional</span>
            </div>

            <h2 className="font-display font-black text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
              Eventos en Santo Domingo & Mérida
            </h2>

            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mt-2 leading-relaxed font-medium">
              Descubre las ferias patronales, festivales gastronómicos, competencias deportivas y eventos culturales que hacen vibrar al Páramo andino. Promovido junto a <strong>CATUREM</strong> y la señal de <strong>Neblina 105.5 FM</strong>.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Buscador Rápido de Eventos */}
          <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input 
              type="text"
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Buscar evento, lugar o fecha..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]/40 transition"
            />
            {searchTerm && (
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSearchTerm('')}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Filtros de Categorías */}
        <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center space-x-2 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none pt-6 mt-6 border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10">
          {EVENT_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
            const isSelected = selectedCategory === cat;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
                className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer border ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'bg-[#00DD9E] text-[#001E4D] border-white/60 font-bold shadow-sm'
                    : 'aeroglass-subcard text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {cat}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Grid de Eventos */}
      {filteredEvents.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl glass-card p-12 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 space-y-3">
          <Calendar className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-slate-400 opacity-60" />
          <p className="text-base font-bold">No se encontraron eventos en esta categoría o búsqueda.</p>
          <button 
            onClick={() => { setSelectedCategory('Todas'); setSearchTerm(''); }}
            className="text-xs text-[#0066cc] dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-semibold underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            Ver toda la cartelera
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredEvents.map((event) => {
            const { day, month } = formatCalendarDate(event.date);
            const isOngoing = event.status === 'ongoing';
            const isCompleted = event.status === 'completed';

            const coordinatorWaUrl = event.coordinatorWhatsApp 
              ? `https://wa.me/${event.coordinatorWhatsApp.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')}?text=${encodeURIComponent(`Hola, vi el evento "${event.title}" en Neblina 105.5 FM y quisiera consultar detalles / adquirir entradas.`)}`
              : null;

            return (
              <article 
                key={event.id}
                className="group rounded-2xl glass-card overflow-hidden border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/10 hover:border-emerald-500/40 dark:hover:border-[#00DD9E]/40 transition-all duration-300 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between"
              >
                <div>
                  {/* Flyer Contenedor con Aspecto Vertical 16:10 */}
                  <div 
                    className="relative aspect-[16/10] overflow-hidden bg-slate-900 cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => setSelectedEvent(event)}
                  >
                    <img 
                      src={event.flyer || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514525253161-7a46d19cd819?w=800&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80'} 
                      alt={event.title}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-500"
                      loading="lazy"
                      decoding="async"
                    />

                    {/* Degradado para Legibilidad */}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/20 to-transparent" />

                    {/* Bloque Calendario iOS Flotante */}
                    <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-12 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/30 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-md">
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase text-red-500 tracking-wider">
                        {month}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-display font-black text-lg leading-none mt-0.5">
                        {day}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Estado del Evento */}
                    <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                      {isOngoing && (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-500 text-slate-950 shadow-md">
                          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-950 animate-ping" />
                          <span>Hoy / En Curso</span>
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {event.featuredInHome && !isOngoing && (
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow-md">
                          Destacado
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {isCompleted && (
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase bg-slate-800 text-slate-300">
                          Finalizado
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Barra Inferior del Flyer: Categoría y Precio */}
                    <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between text-white text-xs">
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-[#00DD9E] truncate max-w-[170px]">
                        {event.category}
                      </span>

                      <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold text-amber-300 bg-black/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg backdrop-blur-sm">
                        {event.isFree ? 'Entrada Libre' : event.admissionPrice}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Cuerpo de la Tarjeta */}
                  <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-3">
                    <h3 
                      onClick={() => setSelectedEvent(event)}
                      className="font-display font-black text-lg sm:text-xl text-[#1d1d1f] dark:text-[#f5f5f7] tracking-tight hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-[#00DD9E] transition-colors cursor-pointer line-clamp-2"
                    >
                      {event.title}
                    </h3>

                    {/* Info de Fecha, Hora y Lugar */}
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 flex-shrink-0" />
                        <span className="font-semibold truncate">{event.dateDisplay || event.date}</span>
                      </div>

                      {event.time && (
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                          <span className="truncate">{event.time}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-500 flex-shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">{event.location}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Descripción Corta */}
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed pt-1 font-medium">
                      {event.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Acciones del Evento */}
                <div className="px-5 sm:px-6 pb-5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                    
                    {/* Botón Coordinador / WhatsApp Directo */}
                    {coordinatorWaUrl && (
                      <a
                        href={coordinatorWaUrl}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="hover:scale-120 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                        title="Contactar al coordinador del evento"
                        aria-label="WhatsApp Coordinador"
                      >
                        <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-6.5 h-6.5 drop-shadow-sm" />
                      </a>
                    )}

                    {/* Instagram del Evento */}
                    {event.instagram && (
                      <a
                        href={`https://instagram.com/${event.instagram.replace('@', '')}`}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="hover:scale-120 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                        title="Instagram oficial del evento"
                        aria-label="Instagram"
                      >
                        <Emoji3D name="instagram" className="w-6.5 h-6.5 drop-shadow-sm" />
                      </a>
                    )}

                    {/* Enlace Web del Evento */}
                    {event.eventUrl && (
                      <a
                        href={event.eventUrl}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="hover:scale-120 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                        title="Página web / Boletería oficial"
                        aria-label="Sitio Web"
                      >
                        <Emoji3D name="globe" className="w-6.5 h-6.5 drop-shadow-sm" />
                      </a>
                    )}

                    {/* Botón Compartir Evento */}
                    <button
                      onClick={(e) => handleShare(e, event)}
                      className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center justify-center transition"
                      title="Compartir evento"
                    >
                      {copiedEventId === event.id ? (
                        <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      ) : (
                        <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Ver Detalles */}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSelectedEvent(event)}
                    className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-white/10 dark:text-white hover:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:hover:text-slate-950 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
                  >
                    <Ticket className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Ver Detalles</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. Modal Ficha Técnica de Evento con Portal al Body */}
      {selectedEvent && (
        <EventDetailModal 
          event={selectedEvent} 
          onClose={() => setSelectedEvent(null)} 
        />
      )}

    </section>
  );
}
```

## src/components/HomeBcvBanner.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  RefreshCw, 
  Calculator, 
  ArrowRightLeft, 
  Copy, 
  Check, 
  Building2, 
  DollarSign, 
  Euro, 
  Sparkles 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getCachedBcvRates, fetchLiveBcvRates } from '../services/bcvService';

export default function HomeBcvBanner() {
  const [rates, setRates] = useState(() => getCachedBcvRates());
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [calcOpen, setCalcOpen] = useState(false);

  // Estado de la Calculadora Rápida BCV
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('10');
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState('USD'); // 'USD' | 'EUR'
  const [direction, setDirection] = useState('to_bs'); // 'to_bs' (Divisa -> Bs) | 'from_bs' (Bs -> Divisa)
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const handleRefresh = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const fresh = await fetchLiveBcvRates();
      if (fresh) setRates(fresh);
    } catch (e) {}
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    handleRefresh();
    const onUpdated = (e) => {
      if (e.detail) setRates(e.detail);
      else setRates(getCachedBcvRates());
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_bcv_rates_updated', onUpdated);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('neblina_bcv_rates_updated', onUpdated);
  }, []);

  const numericAmount = parseFloat(String(amount).replace(',', '.')) || 0;
  const activeRate = currency === 'EUR' ? (rates.eur || 1) : (rates.usd || 1);

  const convertedValue = direction === 'to_bs'
    ? numericAmount * activeRate
    : activeRate > 0 ? (numericAmount / activeRate) : 0;

  const formattedResult = direction === 'to_bs'
    ? `${convertedValue.toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} Bs.`
    : `${convertedValue.toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} ${currency}`;

  const handleCopyResult = () => {
    const text = direction === 'to_bs'
      ? `${numericAmount.toFixed(2)} ${currency} = ${formattedResult} (Tasa BCV ${currency}: ${activeRate.toFixed(2)} Bs.)`
      : `${numericAmount.toFixed(2)} Bs. = ${formattedResult} (Tasa BCV ${currency}: ${activeRate.toFixed(2)} Bs.)`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <section aria-label="Indicadores Oficiales BCV y Calculadora" className="w-full">
      <div className="aeroglass-card rounded-2xl px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 sm:py-5 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden">
        {/* Glow sutil */}
        <div className="absolute -right-12 -top-12 w-44 h-44 rounded-full bg-[#00DD9E]/10 blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute -left-12 -bottom-12 w-44 h-44 rounded-full bg-[#001E4D]/10 blur-2xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center gap-3">
          {/* 1. Fila Superior Centrada: Tasa Oficial BCV y Fecha */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-[#001E4D]/85 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/20 text-white dark:text-[#00DD9E] backdrop-blur-md border border-[#001E4D]/25 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/40">
              <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Tasa Oficial BCV</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
              {rates.fechaValor || 'Vigente Hoy'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* 2. Fila Central Centrada: Tasa del Dólar, Tasa del Euro, Botón de Calculadora e Icono de Actualizar */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2.5 sm:gap-3">
            {/* Dólar BCV */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/65 dark:bg-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/15 shadow-xs text-left">
              <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#00DD9E] flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs border border-emerald-500/25">
                $
              </span>
              <div>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300 block leading-none">
                  Dólar USD
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono tabular-nums font-black text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {Number(rates.usd || 0).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} Bs.
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Euro BCV */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/65 dark:bg-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/15 shadow-xs text-left">
              <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-700 dark:text-sky-400 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs border border-blue-500/25">
                €
              </span>
              <div>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300 block leading-none">
                  Euro EUR
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono tabular-nums font-black text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {Number(rates.eur || 0).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} Bs.
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Botón Calculadora Rápida (Aero Glass) */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setCalcOpen(!calcOpen)}
              className={`inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-black backdrop-blur-md transition cursor-pointer border ${
                calcOpen
                  ? 'bg-[#001E4D]/90 text-white dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/85 dark:text-[#001E4D] border-[#001E4D]/40 dark:border-[#00DD9E] shadow-xs'
                  : 'bg-white/65 hover:bg-white/85 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-white border-slate-300/80 dark:border-white/15'
              }`}
            >
              <Calculator className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{calcOpen ? 'Ocultar Calculadora' : 'Calculadora BCV'}</span>
            </button>

            {/* Botón Refrescar Tasa en Vivo al lado de la calculadora */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleRefresh}
              disabled={loading}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/65 hover:bg-white/85 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300/80 dark:border-white/15 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Actualizar tasa BCV en vivo"
              aria-label="Actualizar tasa BCV"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* 3. Fila Inferior Centrada: Referencia del Banco Central de Venezuela en tiempo real */}
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium">
            Referencia cambiaria del Banco Central de Venezuela en tiempo real
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Panel Desplegable: Calculadora Rápida de Conversión BCV */}
        {calcOpen && (
          <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-2.5 items-center bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-[#0c141f]/70 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10">
              
              {/* Selector de Divisa (USD / EUR) */}
              <div className="md:col-span-3 flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCurrency('USD')}
                  className={`flex-1 py-2 px-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-black transition cursor-pointer border ${
                    currency === 'USD'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-500 shadow-2xs'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-white/5 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  $ Dólar (USD)
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setCurrency('EUR')}
                  className={`flex-1 py-2 px-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-black transition cursor-pointer border ${
                    currency === 'EUR'
                      ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 shadow-2xs'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-white/5 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  € Euro (EUR)
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Input de Monto */}
              <div className="md:col-span-3 relative">
                <input
                  type="number"
                  step="any"
                  min="0"
                  value={amount}
                  onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Monto..."
                  aria-label="Monto a convertir"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 pr-14 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#141d28] border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/15 text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]"
                />
                <span className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-400">
                  {direction === 'to_bs' ? currency : 'Bs.'}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Botón Invertir Conversión */}
              <div className="md:col-span-2 flex justify-center">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setDirection(prev => prev === 'to_bs' ? 'from_bs' : 'to_bs')}
                  className="w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-200/80 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/15 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
                  title="Invertir sentido de conversión"
                >
                  <ArrowRightLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{direction === 'to_bs' ? `${currency} → Bs.` : `Bs. → ${currency}`}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Resultado + Botón Copiar */}
              <div className="md:col-span-4 flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2 rounded-lg bg-[#001E4D]/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/15 border border-[#001E4D]/20 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/30">
                <div className="min-w-0 pr-2">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300 block leading-none">
                    Equivalente Oficial BCV
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-black text-sm sm:text-base text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] truncate block">
                    {formattedResult}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleCopyResult}
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md bg-white dark:bg-[#0c141f] text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-[11px] font-bold border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 hover:border-[#00DD9E] transition cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                  title="Copiar cálculo al portapapeles"
                >
                  {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  <span>{copied ? 'Copiado' : 'Copiar'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## src/components/HomeRankingBanner.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchRankingData, fetchArtworkForSong, STATION_INFO } from '../services/api';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';

const FALLBACK_TOP_3 = [
  {
    rank: 1,
    title: "Topic - In My Arms",
    artist: "Mflex Sounds",
    plays: 1,
    badge: "#1 MÁS SONADO"
  },
  {
    rank: 2,
    title: "Sin Voluntad",
    artist: "Gilberto Santa Rosa",
    plays: 1,
    badge: "#2 TENDENCIA"
  },
  {
    rank: 3,
    title: "La que no pasa de moda",
    artist: "Reymusik",
    plays: 1,
    badge: "#3 EN ALZA"
  }
];

export default function HomeRankingBanner({ onOpenRanking }) {
  const [topSongs, setTopSongs] = useState(FALLBACK_TOP_3);
  const [artworks, setArtworks] = useState({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const loadTop3 = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await fetchRankingData('songs', '7d', 3);
        if (!isMounted) return;

        let items = [];
        if (data && data.ok && Array.isArray(data.items) && data.items.length > 0) {
          items = data.items.slice(0, 3).map((item, idx) => ({
            ...item,
            rank: idx + 1,
            badge: idx === 0 ? '#1 MÁS SONADO' : idx === 1 ? '#2 TENDENCIA' : '#3 EN ALZA'
          }));
        } else {
          items = FALLBACK_TOP_3;
        }

        setTopSongs(items);

        // Cargar carátulas en paralelo desde iTunes o el artwork del API
        const artMap = {};
        await Promise.all(
          items.map(async (song) => {
            const key = `${song.artist}-${song.title}`;
            if (song.artwork && song.artwork.startsWith('http')) {
              artMap[key] = song.artwork;
            } else if (song.artist && song.title) {
              const art = await fetchArtworkForSong(song.artist, song.title);
              if (art) {
                artMap[key] = art;
              }
            }
          })
        );

        if (isMounted) {
          setArtworks(artMap);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Error cargando top 3 para HomeRankingBanner:', err);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadTop3();
    const intervalId = setInterval(loadTop3, 45000);
    const onRankingUpdate = () => loadTop3();
    window.addEventListener('neblina_ranking_updated', onRankingUpdate);

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(intervalId);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_ranking_updated', onRankingUpdate);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleClick = () => {
    if (onOpenRanking) {
      onOpenRanking();
    } else {
      window.location.hash = '#ranking';
    }
  };

  const getRankBadgeStyle = (rank) => {
    if (rank === 1) {
      return 'text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-500/25';
    }
    if (rank === 2) {
      return 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/10 border-slate-300 dark:border-white/15';
    }
    return 'text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400 bg-amber-700/15 border-amber-700/25';
  };

  const getCardBorder = (rank) => {
    if (rank === 1) {
      return 'border-amber-400/40 dark:border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-500/[0.04] dark:bg-amber-400/[0.03] hover:border-amber-400';
    }
    if (rank === 2) {
      return 'border-slate-300/60 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-500/[0.03] dark:bg-white/[0.02] hover:border-slate-400 dark:hover:border-white/20';
    }
    return 'border-amber-800/25 dark:border-amber-700/20 bg-amber-800/[0.03] dark:bg-amber-700/[0.02] hover:border-amber-700/40';
  };

  return (
    <div 
      onClick={handleClick}
      role="button"
      tabIndex={0}
      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); handleClick(); } }}
      className="p-3.5 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl aeroglass-card hover:scale-[1.006] transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer flex flex-col group relative overflow-hidden select-none my-2"
      title="Clic para ver el Ranking de Neblina Completo"
    >
      {/* Resplandores ambientales Apple aeroglass */}
      <div className="absolute -top-16 -right-16 w-56 h-56 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none group-hover:scale-125 transition-transform duration-500" />
      <div className="absolute -bottom-16 -left-16 w-56 h-56 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-[#FEDC01]/08 blur-3xl pointer-events-none group-hover:scale-125 transition-transform duration-500" />

      {/* 1. Cabecera del Banner: Distintivo Oficial + Botón Ver Ranking */}
      <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-black/[0.05] dark:border-white/[0.08]">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 min-w-0">
          <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[11px] sm:text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#00DD9E] bg-emerald-500/15 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border border-emerald-500/30 shrink-0">
            <Emoji3D name="musical-notes" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" alt="Ranking de Neblina" />
            <span>RANKING DE NEBLINA · TOP 3</span>
          </span>
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping inline-block shrink-0" title="Al aire" />
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 truncate">
            Lo más sonado de la semana
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Botón Ver Ranking Completo (Efecto Aero Glass) */}
        <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center">
          <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 sm:px-4 sm:py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#001E4D]/75 hover:bg-[#001E4D]/90 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/20 dark:hover:bg-[#00DD9E]/30 backdrop-blur-xl text-white dark:text-[#00DD9E] text-xs font-black border border-[#00DD9E]/45 transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm group-hover:shadow-md whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer">
            <span>Ver Ranking <span className="hidden sm:inline">Completo</span></span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Grid de las 3 Canciones del Podio (1°, 2°, 3°) */}
      <div className="relative z-10 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3.5 pt-3.5">
        {topSongs.map((song, idx) => {
          const rank = song.rank || (idx + 1);
          const medalName = rank === 1 ? 'medal-1st' : rank === 2 ? 'medal-2nd' : 'medal-3rd';
          const artKey = `${song.artist}-${song.title}`;
          const artUrl = artworks[artKey] || (rank === 1 ? STATION_INFO.cover : null);

          return (
            <div
              key={idx}
              className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border backdrop-blur-md transition-all duration-300 flex items-center space-x-3 group/item shadow-xs hover:shadow-md ${getCardBorder(rank)}`}
            >
              {/* Carátula de la Canción con Medalla 3D Oficial */}
              <div className="relative w-13 h-13 sm:w-14 sm:h-14 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-md bg-black/40 shrink-0 group-hover/item:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300">
                {artUrl ? (
                  <img
                    src={artUrl}
                    alt={`${song.title} - ${song.artist}`}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    loading="lazy"
                    decoding="async"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-tr from-slate-800 to-slate-900 text-white">
                    <Emoji3D name="musical-notes" className="w-6 h-6 drop-shadow-sm" alt="Música" />
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Medalla 3D del puesto */}
                <Emoji3D 
                  name={medalName} 
                  className="absolute -top-1.5 -left-1.5 w-6 h-6 drop-shadow-md z-10" 
                  alt={`${rank}° Puesto`} 
                />
              </div>

              {/* Textos de la Canción */}
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-0.5">
                <span className={`inline-block text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border ${getRankBadgeStyle(rank)}`}>
                  {song.badge || `#${rank}`}
                </span>

                <h4 className="font-display font-black text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate group-hover/item:text-[#001E4D] dark:group-hover/item:text-[#00DD9E] transition-colors">
                  {song.title || 'Tema Musical'}
                </h4>

                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 truncate font-semibold">
                  {song.artist || 'Neblina 105.5 FM'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
            <Emoji3D name="sparkles" className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 drop-shadow-xs" />
            <span>La app se abrirá en pantalla completa y con reproductor persistente en la Dynamic Island y pantalla de bloqueo.</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Botón cerrar */}

          onClick={onClose}
          className="w-full py-3 rounded-full bg-[#001E4D] hover:bg-[#002b66] text-[#00DD9E] dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D] font-black text-xs shadow-md transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          Entendido
        </button>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/MixStylePlayer.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Play, 
  Pause, 
  Volume2, 
  VolumeX, 
  RefreshCw, 
  History,
  Radio,
  MessageCircle,
  Maximize2,
  ChevronDown,
  Share2,
  Check
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAudioPlayer } from '../context/AudioPlayerContext';
import { STATION_INFO } from '../services/api';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';

function formatTime(seconds) {
  if (isNaN(seconds) || seconds < 0) return '0:00';
  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const secs = Math.floor(seconds % 60);
  return `${mins}:${secs < 10 ? '0' : ''}${secs}`;
}

export default function MixStylePlayer({ onOpenHistory }) {
  const { 
    isPlaying, 
    isBuffering, 
    playbackType, 
    activePodcast, 
    currentTime,
    duration,
    seekTo,
    volume, 
    isMuted, 
    metadata, 
    currentShow, 
    togglePlay, 
    returnToLive, 
    setVolume, 
    setIsMuted,
    internalStreamServer,
    isNewsBackupActive
  } = useAudioPlayer();

  // Estado para el Reproductor Expandido estilo Spotify (solo para dispositivos móviles)
  const [isMobileExpanded, setIsMobileExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [copiedShare, setCopiedShare] = useState(false);

  // Cerrar vista expandida si la pantalla pasa a escritorio y bloquear el scroll del fondo
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      if (window.innerWidth >= 768 && isMobileExpanded) {
        setIsMobileExpanded(false);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [isMobileExpanded]);

  // Prevenir que el scroll o swipe del móvil mueva o pierda la vista del reproductor expandido
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isMobileExpanded) {
      const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
      const originalTouchAction = document.body.style.touchAction;
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      document.body.style.touchAction = 'none';

      return () => {
        document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
        document.body.style.touchAction = originalTouchAction;
      };
    }
  }, [isMobileExpanded]);

  const isPodcast = playbackType === 'podcast';
  const isNewsBackup = Boolean(isNewsBackupActive || internalStreamServer === 'noticiero102');

  // Carátula del programa activo al aire según la parrilla
  const activeShowCover = currentShow?.image || currentShow?.artwork;

  // Carátula de programa personalizada (excluyendo placeholders o logos previos)
  const hasCustomShowCover = Boolean(
    activeShowCover && 
    !activeShowCover.includes('default.jpg') && 
    !activeShowCover.includes('logo-tight') && 
    !activeShowCover.includes('icon-tight') &&
    activeShowCover !== '/cover-default.png'
  );

  // Carátula real de canción obtenida desde metadatos de la señal o iTunes
  const hasRealSongCover = Boolean(
    metadata?.hasSongCover && 
    metadata.artwork && 
    metadata.artwork !== '/cover-default.png' && 
    metadata.artwork !== '/icon-tight.svg' && 
    metadata.artwork !== '/logo-tight.svg'
  );

  // Prioridad de Carátula solicitada:
  // 1. Si es podcast: carátula del podcast
  // 2. Si se obtuvo el cover de la canción con los metadatos enviados: cover de la canción
  // 3. Cuando no se consigan o no envíen metadatos de la canción:
  //    - Si hay un programa específico al aire con carátula propia personalizada: carátula del programa
  //    - En cualquier otro caso: la nueva carátula oficial por defecto (/cover-default.png)
  const displayImage = isPodcast 
    ? (activePodcast?.cover_url || '/cover-default.png') 
    : (hasRealSongCover 
        ? metadata.artwork 
        : (hasCustomShowCover ? activeShowCover : '/cover-default.png'));

  // Si la metadata es la genérica de la estación, destacar el nombre y locutor del programa al aire
  const isGenericMetadata = !metadata.song || metadata.song.includes('Neblina') || metadata.song.includes('Radio En Vivo');

  const displayTitle = isPodcast 
    ? (activePodcast?.title || 'Podcast') 
    : (isNewsBackup 
        ? 'Noticiero 102 · Emisión en Vivo' 
        : (!isGenericMetadata ? metadata.song : (currentShow?.title || 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM')));

  const displaySubtitle = isPodcast 
    ? (`${activePodcast?.show || 'Podcast'} · ${activePodcast?.author || 'Neblina'}`) 
    : (isNewsBackup
        ? 'Estudio 102.7 FM (Respaldo Oficial) · Retornará a Neblina automáticamente'
        : (!isGenericMetadata 
            ? (currentShow?.title ? `${metadata.artist || '105.5 FM'} · En: ${currentShow.title}` : (metadata.artist ? `${metadata.artist} · 105.5 FM` : 'Santo Domingo - Mérida · En Vivo'))
            : (currentShow?.host ? `Con ${currentShow.host} · 105.5 FM` : 'Santo Domingo - Mérida · En Vivo')));

  const handleShareStream = async () => {
    const shareText = `🎧 Escuchando en vivo: "${displayTitle}" en Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM (Santo Domingo - Mérida)`;
    const shareUrl = window.location.origin;
    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({
          title: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
          text: shareText,
          url: shareUrl
        });
        return;
      } catch {
        // Fallback a portapapeles
      }
    }
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${shareText} ${shareUrl}`);
      setCopiedShare(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedShare(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* REPRODUCTOR EXPANDIDO ESTILO SPOTIFY (SOLO DISPOSITIVOS MÓVILES < md)     */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {isMobileExpanded && (
        <div className="md:hidden fixed inset-0 z-[100] h-[100dvh] w-screen flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden bg-[#060d1a]/95 backdrop-blur-3xl text-white px-5 pt-4 pb-6 animate-fadeIn select-none touch-none overscroll-none">
          {/* Fondo atmosférico dinámico con la carátula difuminada estilo Spotify */}
          <div 
            className="absolute inset-0 opacity-35 blur-3xl scale-125 pointer-events-none bg-center bg-cover transition-all duration-700"
            style={{ backgroundImage: `url(${displayImage})` }}
          />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#001E4D]/60 via-[#040b17]/80 to-[#02060d]/95 pointer-events-none" />

          {/* Barra superior del reproductor Spotify */}
          <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsMobileExpanded(false)}
              className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 backdrop-blur-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Minimizar reproductor"
            >
              <ChevronDown className="w-6 h-6" />
            </button>

            <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-white/65">
                {isPodcast ? 'Reproduciendo Podcast' : 'Transmitiendo desde Santo Domingo'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-black text-[#00DD9E] tracking-wide mt-0.5">
                Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleShareStream}
              className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 backdrop-blur-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Compartir sintonía"
              title="Compartir lo que suena"
            >
              {copiedShare ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00DD9E]" /> : <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Carátula Principal Grande estilo Spotify */}
          <div className="relative z-10 my-auto py-2 flex flex-col items-center">
            <div className="relative w-56 h-56 sm:w-64 sm:h-64 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] border border-white/20 bg-black/40">
              <img
                src={displayImage}
                alt={displayTitle}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                onError={(e) => { e.currentTarget.src = '/cover-default.png'; }}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Badge EN VIVO palpitante con borde rojo en la vista Spotify */}
            <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-center">
              {isPodcast ? (
                <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-400 text-amber-300 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-ping" />
                  <span>Episodio Podcast</span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-red-600/20 border border-red-500 text-white text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm">
                  <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
                    <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-red-500 shadow-[0_0_8px_#ef4444]"></span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-red-100 drop-shadow-xs">
                    {isNewsBackup ? 'Noticiero 102 · En Vivo' : 'En Vivo · 105.5 FM'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Información de la Canción / Programa */}
            <div className="mt-4 w-full text-center px-2">
              <h2 className="font-display font-extrabold text-xl sm:text-2xl text-white leading-tight line-clamp-2">
                {displayTitle}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#00DD9E] mt-1.5 line-clamp-2">
                {displaySubtitle}
              </p>
              {currentShow?.host && !isPodcast && (
                <p className="text-xs text-white/65 mt-1">
                  Locución: {currentShow.host} {currentShow.timeRange ? `• ${currentShow.timeRange}` : ''}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Controles Inferiores estilo Spotify */}
          <div className="relative z-10 space-y-5">
            {/* Barra de progreso o línea de onda en vivo */}
            {isPodcast ? (
              <div>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="0"
                  max={duration > 0 ? duration : 100}
                  step="1"
                  value={currentTime}
                  onChange={(e) => seekTo(parseFloat(e.target.value))}

                  <span>{formatTime(currentTime)}</span>

                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/15 overflow-hidden p-0.5">
                  <div className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${isPlaying ? 'w-full bg-[#00DD9E]' : 'w-1/3 bg-white/30'}`} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-white/60">

              <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 sm:space-x-3">

                {isPodcast ? (

                      105.5 FM
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={onOpenHistory}
                      className="min-w-[36px] min-h-[36px] sm:min-w-[38px] sm:min-h-[38px] p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/45 dark:bg-white/10 border border-white/60 dark:border-white/15 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Ver historial de canciones (Ya Sonó)"
                      aria-label="Historial de canciones"
                    >
                      <Emoji3D name="history" className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 drop-shadow-xs" alt="Historial" />
                    </button>

                    <a
                      href={STATION_INFO.whatsappSongRequestUrl}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="hidden sm:flex min-w-[38px] min-h-[38px] p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/45 dark:bg-white/10 border border-white/60 dark:border-white/15 backdrop-blur-md items-center justify-center hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer"
                      title="Pedir canción o reportar sintonía por WhatsApp (+58 424 745 9774)"
                      aria-label="Pedir canción por WhatsApp"
                    >
                      <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-5 h-5 drop-shadow-xs" alt="WhatsApp" />
                    </a>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Botón exclusivo para Móviles (< md): Agrandar Reproductor estilo Spotify */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsMobileExpanded(true)}
                  className="md:hidden min-w-[36px] min-h-[36px] p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/55 dark:bg-white/15 border border-white/75 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/40 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
                  title="Agrandar reproductor"
                  aria-label="Agrandar reproductor estilo Spotify"
                >
                  <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Newspaper, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Calendar, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchWordPressNews } from '../services/api';
import { getCombinedNews, getCarouselNews } from '../services/newsData';
import NewsModal from './NewsModal';

export default function NewsCarousel() {
  const [news, setNews] = useState(() => getCarouselNews(getCombinedNews(), 9));
  const [currentIndex, setCurrentIndex] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPost, setSelectedPost] = useState(null);

  const timerRef = useRef(null);

  const loadLatestNews = async () => {
    try {
      const wpData = await fetchWordPressNews(1, 9);
      const combined = getCombinedNews(wpData);
      const carousel9 = getCarouselNews(combined, 9);
      if (carousel9 && carousel9.length > 0) {
        setNews(carousel9);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Error loading carousel news:', err);
      const fallback = getCarouselNews(getCombinedNews([]), 9);
      if (fallback.length > 0) setNews(fallback);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLatestNews();
    const refreshInterval = setInterval(loadLatestNews, 60000);

    const handleNewsUpdate = () => {
      loadLatestNews();
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_news_updated', handleNewsUpdate);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(refreshInterval);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_news_updated', handleNewsUpdate);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (news.length <= 1 || isPaused) return;

    timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % news.length);
    }, 4500);

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [news.length, isPaused]);

  const prevSlide = () => {
    setCurrentIndex((prev) => (prev - 1 + news.length) % news.length);
  };

  const nextSlide = () => {
    setCurrentIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % news.length);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full h-80 sm:h-96 rounded-2xl glass-card border border-neblina-border animate-pulse flex items-center justify-center my-6">
        <div className="text-center text-slate-500">
          <Newspaper className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 " />
          <p className="text-xs">Cargando las últimas noticias de neblina105fm.com...</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (news.length === 0) return null;

  const currentPost = news[currentIndex];

  return (
    <div 
      className="relative w-full my-6 select-none"
      onMouseEnter={() => setIsPaused(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setIsPaused(false)}
      onTouchStart={() => setIsPaused(true)}
      onTouchEnd={() => setIsPaused(false)}
    >
      {/* Encabezado del Carrusel */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 px-1">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 inline-block shadow-xs"></span>
          <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center space-x-2">
            <span>Última hora</span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">• 9 notas destacadas</span>
          </h3>
        </div>

        {/* Controles de navegación */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
          <button
            onClick={prevSlide}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-neblina-card dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 transition"
            aria-label="Noticia anterior"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          
          <button
            onClick={nextSlide}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-neblina-card dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 transition"
            aria-label="Siguiente noticia"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Ventana Corrediza / Slider Card con radio Apple de 28px */}
      <div className="relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/10 shadow-lg h-80 sm:h-96 group">
        
        {/* Imagen de Fondo de la Noticia con Fade Suave Apple */}
        <div key={`img-${currentPost.id}`} className="absolute inset-0 anim-tab-enter">
          <img
            src={currentPost.image}
            alt={currentPost.title}
            width="1200"
            height="600"
            decoding="async"
            className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-1000 group-hover:-translate-y-0.5"
            onError={(e) => { 
              e.currentTarget.onerror = null;
              e.currentTarget.src = '/default-cover.png'; 
            }}
          />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/95 via-black/70 to-transparent"></div>
        </div>

        {/* Contenido de la Noticia con Animación de Entrada Fluida */}
        <div key={`content-${currentPost.id}`} className="relative z-10 h-full p-6 sm:p-10 flex flex-col justify-end anim-tab-enter">
          
          <div className="max-w-3xl space-y-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#001E4D]/65 backdrop-blur-xl text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/45 shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]">
                {currentPost.category}
              </span>
              <span className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-xs text-slate-200 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10">
                <Calendar className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                <span>{currentPost.date}</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <h2
              onClick={() => setSelectedPost(currentPost)}
              className="font-display font-black text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl text-white hover:text-[#00DD9E] transition cursor-pointer leading-tight line-clamp-2"
              dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: currentPost.title }}
            />

            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-200 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed max-w-2xl">
              {currentPost.excerpt}
            </p>

            <div className="pt-1">
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedPost(currentPost)}
                className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg bg-white/15 hover:bg-white/25 text-white font-bold text-xs backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>Leer Noticia Completa</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* Indicadores de bolitas (Dots) */}
        <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-6 z-20 flex items-center space-x-2">
          {news.map((_, idx) => (
            <button
              key={idx}
              onClick={() => setCurrentIndex(idx)}
              className={`transition-all duration-300 rounded-full cursor-pointer ${
                currentIndex === idx
                  ? 'w-7 h-2 bg-[#00DD9E]'
                  : 'w-2 h-2 bg-white/30 hover:bg-white/60'
              }`}
              aria-label={`Ir a noticia ${idx + 1}`}
            />
          ))}
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Modal Lector de Noticia con Botones para Compartir */}
      {selectedPost && <NewsModal post={selectedPost} onClose={() => setSelectedPost(null)} />}

    </div>
  );
}
```
