## src/components/NewsSection.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Calendar, 
  RefreshCw, 
  ArrowRight, 
  Share2, 
  Sparkles, 
  Newspaper, 
  Search, 
  X, 
  ChevronLeft, 
  ChevronRight, 
  ChevronsLeft, 
  ChevronsRight,
  Filter,
  CheckCircle2,
  Images,
  Loader2,
  UserCheck,
  Feather
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  fetchWordPressNews, 
  fetchWordPressNewsPaginated, 
  fetchWordPressCategories 
} from '../services/api';
import { getCombinedNews } from '../services/newsData';
import { getAllJournalists, getAllPressNotes } from '../services/journalistsService';
import NewsModal from './NewsModal';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import NewsGridAdSlot from './NewsGridAdSlot';

export default function NewsSection({ isHome = false, limit = 9, onSeeAllNews }) {
  // Paginación y Filtrado Oficial de WordPress (neblina105fm.com)
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState(() => isHome ? getCombinedNews().slice(0, limit) : []);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!isHome);
  const [selectedPost, setSelectedPost] = useState(null);
  
  // Estados para la Sala de Prensa completa (!isHome) en lotes de 10 notas
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(91);
  const [totalPosts, setTotalPosts] = useState(901);
  const [perPage, setPerPage] = useState(10); // Lotes estrictos de 10 notas por página
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategoryId, setSelectedCategoryId] = useState('all');
  const [selectedJournalistId, setSelectedJournalistId] = useState('all');
  const [journalistsList, setJournalistsList] = useState([]);
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([
    { id: 'all', name: 'Todas las Notas', count: 901 },
    { id: 'press_notes', name: 'Notas de Prensa', count: 0, isPressCategory: true },
    { id: 1, name: 'Noticias', count: 486 },
    { id: 5, name: 'Mundo Stereo', count: 255 },
    { id: 9, name: 'Titulares Neblina', count: 127 },
    { id: 3, name: 'Zona Stereo', count: 61 },
    { id: 4, name: 'Estrenos', count: 43 },
    { id: 21, name: 'Es Viral', count: 4 }
  ]);

  const topGridRef = useRef(null);

  // Debounce para búsqueda reactiva
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(searchQuery);
      if (!isHome) {
        setCurrentPage(1); // Volver a página 1 al buscar
      }
    }, 450);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery, isHome]);

  // Cargar lista de periodistas y conteos de notas de prensa
  useEffect(() => {
    const refreshJournalists = () => {
      const list = getAllJournalists().filter(j => j.status === 'active');
      setJournalistsList(list);
      const pressNotes = getAllPressNotes().filter(n => !n.trashed && n.status === 'published');
      setCategories(prev => prev.map(c => c.id === 'press_notes' ? { ...c, count: pressNotes.length } : c));
    };
    refreshJournalists();
    window.addEventListener('neblina_journalists_updated', refreshJournalists);
    window.addEventListener('neblina_press_notes_updated', refreshJournalists);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_journalists_updated', refreshJournalists);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_press_notes_updated', refreshJournalists);
    };
  }, []);

  // Cargar categorías oficiales de WordPress
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isHome) {
      fetchWordPressCategories().then(cats => {
        if (Array.isArray(cats) && cats.length > 0) {
          const pressNotes = getAllPressNotes().filter(n => !n.trashed && n.status === 'published');
          setCategories([
            { id: 'all', name: 'Todas las Notas', count: 901 },
            { id: 'press_notes', name: 'Notas de Prensa', count: pressNotes.length, isPressCategory: true },
            ...cats
          ]);
        }
      }).catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [isHome]);

  // Carga de Noticias para Inicio vs Sala de Prensa
  const loadNews = async (showSpinner = true) => {
    if (showSpinner) setLoading(true);

    try {
      if (isHome) {
        // En Inicio cargamos estrictamente las 9 más recientes
        const wpData = await fetchWordPressNews(1, limit);
        if (wpData && wpData.length > 0) {
          const combined = getCombinedNews(wpData).slice(0, limit);
          setPosts(combined);
        } else {
          setPosts(getCombinedNews().slice(0, limit));
        }
      } else {
        // En Sala de Prensa:
        // Caso A: Si el usuario seleccionó "Notas de Prensa" o filtró por un periodista específico
        if (selectedCategoryId === 'press_notes' || selectedJournalistId !== 'all') {
          const allPress = getAllPressNotes().filter(n => !n.trashed && n.status === 'published');
          let filtered = allPress.map(n => ({
            id: n.id,
            title: n.title,
            excerpt: n.excerpt,
            content: n.content,
            category: n.category || 'Notas de Prensa',
            author: n.journalistName,
            date: n.date,
            image: n.image,
            images: n.images || (n.image ? [n.image] : []),
            isPressNote: true,
            journalistId: n.journalistId,
            journalistRole: n.journalistRole,
            link: '#'
          }));

          if (selectedJournalistId !== 'all') {
            filtered = filtered.filter(n => n.journalistId === selectedJournalistId);
          }

          if (debouncedSearch && debouncedSearch.trim()) {
            const q = debouncedSearch.toLowerCase();
            filtered = filtered.filter(n => 
              (n.title && n.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
              (n.excerpt && n.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
              (n.author && n.author.toLowerCase().includes(q))
            );
          }

          const total = filtered.length;
          const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / perPage));
          const start = (currentPage - 1) * perPage;
          const paginated = filtered.slice(start, start + perPage);

          setPosts(paginated);
          setTotalPosts(total);
          setTotalPages(pages);
        } else {
          // Caso B: Paginación estándar de WordPress con notas locales combinadas
          const result = await fetchWordPressNewsPaginated({
            page: currentPage,
            perPage: perPage,
            search: debouncedSearch,
            categoryId: selectedCategoryId === 'all' ? null : selectedCategoryId
          });

          if (result && result.posts && result.posts.length > 0) {
            setPosts(result.posts);
            setTotalPosts(result.totalPosts || 901);
            setTotalPages(result.totalPages || Math.ceil((result.totalPosts || 901) / perPage));
          } else if (debouncedSearch || selectedCategoryId !== 'all') {
            setPosts([]);
            setTotalPosts(0);
            setTotalPages(1);
          } else {
            // Fallback a noticias iniciales
            const localFallback = getCombinedNews();
            setPosts(localFallback);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Error cargando noticias de WordPress:', e);
      if (posts.length === 0) {
        setPosts(getCombinedNews().slice(0, isHome ? limit : 12));
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadNews(true);

    const handleNewsUpdate = () => {
      loadNews(false);
    };

    window.addEventListener('neblina_news_updated', handleNewsUpdate);
    window.addEventListener('neblina_press_notes_updated', handleNewsUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_news_updated', handleNewsUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_press_notes_updated', handleNewsUpdate);
    };
  }, [isHome, currentPage, debouncedSearch, selectedCategoryId, selectedJournalistId, perPage]);

  // Manejo de cambio de página con desplazamiento suave hacia el inicio del grid
  const handlePageChange = (newPage) => {
    if (newPage < 1 || newPage > totalPages || newPage === currentPage) return;
    setCurrentPage(newPage);
    if (topGridRef.current) {
      topGridRef.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
  };

  // Generador inteligente de botones de paginación estilo Apple
  const renderPaginationButtons = () => {
    const buttons = [];
    const maxVisiblePages = 5;

    let startPage = Math.max(1, currentPage - 2);
    let endPage = Math.min(totalPages, startPage + maxVisiblePages - 1);

    if (endPage - startPage < maxVisiblePages - 1) {
      startPage = Math.max(1, endPage - maxVisiblePages + 1);
    }

    if (startPage > 1) {
      buttons.push(
        <button
          key={1}
          onClick={() => handlePageChange(1)}
          className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-white dark:bg-[#111923] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 transition"
        >
          1
        </button>
      );
      if (startPage > 2) {
        buttons.push(
          <span key="dots-start" className="px-1 text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs">
            •••
          </span>
        );
      }
    }

    for (let p = startPage; p <= endPage; p++) {
      const isActive = p === currentPage;
      buttons.push(
        <button
          key={p}
          onClick={() => handlePageChange(p)}
          className={`w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition cursor-pointer ${
            isActive
              ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D] shadow-md scale-105 border border-[#00DD9E]/50'
              : 'bg-white dark:bg-[#001E4D]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          {p}
        </button>
      );
    }

    if (endPage < totalPages) {
      if (endPage < totalPages - 1) {
        buttons.push(
          <span key="dots-end" className="px-1 text-slate-400 font-bold text-xs">
            •••
          </span>
        );
      }
      buttons.push(
        <button
          key={totalPages}
          onClick={() => handlePageChange(totalPages)}
          className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-white dark:bg-[#111923] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 transition"
        >
          {totalPages}
        </button>
      );
    }

    return buttons;
  };

  return (
    <section className="py-4" ref={topGridRef}>
      {/* Encabezado Principal */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
        
        {/* Fila Superior: Título + Contador + Botón Actualizar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <Emoji3D 
              name="newspaper" 
              className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 object-contain drop-shadow-[0_8px_16px_rgba(0,30,77,0.3)] hover:scale-110 transition-transform shrink-0" 
              alt="Noticias" 
            />
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h2 className="font-display font-extrabold text-base sm:text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                  {isHome ? 'Últimas Noticias' : 'Sala de Prensa & Noticias'}
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/30">
                  {isHome ? '9 Recientes' : `${totalPosts} Publicaciones`}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {isHome 
                  ? 'Información veraz y al instante desde Santo Domingo, Mérida y Venezuela'
                  : 'Archivo completo de notas de prensa oficiales sincronizadas con neblina105fm.com'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Acciones de Cabecera */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 self-start sm:self-auto">
            {isHome && onSeeAllNews && (
              <button
                onClick={onSeeAllNews}
                className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#001E4D] dark:bg-[#00DD9E] text-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D] text-xs font-black hover:opacity-90 transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>Ver todas las noticias</span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={() => loadNews(true)}
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#001E4D]/80 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs font-bold border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer"
              title="Sincronizar con neblina105fm.com"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Sincronizar</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Fila Secundaria para la Página Dedicada: Buscador en Tiempo Real + Selector de Categorías */}
        {!isHome && (
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
            {/* Buscador Rápido con Input Apple */}
            <div className="relative max-w-xl">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Buscar entre las 901 noticias (título, lugar, suceso)..."
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-10 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001438] border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/25 text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder:text-slate-400 text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E] shadow-sm transition"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Categorías Oficiales de WordPress en Pills Desplazables */}
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none flex-1">
                {categories.map((cat) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedCategoryId === cat.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={cat.id}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedCategoryId(cat.id);
                        setCurrentPage(1);
                      }}
                      className={`shrink-0 flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-black transition cursor-pointer ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-[#00DD9E] dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D] shadow-sm'
                          : 'bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-[#001E4D] dark:hover:text-[#00DD9E] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {cat.isPressCategory && <Feather className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      <span>{cat.name}</span>
                      {cat.count !== undefined && (
                        <span className={`text-[11px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-lg font-bold ${
                          isSelected 
                            ? 'bg-white/20 text-[#00DD9E] dark:bg-[#001E4D]/20 dark:text-[#001E4D]' 
                            : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'
                        }`}>
                          {cat.count}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              {/* Selector Filtro por Periodista (Aero Glass) */}
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 shrink-0 self-start md:self-auto">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E]" />
                  <span>Periodista:</span>
                </span>
                <select
                  value={selectedJournalistId}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setSelectedJournalistId(e.target.value);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                  }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#001438] text-slate-800 dark:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/30 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#00DD9E] shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="all">Todos los Periodistas</option>
                  {journalistsList.map(j => (
                    <option key={j.id} value={j.id}>
                      {j.name} ({j.role || 'Redactor'})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Grid de Noticias (3 Columnas Desktop, 2 Tablet, 1 Móvil) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
        {loading ? (
          // Skeleton Loader de Alta Fidelidad
          Array.from({ length: isHome ? 9 : 6 }).map((_, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className="rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#0c1b29] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 p-4 animate-pulse">
              <div className="w-full h-44 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/5 rounded-2xl mb-4"></div>
              <div className="h-4 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 rounded w-1/3 mb-2"></div>
              <div className="h-5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 rounded w-3/4 mb-3"></div>
              <div className="h-3 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/5 rounded w-full mb-1"></div>
              <div className="h-3 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/5 rounded w-2/3"></div>
            </div>
          ))
        ) : posts.length === 0 ? (
          // Estado Vacío con sugerencia de búsqueda
          <div className="col-span-full text-center py-16 bg-white dark:bg-[#0c141f] rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 px-4">
            <Emoji3D name="newspaper" className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-3 drop-shadow-md opacity-70" alt="Noticias" />
            <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-800 dark:text-white mb-1">
              No se encontraron notas de prensa
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto mb-4">
              {debouncedSearch 
                ? `No hay resultados para "${debouncedSearch}". Intenta con otra palabra clave.`
                : 'No hay notas disponibles en esta categoría actualmente.'}
            </p>
            {debouncedSearch && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 dark:bg-white text-white dark:text-slate-900 text-xs font-bold transition hover:opacity-90"
              >
                Limpiar Búsqueda
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          // Render de Tarjetas de Noticias
          <>
            {posts.map((post) => (
              <article
                key={post.id}
                className="group rounded-2xl glass-card overflow-hidden hover:border-[#00DD9E]/60 transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col hover:shadow-xl shadow-sm"
              >
                {/* Imagen Destacada */}
                <div 
                  className="relative h-44 overflow-hidden bg-slate-900 cursor-pointer"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPost(post)}
                >
                  <img
                    src={post.image}
                    alt={post.title}
                    loading="lazy"
                    decoding="async"
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-500"
                    onError={(e) => { 
                      e.currentTarget.onerror = null;
                      e.currentTarget.src = '/default-cover.png'; 
                    }}
                  />
                  <span className="absolute top-3 left-3 bg-[#001E4D]/65 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/70 backdrop-blur-xl px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/45 shadow-[0_4px_14px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]">
                    {post.category}
                  </span>

                  {/* Badge de Nota de Prensa Oficial Redactada por Periodista */}
                  {post.isPressNote && (
                    <span className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 bg-[#001E4D]/85 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/20 backdrop-blur-md px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black text-white dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/40 flex items-center space-x-1 shadow-sm">
                      <Feather className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                      <span>Nota de Prensa</span>
                    </span>
                  )}

                  {/* Badge de Fotos Múltiples para Carrusel */}
                  {post.images && post.images.length > 1 && (
                    <span className="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold text-white border border-white/20 flex items-center space-x-1 shadow-sm">
                      <Images className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                      <span>{post.images.length} fotos</span>
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Contenido de la Tarjeta */}
                <div className="p-5 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mb-2">
                      <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E]" />
                      <span>{post.date}</span>
                      {post.author && (
                        <>
                          <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-white/20">·</span>
                          <span className="truncate max-w-[140px] font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {post.author}
                          </span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <h3 
                      onClick={() => setSelectedPost(post)}
                      className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white group-hover:text-[#00DD9E] dark:group-hover:text-[#00DD9E] transition-colors cursor-pointer line-clamp-2 mb-2 leading-snug"
                    >
                      {post.title}
                    </h3>

                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed mb-4">
                      {post.excerpt}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setSelectedPost(post)}
                      className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-black text-xs hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <span>Leer Noticia</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>

                    <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      neblina105fm.com
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}

            {/* Banner Publicitario en la Cuadrícula para rellenar espacios vacíos (3 columnas en escritorio) */}
            {posts.length > 0 && (posts.length % 3 !== 0) && (
              <NewsGridAdSlot colSpanLg={3 - (posts.length % 3)} />
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Barra de Paginación Completa (Solo en la Sala de Prensa completa !isHome) */}
      {!isHome && totalPages > 1 && (
        <div className="mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
          {/* Indicador de Rango de Noticias en Lotes de 10 */}
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 text-center sm:text-left">
            Mostrando lote de 10 notas · Página <span className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{currentPage}</span> de <span className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{totalPages}</span> ({totalPosts} notas en total)
          </div>

          {/* Controles de Paginación */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 overflow-x-auto max-w-full pb-1">
            {/* Primera Página */}
            <button
              onClick={() => handlePageChange(1)}
              disabled={currentPage === 1}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001E4D]/80 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition"
              title="Primera Página"
            >
              <ChevronsLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            {/* Página Anterior */}
            <button
              onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage - 1)}
              disabled={currentPage === 1}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001E4D]/80 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition"
              title="Página Anterior"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            {/* Números de Página */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
              {renderPaginationButtons()}
            </div>

            {/* Página Siguiente */}
            <button
              onClick={() => handlePageChange(currentPage + 1)}
              disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001E4D]/80 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition"
              title="Página Siguiente"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            {/* Última Página */}
            <button
              onClick={() => handlePageChange(totalPages)}
              disabled={currentPage === totalPages}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001E4D]/80 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed transition"
              title="Última Página"
            >
              <ChevronsRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Botón Ver Más en Inicio */}
      {isHome && onSeeAllNews && (
        <div className="mt-8 text-center">
          <button
            onClick={onSeeAllNews}
            className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-[#001E4D]/75 hover:bg-[#001E4D]/90 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/20 dark:hover:bg-[#00DD9E]/30 backdrop-blur-xl text-white dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-extrabold text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-[#001E4D]/15 dark:shadow-[#00DD9E]/15 hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all cursor-pointer border border-[#00DD9E]/45"
          >
            <Newspaper className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Visitar sala de prensa</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Lector con Botones para Compartir y Embeds de Redes Sociales */}
      {selectedPost && <NewsModal post={selectedPost} onClose={() => setSelectedPost(null)} />}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
import { Bell, BellRing, X, Check, AlertCircle, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { 
  requestNotificationPermission, 
  getNotificationPermission, 
  sendTestNotification 
} from '../services/notificationService';

export default function NotificationModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const [permission, setPermission] = useState('default');
  const [testing, setTesting] = useState(false);
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setPermission(getNotificationPermission());
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Bloqueo de scroll cuando el modal está abierto
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = (originalOverflow && originalOverflow !== 'hidden') ? originalOverflow : '';
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleActivate = async () => {
    const res = await requestNotificationPermission();
    setPermission(res);
    if (res === 'granted') {
      setSuccessMsg('¡Notificaciones activadas exitosamente!');
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessMsg(''), 4000);
    }
  };

  const handleTest = async () => {
    setTesting(true);
    const sent = await sendTestNotification();
    setTesting(false);
    if (sent) {
      setSuccessMsg('¡Notificación de prueba enviada a tu dispositivo!');
      setTimeout(() => setSuccessMsg(''), 4000);
    }
  };

  const isGranted = permission === 'granted';

  const modalContent = (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-28 sm:pb-32 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-white dark:bg-[#0c1b29] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 max-h-[calc(100dvh-130px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-140px)] overflow-y-auto my-auto">
        
        {/* Encabezado */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <Emoji3D 
              name="bell" 
              className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 object-contain drop-shadow-sm flex-shrink-0" 
              alt="Alertas" 
            />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-black text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Alertas y Notificaciones
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Contenido */}
        <div className="py-5 space-y-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
            Recibe avisos inmediatos en tu teléfono, computadora o Smart TV cada vez que se publique una <strong>noticia de última hora</strong>, reportes viales del Páramo o cambios de programación en vivo.
          </p>

          {/* Estado actual */}
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="text-xs">
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Estado en este dispositivo:</span>
              <p className={`text-[11px] font-semibold mt-0.5 ${isGranted ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'}`}>
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">{isGranted ? <><Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Notificaciones Habilitadas</> : <><AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Notificaciones Pendientes</>}</span>
              </p>
            </div>

            {!isGranted && (
              <button
                onClick={handleActivate}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900 text-xs font-bold shadow-sm hover:opacity-90"
              >
                Activar
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {successMsg && (
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500 flex-shrink-0" />
              <span>{successMsg}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Botón de prueba para el administrador/usuario */}
          <div className="pt-2">
            <button
              onClick={handleTest}
              disabled={testing}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-3 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00DD9E] to-[#00b4d8] text-[#001E4D] font-black text-xs shadow-md shadow-[#00DD9E]/20 hover:opacity-95 transition"
            >
              <Emoji3D name="sparkles" className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" alt="Prueba" />
              <span>{testing ? 'Enviando alerta...' : 'Enviar Notificación de Prueba'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-2 text-center">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white transition"
          >
            Cerrar Ventana
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined'
    ? ReactDOM.createPortal(modalContent, document.body)
    : modalContent;
}
```

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import { Headphones, Play, Pause, Clock, User, Radio, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { PODCASTS_DATA } from '../services/api';
import { useAudioPlayer } from '../context/AudioPlayerContext';

export default function PodcastsSection() {
  const { 
    playbackType, 
    activePodcast, 
    isPlaying, 
    playPodcast, 
    returnToLive 
  } = useAudioPlayer();

  return (
    <section className="py-8">
      {/* Encabezado */}
      <div className="mb-8">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#00DD9E] text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">
          <Emoji3D name="headphones" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Podcasts" />
          <span>Contenido a la Carta</span>
        </div>
        <h2 className="font-display font-extrabold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
          Podcasts y Entrevistas Exclusivas
        </h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
          Escucha reportajes especiales, entrevistas de salud y programas grabados en el reproductor principal.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Grid de Podcasts */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        {PODCASTS_DATA.map((pod) => {
          const isCurrentPodcast = playbackType === 'podcast' && activePodcast?.id === pod.id;
          const isThisPlaying = isCurrentPodcast && isPlaying;

          return (
            <div
              key={pod.id}
              className={`p-6 rounded-2xl glass-card border transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-6 items-center ${
                isCurrentPodcast
                  ? 'border-[#00DD9E] dark:border-[#00DD9E] ring-2 ring-[#00DD9E]/30 dark:ring-[#00DD9E]/30 shadow-xl shadow-[#00DD9E]/10 bg-teal-500/10 dark:bg-[#0d1611]'
                  : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-neblina-border/80 hover:border-[#00DD9E]/40 dark:hover:border-white/20'
              }`}
            >
              {/* Imagen del podcast */}
              <div className="relative w-36 h-36 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0 bg-neblina-dark border border-white/10 group">
                <img
                  src={pod.cover_url}
                  alt={pod.title}
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition duration-500"
                />
                
                {/* Botón Play flotante sobre la imagen que activa el reproductor unificado */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => playPodcast(pod)}
                  className={`absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 hover:bg-black/20 transition cursor-pointer ${
                    isThisPlaying ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-90'
                  }`}
                  aria-label={isThisPlaying ? 'Pausar Podcast' : 'Reproducir Podcast'}
                >
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#00DD9E] to-[#00b4d8] text-[#001E4D] flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-[#00DD9E]/30 transform hover:scale-110 transition">
                    {isThisPlaying ? (
                      <Pause className="w-6 h-6 fill-current" />
                    ) : (
                      <Play className="w-6 h-6 fill-current ml-0.5" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Información */}
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 text-center sm:text-left">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">
                    <span className="bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg font-bold border border-[#00DD9E]/30">
                      {pod.category}
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                      <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                      <span>{pod.duration} min</span>
                    </span>
                    <span>• {pod.date}</span>
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-snug">
                    {pod.title}
                  </h3>

                  <p className="text-xs text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-bold">
                    {pod.show} • Con {pod.author}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                  {pod.description}
                </p>

                <div className="pt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => playPodcast(pod)}
                    className={`inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-black transition cursor-pointer ${
                      isThisPlaying
                        ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00DD9E] to-[#00b4d8] text-[#001E4D] shadow-md shadow-[#00DD9E]/30'
                        : 'bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-neblina-card text-slate-800 dark:text-white hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isThisPlaying ? (
                      <>
                        <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                        <span>Pausar Episodio</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
                        <span>Reproducir en Reproductor</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>

                  {/* Botón rápido para volver a la radio en vivo si este podcast está activo */}
                  {isCurrentPodcast && (
                    <button
                      onClick={returnToLive}
                      className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-red-600/80 hover:bg-red-600 text-white text-xs font-bold transition shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <Radio className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Volver a En Vivo</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X, ShieldCheck, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { registerPrivateVisit } from '../services/analyticsLogger';

export default function PrivacyConsentModal() {
  const [detailsOpen, setDetailsOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Aceptación directa e inmediata sin interrumpir al usuario
    localStorage.setItem('neblina_privacy_consent', 'accepted');
    registerPrivateVisit({ privacyAccepted: true });

    // 2. Escuchar evento bajo demanda si el usuario hace clic en Privacidad desde el footer
    const handleOpenPrivacy = () => {
      setDetailsOpen(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_open_privacy_modal', handleOpenPrivacy);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_open_privacy_modal', handleOpenPrivacy);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      {/* Modal Informativo Detallado (Bajo Demanda desde el Footer o Ajustes) */}
      {detailsOpen && (
        <div 
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-28 sm:pb-32 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200"
          onClick={(e) => {
            if (e.target === e.currentTarget) setDetailsOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-white dark:bg-[#1d1d1f] border border-[#e6e6e8] dark:border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden p-6 shadow-lg transition-colors duration-300 max-h-[calc(100dvh-130px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-140px)] overflow-y-auto my-auto">
            
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
                <Emoji3D name="shield" className="w-6 h-6 drop-shadow-sm flex-shrink-0" />
                <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Privacidad & Términos Oficiales
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setDetailsOpen(false)}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-[#86868b] leading-relaxed">
              <p>
                En <strong>Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM</strong> respetamos y protegemos la privacidad de nuestros oyentes.
              </p>
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-200/60 dark:border-emerald-800/30 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 text-xs">
                <Lock className="inline w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 -mt-0.5" /><strong>Garantía de Confidencialidad:</strong> Tus datos de sintonía, reportes ciudadanos y solicitudes no serán compartidos con ninguna persona, empresa ni ente de seguridad.
              </div>
              <p>
                Al navegar en nuestra Web App, disfrutas de una experiencia optimizada para streaming continuo, libre de publicidad invasiva y con almacenamiento local seguro en tu dispositivo.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => setDetailsOpen(false)}
              className="w-full mt-5 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900 font-bold text-xs shadow-sm transition hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Cerrar
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Trophy, 
  Music, 
  Mic2, 
  TrendingUp, 
  TrendingDown, 
  Sparkles, 
  Minus, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Share2, 
  Check, 
  ExternalLink,
  Flame,
  Award,
  Play,
  Clock,
  Calendar,
  ListMusic
} from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchRankingData, fetchArtworkForSong, STATION_INFO, getSongRequestUrl } from '../services/api';
import { 
  buildHybridRanking, 
  getRankingYoutubePlaylist, 
  checkAndPromoteQueuedPlaylist, 
  extractYouTubeEmbedInfo,
  DEFAULT_YOUTUBE_RECOMMENDED_TRACKS,
  getNextSlotDate
} from '../services/rankingService';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';

// Las 4 categorías principales solicitadas para el Ranking Musical
const RANKING_TABS = [
  {
    id: '24h_songs',
    label: 'Canción Más Sonada (24h)',
    shortLabel: 'Canciones 24h',
    apiType: 'songs',
    apiPeriod: '24h',
    icon: Music,
    badge: 'Últimas 24 Horas'
  },
  {
    id: '24h_artists',
    label: 'Artista Más Sonado (24h)',
    shortLabel: 'Artistas 24h',
    apiType: 'artists',
    apiPeriod: '24h',
    icon: Mic2,
    badge: 'Artistas del Día'
  },
  {
    id: 'weekly',
    label: 'Top 10 de la Semana',
    shortLabel: 'Top 10 Semanal',
    apiType: 'songs',
    apiPeriod: '7d',
    icon: Flame,
    badge: 'Conteo Semanal (7 Días)'
  },
  {
    id: 'monthly',
    label: 'Top 10 Mensual',
    shortLabel: 'Top 10 Mensual',
    apiType: 'songs',
    apiPeriod: '30d',
    icon: Trophy,
    badge: 'Conteo Mensual (30 Días)'
  }
];

export default function RankingSection() {
  const [activeTabId, setActiveTabId] = useState('24h_songs');
  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [artworks, setArtworks] = useState({});
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState(null);

  // Estado de la Playlist Oficial de YouTube (única plataforma en Recomendaciones)
  const [playlistConfig, setPlaylistConfig] = useState(() => checkAndPromoteQueuedPlaylist());
  const [selectedTrack, setSelectedTrack] = useState(null); // null = reproducir URL de playlist configurada, o un tema específico

  const currentTab = RANKING_TABS.find(t => t.id === activeTabId) || RANKING_TABS[0];
  const activeType = currentTab.apiType; // 'songs' | 'artists'

  // Cargar datos del ranking combinando API en vivo + detector de streaming
  const loadRanking = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await fetchRankingData(currentTab.apiType, currentTab.apiPeriod, 15);
      const apiItems = data && data.ok && Array.isArray(data.items) ? data.items : [];
      const top10 = buildHybridRanking(apiItems, activeTabId);
      setItems(top10);
      loadArtworks(top10, currentTab.apiType);
    } catch (e) {
      const fallbackTop10 = buildHybridRanking([], activeTabId);
      setItems(fallbackTop10);
      loadArtworks(fallbackTop10, currentTab.apiType);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRanking();
  }, [activeTabId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handlePlaylistUpdated = () => {
      setPlaylistConfig(checkAndPromoteQueuedPlaylist());
      setSelectedTrack(null);
    };
    const handleRankingUpdated = () => {
      loadRanking();
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_youtube_playlist_updated', handlePlaylistUpdated);
    window.addEventListener('neblina_ranking_updated', handleRankingUpdated);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_youtube_playlist_updated', handlePlaylistUpdated);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_ranking_updated', handleRankingUpdated);
    };
  }, [activeTabId]);

  // Obtener carátulas HD de iTunes para canciones o artistas
  const loadArtworks = async (rankingItems, type) => {
    for (const item of rankingItems.slice(0, 10)) {
      const artist = item.artist || '';
      const title = type === 'songs' ? (item.title || '') : '';
      const key = `${artist}-${title}`;
      if (item.artwork && !artworks[key]) {
        setArtworks(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: item.artwork }));
      }
      fetchArtworkForSong(artist, title).then(art => {
        if (art && !art.includes('cover-default')) {
          setArtworks(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: art }));
        }
      });
    }
  };

  const handleCopy = (id, text) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
  };

  const top1 = items[0];
  const top2 = items[1];
  const top3 = items[2];
  const restItems = items.slice(3, 10);

  // Construir URL del iframe de YouTube
  const embedInfo = extractYouTubeEmbedInfo(playlistConfig.currentUrl);
  const activeEmbedUrl = selectedTrack
    ? `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${selectedTrack.videoId}?autoplay=1&rel=0`
    : embedInfo.embedUrl;

  const nextSwitchDate = getNextSlotDate(playlistConfig.scheduledSlot || 'lunes_12');
  const nextSwitchStr = nextSwitchDate.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', {
    weekday: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit'
  });

  // Renderizar indicador de tendencia
  const renderTrend = (trend) => {
    if (!trend) return null;
    if (trend.is_new || trend.state === 'new') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-pink-500/15 text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400 border border-pink-500/25">
          <Emoji3D name="sparkles" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" alt="Nuevo" />
          <span>NUEVO</span>
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (trend.state === 'up') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/25">
          <TrendingUp className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
          <span>▲ {trend.delta || ''}</span>
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (trend.state === 'down') {
      return (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/25">
          <TrendingDown className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
          <span>▼ {trend.delta || ''}</span>
        </span>
      );
    }
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
        <Minus className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
        <span>ESTABLE</span>
      </span>
    );
  };

  return (
    <section className="py-4 space-y-6 sm:space-y-8 animate-in fade-in duration-300">
      
      {/* 1. Encabezado Hero Aero Glass */}
      <div className="glass-card p-6 sm:p-8 relative overflow-hidden border border-[#e6e6e8] dark:border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-sm">
        
        {/* Glows de Degradados Leves iOS */}
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-amber-400/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute -bottom-24 -left-24 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-500 text-white shadow-sm">
                <Emoji3D name="musical-notes" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Ranking de Neblina" />
                <span>RANKING OFICIAL · NEBLINA 105.5 FM</span>
              </span>
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping"></span>
            </div>
            
            <h1 className="font-display font-black text-2xl sm:text-4xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
              Ranking Musical · Lo Más Sonado
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 max-w-2xl leading-relaxed font-medium">
              Monitoreo automático en tiempo real de las canciones y artistas con mayor rotación en las últimas 24 horas, el Top 10 de la Semana y el conteo Mensual de Neblina Stereo.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Botón Refrescar */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <button
              onClick={loadRanking}
              disabled={loading}
              className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/15 text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-xs font-bold border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 transition shadow-sm cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Actualizar Ranking en Tiempo Real"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
              <span>Actualizar</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Selector de las 4 Categorías de Ranking (24h Canciones, 24h Artistas, Top 10 Semana, Top 10 Mensual) */}
        <div className="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
            {RANKING_TABS.map((tab) => {
              const Icon = tab.icon;
              const isSelected = activeTabId === tab.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={tab.id}
                  onClick={() => setActiveTabId(tab.id)}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-left transition-all cursor-pointer border ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-[#001E4D] text-white dark:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:text-[#001E4D] border-[#001E4D] dark:border-[#00DD9E] shadow-md scale-[1.01]'
                      : 'bg-white/80 dark:bg-white/5 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-white/10 border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 min-w-0">
                    <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                      isSelected
                        ? 'bg-white/15 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/15'
                        : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10'
                    }`}>
                      <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-xs font-black truncate">{tab.label}</p>
                      <p className={`text-[11px] font-semibold truncate ${
                        isSelected ? 'text-white/80 dark:text-[#001E4D]/80' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'
                      }`}>
                        {tab.badge}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Podio TOP 3 Espectacular (1° Oro Centro, 2° Plata Izquierda, 3° Bronce Derecha) */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
            <div key={i} className="h-64 rounded-2xl glass-card animate-pulse border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : items.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="glass-card p-12 text-center rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
          <Emoji3D name="musical-notes" className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-3 drop-shadow-md opacity-70" alt="Ranking de Neblina" />
          <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Sin datos en este periodo</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Prueba seleccionando otro rango de tiempo o actualiza en unos minutos.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 items-end">
          
          {/* #2 Puesto - Plata (Izquierda) */}
          {top2 && (
            <div className="order-2 md:order-1 glass-card p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-300/80 dark:border-slate-400/25 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col items-center text-center shadow-md hover:scale-[1.01] transition-transform">
              <Emoji3D name="medal-2nd" className="absolute top-3 left-3 w-9 h-9 drop-shadow-md z-10" alt="2° Puesto" />
              <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 mb-2">
                <Emoji3D name="medal-2nd" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Plata" />
                <span>Medalla de Plata · #2</span>
              </span>
              
              <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20 mb-3 bg-black/40">
                <img 
                  src={artworks[`${top2.artist}-${activeType === 'songs' ? (top2.title || '') : ''}`] || top2.artwork || STATION_INFO.cover} 
                  alt={top2.artist}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                />
              </div>

              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white line-clamp-1">
                {activeType === 'songs' ? top2.title : top2.artist}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 line-clamp-1 mb-2 font-medium">
                {activeType === 'songs' ? top2.artist : `${top2.unique_titles || 1} temas distintos en rotación`}
              </p>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-auto">
                <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                  {top2.plays || top2.total_plays} {activeType === 'songs' ? 'reproducciones' : 'veces al aire'}
                </span>
                {renderTrend(top2.trend)}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* #1 Puesto - Oro (Centro, Más Elevado y Prominente) */}
          {top1 && (
            <div className="order-1 md:order-2 glass-card p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl border-2 border-amber-400/70 dark:border-amber-400/50 bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-500/10 via-transparent to-transparent relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col items-center text-center shadow-xl hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform md:-translate-y-2">
              <Emoji3D name="medal-1st" className="absolute top-3 left-3 w-11 h-11 drop-shadow-lg z-10" alt="1° Puesto" />

              <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 mb-3">
                <Emoji3D name="medal-1st" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Oro" />
                <span>NÚMERO 1 · {currentTab.shortLabel.toUpperCase()}</span>
              </div>
              
              <div className="w-32 h-32 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg border-2 border-amber-400/80 mb-4 bg-black/40 ring-4 ring-amber-400/20">
                <img 
                  src={artworks[`${top1.artist}-${activeType === 'songs' ? (top1.title || '') : ''}`] || top1.artwork || STATION_INFO.cover} 
                  alt={top1.artist}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                />
              </div>

              <h2 className="font-display font-black text-lg sm:text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white line-clamp-1">
                {activeType === 'songs' ? top1.title : top1.artist}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold line-clamp-1 mb-3">
                {activeType === 'songs' ? top1.artist : `${top1.unique_titles || 1} canciones distintas en rotación`}
              </p>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-auto">
                <span className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-black bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-yellow-400 text-slate-950 shadow-sm">
                  {top1.plays || top1.total_plays} {activeType === 'songs' ? 'reproducciones' : 'veces al aire'}
                </span>
                {renderTrend(top1.trend)}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* #3 Puesto - Bronce (Derecha) */}
          {top3 && (
            <div className="order-3 md:order-3 glass-card p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl border border-amber-700/40 dark:border-amber-600/30 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col items-center text-center shadow-md hover:scale-[1.01] transition-transform">
              <Emoji3D name="medal-3rd" className="absolute top-3 left-3 w-9 h-9 drop-shadow-md z-10" alt="3° Puesto" />
              <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-500 mb-2">
                <Emoji3D name="medal-3rd" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Bronce" />
                <span>Medalla de Bronce · #3</span>
              </span>
              
              <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg border border-amber-700/30 dark:border-white/20 mb-3 bg-black/40">
                <img 
                  src={artworks[`${top3.artist}-${activeType === 'songs' ? (top3.title || '') : ''}`] || top3.artwork || STATION_INFO.cover} 
                  alt={top3.artist}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                />
              </div>

              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white line-clamp-1">
                {activeType === 'songs' ? top3.title : top3.artist}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 line-clamp-1 mb-2 font-medium">
                {activeType === 'songs' ? top3.artist : `${top3.unique_titles || 1} temas distintos en rotación`}
              </p>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-auto">
                <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                  {top3.plays || top3.total_plays} {activeType === 'songs' ? 'reproducciones' : 'veces al aire'}
                </span>
                {renderTrend(top3.trend)}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4. Lista de Posiciones Restantes del Top 10 (Puestos 4 al 10) */}
      {restItems.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 pt-2">
            <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-[#f5f5f7] flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Emoji3D name="fire" className="w-4 h-4 drop-shadow-xs" alt="Tendencia" />
              <span>Conteo Oficial · Puestos #4 al #{items.length} ({currentTab.label})</span>
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#86868b]">
              Sincronizado con la señal en vivo
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl border border-[#e6e6e8] dark:border-white/10 divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-white/5 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
            {restItems.map((item, idx) => {
              const rankNum = idx + 4;
              const title = activeType === 'songs' ? (item.title || 'Tema Musical') : item.artist;
              const subtitle = activeType === 'songs' ? item.artist : `${item.unique_titles || 1} canciones emitidas`;
              const plays = item.plays || item.total_plays;
              const artKey = `${item.artist}-${activeType === 'songs' ? (item.title || '') : ''}`;
              const artUrl = artworks[artKey] || item.artwork || STATION_INFO.cover;

              return (
                <div 
                  key={idx}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 sm:p-4 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors duration-150 gap-3"
                >
                  {/* Puesto y Carátula */}
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 sm:space-x-4 min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <span className="w-6 sm:w-8 text-center font-display font-black text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                      #{rankNum}
                    </span>

                    <div className="w-11 h-11 sm:w-12 sm:h-12 rounded-xl overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-black/40">
                      <img 
                        src={artUrl} 
                        alt={title}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        loading="lazy"
                        decoding="async"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="font-display font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                        {title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-medium truncate">
                        {subtitle}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Reproducciones y Tendencia */}
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 flex-shrink-0">
                    <span className="hidden sm:inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-[#f5f5f7]">
                      {plays} {activeType === 'songs' ? 'reproducciones' : 'veces'}
                    </span>

                    {renderTrend(item.trend)}

                    {/* Copiar Info */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(rankNum, `${title} - ${subtitle}`)}
                      className="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
                      title="Copiar nombre del tema"
                    >
                      {copiedId === rankNum ? (
                        <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      ) : (
                        <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      )}
                    </button>

                    {/* Solicitar canción / complacencia por WhatsApp */}
                    <a
                      href={getSongRequestUrl(title, activeType === 'songs' ? subtitle : '')}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="p-2 hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer drop-shadow-xs"
                      title="Solicitar este tema a cabina por WhatsApp (+58 424 745 9774)"
                    >
                      <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-4 h-4" alt="WhatsApp" />
                    </a>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 5. RECOMENDACIONES EN NEBLINA — EXCLUSIVAMENTE YOUTUBE PLAYLIST EMBEBIDA EN LA PÁGINA */}
      <div className="glass-card p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-2xl border border-[#e6e6e8] dark:border-white/10 shadow-md relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-72 h-72 rounded-full bg-red-500/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 space-y-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 pb-4">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-red-600 text-white text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow-xs">
                <Emoji3D name="youtube" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" alt="YouTube" />
                <span>Recomendaciones en Neblina · Playlist Oficial YouTube</span>
              </div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-black text-xl sm:text-2xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {playlistConfig.currentTitle || 'Selección Musical de la Semana en YouTube'}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium">
                Escucha y disfruta la lista oficial recomendada por nuestros locutores directamente aquí, sin salir de la página.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#008f7a] dark:text-[#00DD9E]" />
                <span>Renovación semanal: {nextSwitchStr}</span>
              </span>

              {playlistConfig.queuedUrl && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-bold border border-emerald-500/30">
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Próxima Playlist en Cola Lista</span>
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Reproductor Embebido de YouTube + Selector Rápido de Temas */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-5 items-stretch">
            {/* Iframe Embebido (Reproduce dentro de la misma página) */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-7 xl:col-span-8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/15 bg-black shadow-lg aspect-video relative">
              <iframe
                key={activeEmbedUrl}
                src={activeEmbedUrl}
                title="Playlist Oficial Recomendada - Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM"
                className="w-full h-full"
                allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"
                allowFullScreen
              />
            </div>

            {/* Lista Interactiva de Canciones de la Playlist para cambiar sin abrir otra pestaña */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-5 xl:col-span-4 flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-white/[0.04] border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/10 p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  <ListMusic className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                  <h3 className="font-display font-black text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Reproducir aquí mismo
                  </h3>
                </div>
                {selectedTrack && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSelectedTrack(null)}
                    className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#008f7a] dark:text-[#00DD9E] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Ver Playlist Completa
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 overflow-y-auto max-h-64 pr-1">
                {DEFAULT_YOUTUBE_RECOMMENDED_TRACKS.map((track, idx) => {
                  const isPlayingThis = selectedTrack?.id === track.id;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={track.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedTrack(track)}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl text-left transition cursor-pointer border ${
                        isPlayingThis
                          ? 'bg-red-600 text-white border-red-500 shadow-sm'
                          : 'bg-white/90 dark:bg-white/5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 min-w-0 pr-2">
                        <span className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-black shrink-0 ${
                          isPlayingThis ? 'bg-white text-red-600' : 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400'
                        }`}>
                          {isPlayingThis ? <Play className="w-3 h-3 fill-current" /> : idx + 1}
                        </span>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <p className="text-xs font-bold truncate">{track.title}</p>
                          <p className={`text-[11px] truncate ${isPlayingThis ? 'text-white/80' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400'}`}>
                            {track.artist}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className={`text-[11px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0 px-2 py-0.5 rounded ${
                        isPlayingThis ? 'bg-black/20 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300'
                      }`}>
                        {track.duration}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>

              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                  <span>Actualización automática semanal</span>
                </span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">YouTube Oficial</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </section>
  );
}
```
