## src/components/ScheduleSection.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Calendar, Clock, User, Radio, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { getCurrentLiveShow } from '../services/api';
import { getAllSchedule } from '../services/scheduleData';

export default function ScheduleSection() {
  const [scheduleList, setScheduleList] = useState(getAllSchedule());
  const currentShow = getCurrentLiveShow();
  const [filterDay, setFilterDay] = useState('all'); // 'all' | 'weekdays' | 'weekend'

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleUpdate = () => {
      setScheduleList(getAllSchedule());
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_schedule_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('neblina_schedule_updated', handleUpdate);
  }, []);

  const daysLabel = {
    1: 'Lun', 2: 'Mar', 3: 'Mié', 4: 'Jue', 5: 'Vie', 6: 'Sáb', 7: 'Dom'
  };

  const activeShows = scheduleList.filter(show => show.active !== false);

  const filteredSchedule = activeShows.filter(show => {
    if (filterDay === 'weekdays') {
      return (show.days || []).some(d => d >= 1 && d <= 5);
    }
    if (filterDay === 'weekend') {
      return (show.days || []).some(d => d === 6 || d === 7);
    }
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <section className="py-8">
      {/* Encabezado */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 mb-8">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-[#00DD9E] text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">
            <Emoji3D name="clock" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Parrilla" />
            <span>Parrilla Radial</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="font-display font-extrabold text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            Programación Oficial
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-medium">
            Los mejores locutores y producciones en la señal de Neblina 105.5 FM · Santo Domingo, Mérida
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Filtros de días con alto contraste */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/5 p-1 rounded-2xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 self-start sm:self-auto shadow-sm">
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilterDay('all')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              filterDay === 'all'
                ? 'bg-[#00DD9E] text-[#001E4D] font-bold shadow-sm border border-white/40'
                : 'aeroglass-subcard text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            Toda la Semana
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilterDay('weekdays')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              filterDay === 'weekdays'
                ? 'bg-[#00DD9E] text-[#001E4D] font-bold shadow-sm border border-white/40'
                : 'aeroglass-subcard text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            Lunes a Viernes
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilterDay('weekend')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
              filterDay === 'weekend'
                ? 'bg-[#00DD9E] text-[#001E4D] font-bold shadow-sm border border-white/40'
                : 'aeroglass-subcard text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            Fines de Semana
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Grid de Programas */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {filteredSchedule.map((prog) => {
          const isLiveNow = currentShow.id === prog.id;

          return (
            <div
              key={prog.id}
              className={`relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden glass-card transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col justify-between border ${
                isLiveNow
                  ? 'border-[#00DD9E] ring-2 ring-[#00DD9E]/50 shadow-lg shadow-[#00DD9E]/20'
                  : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 hover:border-[#00DD9E]/40'
              }`}
            >
              {/* Imagen del programa */}
              <div className="relative h-44 overflow-hidden bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/30">
                <img
                  src={prog.image}
                  alt={prog.title}
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  onError={(e) => { 
                    e.currentTarget.onerror = null;
                    e.currentTarget.src = '/default-cover.png'; 
                  }}
                />

                {/* Badge Al Aire si está en vivo */}
                {isLiveNow && (
                  <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 flex items-center space-x-1.5 bg-[#00DD9E] backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[#001E4D] text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#001E4D] animate-ping"></span>
                    <span>AL AIRE AHORA</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Horario */}
                <div className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 flex items-center space-x-1.5 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-white text-xs font-mono font-bold border border-white/10">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                  <span>{prog.startTime} - {prog.endTime}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Detalles */}
              <div className="p-6 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div>
                  {/* Días de emisión */}
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 mb-2">
                    {prog.days.map((d) => (
                      <span
                        key={d}
                        className="text-[11px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/5 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/5"
                      >
                        {daysLabel[d]}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-1">
                    {prog.title}
                  </h3>

                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-bold mb-3">
                    <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Conduce: {prog.host}</span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed line-clamp-3">
                    {prog.description}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4 mt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-semibold">Neblina 105.5 FM</span>
                  {isLiveNow && (
                    <span className="text-[#00DD9E] font-bold flex items-center space-x-1">
                      <Radio className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Transmitiendo</span>
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## src/components/SongHistoryModal.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
import { History, X, Music, Radio } from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { useAudioPlayer } from '../context/AudioPlayerContext';

export default function SongHistoryModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const { metadata } = useAudioPlayer();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = (originalOverflow && originalOverflow !== 'hidden') ? originalOverflow : '';
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const historyList = (metadata && Array.isArray(metadata.history)) ? metadata.history : [];

  const modalContent = (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-28 sm:pb-32 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg max-h-[calc(100dvh-130px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-140px)] bg-white dark:bg-[#1d1d1f] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-lg transition-colors duration-300 my-auto">
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/40">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <Emoji3D name="history" className="w-8 h-8 drop-shadow-md flex-shrink-0" alt="Historial" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-[#1d1d1f] dark:text-[#f5f5f7]">Historial de Canciones</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Temas emitidos recientemente en la 105.5 FM</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full hover:bg-black/10 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Cerrar modal"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Lista de temas */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-white/5 space-y-1">
          {historyList.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-10">
              <Emoji3D name="musical-notes" className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 drop-shadow-md" alt="Música" />
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Cargando historial de canciones...</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            historyList.map((item, idx) => {
              const song = item?.song || item || {};
              const rawTitle = typeof song === 'object' ? (song.title || song.song || 'Tema Musical') : song;
              const title = typeof rawTitle === 'string' ? rawTitle : 'Tema Musical';
              const rawArtist = typeof song === 'object' ? (song.artist || 'Neblina 105.5 FM') : 'Neblina 105.5 FM';
              const artist = typeof rawArtist === 'string' ? rawArtist : 'Neblina 105.5 FM';

              return (
                <div key={idx} className="flex items-center space-x-3 py-3 first:pt-0">
                  <span className="w-6 text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                    {idx + 1}
                  </span>
                  
                  <Emoji3D name="musical-note" className="w-7 h-7 flex-shrink-0 drop-shadow-sm" alt="Canción" />

                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-[#1d1d1f] dark:text-[#f5f5f7] truncate">
                      {title}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                      {artist}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-black/40 text-center">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/15 text-[#1d1d1f] dark:text-white text-xs font-bold transition border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 cursor-pointer"
          >
            Cerrar Historial
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined'
    ? ReactDOM.createPortal(modalContent, document.body)
    : modalContent;
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
import { 
  X, 
  MapPin, 
  Phone, 
  Globe, 
  ChevronLeft, 
  ChevronRight, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Sparkles, 
  UtensilsCrossed,
  Share2,
  Check,
  Building2,
  Navigation
} from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';

// Iconos vectoriales de redes
const InstagramIcon = ({ className = 'w-4 h-4' }) => (

  </svg>
);

const FacebookIcon = ({ className = 'w-4 h-4' }) => (
  <svg className={className} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
    <path d="M24 12.073c0-6.627-5.373-12-12-12s-12 5.373-12 12c0 5.99 4.388 10.954 10.125 11.854v-8.385H7.078v-3.47h3.047V9.43c0-3.007 1.792-4.669 4.533-4.669 1.312 0 2.686.235 2.686.235v2.953H15.83c-1.491 0-1.956.925-1.956 1.874v2.25h3.328l-.532 3.47h-2.796v8.385C19.612 23.027 24 18.062 24 12.073z"/>
  </svg>
);

const TikTokIcon = ({ className = 'w-4 h-4' }) => (
  <svg className={className} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
    <path d="M12.525.02c1.31-.02 2.61-.01 3.91-.02.08 1.53.63 3.09 1.75 4.17 1.12 1.11 2.7 1.62 4.24 1.79v4.03c-1.44-.05-2.89-.35-4.2-.97-.57-.26-1.1-.59-1.62-.93-.01 2.92.01 5.84-.02 8.75-.08 1.4-.54 2.79-1.35 3.94-1.31 1.92-3.58 3.17-5.91 3.21-1.43.08-2.86-.31-4.08-1.03-2.02-1.19-3.44-3.37-3.65-5.71-.02-.5-.03-1-.01-1.49.18-1.9 1.12-3.72 2.58-4.96 1.66-1.44 3.98-2.13 6.15-1.72.02 1.48-.04 2.96-.04 4.44-.99-.32-2.15-.23-3.02.37-.63.41-1.11 1.04-1.36 1.75-.21.51-.24 1.07-.14 1.61.24 1.64 1.82 3.02 3.5 2.87 1.12-.01 2.19-.66 2.77-1.61.19-.33.4-.67.41-1.06.1-1.79.06-3.57.07-5.36.01-4.03-.01-8.05.02-12.07z"/>
  </svg>
);

export default function SponsorDetailModal({ sponsor, onClose }) {
  const [activePhotoIdx, setActivePhotoIdx] = useState(0);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const autoSlideTimerRef = useRef(null);

  // Lista de fotos del marco
  const photos = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!sponsor) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(sponsor.photos) && sponsor.photos.length > 0) {
      return sponsor.photos.filter(p => p && typeof p === 'string' && p.trim().length > 0);
    }
    // Si no tiene fotos explícitas, usar el logo o una foto por defecto
    if (sponsor.logo) return [sponsor.logo];
    return [];
  }, [sponsor]);

  // Rotación automática de fotos cada 3.5 segundos
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sponsor || photos.length <= 1 || isPaused) return;

    autoSlideTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setActivePhotoIdx(prev => (prev + 1) % photos.length);
    }, 3500);

    return () => {
      if (autoSlideTimerRef.current) clearInterval(autoSlideTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, [sponsor, photos.length, isPaused]);

  // Reiniciar índice de fotos cuando cambia el sponsor
  useEffect(() => {
    setActivePhotoIdx(0);
  }, [sponsor?.id]);

  // Bloqueo de scroll controlado: se activa SOLO cuando el modal está abierto
  // y restaura siempre el scroll limpio en el cleanup
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sponsor) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = (originalOverflow && originalOverflow !== 'hidden') ? originalOverflow : '';
    };
  }, [sponsor]);

  // Atajo de teclado Escape para cerrar
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!sponsor) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [sponsor, onClose]);

  if (!sponsor) return null;

  const isRestaurant = sponsor.category && (
    sponsor.category.toLowerCase().includes('restaurante') ||
    sponsor.category.toLowerCase().includes('gastronom') ||
    sponsor.category.toLowerCase().includes('café') ||
    sponsor.category.toLowerCase().includes('comida')
  );

  const hasDigitalMenu = !!(sponsor.menuUrl && sponsor.menuUrl.trim());

  // Mensaje de WhatsApp
  const cleanPhone = (sponsor.whatsapp || '584247459774').replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
  const contactMsg = encodeURIComponent(
    `¡Hola, ${sponsor.name}! Los encontré a través del Directorio de Aliados de Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM y quisiera consultar sobre sus servicios e información.`
  );
  const waUrl = `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=${cleanPhone}&text=${contactMsg}`;

  // Copiar enlace de ficha técnica
  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    const url = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname + `?aliado=${encodeURIComponent(sponsor.name)}`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2200);
  };

  const nextPhoto = (e) => {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    setActivePhotoIdx(prev => (prev + 1) % photos.length);
  };

  const prevPhoto = (e) => {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    setActivePhotoIdx(prev => (prev - 1 + photos.length) % photos.length);
  };

  const modalContent = (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-28 sm:pb-32 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="sponsor-detail-title"
    >
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001438] border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/15 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-lg transition-colors duration-300 my-auto max-h-[calc(100dvh-120px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-130px)]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        {/* CABECERA DE LA FICHA TÉCNICA */}
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        <div className="relative px-5 sm:px-7 pt-5 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-white/[0.02] flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 min-w-0">
            {/* Logo / Emblema Cuadrado */}
            <div className="w-12 h-12 sm:w-14 sm:h-14 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 bg-white dark:bg-black/30 flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center p-1 shadow-sm">
              {sponsor.logo ? (
                <img 
                  src={sponsor.logo} 
                  alt={sponsor.name} 
                  className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                  onError={(e) => {
                    e.target.style.display = 'none';
                    e.target.nextSibling.style.display = 'flex';
                  }}
                />
              ) : null}
              <div 
                style={{ display: sponsor.logo ? 'none' : 'flex' }}
                className="w-full h-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#001E4D] to-[#00DD9E] text-white items-center justify-center font-black text-sm"
              >
                {sponsor.name.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 flex-wrap gap-y-1">
                <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/30">
                  <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                  <span>{sponsor.category || 'Aliado Comercial'}</span>
                </span>
                {sponsor.rif && (
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
                    RIF: {sponsor.rif}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <h2 id="sponsor-detail-title" className="font-display font-black text-base sm:text-lg md:text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate mt-0.5">
                {sponsor.name}
              </h2>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Botones Superiores: Copiar enlace & Cerrar */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 flex-shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={handleCopyLink}
              className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Copiar enlace de esta ficha técnica"
              aria-label="Copiar enlace"
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Cerrar ficha técnica"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ================================================================= */}
        {/* CUERPO CON SCROLL INTERNO DE LA FICHA */}
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-7 space-y-6">

          {/* 1. MARCO DE FOTOS CON DESLIZAMIENTO AUTOMÁTICO */}
          {photos.length > 0 && (
            <div 
              className="relative w-full aspect-[16/9] sm:aspect-[21/9] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/10 shadow-lg bg-slate-950 group select-none"
              onMouseEnter={() => setIsPaused(true)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setIsPaused(false)}
              onTouchStart={() => setIsPaused(true)}
              onTouchEnd={() => setIsPaused(false)}
            >
              {/* Fotos */}
              {photos.map((photoUrl, idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className={`absolute inset-0 transition-opacity duration-700 ease-in-out ${
                    idx === activePhotoIdx ? 'opacity-100 z-10' : 'opacity-0 z-0 pointer-events-none'
                  }`}
                >
                  <img
                    src={photoUrl}
                    alt={`${sponsor.name} - Foto ${idx + 1}`}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    loading="lazy"
                  />
                  {/* Gradiente sutil inferior para legibilidad */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
                </div>
              ))}

              {/* Botón Anterior */}
              {photos.length > 1 && (
                <button
                  onClick={prevPhoto}
                  className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-black/50 hover:bg-black/80 text-white backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center opacity-80 sm:opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all cursor-pointer border border-white/20"
                  aria-label="Foto anterior"
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Botón Siguiente */}
              {photos.length > 1 && (
                <button
                  onClick={nextPhoto}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-black/50 hover:bg-black/80 text-white backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center opacity-80 sm:opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all cursor-pointer border border-white/20"
                  aria-label="Foto siguiente"
                >
                  <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              )}

              {/* Indicadores de Puntos (Dots) */}
              {photos.length > 1 && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20 flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10">
                  {photos.map((_, dotIdx) => (
                    <button
                      key={dotIdx}
                      onClick={() => setActivePhotoIdx(dotIdx)}
                      className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        dotIdx === activePhotoIdx 
                          ? 'w-5 bg-[#00DD9E]' 
                          : 'w-1.5 bg-white/50 hover:bg-white/80'
                      }`}
                      aria-label={`Ver foto ${dotIdx + 1}`}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Badge Contador de Fotos */}
              {photos.length > 1 && (
                <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 z-20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md text-[11px] font-bold text-white border border-white/15">
                  {activePhotoIdx + 1} / {photos.length}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 2. SLOGAN & DESCRIPCIÓN DEL ESTABLECIMIENTO */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {sponsor.slogan && (
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-[#00DD9E] flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                <span>“{sponsor.slogan}”</span>
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed space-y-2">
              <p>
                {sponsor.description || 'Aliado comercial certificado y verificado por la directiva de Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM. Servicio con garantía de calidad y atención preferencial para nuestra audiencia en toda la región andina.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 3. BOTÓN DESTACADO DE MENÚ DIGITAL (SI ES RESTAURANTE O TIENE MENÚ) */}
          {(hasDigitalMenu || isRestaurant) && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/30 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 w-full sm:w-auto">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-[#001E4D] flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 shadow-sm font-black">
                  <UtensilsCrossed className="w-5 h-5" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-display font-black text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {hasDigitalMenu ? 'Menú Digital Disponible' : 'Carta & Especialidades'}
                  </h4>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                    {hasDigitalMenu 
                      ? 'Explora los platillos, precios y especialidades gastronómicas.'
                      : 'Solicita la carta y platillos del día vía WhatsApp oficial.'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {hasDigitalMenu ? (
                <a
                  href={sponsor.menuUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="w-full sm:w-auto inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 active:scale-95 text-[#001E4D] text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer flex-shrink-0"
                >
                  <UtensilsCrossed className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Ver Menú Digital</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </a>
              ) : (
                <a
                  href={`${waUrl}&text=${encodeURIComponent(`¡Hola, ${sponsor.name}! Deseo consultar su menú y platillos disponibles.`)}`}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="w-full sm:w-auto inline-flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer flex-shrink-0"
                >
                  <UtensilsCrossed className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Pedir Menú</span>
                </a>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 4. SECCIÓN DE UBICACIÓN & CÓMO LLEGAR */}
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/[0.03] border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500" />
                <h4 className="font-display font-black text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Ubicación & Referencias
                </h4>
              </div>

              {/* Botón Google Maps */}
              {sponsor.googleMapsUrl && (
                <a
                  href={sponsor.googleMapsUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-400 text-white text-[11px] font-bold transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  <Navigation className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Abrir en Google Maps</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                </a>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Dirección principal */}
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-start space-x-1.5">
              <span>{sponsor.location || 'Santo Domingo, Estado Mérida, Venezuela'}</span>
            </p>

            {/* Breve descripción de la ubicación / Puntos de referencia */}
            {sponsor.locationDetails && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/5 text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 space-y-1">
                <span className="font-black text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 block uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px]">
                  Punto de Referencia:
                </span>
                <p className="leading-relaxed">
                  {sponsor.locationDetails}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 5. BOTONERA DE CONTACTO Y REDES SOCIALES */}
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
            <h4 className="font-display font-black text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Canales Directos de Atención
            </h4>

            {/* Fila Primaria: WhatsApp y Llamada Telefónica */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
              <a
                href={waUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-4.5 h-4.5 flex-shrink-0" alt="WhatsApp" />
                <span>Contactar por WhatsApp</span>
              </a>

              {sponsor.phone ? (
                <a
                  href={`tel:${sponsor.phone.replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '')}`}
                  className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs font-bold transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Phone className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" />
                  <span>Llamar: {sponsor.phone}</span>
                </a>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 text-slate-400 text-xs font-semibold">
                  <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Atención en Horario Comercial</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Fila Secundaria: Redes Sociales y Sitio Web */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
              {sponsor.instagram && (
                <a
                  href={`https://instagram.com/${sponsor.instagram.replace('@', '').trim()}`}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-pink-500/10 hover:bg-pink-500 hover:text-white text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400 text-xs font-bold transition border border-pink-500/20 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <InstagramIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{sponsor.instagram}</span>
                </a>
              )}

              {sponsor.facebook && (
                <a
                  href={sponsor.facebook}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-600/10 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs font-bold transition border border-blue-600/20 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <FacebookIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Facebook</span>
                </a>
              )}

              {sponsor.tiktok && (
                <a
                  href={sponsor.tiktok.startsWith('http') ? sponsor.tiktok : `https://tiktok.com/@${sponsor.tiktok.replace('@', '')}`}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-black hover:text-white text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <TikTokIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>TikTok</span>
                </a>
              )}

              {sponsor.web && (
                <a
                  href={sponsor.web}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer ml-auto"
                >
                  <Globe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                  <span>Sitio Web Oficial</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                </a>
              )}
            </div>

          </div>

          {/* Sello de Autenticidad */}
          <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
              <Emoji3D name="shield" className="w-3.5 h-3.5" alt="Verificado" />
              <span>Patrocinante Oficial · Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM</span>
            </span>
            <span>Santo Domingo - Mérida</span>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined'
    ? ReactDOM.createPortal(modalContent, document.body)
    : modalContent;
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { getActiveSponsors } from '../services/sponsorsData';
import SponsorDetailModal from './SponsorDetailModal';

// Logotipos vectoriales limpios oficiales para los aliados predeterminados
// (Garantizan nitidez absoluta sin bordes ni fondos blancos forzados)
const DEFAULT_VECTOR_LOGOS = {
  sp_1: (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 54" className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto object-contain text-slate-800 dark:text-white" fill="none">
      <path d="M12 38L24 14L36 38H29L24 28L19 38H12Z" fill="#00DD9E"/>
      <path d="M31 38L39 22L47 38H41L39 34L37 38H31Z" fill="#0071E3"/>
      <text x="56" y="28" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="15" fontWeight="900" fill="currentColor" letterSpacing="1.2">TRANSFERS</text>
      <text x="56" y="42" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="10" fontWeight="800" fill="#00DD9E" letterSpacing="3">MÉRIDA</text>
    </svg>
  ),
  sp_2: (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 54" className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto object-contain text-slate-800 dark:text-white" fill="none">
      <circle cx="24" cy="27" r="16" stroke="#10B981" strokeWidth="2"/>
      <path d="M24 16C24 22 18 25 18 30C18 34 21 37 24 37C27 37 30 34 30 30C30 25 24 22 24 16Z" fill="#10B981"/>
      <text x="50" y="26" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="14" fontWeight="900" fill="currentColor" letterSpacing="0.8">EL ENCANTO</text>
      <text x="50" y="40" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="9" fontWeight="700" fill="#10B981" letterSpacing="2.5">ESTANCIA &amp; SPA</text>
    </svg>
  ),
  sp_3: (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 54" className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto object-contain text-slate-800 dark:text-white" fill="none">
      <path d="M10 38L22 14L34 38H10Z" fill="#0284C7"/>
      <path d="M24 38L34 20L44 38H24Z" fill="#38BDF8"/>
      <text x="52" y="26" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="14" fontWeight="900" fill="currentColor" letterSpacing="1">LOS VIRIOS</text>
      <text x="52" y="40" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="9" fontWeight="700" fill="#0284C7" letterSpacing="2">HOTEL &amp; CABAÑAS</text>
    </svg>
  ),
  sp_4: (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 54" className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto object-contain text-slate-800 dark:text-white" fill="none">
      <circle cx="24" cy="27" r="9" fill="#F59E0B"/>
      <path d="M24 10V14M24 40V44M7 27H11M37 27H41M12 15L14.8 17.8M33.2 36.2L36 39M12 39L14.8 36.2M33.2 17.8L36 15" stroke="#F59E0B" strokeWidth="2.2" strokeLinecap="round"/>
      <text x="50" y="26" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="13" fontWeight="900" fill="currentColor" letterSpacing="1">DESTINOS DEL SOL</text>
      <text x="50" y="40" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="9" fontWeight="700" fill="#F59E0B" letterSpacing="2.5">TURISMO &amp; VIAJES</text>
    </svg>
  ),
  sp_5: (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 54" className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto object-contain text-slate-800 dark:text-white" fill="none">
      <path d="M12 38L24 16L30 26L38 12L48 38H12Z" fill="#16A34A"/>
      <text x="58" y="26" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="14" fontWeight="900" fill="currentColor" letterSpacing="1">GREEN TRAVEL</text>
      <text x="58" y="40" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="9" fontWeight="700" fill="#16A34A" letterSpacing="2">ECOTURISMO ANDINO</text>
    </svg>
  ),
  sp_6: (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 54" className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto object-contain text-slate-800 dark:text-white" fill="none">
      <rect x="12" y="13" width="28" height="28" rx="6" stroke="#6366F1" strokeWidth="2"/>
      <path d="M20 33V21L26 27L32 21V33" stroke="#6366F1" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
      <text x="48" y="26" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="14" fontWeight="900" fill="currentColor" letterSpacing="1">CONVENCIÓN</text>
      <text x="48" y="40" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="9" fontWeight="700" fill="#6366F1" letterSpacing="2">HOTEL BOUTIQUE</text>
    </svg>
  ),
  sp_7: (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 54" className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto object-contain text-slate-800 dark:text-white" fill="none">
      <circle cx="24" cy="27" r="15" stroke="#EC4899" strokeWidth="2"/>
      <path d="M24 17V37M14 27H34" stroke="#EC4899" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round"/>
      <text x="48" y="26" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="12" fontWeight="900" fill="currentColor" letterSpacing="0.5">DRA. MELINA CHUECOS</text>
      <text x="48" y="40" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="8.5" fontWeight="700" fill="#EC4899" letterSpacing="1.5">GINECOLOGÍA &amp; OBSTETRICIA</text>
    </svg>
  ),
  sp_8: (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 240 54" className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto object-contain text-slate-800 dark:text-white" fill="none">
      <path d="M16 35C16 35 20 17 26 17C32 17 36 35 36 35H16Z" fill="#EA580C"/>
      <circle cx="26" cy="17" r="3.5" fill="#EA580C"/>
      <text x="44" y="26" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="14" fontWeight="900" fill="currentColor" letterSpacing="1">LA CIMA</text>
      <text x="44" y="40" fontFamily="system-ui, sans-serif" fontSize="9" fontWeight="700" fill="#EA580C" letterSpacing="2">RESTAURANTE &amp; CAFÉ</text>
    </svg>
  )
};

function getSponsorLink(sponsor) {
  if (sponsor.url && sponsor.url.trim() && sponsor.url !== '#') return sponsor.url;
  if (sponsor.web && sponsor.web.trim()) return sponsor.web;
  if (sponsor.instagram && sponsor.instagram.trim()) {
    const cleanIg = sponsor.instagram.replace('@', '').trim();
    return `https://instagram.com/${cleanIg}`;
  }
  if (sponsor.whatsapp && sponsor.whatsapp.trim()) {
    const cleanWa = sponsor.whatsapp.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
    return `https://wa.me/${cleanWa}`;
  }
  return '#';
}

function SponsorLogoItem({ sponsor, onSelect }) {
  const [imgError, setImgError] = useState(false);

  // Si tiene un vector oficial predeterminado y el logo almacenado es el unsplash de prueba
  const isDefaultUnsplash = sponsor.logo && sponsor.logo.includes('images.unsplash.com');
  const hasVector = DEFAULT_VECTOR_LOGOS[sponsor.id];

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onSelect}
      className="group relative flex items-center justify-center py-2 px-3 sm:px-5 flex-shrink-0 transition-transform duration-300 hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer select-none bg-transparent border-0"
      title={`Ver ficha técnica de ${sponsor.name} (${sponsor.category})`}
    >
      {/* 1. Si es uno de los sponsors iniciales o la imagen falló, mostrar el logo vectorial */}
      {hasVector && (!sponsor.logo || isDefaultUnsplash || imgError) ? (
        <div className="opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
          {DEFAULT_VECTOR_LOGOS[sponsor.id]}
        </div>
      ) : sponsor.logo && !imgError ? (
        /* 2. Logo real proporcionado por el usuario (imagen, PNG transparente, SVG, etc.) */
        <img
          src={sponsor.logo}
          alt={sponsor.name}
          onError={() => setImgError(true)}
          className="h-9 sm:h-11 md:h-12 w-auto max-w-[150px] sm:max-w-[180px] object-contain opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-all duration-300 filter drop-shadow-xs"
          loading="lazy"
          decoding="async"
        />
      ) : (
        /* 3. Fallback tipográfico limpio en caso de no tener foto ni vector */
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1">
          <span className="font-display font-black text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-800 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-wider group-hover:text-emerald-500 dark:group-hover:text-[#00DD9E] transition-colors whitespace-nowrap">
            {sponsor.vectorText || sponsor.name}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

export default function SponsorsCarousel({ setActiveTab }) {
  const [sponsors, setSponsors] = useState([]);
  const [selectedSponsor, setSelectedSponsor] = useState(null);

  const reloadSponsors = () => {
    const list = getActiveSponsors().filter(s => s.featuredInHome !== false);
    setSponsors(list);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    reloadSponsors();

    const handleUpdate = () => reloadSponsors();
    window.addEventListener('neblina_sponsors_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('neblina_sponsors_updated', handleUpdate);
  }, []);

  if (!sponsors || sponsors.length === 0) return null;

  // Duplicar la lista para un carrusel marquee continuo infinito sin saltos
  const marqueeItems = [...sponsors, ...sponsors];

  const handleGoToDirectory = () => {
    if (setActiveTab) {
      setActiveTab('sponsors');
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="py-4 sm:py-6 select-none bg-transparent">
      
      {/* 1. Encabezado Integrado Directamente con el Fondo */}
      <div className="text-center max-w-2xl mx-auto mb-4 sm:mb-6">
        <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/10 border border-emerald-500/20 mb-1.5">
          <Emoji3D name="sparkles" className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline-block" alt="Patrocinantes" />
          <span>Nuestros patrocinantes y aliados</span>
        </div>

        <h3 className="font-display font-black text-lg sm:text-xl md:text-2xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
          Las empresas que hacen posible nuestra señal
        </h3>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Carrusel Continuo Deslizándose (Marquee Infinito de Logos Puros) */}
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden w-full marquee-mask py-2">
        <div className="anim-marquee space-x-6 sm:space-x-10 md:space-x-14 items-center">
          {marqueeItems.map((sponsor, idx) => (
            <SponsorLogoItem 
              key={`${sponsor.id}-${idx}`} 
              sponsor={sponsor} 
              onSelect={() => setSelectedSponsor(sponsor)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Acceso Sutil al Directorio Completo */}
      <div className="mt-3 text-center">
        <button
          onClick={handleGoToDirectory}
          className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-emerald-600 dark:hover:text-[#00DD9E] transition-colors cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 group"
        >
          <span>Ver directorio completo de aliados comerciales</span>
          <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Modal Ficha Técnica del Aliado Comercial al hacer clic en cualquier logo */}
      {selectedSponsor && (
        <SponsorDetailModal
          sponsor={selectedSponsor}
          onClose={() => setSelectedSponsor(null)}
        />
      )}

    </section>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Building2, 
  Search, 
  MapPin, 
  Phone, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Sparkles, 
  MessageCircle, 
  Globe, 
  ArrowRight, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Layers, 
  Lock,
  ChevronRight,
  Info
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  getActiveSponsors, 
  SPONSOR_CATEGORIES, 
  getSponsorsCategoriesCount 
} from '../services/sponsorsData';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { STATION_INFO } from '../services/api';
import SponsorDetailModal from './SponsorDetailModal';

const InstagramIcon = ({ className }) => (
  <svg className={className} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">

export default function SponsorsDirectorySection({ onOpenAdmin }) {
  const [sponsors, setSponsors] = useState([]);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('Todas');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [categoriesCount, setCategoriesCount] = useState({});
  const [selectedSponsor, setSelectedSponsor] = useState(null);

  const reloadData = () => {
    const list = getActiveSponsors();
    setSponsors(list);
    setCategoriesCount(getSponsorsCategoriesCount(list));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    reloadData();

    const handleUpdate = () => reloadData();
    window.addEventListener('neblina_sponsors_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('neblina_sponsors_updated', handleUpdate);
  }, []);

  // Filtrado reactivo en tiempo real
  const filteredSponsors = sponsors.filter((item) => {
    const matchCategory = 
      selectedCategory === 'Todas' || 
      item.category?.toLowerCase() === selectedCategory.toLowerCase();

    const query = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return matchCategory;

    const matchQuery = 
      (item.name && item.name.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
      (item.description && item.description.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
      (item.location && item.location.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
      (item.category && item.category.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
      (item.slogan && item.slogan.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
      (item.tag && item.tag.toLowerCase().includes(query));

    return matchCategory && matchQuery;
  });

  const advertisingWhatsAppUrl = `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=584247459774&text=${encodeURIComponent(
    '¡Hola, Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM! 🎙️ Deseo información detallada para afiliar mi empresa al Directorio de Aliados Comerciales y pautar publicidad en la radio.'
  )}`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 py-4 sm:py-6 animate-fadeIn">
      
      {/* 1. HERO HEADER DE LA SECCIÓN DE ALIADOS */}

        <div className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

            <span>DIRECTORIO COMERCIAL & TURÍSTICO · NEBLINA 105.5 FM</span>
          </div>

          <h1 className="font-display font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
            Nuestros Aliados Comerciales y Patrocinantes

          <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 max-w-2xl mx-auto leading-relaxed font-medium">
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Download, Check, Smartphone, Monitor } from 'lucide-react';

export default function SystemInstallButton({ appName = 'Sistema', className = '' }) {
  const [canInstall, setCanInstall] = useState(false);
  const [installed, setInstalled] = useState(false);
  const [isIos, setIsIos] = useState(false);
  const [showIosGuide, setShowIosGuide] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Detectar si ya corre en modo standalone
    const isStandalone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || window.navigator.standalone;
    if (isStandalone) {
      setInstalled(true);
      return;
    }

    // Detectar iOS Safari
    const userAgent = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    const isIosDevice = /iphone|ipad|ipod/.test(userAgent);
    setIsIos(isIosDevice);

    if (window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt) {
      setCanInstall(true);
    }

    const handlePromptReady = () => {
      setCanInstall(true);
    };

    window.addEventListener('neblina_install_prompt_ready', handlePromptReady);
    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
      setInstalled(true);
      setCanInstall(false);
    });

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_install_prompt_ready', handlePromptReady);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleInstallClick = async () => {
    if (isIos) {
      setShowIosGuide(!showIosGuide);
      return;
    }

    const promptEvent = window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt;
    if (!promptEvent) {
      // Si el navegador soporta instalación manual o instrucciones
      alert(`Para instalar ${appName} en tu dispositivo: abre el menú de opciones de tu navegador y pulsa 'Instalar aplicación' o 'Agregar a pantalla principal'.`);
      return;
    }

    promptEvent.prompt();
    const result = await promptEvent.userChoice;
    if (result.outcome === 'accepted') {
      setInstalled(true);
      setCanInstall(false);
      window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt = null;
    }
  };

  if (installed) {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] text-xs font-bold border border-emerald-500/20">
        <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span className="hidden sm:inline">App Instalada</span>
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative inline-block">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleInstallClick}
        className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 dark:bg-white/5 hover:bg-[#00DD9E] hover:text-[#001E4D] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300/40 dark:border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md text-xs font-black transition cursor-pointer shadow-xs active:scale-95 ${className}`}
        title={`Instalar ${appName} como App Independiente`}
      >
        <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        <span>Instalar App</span>
      </button>

      {/* Guía flotante para iOS Safari (Adaptable a Modo Claro y Oscuro con Efecto Aero Glass) */}
      {showIosGuide && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-2 w-64 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/95 text-slate-800 dark:text-white border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/40 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-2xl text-xs space-y-2 z-50 animate-fadeIn">
          <p className="font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Instalar en iPhone / iPad:</span>
          </p>
          <ol className="list-decimal pl-4 space-y-1 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-200 text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
            <li>Toca el botón <strong>Compartir</strong> (icono de cuadrado con flecha arriba) en Safari.</li>
            <li>Baja en el menú y selecciona <strong>"Agregar al inicio"</strong>.</li>
            <li>Confirma tocando <strong>Agregar</strong> en la esquina superior.</li>
          </ol>
          <button 
            type="button" 
            onClick={() => setShowIosGuide(false)} 
            className="w-full mt-1 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-white font-bold text-[11px] transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            Entendido
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```jsx
  </svg>

export default function TalentDetailModal({ talent, onClose }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // Bloqueo controlado de scroll del fondo (body) mientras el modal esté abierto
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!talent) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = (originalOverflow && originalOverflow !== 'hidden') ? originalOverflow : '';
    };
  }, [talent]);

  // Atajo de teclado Escape para cerrar
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!talent) return;
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [talent, onClose]);

  if (!talent) return null;

  // Detección de formato PNG o imagen con recorte transparente
  const isPng = Boolean(
    talent.isTransparentPng ||
    talent.isPng ||
    talent.transparent ||
    (talent.photo && (
      /\.png($|\?)/i.test(talent.photo) ||
      talent.photo.includes('format=png') ||
      talent.photo.startsWith('data:image/png')
    ))
  );

  const handleShare = async (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const currentUrl = window.location.href;
    const shareData = {
      title: `${talent.name} • Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM`,
      text: `Conoce a ${talent.name}, conductor(a) de "${talent.showName}" en Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM.`,
      url: currentUrl
    };

    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share(shareData);
      } catch (err) {}
    } else {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${shareData.text} ${shareData.url}`);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
    }
  };

  const talentWaUrl = talent.socialLinks?.whatsapp
    ? `https://wa.me/${talent.socialLinks.whatsapp.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')}?text=${encodeURIComponent(
        `Hola ${talent.name}, te escucho a través de Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM en tu programa "${talent.showName}". Un saludo cordial desde el Páramo.`
      )}`
    : `https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=584247459774&text=${encodeURIComponent(
        `Hola cabina de Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM. Un saludo cordial para ${talent.name} en "${talent.showName}".`
      )}`;

  const modalContent = (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-28 sm:pb-32 bg-slate-950/70 dark:bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="talent-detail-name"
    >
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-white dark:bg-[#001438] border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/15 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-lg transition-colors duration-300 my-auto max-h-[calc(100dvh-120px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-130px)]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        {/* CABECERA DE LA FICHA DEL LOCUTOR */}
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        <div className="relative px-5 sm:px-7 pt-5 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-white/[0.02] flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 sm:space-x-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 sm:space-x-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/30 min-w-0">
              <Emoji3D name="microphone" className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" alt="Mic" />
              <span className="truncate max-w-[130px] sm:max-w-none">Staff Oficial · 105.5 FM</span>
            </span>

            {talent.featuredInHome && (
              <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-[#FEDC01] border border-amber-500/25 flex-shrink-0">
                <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Destacado</span>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Botones de acción rápida: Compartir & Cerrar */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 flex-shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={handleShare}
              className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              title="Compartir perfil"
              aria-label="Compartir perfil de locutor"
            >
              {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Cerrar perfil de locutor"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ================================================================= */}
        {/* CUERPO DEL MODAL CON FOTO AGRANDADA Y SOPORTE PNG */}
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-7 space-y-6">

          {/* HERO ESCÉNICO: FOTO AGRANDADA + DATOS DEL LOCUTOR */}
          <div className="relative rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-100 via-slate-50 to-emerald-500/5 dark:from-white/[0.04] dark:via-white/[0.02] dark:to-[#00DD9E]/10 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 p-5 sm:p-6 overflow-hidden">
            
            {/* Glow atmosférico trasero que resalta el PNG del locutor */}
            <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/4 -translate-y-1/2 w-64 h-64 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#00DD9E]/25 via-emerald-500/15 to-[#001E4D]/20 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

            <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center md:items-end gap-6">
              
              {/* =========================================================== */}
              {/* FOTO AGRANDADA DEL LOCUTOR (OPTIMIZADA PARA PNG TRANSPARENTE) */}
              {/* =========================================================== */}
              <div className="w-full md:w-56 lg:w-64 flex-shrink-0 flex items-end justify-center relative">
                
                {isPng ? (
                  /* Modo PNG Transparente: sin marco rígido, silueta que se fusiona con el fondo aeroglass */
                  <div className="relative w-48 sm:w-56 md:w-64 h-64 sm:h-72 md:h-80 flex items-end justify-center">
                    <img 
                      src={talent.photo} 
                      alt={talent.name}
                      className="max-h-full max-w-full object-contain object-bottom select-none transition-transform duration-500 hover:scale-103 drop-shadow-[0_16px_28px_rgba(0,0,0,0.40)] dark:drop-shadow-[0_18px_32px_rgba(0,221,158,0.25)]"
                      style={{
                        WebkitMaskImage: 'linear-gradient(to bottom, black 85%, transparent 100%)',
                        maskImage: 'linear-gradient(to bottom, black 85%, transparent 100%)'
                      }}
                      loading="eager"
                    />
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  /* Modo Fotografía Clásica Cuadrada / Retrato con marco Squircle de diseño Apple */
                  <div className="relative w-44 sm:w-52 md:w-56 h-56 sm:h-64 md:h-72 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-slate-200 dark:border-[#00DD9E]/30 shadow-xl bg-slate-900 group">
                    <img 
                      src={talent.photo} 
                      alt={talent.name}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover object-top transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                      loading="eager"
                    />
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-950/70 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
                    <span className="absolute bottom-2.5 left-2.5 right-2.5 text-center text-[11px] font-bold text-white/90 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full py-0.5 border border-white/10">
                      Foto Oficial
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>

              {/* DATOS PRINCIPALES DEL LOCUTOR */}
              <div className="flex-1 text-center md:text-left space-y-2.5 min-w-0">
                
                <div>
                  <span className="inline-block text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E]">
                    {talent.role || 'Locutor & Productor'}
                  </span>
                  
                  <h2 id="talent-detail-name" className="font-display font-black text-2xl sm:text-3xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight mt-0.5 leading-tight">
                    {talent.name}
                  </h2>
                </div>

                {/* Badge de Programa Radial */}
                <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/10 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-white border border-slate-300/60 dark:border-white/10 shadow-xs">
                  <Radio className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E]" />
                  <span className="truncate max-w-[240px] sm:max-w-none">{talent.showName}</span>
                </div>

                {/* Tarjeta de Horario al Aire */}
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-black/30 border border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center space-x-3 text-left">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                    <Clock className="w-4.5 h-4.5" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <span className="block font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Horario de Transmisión en Vivo
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs sm:text-sm truncate block mt-0.5">
                      {talent.showSchedule}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>

            </div>
          </div>

          {/* BIOGRAFÍA COMPLETA */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              Acerca de {talent.name}
            </h3>
            <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-white/[0.02] border border-slate-200/70 dark:border-white/5">
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line font-medium">
                {talent.bio}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* BOTONES DE CONTACTO Y REDES SOCIALES */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              Canales de Contacto Directo
            </h3>

            {/* Fila Primaria: WhatsApp en Cabina */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
              <a
                href={talentWaUrl}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 active:scale-95 text-white text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-4.5 h-4.5 flex-shrink-0" alt="WhatsApp" />
                <span>Escribir por WhatsApp</span>
              </a>

              <a
                href={`https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=584247459774&text=${encodeURIComponent(
                  `Hola Neblina 105.5 FM. Deseo solicitar una complacencia musical para el programa "${talent.showName}" de ${talent.name}.`
                )}`}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 py-3 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/20 active:scale-95 text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs font-bold transition shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Radio className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
                <span>Pedir Canción al Aire</span>
              </a>
            </div>

            {/* Fila Secundaria: Redes Sociales */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1">
              {talent.socialLinks?.instagram && (
                <a
                  href={talent.socialLinks.instagram}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-pink-500/10 hover:bg-pink-500 hover:text-white text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400 text-xs font-bold transition border border-pink-500/20 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <InstagramIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Instagram</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                </a>
              )}

              {talent.socialLinks?.facebook && (
                <a
                  href={talent.socialLinks.facebook}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-blue-600/10 hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs font-bold transition border border-blue-600/20 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <FacebookIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Facebook</span>
                </a>
              )}

              {talent.socialLinks?.twitter && (
                <a
                  href={talent.socialLinks.twitter}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-black hover:text-white text-slate-800 dark:text-white text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <XTwitterIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>X / Twitter</span>
                </a>
              )}

              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="ml-auto px-5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cerrar
              </button>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

        {/* SELLO DE AUTENTICIDAD EN EL PIE */}
        <div className="px-5 sm:px-7 py-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-black/20 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          <span className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
            <Radio className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00DD9E]" />
            <span>Staff Oficial · Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM</span>
          </span>
          <span>Santo Domingo - Mérida</span>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined'
    ? ReactDOM.createPortal(modalContent, document.body)
    : modalContent;
}
```
