## src/components/TalentsSection.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Mic, 
  Radio, 
  Clock, 
  Calendar, 
  Sparkles, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Share2, 
  Search, 
  X, 
  Info,
  Check
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getActiveTalents } from '../services/talentsData';
import { STATION_INFO } from '../services/api';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import TalentDetailModal from './TalentDetailModal';

export default function TalentsSection() {
  const [talents, setTalents] = useState([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedTalent, setSelectedTalent] = useState(null);

  const loadTalents = () => {
    setTalents(getActiveTalents());
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTalents();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadTalents();
    window.addEventListener('neblina_talents_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('neblina_talents_updated', handleUpdate);
  }, []);

  const filteredTalents = talents.filter(t => {
    const term = search.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!term) return true;
    return (
      t.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      (t.role && t.role.toLowerCase().includes(term)) ||
      (t.showName && t.showName.toLowerCase().includes(term)) ||
      (t.bio && t.bio.toLowerCase().includes(term))
    );
  });

  return (
    <section className="py-4 space-y-6">
      
      {/* Cabecera Principal Inspirada en Mix Radio Locutores & Apple Media */}
      <div className="relative rounded-2xl glass-card p-6 sm:p-10 overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
        <div className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/10 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute -bottom-24 -left-24 w-80 h-80 rounded-full bg-teal-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/08 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="max-w-2xl">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 dark:bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#00DD9E] text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider mb-3 border border-emerald-500/20">
              <Emoji3D name="microphone" className="w-4 h-4 inline-block" alt="Micrófono" />
              <span>Voces & Staff Oficial</span>
            </div>
            
            <h2 className="font-display font-black text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
              Nuestros Talentos
            </h2>
            
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 mt-2 leading-relaxed font-medium">
              Conoce a los locutores, periodistas, animadores y DJs que le dan vida y ritmo a cada momento en <strong>Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM</strong> desde Santo Domingo para todo el Páramo merideño.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Barra de Búsqueda Rápida */}
          <div className="relative w-full md:w-72">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input 
              type="text"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Buscar locutor o programa..."
              className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-white/10 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00DD9E]/40 transition"
            />
            {search && (
              <button 
                onClick={() => setSearch('')}
                className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Grid de Talentos con Formato de Tarjetas Apple Glass Squircle */}
      {filteredTalents.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl glass-card p-12 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 space-y-3">
          <Mic className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-slate-400 opacity-60" />
          <p className="text-base font-bold">No se encontraron locutores que coincidan con la búsqueda.</p>
          <button 
            onClick={() => setSearch('')}
            className="text-xs text-[#0066cc] dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-semibold underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            Ver todos los talentos
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {filteredTalents.map((talent) => (
            <article 
              key={talent.id}
              className="group rounded-2xl glass-card overflow-hidden border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/10 hover:border-emerald-500/40 dark:hover:border-[#00DD9E]/40 transition-all duration-300 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between"
            >
              <div>
                {/* Contenedor de la Foto HD */}
                <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900">
                  <img 
                    src={talent.photo || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80'} 
                    alt={talent.name}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover object-top group-hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-500"
                    loading="lazy"
                    decoding="async"
                  />
                  
                  {/* Degradado para legibilidad */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 via-black/20 to-transparent" />

                  {/* Badge de Programa en Vivo / Horario sobre la Foto */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between text-white">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-[#00DD9E] flex items-center space-x-1">
                      <Radio className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                      <span className="truncate max-w-[150px]">{talent.showName}</span>
                    </span>

                    {talent.featuredInHome && (
                      <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 shadow-xs">
                        Destacado
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Contenido de la Tarjeta */}
                <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-display font-black text-lg sm:text-xl text-[#1d1d1f] dark:text-[#f5f5f7] tracking-tight group-hover:text-emerald-600 dark:group-hover:text-[#00DD9E] transition-colors">
                      {talent.name}
                    </h3>
                    
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#00DD9E] uppercase tracking-wide mt-0.5">
                      {talent.role || 'Locutor & Productor'}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* Horario del Programa */}
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-white/5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-white/5">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <span className="font-medium text-[11px] sm:text-xs truncate">{talent.showSchedule}</span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Pequeña Biografía */}
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed font-medium">
                    {talent.bio}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Barra Inferior: Redes Sociales & Botón de Perfil */}
              <div className="px-5 sm:px-6 pb-5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                
                {/* Redes Sociales Oficiales del Locutor en Formato 3D Estilo iOS */}
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                  {/* WhatsApp */}
                  {talent.socialLinks?.whatsapp && (
                    <a
                      href={`https://wa.me/${talent.socialLinks.whatsapp.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')}?text=${encodeURIComponent(`Hola ${talent.name}, te escucho a través de Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM!`)}`}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="hover:scale-120 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                      title={`WhatsApp de ${talent.name}`}
                      aria-label="WhatsApp"
                    >
                      <Emoji3D name="whatsapp" className="w-6 h-6 sm:w-6.5 sm:h-6.5 drop-shadow-sm" />
                    </a>
                  )}

                  {/* Instagram */}
                  {talent.socialLinks?.instagram && (
                    <a
                      href={talent.socialLinks.instagram}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="hover:scale-120 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                      title={`Instagram de ${talent.name}`}
                      aria-label="Instagram"
                    >
                      <Emoji3D name="instagram" className="w-6 h-6 sm:w-6.5 sm:h-6.5 drop-shadow-sm" />
                    </a>
                  )}

                  {/* Facebook */}
                  {talent.socialLinks?.facebook && (
                    <a
                      href={talent.socialLinks.facebook}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="hover:scale-120 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                      title={`Facebook de ${talent.name}`}
                      aria-label="Facebook"
                    >
                      <Emoji3D name="facebook" className="w-6 h-6 sm:w-6.5 sm:h-6.5 drop-shadow-sm" />
                    </a>
                  )}

                  {/* Twitter / X */}
                  {talent.socialLinks?.twitter && (
                    <a
                      href={talent.socialLinks.twitter}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="hover:scale-120 active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-200 cursor-pointer p-0.5"
                      title={`X de ${talent.name}`}
                      aria-label="Twitter"
                    >
                      <Emoji3D name="x" className="w-6 h-6 sm:w-6.5 sm:h-6.5 drop-shadow-sm" />
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Botón Píldora Ver Perfil */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedTalent(talent)}
                  className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-white/10 dark:text-white hover:bg-emerald-600 dark:hover:bg-[#00DD9E] dark:hover:text-slate-950 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
                >
                  <Mic className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Ver Perfil</span>
                </button>
              </div>

            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal Detallado de Perfil del Talento con Portal al Body */}
      {selectedTalent && (
        <TalentDetailModal 
          talent={selectedTalent} 
          onClose={() => setSelectedTalent(null)} 
        />
      )}

    </section>
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';

export default function UniversalInstallModal() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [device, setDevice] = useState({ os: 'Dispositivo', isApple: false, isAndroid: false, isSmartTV: false });
  const [selectedPlatform, setSelectedPlatform] = useState('android');
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState(null);
  const [isInstalled, setIsInstalled] = useState(false);
  const [installSuccess, setInstallSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const dev = detectDevice();
    setDevice(dev);
    const installed = isAppInstalled();
    setIsInstalled(installed);

    // Inicializar la pestaña seleccionada según el dispositivo detectado
    if (dev.isSmartTV) {
      setSelectedPlatform(dev.isAppleTV ? 'apple-tv' : 'android-tv');
    } else if (dev.isApple) {
      setSelectedPlatform('ios');
    } else if (dev.isAndroid) {
      setSelectedPlatform('android');
    } else {
      setSelectedPlatform('pc');
    }

    // Escuchar el evento de instalación nativa PWA
    const handleBeforeInstall = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDeferredPrompt(e);
      window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt = e;
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstall);

    // Escuchar si la app ya fue instalada
    const handleAppInstalled = () => {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      setInstallSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => setIsOpen(false), 2000);
    };
    window.addEventListener('appinstalled', handleAppInstalled);

    // Escuchar peticiones para abrir el modal desde el Navbar o cualquier botón
    const handleOpenRequest = () => {
      autoEnableNotifications();
      setIsOpen(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_open_install_modal', handleOpenRequest);

    // Atajo de teclado Escape para cerrar
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') setIsOpen(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_open_install_modal', handleOpenRequest);
      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handleBeforeInstall);
      window.removeEventListener('appinstalled', handleAppInstalled);
    };
  }, []);

  // Bloqueo controlado de scroll cuando el modal está abierto
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = (originalOverflow && originalOverflow !== 'hidden') ? originalOverflow : '';
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleClose = () => {
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const handleInstallAction = async () => {
    autoEnableNotifications();

    const promptEvent = deferredPrompt || window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt;

    if (promptEvent && (selectedPlatform === 'android' || selectedPlatform === 'pc')) {
      try {
        promptEvent.prompt();
        const { outcome } = await promptEvent.userChoice;
        if (outcome === 'accepted') {
          setIsInstalled(true);
          setInstallSuccess(true);
          setTimeout(() => setIsOpen(false), 2200);
        }
        setDeferredPrompt(null);
        window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt = null;
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Error en prompt de instalación:', e);
      }
      return;
    }

    setInstallSuccess(true);
    setTimeout(() => setIsOpen(false), 2500);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const modalContent = (
    <div 
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 pt-3 sm:pt-4 pb-28 sm:pb-32 bg-slate-950/75 dark:bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200"
      onClick={handleClose}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="install-modal-title"
    >
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-[#001438] border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-white/15 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 max-h-[calc(100dvh-120px)] sm:max-h-[calc(100dvh-130px)] overflow-y-auto my-auto"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Botón de cierre */}
        <button
          onClick={handleClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer z-10"
          aria-label="Cerrar ventana de instalación"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        {/* ================================================================= */}
        {/* CASO: INSTALACIÓN EXITOSA */}
        {/* ================================================================= */}
        {installSuccess ? (
          <div className="text-center py-8 space-y-3">
            <Emoji3D name="sparkles" className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto  drop-shadow-xl" />
            <h3 className="font-display font-black text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              ¡Neblina 105.5 FM Lista!
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 max-w-xs mx-auto leading-relaxed">
              La aplicación oficial se ha configurado con su icono de esquinas redondeadas, alertas automáticas de noticias y streaming HD 24/7.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* CABECERA CON EL NUEVO ICONO OFICIAL PNG CON ESQUINAS REDONDEADAS */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-3.5 mb-4">
              <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                {/* Icono Oficial PNG con Esquinas Redondeadas Transparentes */}
                <div className="w-14 h-14 sm:w-16 sm:h-16 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 p-1 flex items-center justify-center border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/15 shadow-md">
                  <img 
                    src="/apple-touch-icon.png?v=2026.4" 
                    alt="Icono Oficial Neblina 105.5 FM" 
                    className="w-full h-full object-contain drop-shadow-sm select-none"
                    loading="eager"
                  />
                </div>
                {/* Indicador de señal activa */}
                <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-[#00DD9E] border-2 border-white dark:border-[#001438] flex items-center justify-center">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#001E4D] animate-ping" />
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 flex-wrap gap-y-1">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/30">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E]" />
                    <span>App oficial · PNG Squircle</span>
                  </span>
                </div>

                <h3 id="install-modal-title" className="font-display font-black text-lg sm:text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-tight mt-0.5">
                  Instalar Neblina 105.5 FM
                </h3>

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                  Streaming digital HD sin interrupciones
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* SELECTOR DE PLATAFORMA / TIENDA (ANDROID, IOS, SMART TV, PC) */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5 my-3">
              <span className="block text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Selecciona tu dispositivo o tienda:
              </span>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                {/* 1. Android (Google Play Store) */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPlatform('android')}
                  className={`flex items-center space-x-2 p-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedPlatform === 'android'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-500/50 text-slate-900 dark:text-white ring-1 ring-emerald-500/30'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <GooglePlayStoreIcon className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">Android</span>
                </button>

                {/* 2. iOS / Apple (App Store) */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPlatform('ios')}
                  className={`flex items-center space-x-2 p-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedPlatform === 'ios'
                      ? 'bg-blue-500/15 border-blue-500/50 text-slate-900 dark:text-white ring-1 ring-blue-500/30'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <AppleAppStoreIcon className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">Apple iOS</span>
                </button>

                {/* 3. Android TV (Google Play) */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPlatform('android-tv')}
                  className={`flex items-center space-x-2 p-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedPlatform === 'android-tv'
                      ? 'bg-teal-500/15 border-teal-500/50 text-slate-900 dark:text-white ring-1 ring-teal-500/30'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <AndroidTvIcon className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">Android TV</span>
                </button>

                {/* 4. Apple TV (App Store) */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPlatform('apple-tv')}
                  className={`flex items-center space-x-2 p-2 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedPlatform === 'apple-tv'
                      ? 'bg-purple-500/15 border-purple-500/50 text-slate-900 dark:text-white ring-1 ring-purple-500/30'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-white/5 border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <AppleTvIcon className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">Apple TV</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* INSTRUCCIONES ESPECÍFICAS SEGÚN LA TIENDA Y PLATAFORMA */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}

            {/* CASO 1: ANDROID (TIENDA DE APLICACIONES GOOGLE PLAY) */}
            {selectedPlatform === 'android' && (
              <div className="space-y-3 my-3 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-white/[0.03] border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 pb-2 border-b border-emerald-500/20">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center p-1.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10">
                    <GooglePlayStoreIcon className="w-full h-full" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs block">
                      Instalación para Android
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#00DD9E] font-semibold">
                      Compatible con el ecosistema de Google Play
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                  <div className="flex items-start space-x-2.5">

            {/* CASO 5: COMPUTADORAS / PC & MAC */}

                    <Laptop className="w-5 h-5" />

                  <div>
                    <span className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs block">
                      Computadora & Portátil (PC / Mac)
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 font-semibold">
                      Chrome, Edge, Brave o Safari
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
                  <div className="flex items-start space-x-2.5">
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-sky-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-black flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">1</span>
                    <p className="leading-snug">
                      Pulsa el botón <strong>"Instalar en PC"</strong> ubicado abajo.
                    </p>

                  <div className="flex items-start space-x-2.5">
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-sky-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-black flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5">2</span>
                    <p className="leading-snug">

                    </p>

            )}

            {/* ============================================================= */}
            {/* BOTÓN DE ACCIÓN PRINCIPAL CON ICONO DE LA TIENDA CORRESPONDIENTE */}
            {/* ============================================================= */}
            <div className="space-y-2 pt-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleInstallAction}
                className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#001E4D] via-[#002a66] to-[#00DD9E] text-white font-black text-sm shadow-lg shadow-[#00DD9E]/20 hover:shadow-[#00DD9E]/35 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all duration-200 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2.5 cursor-pointer border border-[#00DD9E]/40"
              >
                {selectedPlatform === 'android' && (
                  <>
                    <GooglePlayStoreIcon className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <span>Instalar Aplicación en Android (Google Play)</span>
                  </>
                )}

                {selectedPlatform === 'ios' && (
                  <>
                    <AppleAppStoreIcon className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <span>Instalar desde Safari en iOS (App Store)</span>
                  </>
                )}

                {selectedPlatform === 'android-tv' && (
                  <>
                    <AndroidTvIcon className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <span>Fijar en mi Smart TV (Android TV)</span>
                  </>
                )}

                {selectedPlatform === 'apple-tv' && (
                  <>
                    <AppleTvIcon className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0" />
                    <span>Sintonizar en mi Apple TV</span>
                  </>
                )}

                {selectedPlatform === 'pc' && (
                  <>
                    <Laptop className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00DD9E] flex-shrink-0" />
                    <span>Instalar Aplicación en Computadora</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={handleClose}
                className="w-full py-2 text-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Continuar navegando en la web
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return typeof document !== 'undefined'
    ? ReactDOM.createPortal(modalContent, document.body)
    : modalContent;
}
```

## src/components/WeatherBanner.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Sun, 
  CloudSun, 
  Cloud, 
  CloudFog, 
  CloudRain, 
  CloudLightning, 
  CloudSnow, 
  MapPin, 
  Droplets, 
  Wind,
  RefreshCw,
  Sparkles
} from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchWordPressNews } from '../services/api';
import { getCombinedNews } from '../services/newsData';
import NewsModal from './NewsModal';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';

// Coordenadas oficiales de respaldo: Santo Domingo, Mérida, Venezuela (Sede de Neblina 105.5 FM)
const FALLBACK_COORDS = {
  lat: 8.8667,
  lon: -70.7667,
  city: 'Santo Domingo, Mérida'
};

const WEATHER_CACHE_KEY = 'neblina_cached_weather_v2';

function getWeatherCondition(code) {
  if (code === 0) return { label: 'Cielo Despejado', emoji: 'sun', icon: Sun, color: 'text-amber-500' };
  if (code >= 1 && code <= 2) return { label: 'Parcialmente Nublado', emoji: 'cloud-sun', icon: CloudSun, color: 'text-sky-500' };
  if (code === 3) return { label: 'Nublado', emoji: 'cloud', icon: Cloud, color: 'text-slate-400' };
  if (code === 45 || code === 48) return { label: 'Neblina en la Cima', emoji: 'cloud-fog', icon: CloudFog, color: 'text-teal-400' };
  if (code >= 51 && code <= 67) return { label: 'Lluvias / Lloviznas', emoji: 'cloud-rain', icon: CloudRain, color: 'text-blue-500' };
  if (code >= 71 && code <= 77) return { label: 'Aguanieve en Páramo', emoji: 'cloud-snow', icon: CloudSnow, color: 'text-cyan-300' };
  if (code >= 80 && code <= 82) return { label: 'Chubascos Andinos', emoji: 'cloud-rain', icon: CloudRain, color: 'text-indigo-400' };
  if (code >= 95) return { label: 'Tormenta Eléctrica', emoji: 'cloud-lightning', icon: CloudLightning, color: 'text-amber-400' };
  return { label: 'Tiempo Estable', emoji: 'cloud-sun', icon: CloudSun, color: 'text-sky-400' };
}

export default function WeatherBanner() {
  // Estado del Clima
  const [weather, setWeather] = useState({
    temp: 18,
    conditionCode: 45,
    humidity: 80,
    wind: 5,
    city: FALLBACK_COORDS.city,
    loading: true,
    lastUpdated: null
  });

  // Estado del Teleprompter "Es viral" inicializado con los 9 titulares oficiales
  const [headlines, setHeadlines] = useState(() => (getCombinedNews() || []).slice(0, 9));
  const [tickerIndex, setTickerIndex] = useState(0);
  const [isTickerPaused, setIsTickerPaused] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPost, setSelectedPost] = useState(null);

  // 1. Obtener datos meteorológicos de Open-Meteo
  const fetchWeatherData = async (lat, lon, cityName) => {
    try {
      const url = `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${lat}&longitude=${lon}&current=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&timezone=auto`;
      const res = await fetch(url);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error al consultar Open-Meteo');
      const data = await res.json();
      const current = data.current || {};

      const newWeather = {
        temp: Math.round(current.temperature_2m ?? 18),
        conditionCode: current.weather_code ?? 45,
        humidity: Math.round(current.relative_humidity_2m ?? 80),
        wind: Math.round(current.wind_speed_10m ?? 5),
        city: cityName || FALLBACK_COORDS.city,
        loading: false,
        lastUpdated: Date.now()
      };

      setWeather(newWeather);

      // Guardar en caché local para carga instantánea en próximas visitas
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(WEATHER_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
          ...newWeather,
          lat,
          lon
        }));
      } catch (e) {}
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Error fetching weather data:', err);
      setWeather(prev => ({ ...prev, loading: false }));
    }
  };

  // 2. Detección Inteligente de Ubicación Real (IP + GPS Fallback)
  const detectLocationAndWeather = async (forceRefresh = false) => {
    setWeather(prev => ({ ...prev, loading: true }));

    // Cargar caché si es reciente (menos de 20 minutos) y no es recarga forzada
    if (!forceRefresh) {
      try {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem(WEATHER_CACHE_KEY);
        if (cached) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
          if (Date.now() - (parsed.lastUpdated || 0) < 20 * 60 * 1000) {
            setWeather({ ...parsed, loading: false });
            return;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    let detectedViaIP = false;

    // A) Detección inmediata por IP (sin requerir permisos ni popups del navegador)
    try {
      const geoRes = await fetch('https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client?localityLanguage=es');
      if (geoRes.ok) {
        const geoData = await geoRes.json();
        const lat = geoData.latitude || FALLBACK_COORDS.lat;
        const lon = geoData.longitude || FALLBACK_COORDS.lon;
        
        let detectedCity = 'Tu Ubicación';
        if (geoData.city) {
          const clean = geoData.city.replace(/^Municipio\s+/i, '');
          detectedCity = geoData.principalSubdivision && !clean.toLowerCase().includes(geoData.principalSubdivision.toLowerCase())
            ? `${clean}, ${geoData.principalSubdivision}`
            : clean;
        } else if (geoData.principalSubdivision) {
          detectedCity = geoData.principalSubdivision;
        } else if (geoData.countryName) {
          detectedCity = geoData.countryName;
        }

        detectedViaIP = true;
        await fetchWeatherData(lat, lon, detectedCity);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('IP geocode error:', e);
    }

    // B) Detección precisa por HTML5 GPS (si el usuario la tiene autorizada)
    if ('geolocation' in navigator) {
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
        async (position) => {
          const { latitude, longitude } = position.coords;
          let preciseCity = 'Tu Ubicación';
          try {
            const gpsGeoRes = await fetch(`https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client?latitude=${latitude}&longitude=${longitude}&localityLanguage=es`);
            if (gpsGeoRes.ok) {
              const gpsGeo = await gpsGeoRes.json();
              const cleanCity = gpsGeo.locality || gpsGeo.city?.replace(/^Municipio\s+/i, '') || gpsGeo.principalSubdivision;
              if (cleanCity) {
                preciseCity = gpsGeo.principalSubdivision && !cleanCity.toLowerCase().includes(gpsGeo.principalSubdivision.toLowerCase())
                  ? `${cleanCity}, ${gpsGeo.principalSubdivision}`
                  : cleanCity;
              }
            }
          } catch (e) {}
          fetchWeatherData(latitude, longitude, preciseCity);
        },
        () => {
          // Si no hay permiso GPS y tampoco funcionó IP, usar coordenadas de la estación
          if (!detectedViaIP) {
            fetchWeatherData(FALLBACK_COORDS.lat, FALLBACK_COORDS.lon, FALLBACK_COORDS.city);
          }
        },
        { timeout: 6000, maximumAge: 300000, enableHighAccuracy: false }
      );
    } else if (!detectedViaIP) {
      fetchWeatherData(FALLBACK_COORDS.lat, FALLBACK_COORDS.lon, FALLBACK_COORDS.city);
    }
  };

  // 3. Carga de los últimos 9 titulares de noticias (sincronizados con neblina105fm.com)
  const loadLatestHeadlines = async () => {
    try {
      const wpData = await fetchWordPressNews(1, 9);
      const combined = getCombinedNews(wpData);
      const top9 = (combined || [])
        .filter(item => !item.status || item.status === 'published')
        .slice(0, 9);

      if (top9.length > 0) {
        setHeadlines(top9);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const fallback = (getCombinedNews([]) || []).slice(0, 9);
      if (fallback.length > 0) setHeadlines(fallback);
    }
  };

  // Efecto inicial de carga del clima y titulares
  useEffect(() => {
    detectLocationAndWeather();
    loadLatestHeadlines();

    // Actualizar periódicamente noticias cada minuto
    const newsInterval = setInterval(loadLatestHeadlines, 60000);
    const handleNewsUpdate = () => loadLatestHeadlines();
    window.addEventListener('neblina_news_updated', handleNewsUpdate);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(newsInterval);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_news_updated', handleNewsUpdate);
    };
  }, []);

  // Efecto del Teleprompter: rotación de titulares cada 4 segundos
  useEffect(() => {
    if (headlines.length <= 1 || isTickerPaused) return;

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTickerIndex(prev => (prev + 1) % headlines.length);
    }, 4000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [headlines.length, isTickerPaused]);

  const condition = getWeatherCondition(weather.conditionCode);
  const IconComponent = condition.icon;
  const currentHeadline = headlines[tickerIndex];

  return (
    <div className="w-full select-none bg-transparent">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl aeroglass-card transition-all duration-300 text-xs">
        
        {/* FILA SUPERIOR EN MÓVIL / IZQUIERDA EN ESCRITORIO: Ubicación y Clima */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-start space-x-2 sm:space-x-2.5 flex-shrink-0">
          
          {/* Ubicación detectada */}
          <div 
            className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold cursor-pointer"
            onClick={() => detectLocationAndWeather(true)}
            title="Tu ubicación actual detectada. Haz clic para refrescar."
          >
            <Emoji3D name="pin" className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" alt="Ubicación" />
            <span className="truncate max-w-[130px] sm:max-w-[160px] md:max-w-[180px]">
              {weather.city}
            </span>
          </div>

          <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hidden sm:inline">•</span>

          {/* Condición con icono 3D */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 flex-shrink-0">
            <Emoji3D name={condition.emoji || 'cloud-sun'} className="w-5 h-5 drop-shadow-sm flex-shrink-0" alt={condition.label} />
            <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-semibold hidden md:inline">
              {condition.label}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* En móvil, mostrar temperatura aquí en la primera fila */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 sm:hidden font-mono">
            <span className="text-xs font-black font-sans text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
              {weather.temp}°C
            </span>
            <button
              onClick={() => detectLocationAndWeather(true)}
              className="p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white transition"
              title="Actualizar clima"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 ${weather.loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ESPACIO CENTRAL: TELEPROMPTER "Es viral" (Aprovecha el espacio en blanco) */}
        <div className="flex-1 sm:order-first mx-0 sm:mr-3 min-w-0 flex items-center gap-2 py-0.5 border-t sm:border-t-0 sm:border-r border-slate-300/40 dark:border-white/10 pt-1.5 sm:pt-0 sm:pr-3">
          
          {/* Chip informativo "Es viral" en color turquesa oficial de la marca (#00DD9E), estilo HIG Apple */}
          <span
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold text-[11px] sm:text-[11px] bg-[#00DD9E]/15 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] border border-[#00DD9E]/30 flex-shrink-0 select-none"
            title="Titulares más destacados"
          >
            <Emoji3D name="fire" className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" alt="Viral" />
            <span>Es viral</span>
          </span>

          {/* Teleprompter: Titular animado de las últimas 9 noticias */}
          <div 
            className="flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-hidden relative h-5 sm:h-6 flex items-center cursor-pointer group"
            onMouseEnter={() => setIsTickerPaused(true)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setIsTickerPaused(false)}
            onClick={() => currentHeadline && setSelectedPost(currentHeadline)}
            title={currentHeadline ? `${currentHeadline.title} (Clic para leer)` : 'Cargando titulares...'}
          >
            <div 
              key={tickerIndex}
              className="animate-teleprompter flex items-center w-full"
            >
              <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 truncate group-hover:text-[#00DD9E] dark:group-hover:text-[#00DD9E] transition-colors">
                {currentHeadline ? currentHeadline.title : 'Cargando últimos titulares...'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Contador sutil de titular (Ej: 1/9) */}
          {headlines.length > 0 && (
            <span className="hidden lg:inline text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex-shrink-0">
              {tickerIndex + 1}/{headlines.length}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* MÉTRICAS COMPLETAS DE CLIMA (Visible en pantallas medianas y escritorio) */}
        <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center space-x-2.5 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono flex-shrink-0">
          <span className="text-sm font-black font-sans text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {weather.temp}°C
          </span>

          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border-l border-slate-300 dark:border-white/15 pl-2.5">
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1" title="Humedad relativa">
              <Droplets className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-500" />
              <span>{weather.humidity}%</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1" title="Velocidad del viento">
              <Wind className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
              <span>{weather.wind} km/h</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => detectLocationAndWeather(true)}
            className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
            title="Actualizar clima según tu ubicación"
            aria-label="Actualizar clima"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 ${weather.loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Modal Lector si el usuario pulsa en el titular del Teleprompter */}
      {selectedPost && <NewsModal post={selectedPost} onClose={() => setSelectedPost(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/components/YouTubeShortsSection.jsx

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom';
import { 
  Play, 
  ExternalLink, 
  X, 
  ChevronLeft, 
  ChevronRight, 
  ChevronUp, 
  ChevronDown, 
  Share2, 
  Check 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { STATION_INFO } from '../services/api';
import Emoji3D from './Emoji3D';
import { useAudioPlayer } from '../context/AudioPlayerContext';
import { DEFAULT_SHORTS, fetchLatestYouTubeShorts } from '../services/youtubeService';

const YouTubeIcon = ({ className }) => (
  <svg className={className} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
    <path d="M23.498 6.186a3.016 3.016 0 0 0-2.122-2.136C19.505 3.545 12 3.545 12 3.545s-7.505 0-9.377.505A3.017 3.017 0 0 0 .502 6.186C0 8.07 0 12 0 12s0 3.93.502 5.814a3.016 3.016 0 0 0 2.122 2.136c1.871.505 9.376.505 9.376.505s7.505 0 9.377-.505a3.015 3.015 0 0 0 2.122-2.136C24 15.93 24 12 24 12s0-3.93-.502-5.814zM9.545 15.568V8.432L15.818 12l-6.273 3.568z"/>
  </svg>
);

export default function YouTubeShortsSection() {
  const [shorts, setShorts] = useState(DEFAULT_SHORTS);
  const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(null);
  const [slideDirection, setSlideDirection] = useState(null); // 'up' | 'down' | null
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState(null);
  const [isPaused, setIsPaused] = useState(false);
  const { isPlaying, pauseStream } = useAudioPlayer();

  // Detección de ítems visibles: 4 en Computadoras de Mesa (>=1024px), 2 en Móviles (<1024px)
  const [itemsPerView, setItemsPerView] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 4;
    return window.innerWidth >= 1024 ? 4 : 2;
  });

  const [currentCarouselPage, setCurrentCarouselPage] = useState(0);

  // Referencias para interacción táctil y rueda del ratón
  const carouselTouchStartX = useRef(0);
  const carouselTouchStartY = useRef(0);
  const modalTouchStartY = useRef(0);
  const modalTouchStartX = useRef(0);
  const lastWheelTime = useRef(0);
  const autoPlayTimerRef = useRef(null);

  // Sincronización responsiva de items visibles
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      const newItemsPerView = window.innerWidth >= 1024 ? 4 : 2;
      setItemsPerView(newItemsPerView);
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);

  // Carga y sincronización dinámica con el canal oficial de YouTube (@neblina105fm)
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const loadShorts = async () => {
      const latest = await fetchLatestYouTubeShorts();
      if (isMounted && Array.isArray(latest) && latest.length > 0) {
        // Asegurar que siempre contenga hasta los últimos 12 shorts
        setShorts(latest.slice(0, 12));
      }
    };

    loadShorts();

    const interval = setInterval(loadShorts, 15 * 60 * 1000);
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []);

  // Total de páginas en la ventana corrediza del carrusel
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(shorts.length / itemsPerView));

  // Ajustar página si cambia el tamaño de pantalla
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentCarouselPage >= totalPages) {
      setCurrentCarouselPage(Math.max(0, totalPages - 1));
    }
  }, [totalPages, currentCarouselPage]);

  // Autoplay del carrusel (cada 5.5 segundos cuando no está en pausa)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (totalPages <= 1 || isPaused || selectedIndex !== null) return;

    autoPlayTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentCarouselPage((prev) => (prev + 1) % totalPages);
    }, 5500);

    return () => {
      if (autoPlayTimerRef.current) clearInterval(autoPlayTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, [totalPages, isPaused, selectedIndex]);

  // Navegación manual del carrusel en la página
  const prevCarouselSlide = () => {
    setCurrentCarouselPage((prev) => (prev - 1 + totalPages) % totalPages);
  };

  const nextCarouselSlide = () => {
    setCurrentCarouselPage((prev) => (prev + 1) % totalPages);
  };

  // Gestos táctiles en el carrusel de la página
  const handleCarouselTouchStart = (e) => {
    setIsPaused(true);
    carouselTouchStartX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;
    carouselTouchStartY.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
  };

  const handleCarouselTouchEnd = (e) => {
    setIsPaused(false);
    const deltaX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - carouselTouchStartX.current;
    const deltaY = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - carouselTouchStartY.current;

    // Solo reaccionar si es un deslizamiento horizontal intencional
    if (Math.abs(deltaX) > 40 && Math.abs(deltaX) > Math.abs(deltaY)) {
      if (deltaX < 0) {
        nextCarouselSlide();
      } else {
        prevCarouselSlide();
      }
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // CONTROL DEL REPRODUCTOR MODAL VERTICAL ESTILO TIKTOK / INSTAGRAM REELS
  // =========================================================================
  const handleOpenShort = (index) => {
    setSelectedIndex(index);
    setSlideDirection(null);
    if (isPlaying && pauseStream) {
      pauseStream();
    }
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setSelectedIndex(null);
    setSlideDirection(null);
  };

  // Cambio vertical al siguiente Short (Scroll hacia abajo de TikTok / Reels)
  const goToNextShort = () => {
    setSlideDirection('up');
    setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % shorts.length);
  };

  // Cambio vertical al Short anterior (Scroll hacia arriba de TikTok / Reels)
  const goToPrevShort = () => {
    setSlideDirection('down');
    setSelectedIndex((prev) => (prev - 1 + shorts.length) % shorts.length);
  };

  // Escucha de rueda del mouse (Scroll de escritorio vertical como TikTok/Shorts)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedIndex === null) return;

    const handleWheel = (e) => {
      // Prevenir el scroll predeterminado de la página mientras el visor vertical está activo
      e.preventDefault();
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastWheelTime.current < 450) return; // Debounce suave

      if (e.deltaY > 25) {
        lastWheelTime.current = now;
        goToNextShort();
      } else if (e.deltaY < -25) {
        lastWheelTime.current = now;
        goToPrevShort();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: false });
    return () => window.removeEventListener('wheel', handleWheel);
  }, [selectedIndex, shorts.length]);

  // Atajos de teclado en el visor vertical
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedIndex === null) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        handleClose();
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        goToNextShort();
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        goToPrevShort();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [selectedIndex, shorts.length]);

  // Bloqueo de scroll del body cuando el visor vertical de shorts está abierto
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedIndex === null) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = (originalOverflow && originalOverflow !== 'hidden') ? originalOverflow : '';
    };
  }, [selectedIndex]);

  // Gestos táctiles verticales en el visor de Shorts (Swipe Up / Swipe Down)
  const handleModalTouchStart = (e) => {
    modalTouchStartY.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
    modalTouchStartX.current = e.touches[0].clientX;
  };

  const handleModalTouchEnd = (e) => {
    const deltaY = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - modalTouchStartY.current;
    const deltaX = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - modalTouchStartX.current;

    // Estricto gesto vertical (TikTok / Reels / Shorts: deslizar hacia arriba = siguiente)
    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 40 && Math.abs(deltaY) > Math.abs(deltaX)) {
      if (deltaY < 0) {
        // Deslizó hacia arriba -> Siguiente Short
        goToNextShort();
      } else {
        // Deslizó hacia abajo -> Short anterior
        goToPrevShort();
      }
    }
  };

  // Función para compartir en redes sociales
  const handleShare = (platform, short, e) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    const shortUrl = short.url || `https://www.youtube.com/shorts/${short.id}`;
    const text = `${short.title} - Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM`;

    if (platform === 'whatsapp') {
      window.open(`https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=${encodeURIComponent(text + '\n' + shortUrl)}`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    } else if (platform === 'facebook') {
      window.open(`https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${encodeURIComponent(shortUrl)}`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    } else if (platform === 'twitter') {
      window.open(`https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}&url=${encodeURIComponent(shortUrl)}`, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
    } else if (platform === 'copy') {
      if (navigator.clipboard) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(shortUrl);
        setCopiedId(short.id);
        setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2200);
      }
    }
  };

  const activeShort = selectedIndex !== null ? shorts[selectedIndex] : null;

  return (
    <section className="py-4 select-none bg-transparent">

      {/* ENCABEZADO CON CONTROLES DEL CARRUSEL (VENTANA CORREDIZA)                 */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4 px-1">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          <Emoji3D 
            name="youtube" 
            className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 drop-shadow-md hover:scale-110 transition-transform flex-shrink-0" 
            alt="YouTube Shorts" 
          />
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-display font-black text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center space-x-2">
              <span>Shorts Neblina</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 bg-red-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-red-500/20 backdrop-blur-md">
                @neblina105fm
              </span>
            </h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Controles de Navegación del Carrusel y Enlace al Canal */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <a
            href={STATION_INFO.youtubeShorts}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="hidden md:flex items-center space-x-1 text-xs font-bold text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 hover:text-red-700 dark:hover:text-red-300 transition mr-2"
          >
            <span>Ver canal</span>
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </a>

          {/* Flecha Anterior */}
          <button
            onClick={prevCarouselSlide}
            className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-full bg-slate-200/80 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center border border-slate-300/80 dark:border-white/10 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer backdrop-blur-md shadow-xs"
            aria-label="Shorts anteriores"
            title="Shorts anteriores"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-4.5 sm:h-4.5" />
          </button>

          {/* Flecha Siguiente */}
          <button
            onClick={nextCarouselSlide}
            className="w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-full bg-slate-200/80 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/10 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center justify-center border border-slate-300/80 dark:border-white/10 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer backdrop-blur-md shadow-xs"
            aria-label="Siguientes shorts"
            title="Siguientes shorts"
          >
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-4.5 sm:h-4.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* VENTANA CORREDIZA DEL CARRUSEL (4 EN ESCRITORIO, 2 EN MÓVIL)             */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <div 
        className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl p-0.5"
        onMouseEnter={() => setIsPaused(true)}
        onMouseLeave={() => setIsPaused(false)}
        onTouchStart={handleCarouselTouchStart}
        onTouchEnd={handleCarouselTouchEnd}
      >
        {/* Pista Deslizante Suave (Track) */}
        <div 
          className="flex transition-transform duration-700 ease-out -mx-1.5 sm:-mx-2"
          style={{
            transform: `translateX(-${currentCarouselPage * 100}%)`
          }}
        >
          {shorts.map((short, idx) => (
            <div
              key={short.id}
              className="flex-shrink-0 px-1.5 sm:px-2 w-1/2 lg:w-1/4"
            >
              <div
                onClick={() => handleOpenShort(idx)}
                className="group relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-slate-950 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg hover:scale-[1.025] transition-all duration-300 aspect-[9/16] flex flex-col justify-between p-3 sm:p-3.5 cursor-pointer border border-white/5 dark:border-white/10"
                title={`${short.title} (Clic para reproducir en sobreventana)`}
              >
                {/* 1. Miniatura Vertical de Alta Definición (Sin pantalla negra que oscurezca la imagen) */}
                <div className="absolute inset-0">
                  <img
                    src={`https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${short.id}/oar2.jpg`}
                    alt={short.title}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-108"
                    loading="lazy"
                    decoding="async"
                    onError={(e) => {
                      if (!e.target.dataset.triedMaxres) {
                        e.target.dataset.triedMaxres = 'true';
                        e.target.src = `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${short.id}/maxresdefault.jpg`;
                      } else if (!e.target.dataset.triedHq) {
                        e.target.dataset.triedHq = 'true';
                        e.target.src = `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/${short.id}/hqdefault.jpg`;
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                  {/* Degradado leve únicamente en la parte inferior para lectura de letras y botones de compartir */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-28 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/75 via-black/30 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
                </div>

                {/* 2. Etiqueta Superior de Short */}
                <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-red-600/85 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/25 text-white text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center space-x-1 shadow-xs">
                    <YouTubeIcon className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    <span>Short</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-white bg-black/35 border border-white/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg backdrop-blur-md">
                    #{idx + 1}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* 3. Botón Central de Play */}
                <div className="relative z-10 self-center my-auto">
                  <div 
                    className="w-11 h-11 sm:w-13 sm:h-13 rounded-full bg-red-600/95 group-hover:bg-red-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-red-950/50 transform group-hover:scale-115 active:scale-95 transition-all duration-300 border border-white/35"
                    aria-label="Reproducir Short"
                  >
                    <Play className="w-5 h-5 fill-current ml-0.5" />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 4. Bloque Inferior: Título + Acciones en Aero Glass Líquido */}
                <div className="relative z-10 space-y-2">
                  <p className="font-display font-bold text-xs text-white line-clamp-2 leading-snug group-hover:text-red-200 transition-colors drop-shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)]">
                    {short.title}
                  </p>

                  <div 
                    className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1.5 border-t border-white/20"
                    onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                  >
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-white/90 font-semibold tracking-wide drop-shadow-xs">
                      Compartir:
                    </span>

                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 sm:space-x-1.5">
                      <button
                        onClick={(e) => handleShare('whatsapp', short, e)}

                        title="Compartir en WhatsApp"
                        aria-label="Compartir en WhatsApp"
                      >
                        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current drop-shadow-xs" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                          <path d="M12.031 6.172c-3.181 0-5.767 2.586-5.768 5.766-.001 1.298.38 2.27 1.019 3.287l-.582 2.128 2.182-.573c.978.58 1.911.928 3.145.929 3.178 0 5.767-2.587 5.768-5.766.001-3.187-2.575-5.77-5.764-5.771zm3.392 8.244c-.144.405-.837.774-1.17.824-.299.045-.677.063-1.092-.069-.252-.08-.575-.187-.988-.365-1.739-.751-2.874-2.502-2.961-2.617-.087-.116-.708-.94-.708-1.793s.448-1.273.607-1.446c.159-.173.346-.217.462-.217l.332.006c.106.005.249-.04.39.298.144.347.491 1.2.534 1.287.043.087.072.188.014.304-.058.116-.087.188-.173.289l-.26.304c-.087.086-.177.18-.076.354.101.174.449.741.964 1.201.662.591 1.221.774 1.394.86s.274.072.376-.043c.101-.116.433-.506.549-.68.116-.173.231-.145.39-.087s1.011.477 1.184.564.289.13.332.202c.045.072.045.419-.1.824zm-3.423-14.416c-6.627 0-12 5.373-12 12 0 2.625.846 5.059 2.284 7.033l-1.494 5.462 5.606-1.471c1.916 1.246 4.197 1.976 6.604 1.976 6.627 0 12-5.373 12-12s-5.373-12-12-12z"/>
                        </svg>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={(e) => handleShare('facebook', short, e)}

                        title="Compartir en Facebook"
                        aria-label="Compartir en Facebook"
                      >
                        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current drop-shadow-xs" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                          <path d="M22.675 0h-21.35c-.732 0-1.325.593-1.325 1.325v21.351c0 .731.593 1.324 1.325 1.324h11.495v-9.294h-3.128v-3.622h3.128v-2.671c0-3.1 1.893-4.788 4.659-4.788 1.325 0 2.463.099 2.795.143v3.24l-1.918.001c-1.504 0-1.795.715-1.795 1.763v2.313h3.587l-.467 3.622h-3.12v9.293h6.116c.73 0 1.323-.593 1.323-1.325v-21.35c0-.732-.593-1.325-1.325-1.325z"/>
                        </svg>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        onClick={(e) => handleShare('twitter', short, e)}
                        className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-white/20 hover:bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/35 hover:border-white/60 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.25)] hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer"

                      >
                        <svg className="w-3 h-3 fill-current drop-shadow-xs" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">

                        title={copiedId === short.id ? "¡Enlace copiado!" : "Copiar enlace del Short"}
                        aria-label="Copiar enlace"
                      >
                        {copiedId === short.id ? (
                          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00DD9E] stroke-[2.5]" />
                        ) : (
                          <Share2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[2.2]" />
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Indicadores de Paginación del Carrusel (Estilo Apple / NewsCarousel) */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 mt-3 pt-1">
        {Array.from({ length: totalPages }).map((_, pIdx) => (
          <button
            key={pIdx}
            onClick={() => setCurrentCarouselPage(pIdx)}
            className={`transition-all duration-300 rounded-full cursor-pointer ${
              currentCarouselPage === pIdx
                ? 'w-7 sm:w-8 h-2 bg-red-600 dark:bg-red-500 shadow-xs'
                : 'w-2 h-2 bg-slate-300 dark:bg-white/25 hover:bg-slate-400 dark:hover:bg-white/50'
            }`}
            aria-label={`Ir a la ventana ${pIdx + 1}`}
            title={`Ventana ${pIdx + 1}`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* SOBREVENTANA MODAL VERTICAL ESTILO TIKTOK / INSTAGRAM REELS               */}

      {/* Con área segura inferior (pb-28 sm:pb-32) para no chocar con el reproductor */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {activeShort && typeof document !== 'undefined' && ReactDOM.createPortal(

          onTouchEnd={handleModalTouchEnd}

                slideDirection === 'up'
                  ? 'animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-12 duration-300'
                  : slideDirection === 'down'
                  ? 'animate-in slide-in-from-top-12 duration-300'
                  : 'animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200'
              }`}
            >
              {/* Cabecera Superior Transparente con Información y Botón Cerrar */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/90 via-black/50 to-transparent absolute top-0 inset-x-0 z-30 text-white">

                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-600 animate-pulse flex-shrink-0" />
                  <span className="font-bold text-xs truncate max-w-[210px] sm:max-w-[240px]">
                    {activeShort.title}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={handleClose}
                  className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-black/60 hover:bg-white/20 text-white flex items-center justify-center border border-white/20 backdrop-blur-md transition flex-shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow-md"
                  title="Cerrar reproductor"
                  aria-label="Cerrar reproductor"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* IFRAME Embebido con Autoplay y Control Táctil */}
              <div className="relative w-full h-full bg-black">

                  title={activeShort.title}
                  className="w-full h-full border-0"
                  allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"

              <div className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 p-3 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/95 via-black/70 to-transparent flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-white border-t border-white/10 z-20">

                  title="Abrir en YouTube"
                >
                  <span>YouTube</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ===================================================================== */}
            {/* COLUMNA VERTICAL DE NAVEGACIÓN Y ACCIONES (ESTILO TIKTOK / REELS)    */}
            {/* Ubicada flotante a la derecha del video tanto en móvil como escritorio */}
            {/* ===================================================================== */}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center space-y-2.5 ml-2.5 sm:ml-4 z-30">
              
              {/* Botón Vertical ARRIBA: Short Anterior (Swipe Down / Scroll Up) */}

              {/* Indicador de posición vertical */}

                {selectedIndex + 1}/{shorts.length}

              {/* Botón Vertical ABAJO: Siguiente Short (Swipe Up / Scroll Down) */}
              <button

              <div className="w-6 h-px bg-white/20 my-1" />

              {/* Botones de Compartir Verticales (Efecto Aero Glass Líquido) */}
              <button

                title="Compartir en WhatsApp"

                </svg>
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={(e) => handleShare('facebook', activeShort, e)}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/15 hover:bg-[#1877F2]/85 text-white flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/30 hover:border-white/60 transition-all hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-lg"
                title="Compartir en Facebook"
                aria-label="Compartir en Facebook"
              >
                <svg className="w-4.5 h-4.5 fill-current drop-shadow-xs" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                  <path d="M22.675 0h-21.35c-.732 0-1.325.593-1.325 1.325v21.351c0 .731.593 1.324 1.325 1.324h11.495v-9.294h-3.128v-3.622h3.128v-2.671c0-3.1 1.893-4.788 4.659-4.788 1.325 0 2.463.099 2.795.143v3.24l-1.918.001c-1.504 0-1.795.715-1.795 1.763v2.313h3.587l-.467 3.622h-3.12v9.293h6.116c.73 0 1.323-.593 1.323-1.325v-21.35c0-.732-.593-1.325-1.325-1.325z"/>
                </svg>
              </button>

              <button
                onClick={(e) => handleShare('twitter', activeShort, e)}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/15 hover:bg-black/85 text-white flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/30 hover:border-white/60 transition-all hover:scale-110 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-lg"
                title="Compartir en X"

                  <path d="M18.244 2.25h3.308l-7.227 8.26 8.502 11.24H16.17l-5.214-6.817L4.99 21.75H1.68l7.73-8.835L1.254 2.25H8.08l4.713 6.231zm-1.161 17.52h1.833L7.084 4.126H5.117z"/>
                </svg>

              <button

                title={copiedId === activeShort.id ? "¡Enlace copiado!" : "Copiar enlace del Short"}

              >

                  <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />

          </div>

          {/* Indicación Flotante Inferior de Navegación Vertical (Estilo TikTok) */}
          <div className="absolute bottom-20 sm:bottom-22 inset-x-0 flex justify-center pointer-events-none">
            <div className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-black/60 border border-white/15 backdrop-blur-md text-[11px] text-white/80 flex items-center space-x-1.5 shadow-lg">
              <span className="text-red-400 font-bold">↕️</span>
              <span>Desplaza con la rueda o desliza verticalmente</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>,
        document.body
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```
