## src/context/AudioPlayerContext.jsx

```jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  STREAM_CONFIG, 
  fetchNowPlaying, 
  getCurrentLiveShow, 
  STATION_INFO,
  isNoticiero102Window,
  probeAudioStream
} from '../services/api';
import { recordSongPlay } from '../services/rankingService';

const AudioPlayerContext = createContext(null);

export function AudioPlayerProvider({ children }) {
  const [isPlaying, setIsPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [isBuffering, setIsBuffering] = useState(false);
  
  // 'live' (Radio en vivo) o 'podcast' (Audio grabado)
  const [playbackType, setPlaybackType] = useState('live'); 
  const [activePodcast, setActivePodcast] = useState(null);
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState(0);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(0);

  // Servidor interno (oculto al usuario):
  // 'primary' (Éxtasis HD) | 'backup' (Zeno Neblina) | 'noticiero102' (Estudio 102.7 FM Respaldo Especial L-V 7-8am / 12-1pm)
  const [internalStreamServer, setInternalStreamServer] = useState('primary');

  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(1);
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);

  // Metadatos en vivo
  const [metadata, setMetadata] = useState({
    songtitle: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
    artist: 'Contigo en la cima',
    song: 'Radio En Vivo',
    artwork: STATION_INFO.cover,
    hasSongCover: false,
    history: []
  });
  const [currentShow, setCurrentShow] = useState(getCurrentLiveShow());

  // Referencias mutables para evitar re-crear listeners en useEffect
  const audioRef = useRef(null);
  const playbackTypeRef = useRef('live');
  const internalStreamServerRef = useRef('primary');
  const isPlayingRef = useRef(false);
  const bufferingWatchdogRef = useRef(null);
  const isSwitchingRef = useRef(false);
  const lastFailoverTimeRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    playbackTypeRef.current = playbackType;
  }, [playbackType]);

  useEffect(() => {
    internalStreamServerRef.current = internalStreamServer;
  }, [internalStreamServer]);

  useEffect(() => {
    isPlayingRef.current = isPlaying;
  }, [isPlaying]);

  // Función unificada de conmutación de servidor de streaming
  const switchToStream = (serverKey) => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return;

    if (isSwitchingRef.current) {
      console.log(`[AudioPlayer] Conmutación ya en curso. Omitiendo solicitud concurrente para ${serverKey}.`);
      return;
    }
    isSwitchingRef.current = true;

    const targetConfig = STREAM_CONFIG[serverKey];
    if (!targetConfig) {
      isSwitchingRef.current = false;
      return;
    }

    console.log(`[AudioPlayer] Conmutando a servidor: ${targetConfig.name} (${serverKey}) -> ${targetConfig.url}`);
    internalStreamServerRef.current = serverKey;
    setInternalStreamServer(serverKey);

    try {
      audio.pause();
      audio.src = targetConfig.url;
      audio.load();
    } catch (e) {}

    const p = audio.play();
    if (p !== undefined) {
      p.then(() => {
        setIsPlaying(true);
        setIsBuffering(false);
        isSwitchingRef.current = false;
      }).catch((err) => {
        isSwitchingRef.current = false;
        if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
          // Descarte normal de promesa interrumpida por nueva carga
          return;
        }
        console.warn(`[AudioPlayer] Fallo al reproducir ${serverKey}:`, err);
        handleStreamFailover(serverKey);
      });
    } else {
      isSwitchingRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  // Manejador centralizado de conmutación por fallas (failover) con limitador de frecuencia
  const handleStreamFailover = (failedServer = internalStreamServerRef.current) => {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastFailoverTimeRef.current < 900) {
      return;
    }
    lastFailoverTimeRef.current = now;

    const inNewsWindow = isNoticiero102Window();

    if (failedServer === 'primary') {
      console.warn('[Failover] Señal primaria Éxtasis HD con problemas. Conmutando a señal de respaldo propia (Zeno Neblina)...');
      switchToStream('backup');
    } else if (failedServer === 'backup') {
      // Si el respaldo de Neblina falla:
      // ¿Estamos en la ventana horaria del Noticiero 102 (L-V 7-8am / 12-1pm)?
      if (inNewsWindow) {
        console.warn('[Failover] Ambas señales de Neblina inactivas durante emisión de Noticiero 102. Conmutando a señal de respaldo de Estudio 102.7 FM...');
        switchToStream('noticiero102');
      } else {
        // Fuera del horario de noticias, no se usa Estudio 102.7; reintentar la primaria de Neblina
        console.warn('[Failover] Señal de respaldo Neblina caída fuera de horario de noticias. Reintentando señal primaria...');
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (audioRef.current && isPlayingRef.current && playbackTypeRef.current === 'live') {
            switchToStream('primary');
          }
        }, 3500);
      }
    } else if (failedServer === 'noticiero102') {
      // Si falló el stream de Estudio 102.7, reintentar las señales de Neblina para verificar si ya volvieron
      console.warn('[Failover] Falla en enlace de Estudio 102.7 FM. Verificando si señales de Neblina ya están activas...');
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (audioRef.current && isPlayingRef.current && playbackTypeRef.current === 'live') {
          switchToStream('primary');
        }
      }, 3500);
    }
  };

  // Inicializar el elemento de audio UNA SOLA VEZ al montar el proveedor
  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = new Audio();
    audio.preload = 'auto';
    audioRef.current = audio;

    const onPlaying = () => {
      setIsPlaying(true);
      setIsBuffering(false);
      if (bufferingWatchdogRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(bufferingWatchdogRef.current);
        bufferingWatchdogRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    const onPause = () => {
      setIsPlaying(false);
      setIsBuffering(false);
      if (bufferingWatchdogRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(bufferingWatchdogRef.current);
        bufferingWatchdogRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    const onWaiting = () => {
      setIsBuffering(true);
      // Watchdog para evitar silencios prolongados si un streaming se congela (>12s)
      if (playbackTypeRef.current === 'live' && isPlayingRef.current) {
        if (bufferingWatchdogRef.current) clearTimeout(bufferingWatchdogRef.current);
        bufferingWatchdogRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
          console.warn('[AudioPlayer Watchdog] Buffering prolongado detectado (>12s). Activando conmutación de servidor...');
          handleStreamFailover(internalStreamServerRef.current);
        }, 12000);
      }
    };

    const onCanPlay = () => {
      setIsBuffering(false);
      if (bufferingWatchdogRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(bufferingWatchdogRef.current);
        bufferingWatchdogRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    const onError = (e) => {
      if (isSwitchingRef.current) return;
      console.warn('Audio playback error:', e);
      setIsBuffering(false);
      if (bufferingWatchdogRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(bufferingWatchdogRef.current);
        bufferingWatchdogRef.current = null;
      }

      // Si falla mientras se está en vivo, activar conmutación inteligente
      if (playbackTypeRef.current === 'live') {
        handleStreamFailover(internalStreamServerRef.current);
      }
    };

    const onEnded = () => {
      if (playbackTypeRef.current === 'podcast') {
        returnToLive();
      }
    };

    const onTimeUpdate = () => {
      if (playbackTypeRef.current === 'podcast') {
        setCurrentTime(audio.currentTime || 0);
        if (audio.duration && !isNaN(audio.duration) && isFinite(audio.duration)) {
          setDuration(audio.duration);
        }
      }
    };

    const onLoadedMetadata = () => {
      if (playbackTypeRef.current === 'podcast') {
        if (audio.duration && !isNaN(audio.duration) && isFinite(audio.duration)) {
          setDuration(audio.duration);
        }
      }
    };

    audio.addEventListener('playing', onPlaying);
    audio.addEventListener('pause', onPause);
    audio.addEventListener('waiting', onWaiting);
    audio.addEventListener('canplay', onCanPlay);
    audio.addEventListener('error', onError);
    audio.addEventListener('ended', onEnded);
    audio.addEventListener('timeupdate', onTimeUpdate);
    audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', onLoadedMetadata);

    return () => {
      audio.pause();
      audio.removeEventListener('playing', onPlaying);
      audio.removeEventListener('pause', onPause);
      audio.removeEventListener('waiting', onWaiting);
      audio.removeEventListener('canplay', onCanPlay);
      audio.removeEventListener('error', onError);
      audio.removeEventListener('ended', onEnded);
      audio.removeEventListener('timeupdate', onTimeUpdate);
      audio.removeEventListener('loadedmetadata', onLoadedMetadata);
      if (bufferingWatchdogRef.current) clearTimeout(bufferingWatchdogRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Control de volumen
  useEffect(() => {
    if (audioRef.current) {
      audioRef.current.volume = isMuted ? 0 : volume;
    }
  }, [volume, isMuted]);

  // Monitor de Auto-Recuperación cuando Estudio 102.7 FM (Noticiero 102) está activo:
  // Conmuta de vuelta a los servidores propios de Neblina en el momento exacto en que comiencen a transmitir,
  // o cuando la ventana horaria del noticiero culmine.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (internalStreamServer !== 'noticiero102' || playbackType !== 'live') {
      return;
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    console.log('[Noticiero 102 Respaldo] Monitor de auto-recuperación activo. Sondeando regreso de servidores de Neblina...');

    const intervalId = setInterval(async () => {
      if (!isMounted) return;

      // 1. Si culminó la ventana horaria del noticiero, retornar de inmediato a la señal habitual
      if (!isNoticiero102Window()) {
        console.log('[Noticiero 102] Culminó la ventana del noticiero (7-8am / 12-1pm L-V). Retornando a señal de Neblina...');
        switchToStream('primary');
        return;
      }

      // 2. Si todavía estamos en el horario del noticiero, sondear si Neblina principal ya comenzó a transmitir
      try {
        const primaryOk = await probeAudioStream(STREAM_CONFIG.primary.url, 3500);
        if (!isMounted) return;

        if (primaryOk) {
          console.log('[Auto-Recuperación] ¡Señal principal de Neblina (Éxtasis HD) activa y transmitiendo! Retornando automáticamente...');
          switchToStream('primary');
          return;
        }

        // Si la principal aún no, sondear el respaldo propio de Neblina (Zeno)
        const backupOk = await probeAudioStream(STREAM_CONFIG.backup.url, 3500);
        if (!isMounted) return;

        if (backupOk) {
          console.log('[Auto-Recuperación] ¡Señal de respaldo de Neblina (Zeno) activa y transmitiendo! Retornando automáticamente...');
          switchToStream('backup');
          return;
        }

        console.log('[Noticiero 102] Servidores propios de Neblina aún no transmiten. Manteniendo Estudio 102.7 FM...');
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Error en sondeo de auto-recuperación:', err);
      }
    }, 15000); // Comprobación cada 15 segundos

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(intervalId);
    };
  }, [internalStreamServer, playbackType]);

  // Monitor secundario: Si estamos en el respaldo de Neblina (Zeno), sondear el regreso de la principal (Éxtasis HD)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (internalStreamServer !== 'backup' || playbackType !== 'live') {
      return;
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    const intervalId = setInterval(async () => {
      if (!isMounted) return;
      try {
        const primaryOk = await probeAudioStream(STREAM_CONFIG.primary.url, 3500);
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (primaryOk) {
          console.log('[Auto-Recuperación] Señal principal Éxtasis HD recuperada. Conmutando a primaria...');
          switchToStream('primary');
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }, 45000); // Comprobación cada 45 segundos

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(intervalId);
    };
  }, [internalStreamServer, playbackType]);

  // Actualizar metadatos cada 10 segundos y escuchar cambios en la parrilla radial
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const updateMeta = async () => {
      const data = await fetchNowPlaying();
      if (isMounted) {
        setMetadata(data);
        setCurrentShow(getCurrentLiveShow());
        if (data && data.song && data.artist) {
          recordSongPlay(data);
        }

        // Verificación de horario: Si estamos en noticiero102 y ya pasó la hora, salir del respaldo
        if (internalStreamServerRef.current === 'noticiero102' && !isNoticiero102Window()) {
          console.log('[Horario] Fin de la ventana de Noticiero 102 detectado por el reloj. Regresando a señal de Neblina...');
          switchToStream('primary');
        }
      }
    };

    const handleScheduleUpdated = () => {
      if (isMounted) {
        setCurrentShow(getCurrentLiveShow());
      }
    };

    updateMeta();
    const interval = setInterval(updateMeta, 10000);
    window.addEventListener('neblina_schedule_updated', handleScheduleUpdated);

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
      window.removeEventListener('neblina_schedule_updated', handleScheduleUpdated);
    };
  }, []);

  // Media Session API para pantalla de bloqueo, Smart TV y centro de notificaciones nativo
  useEffect(() => {
    if ('mediaSession' in navigator) {
      const isLive = playbackType === 'live';
      const isNewsBackup = internalStreamServer === 'noticiero102';
      
      const artworkUrl = isLive 
        ? (metadata.hasSongCover ? metadata.artwork : (currentShow?.image || STATION_INFO.cover)) 
        : (activePodcast?.cover_url || STATION_INFO.cover);
      
      const absoluteArtwork = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && artworkUrl && !artworkUrl.startsWith('http'))
        ? window.location.origin + artworkUrl
        : (artworkUrl || (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin + '/cover-default.png' : '/cover-default.png'));

      const liveTitle = isNewsBackup 
        ? 'Noticiero 102 · Estudio 102.7 FM (Respaldo Oficial)' 
        : (currentShow?.title || metadata.song || 'Neblina 105.5 FM');

      const liveArtist = isNewsBackup 
        ? 'Estudio 102.7 FM · Transmisión de Respaldo' 
        : (currentShow?.host || metadata.artist || 'Santo Domingo - Mérida · En Vivo');

      try {
        navigator.mediaSession.metadata = new MediaMetadata({
          title: isLive ? liveTitle : (activePodcast?.title || 'Podcast'),
          artist: isLive ? liveArtist : (activePodcast?.author || 'Neblina Stereo'),
          album: isLive ? (isNewsBackup ? 'Noticiero 102' : (currentShow.title || 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM')) : (activePodcast?.show || 'Podcast'),
          artwork: [
            { src: absoluteArtwork, sizes: '96x96', type: 'image/jpeg' },
            { src: absoluteArtwork, sizes: '192x192', type: 'image/jpeg' },
            { src: absoluteArtwork, sizes: '512x512', type: 'image/jpeg' }
          ]
        });

        navigator.mediaSession.playbackState = isPlaying ? 'playing' : 'paused';

        navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('play', () => togglePlay());
        navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('pause', () => togglePlay());
        navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('stop', () => {
          if (audioRef.current) {
            audioRef.current.pause();
            setIsPlaying(false);
          }
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Error setting mediaSession:', err);
      }
    }
  }, [metadata, currentShow, playbackType, activePodcast, isPlaying, internalStreamServer]);

  // Reproducir transmisión en vivo
  const playLiveStream = () => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return;

    setPlaybackType('live');
    playbackTypeRef.current = 'live';
    setActivePodcast(null);
    setIsBuffering(true);

    const inNewsWindow = isNoticiero102Window();

    // Si estábamos en noticiero102 pero ya no es horario de noticiero, resetear a primaria
    if (internalStreamServerRef.current === 'noticiero102' && !inNewsWindow) {
      internalStreamServerRef.current = 'primary';
      setInternalStreamServer('primary');
    }

    const currentKey = internalStreamServerRef.current;
    const targetUrl = STREAM_CONFIG[currentKey]?.url || STREAM_CONFIG.primary.url;
    
    if (audio.src !== targetUrl) {
      audio.src = targetUrl;
    }

    const playPromise = audio.play();
    if (playPromise !== undefined) {
      playPromise
        .then(() => {
          setIsPlaying(true);
          setIsBuffering(false);
        })
        .catch((err) => {
          if (err.name === 'AbortError') return;
          console.warn(`[AudioPlayer] Fallo al iniciar señal (${currentKey}), ejecutando conmutación:`, err);
          handleStreamFailover(currentKey);
        });
    }
  };

  // Reproducir un podcast en el reproductor unificado
  const playPodcast = (podcast) => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return;

    if (playbackType === 'podcast' && activePodcast?.id === podcast.id) {
      if (audio.paused) {
        audio.play().then(() => setIsPlaying(true)).catch(() => {});
      } else {
        audio.pause();
        setIsPlaying(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    setPlaybackType('podcast');
    playbackTypeRef.current = 'podcast';
    setActivePodcast(podcast);
    setIsBuffering(true);

    audio.src = podcast.audio_url;
    audio.load();
    audio.play()
      .then(() => {
        setIsPlaying(true);
        setIsBuffering(false);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('Error al reproducir podcast:', err);
        setIsBuffering(false);
      });
  };

  // Volver a la transmisión en vivo
  const returnToLive = () => {
    setCurrentTime(0);
    setDuration(0);
    playLiveStream();
  };

  // Adelantar o retroceder en el podcast
  const seekTo = (seconds) => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (audio && playbackType === 'podcast') {
      audio.currentTime = seconds;
      setCurrentTime(seconds);
    }
  };

  // Alternar reproducción / pausa
  const togglePlay = () => {
    const audio = audioRef.current;
    if (!audio) return;

    if (!audio.paused) {
      audio.pause();
      setIsPlaying(false);
      setIsBuffering(false);
    } else {
      if (playbackType === 'podcast' && activePodcast) {
        audio.play().then(() => setIsPlaying(true)).catch(() => {});
      } else {
        playLiveStream();
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <AudioPlayerContext.Provider
      value={{
        isPlaying,
        isBuffering,
        playbackType,
        activePodcast,
        currentTime,
        duration,
        seekTo,
        volume,
        isMuted,
        metadata,
        currentShow,
        togglePlay,
        playLiveStream,
        playPodcast,
        returnToLive,
        setVolume,
        setIsMuted,
        internalStreamServer,
        isNewsBackupActive: internalStreamServer === 'noticiero102',
        streamServerInfo: STREAM_CONFIG[internalStreamServer],
        inNewsWindow: isNoticiero102Window(),
        switchToStream
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AudioPlayerContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useAudioPlayer() {
  const context = useContext(AudioPlayerContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAudioPlayer must be used within an AudioPlayerProvider');
  }
  return context;
}
```

## src/context/ThemeContext.jsx

```jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const ThemeContext = createContext(null);

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('neblina_theme') || 'dark';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const metaThemeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
    if (theme === 'dark') {
      root.classList.add('dark');
      root.classList.remove('light');
      if (metaThemeColor) metaThemeColor.setAttribute('content', '#001E4D');
    } else {
      root.classList.add('light');
      root.classList.remove('dark');
      if (metaThemeColor) metaThemeColor.setAttribute('content', '#FFFFFF');
    }
    localStorage.setItem('neblina_theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme(prev => (prev === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  return context;
}
```

## src/main.jsx

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client';
import App from './App';
import { AudioPlayerProvider } from './context/AudioPlayerContext';
import { initNewsNotificationMonitor, autoEnableNotifications } from './services/notificationService';
import './index.css';

// Activar notificaciones por default automáticamente
autoEnableNotifications();

// Capturar evento de instalación PWA para instalar bajo demanda desde los sistemas
window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt = e;
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('neblina_install_prompt_ready'));
});

// Registrar Service Worker para PWA y Notificaciones en segundo plano
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js')
      .then((reg) => {
        // Inicializar monitor de noticias en segundo plano
        initNewsNotificationMonitor();
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.log('SW registration error:', err);
      });
  });
}

ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <AudioPlayerProvider>
      <App />
    </AudioPlayerProvider>
  </React.StrictMode>
);
```

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import AdminModal from '../components/admin/AdminModal';

/**
 * AdminPage - Página Administrativa Independiente y Dedicada de Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM
 * Funciona bajo la misma dirección web (/admin, #admin, #panel) pero con una vista 100%
 * autónoma y dedicada (no una ventana modal sobrepuesta), adaptada a monitores de escritorio
 * y dispositivos móviles.
 */
export default function AdminPage({ onClose, onBackToWeb }) {
  const handleBack = () => {
    if (onBackToWeb) {
      onBackToWeb();
    } else if (onClose) {
      onClose();
    } else {
      // Limpiar hash y volver a la web principal
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname + window.location.search.replace(/[?&]admin=[^&]+/, ''));
      window.location.hash = '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <AdminModal 
      isOpen={true} 
      onClose={handleBack} 
      isStandalonePage={true} 
    />
  );
}
```

```jsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Play, 
  Pause, 
  Tv, 
  Sun, 
  Moon,
  CloudSun, 
  Cloud, 
  CloudFog, 
  CloudRain, 
  CloudLightning, 
  CloudSnow, 
  Download, 
  QrCode,
  Calendar,
  Clock
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useAudioPlayer } from '../context/AudioPlayerContext';
import { useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { getCachedBcvRates, fetchLiveBcvRates } from '../services/bcvService';
import { getCombinedNews, getAllNews } from '../services/newsData';
import { getActiveBannersForPlacement, recordBannerView } from '../services/adBannerService';
import Emoji3D from '../components/Emoji3D';

// Coordenadas de Santo Domingo, Mérida como base
const FALLBACK_COORDS = { lat: 8.8667, lon: -70.7667, city: 'Santo Domingo, Mérida' };

function getWeatherCondition(code) {
  if (code === 0) return { label: 'Despejado', icon: Sun, color: 'text-amber-400' };
  if (code >= 1 && code <= 2) return { label: 'Parcial', icon: CloudSun, color: 'text-sky-400' };
  if (code === 3) return { label: 'Nublado', icon: Cloud, color: 'text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-400' };
  if (code === 45 || code === 48) return { label: 'Neblina en la Cima', icon: CloudFog, color: 'text-[#00DD9E]' };
  if (code >= 51 && code <= 67) return { label: 'Lluvias', icon: CloudRain, color: 'text-blue-400' };
  if (code >= 71 && code <= 77) return { label: 'Aguanieve', icon: CloudSnow, color: 'text-cyan-300' };
  if (code >= 80 && code <= 82) return { label: 'Chubascos', icon: CloudRain, color: 'text-indigo-400' };
  if (code >= 95) return { label: 'Tormenta Eléctrica', icon: CloudLightning, color: 'text-amber-400' };
  return { label: 'Tiempo Estable', icon: CloudSun, color: 'text-sky-400' };
}

export default function SmartTvPage() {
  const { isPlaying, togglePlay, metadata } = useAudioPlayer();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();

  // 0. Estudio de resolución de pantalla para centrado perfecto y cálculo de escala
  const [screenInfo, setScreenInfo] = useState(() => ({
    width: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth : 1920,
    height: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerHeight : 1080
  }));

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      setScreenInfo({
        width: window.innerWidth,
        height: window.innerHeight
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!isPlaying) {
        try {
          const res = togglePlay();
          if (res && typeof res.catch === 'function') {
            res.catch(() => {});
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // Autoplay policy
        }
      }
    }, 800);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, []);

  // 2. Tasas del Dólar y Euro oficial BCV
  const [bcvRates, setBcvRates] = useState(() => getCachedBcvRates());
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchLiveBcvRates().then(rates => {
      if (rates) setBcvRates(rates);
    });
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      fetchLiveBcvRates().then(rates => {
        if (rates) setBcvRates(rates);
      });
    }, 60000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // 3. Clima de la ubicación del dispositivo (IP / Open-Meteo)
  const [weather, setWeather] = useState({
    temp: 18,
    conditionCode: 45,
    humidity: 80,
    city: 'Santo Domingo, Mérida',
    loading: false
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchWeather = async () => {
      try {
        let lat = FALLBACK_COORDS.lat;
        let lon = FALLBACK_COORDS.lon;
        let city = FALLBACK_COORDS.city;

        // Detección por IP
        try {
          const ipRes = await fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/');
          if (ipRes.ok) {
            const ipData = await ipRes.json();
            if (ipData.latitude && ipData.longitude) {
              lat = ipData.latitude;
              lon = ipData.longitude;
              city = `${ipData.city || 'Mérida'}, ${ipData.region_code || 'VE'}`;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        const meteoRes = await fetch(
          `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${lat}&longitude=${lon}&current=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,weather_code&timezone=auto`
        );
        if (meteoRes.ok) {
          const data = await meteoRes.json();
          if (data.current) {
            setWeather({
              temp: Math.round(data.current.temperature_2m),
              conditionCode: data.current.weather_code,
              humidity: Math.round(data.current.relative_humidity_2m),
              city: city,
              loading: false
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        setWeather(prev => ({ ...prev, loading: false }));
      }
    };

    fetchWeather();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchWeather, 10 * 60 * 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // 4. Reloj y fecha viva en tiempo real para el widget del clima
  const [currentDateTime, setCurrentDateTime] = useState(new Date());
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentDateTime(new Date());
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  // 5. Últimas 15 Noticias para el Teleprompter
  const [newsList, setNewsList] = useState(() => {
    const list = getAllNews() || getCombinedNews() || [];
    return list.slice(0, 15);
  });

  // 6. Banner Superior de Publicidad para Smart TV
  const [tvBanners, setTvBanners] = useState(() => getActiveBannersForPlacement('smart-tv'));
  const [currentBannerIndex, setCurrentBannerIndex] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleUpdate = () => {
      setTvBanners(getActiveBannersForPlacement('smart-tv'));
    };
    window.addEventListener('neblina_banners_updated', handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('neblina_banners_updated', handleUpdate);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!tvBanners || tvBanners.length <= 1) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setCurrentBannerIndex(prev => (prev + 1) % tvBanners.length);
    }, 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [tvBanners]);

  const activeBanner = tvBanners && tvBanners.length > 0 ? tvBanners[currentBannerIndex] : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeBanner?.id) {
      recordBannerView(activeBanner.id);
    }
  }, [activeBanner?.id]);

  // 7. Detección / Instalación de la App en Smart TV
  const [isTvInstalled, setIsTvInstalled] = useState(false);
  const [showInstallPrompt, setShowInstallPrompt] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isStandalone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches || window.navigator.standalone === true;
    const isSavedInstalled = localStorage.getItem('neblina_smart_tv_app_installed') === 'true';

    if (isStandalone || isSavedInstalled) {
      setIsTvInstalled(true);
      setShowInstallPrompt(false);
    } else {
      setIsTvInstalled(false);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setShowInstallPrompt(true);
      }, 4000);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleInstallTvApp = async () => {
    if (window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt) {
      window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt.prompt();
      window.__neblinaDeferredPrompt.userChoice.then(choice => {
        if (choice.outcome === 'accepted') {
          localStorage.setItem('neblina_smart_tv_app_installed', 'true');
          setIsTvInstalled(true);
          setShowInstallPrompt(false);
        }

    playControlTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {

  const coverImage = metadata?.artwork || '/icon-512.png';

  // Fecha y hora formateada para el widget de clima
  const formattedDate = currentDateTime.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  const formattedTime = currentDateTime.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' });

  // Fecha de vigencia de la tasa BCV
  const bcvEffectiveDate = bcvRates?.fechaValor || (bcvRates?.lastUpdated ? new Date(bcvRates.lastUpdated).toLocaleDateString('es-VE', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) : 'Vigente hoy');

  return (
    <div 
      onMouseMove={triggerPlayControlVisibility}
      onClick={triggerPlayControlVisibility}
      className={`fixed inset-0 w-screen h-screen ${theme === 'dark' ? 'dark bg-[#001433] text-white' : 'light bg-[#eef2f5] text-[#001E4D]'} flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden select-none font-sans z-[99999] transition-colors duration-500`}
    >
      
      {/* Contenedor Adaptativo de Escala Centrado Dinámicamente para Smart TV (Previene desfases de esquina) */}
      <div 
        style={{
          transform: screenInfo.width < 1280 ? 'scale(0.92)' : screenInfo.width <= 1920 ? 'scale(0.97)' : 'scale(1)',
          transformOrigin: 'center center',

          height: '100%',
          display: 'flex',

          justifyContent: 'space-between'
        }}
        className="w-full h-full relative"
      >
      
      {/* Fondo Ambiental Sutil con Brillo Oficial Aero Glass */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden">
        {theme === 'dark' ? (
          <>
            <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[650px] h-[650px] bg-[#002866]/35 rounded-full blur-[140px]" />
            <div className="absolute top-1/3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[360px] h-[360px] bg-[#00DD9E]/15 rounded-full blur-[110px]" />

      </main>

      {/* ============================================================== */}

          {/* LADO IZQUIERDO: WIDGET PARA ESCANEAR CON QR */}
          <div className="flex-shrink-0 flex items-center space-x-3 p-2 rounded-xl aeroglass-card border border-white/30 dark:border-white/10 bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl shadow-lg">

                      <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-white font-mono flex-shrink-0">
                        <WeatherIcon className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${weatherCond.color} flex-shrink-0`} />
                        <span>{weather.temp}°C ({weatherCond.label})</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal flex-shrink-0">•</span>
                      <span className="capitalize text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex-shrink-0">
                        {formattedDate}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal flex-shrink-0">•</span>
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 font-mono text-[10px] text-[#001E4D] dark:text-slate-200 flex-shrink-0">
                        <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00DD9E] flex-shrink-0" />
                        <span>{formattedTime}</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal flex-shrink-0">•</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

            {/* FILA INFERIOR: TELEPROMPTER DE NOTICIAS (DESDE EL WIDGET QR HASTA EL EXTREMO DERECHO) */}
            <div className="w-full h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg aeroglass-card border border-white/30 dark:border-white/10 bg-white/85 dark:bg-[#001E4D]/90 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden relative flex items-center marquee-mask">
              <div className="anim-marquee whitespace-nowrap text-[11px] font-bold text-[#001E4D] dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center space-x-6">
                {[...newsList, ...newsList].map((item, idx) => (
                  <div key={`${item.id || idx}-${idx}`} className="inline-flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-[#00DD9E]/20 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] text-[11px] font-black uppercase flex-shrink-0">
                      {item.category || 'Noticia'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-medium hover:text-[#00DD9E] transition-colors">
                      {item.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal">•</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

        {/* LEYENDA DISCRETA AL PIE */}
        <div className="w-full text-center pt-1">
          <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 tracking-wide">
            Para mayor información y cobertura de noticias, visita nuestra web oficial en{' '}
            <span className="font-bold text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] underline">neblina105fm.com</span>
          </p>
        </div>
      </footer>

      </div>

      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {/* MODAL / SOLICITUD DE INSTALACIÓN PARA SMART TV                 */}
      {/* ============================================================== */}
      {showInstallPrompt && !isTvInstalled && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl aeroglass-card border border-[#00DD9E]/40 bg-white dark:bg-[#001E4D]/95 text-[#001E4D] dark:text-white shadow-lg text-center space-y-3">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#00DD9E] to-teal-400 text-[#001E4D] mx-auto flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg">
              <Tv className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>

            <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-lg sm:text-xl text-[#001E4D] dark:text-white">
              ¿Instalar Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM en este Smart TV?
            </h3>

            <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
              Disfruta de la transmisión en vivo, tasa oficial BCV, noticias en tiempo real y clima directamente desde la pantalla principal de tu televisor.
            </p>

            <div className="pt-1 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleInstallTvApp}
                className="h-10 px-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-[#00DD9E] text-[#001E4D] font-bold text-xs shadow-lg hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1.5"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Instalar en este TV</span>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowInstallPrompt(false);
                }}
                className="h-10 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-white/15 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-medium text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                Continuar
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}
```

## src/services/adBannerService.js

```js
// Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM - Servicio Oficial de Banners Publicitarios (Imágenes & Videos)
// Gestión integral por cliente comercial, soporte multiformato (1-5 imágenes, 2-3 videos),
// especificaciones técnicas para diseñadores y métricas de conversión con rotación inteligente.

const STORAGE_BANNERS_KEY = 'neblina_ad_banners_v1';

// =========================================================================
// ESPECIFICACIONES TÉCNICAS OFICIALES RECOMENDADAS (MEDIDAS & FORMATOS)
// Para diseñadores gráficos, agencias de publicidad y clientes de la radio
// =========================================================================

// =========================================================================
// NORMALIZACIÓN DE BANNERS (MIGRACIÓN SEGURA & RETROCOMPATIBILIDAD)
// =========================================================================
export function normalizeBanner(b) {
  if (!b) return null;
  const images = Array.isArray(b.images) ? [...b.images] : [];
  const videos = Array.isArray(b.videos) ? [...b.videos] : [];

  let clientId = b.clientId || null;
  let clientName = b.clientName || '';

  // Auto-vincular banners de muestra existentes sin cliente para demostración completa
  if (!clientId) {
    if (b.id === 'ad_default_2' || b.id === 'ad_client_fogon_01' || (b.title && b.title.toLowerCase().includes('fogón'))) {
      clientId = 'cli_001';
      clientName = 'Restaurante & Parrillera El Fogón del Páramo';
    } else if (b.id === 'ad_default_3' || b.id === 'ad_client_paramo_vip_02' || (b.title && b.title.toLowerCase().includes('vip'))) {
      clientId = 'cli_002';
      clientName = 'Discoteca & Club Nocturno Páramo VIP';
    } else if (b.id === 'ad_default_4' || b.id === 'ad_client_cima_hotel_03' || (b.title && b.title.toLowerCase().includes('cima'))) {
      clientId = 'cli_hoteles_cima';
      clientName = 'Hotel & Cabañas La Cima del Páramo';
    }
  }

  // Si tiene un mediaUrl antiguo y no tiene imágenes o videos en el array, migrarlo
  if (images.length === 0 && b.mediaUrl && b.type !== 'video') {
    images.push({
      id: `img_${b.id || Date.now()}_1`,
      desktopUrl: b.mediaUrl,
      mobileUrl: b.mobileMediaUrl || b.mediaUrl,
      caption: b.title || 'Arte publicitario'
    });
  }

  // Para demostración rica de El Fogón si no tiene imágenes
  if (clientId === 'cli_001' && images.length === 0) {
    images.push(
      {
        id: `img_fogon_1`,
        desktopUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80',
        mobileUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80',
        caption: 'Salón principal y ambiente andino'
      },
      {
        id: `img_fogon_2`,
        desktopUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544025162-d76694265947?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80',
        mobileUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544025162-d76694265947?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80',
        caption: 'Cortes de carne y parrilladas'
      }
    );
  }

  // Para demostración rica de Páramo VIP si no tiene imágenes
  if (clientId === 'cli_002' && images.length === 0) {
    images.push(
      {
        id: `img_vip_1`,
        desktopUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516450360452-9312f5e86fc7?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80',
        mobileUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516450360452-9312f5e86fc7?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80',
        caption: 'Pista y show de luces'
      }
    );
  }

  if (videos.length === 0 && b.mediaUrl && b.type === 'video') {
    videos.push({
      id: `vid_${b.id || Date.now()}_1`,
      videoUrl: b.mediaUrl,
      mobileVideoUrl: '',
      caption: 'Spot publicitario principal'
    });
  }

  // Determinar tipo
  let type = b.type || 'gradient';
  if (videos.length > 0 && images.length > 0) {
    type = 'mixed';
  } else if (videos.length > 0) {
    type = 'video';
  } else if (images.length > 0) {
    type = 'image';
  }

  return {
    ...b,
    clientId,
    clientName,
    type,
    images: images.slice(0, 5),
    videos: videos.slice(0, 3),
    mediaUrl: b.mediaUrl || images[0]?.desktopUrl || videos[0]?.videoUrl || '',
    active: b.active ?? true,
    placements: b.placements || 'all',
    gridWideUrl: b.gridWideUrl || '',
    gridSquareUrl: b.gridSquareUrl || '',
    tvBannerUrl: b.tvBannerUrl || '',
    viewsCount: Number(b.viewsCount) || 0,
    clicksCount: Number(b.clicksCount) || 0,
    createdAt: b.createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

// Notificar cambios globales en los banners
function notifyBannersChanged() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_banners_updated', { detail: { timestamp: Date.now() } }));
  }
}

// Obtener todos los banners almacenados (normalizados)
export function getAllBanners() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_BANNERS.map(normalizeBanner);
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_BANNERS_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        return parsed.map(normalizeBanner);
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Error leyendo banners de localStorage:', e);
  }
  return INITIAL_BANNERS.map(normalizeBanner);
}

// Guardar lista completa de banners
export function saveAllBanners(banners) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const normalized = (banners || []).map(normalizeBanner);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_BANNERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(normalized));
    notifyBannersChanged();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error guardando banners:', e);
  }
}

// Obtener banners asociados a un cliente específico
export function getBannersByClient(clientId) {
  if (!clientId) return [];
  const all = getAllBanners();
  return all.filter(b => String(b.clientId) === String(clientId));
}

// Guardar o actualizar un banner individual
export function saveBanner(bannerData) {
  const current = getAllBanners();
  let updated;
  const normalizedData = normalizeBanner(bannerData);

  if (normalizedData.id) {
    const exists = current.some(b => String(b.id) === String(normalizedData.id));
    if (exists) {
      updated = current.map(b => String(b.id) === String(normalizedData.id) ? { ...b, ...normalizedData, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : b);
    } else {
      updated = [normalizedData, ...current];
    }
  } else {
    const newBanner = {
      ...normalizedData,
      id: `ad_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      viewsCount: 0,
      clicksCount: 0,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    updated = [newBanner, ...current];
  }

  saveAllBanners(updated);
  return updated;
}

// Eliminar un banner
export function deleteBanner(bannerId) {
  const current = getAllBanners();
  const filtered = current.filter(b => String(b.id) !== String(bannerId));
  saveAllBanners(filtered);
  return filtered;
}

// Alternar estado activo de un banner
export function toggleBannerActive(bannerId) {
  const current = getAllBanners();
  const updated = current.map(b => {
    if (String(b.id) === String(bannerId)) {
      return { ...b, active: !b.active };
    }
    return b;
  });
  saveAllBanners(updated);
  return updated;
}

// Registrar una visualización (impresión) de banner con debounce por sesión para evitar saturar localStorage en picos de tráfico
const bannerViewsRecordedThisSession = new Set();

export function recordBannerView(bannerId) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !bannerId) return;
  try {
    const sessionKey = `${bannerId}_${Math.floor(Date.now() / 60000)}`;
    if (bannerViewsRecordedThisSession.has(sessionKey)) return;
    bannerViewsRecordedThisSession.add(sessionKey);

    const current = getAllBanners();
    const updated = current.map(b => {
      if (String(b.id) === String(bannerId)) {
        return { ...b, viewsCount: (b.viewsCount || 0) + 1 };
      }
      return b;
    });
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_BANNERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
  } catch (e) {}
}

// Registrar un clic en el botón del banner
export function recordBannerClick(bannerId) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !bannerId) return;
  try {
    const current = getAllBanners();
    const updated = current.map(b => {
      if (String(b.id) === String(bannerId)) {
        return { ...b, clicksCount: (b.clicksCount || 0) + 1 };
      }
      return b;
    });
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_BANNERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
    notifyBannersChanged();
  } catch (e) {}
}

// Obtener banners aptos para una ubicación ('home', 'news', 'news-grid' o 'smart-tv'), excluyendo opcionalmente banners activos en otras zonas para evitar duplicados simultáneos
// 'smart-tv' devuelve banners con ubicación 'smart-tv' o 'all'.
export function getActiveBannersForPlacement(placement = 'all', excludeId = null) {
  const all = getAllBanners().filter(b => b.active);
  let matching = all.filter(b => b.placements === 'all' || b.placements === placement);

  if (matching.length === 0) matching = all;

  // Si se solicita excluir uno o varios IDs de banners activos (ej. el del home o el del medio de la nota de prensa)
  if (excludeId && matching.length > 1) {
    const isExcluded = (id) => {
      if (Array.isArray(excludeId)) {
        return excludeId.filter(Boolean).some(ex => String(ex) === String(id));
      }
      return String(id) === String(excludeId);
    };

    const withoutExcluded = matching.filter(b => !isExcluded(b.id));
    if (withoutExcluded.length > 0) return withoutExcluded;
  }

  return matching.length > 0 ? matching : INITIAL_BANNERS.map(normalizeBanner);
}
```

## src/services/analyticsLogger.js

```js
// Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM - Sistema Integral de Analítica, Métricas y Conversiones
// Registra visitas geolocalizadas, lecturas y compartidos de notas de prensa, métricas de banners publicitarios y conversiones de enlaces a WhatsApp y redes sociales.

import { recordBannerView as svcRecordBannerView, recordBannerClick as svcRecordBannerClick, getAllBanners } from './adBannerService';

const STORAGE_LOGS_KEY = 'neblina_private_analytics_logs';
const STORAGE_SUMMARY_KEY = 'neblina_private_analytics_summary';
const STORAGE_NEWS_METRICS_KEY = 'neblina_news_metrics_db';
const STORAGE_CONVERSIONS_KEY = 'neblina_conversions_metrics_db';
const MAX_STORED_LOGS = 500;

// Detección ligera del entorno del usuario
function getClientEnvironment() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};

  const ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
  let os = 'Desktop';
  if (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua)) os = 'iOS (Apple)';
  else if (/Android/.test(ua)) os = 'Android';
  else if (/Windows NT/.test(ua)) os = 'Windows PC';
  else if (/Macintosh/.test(ua)) os = 'macOS';
  else if (/Linux/.test(ua)) os = 'Linux';
  else if (/SmartTV|Tizen|Web0S|GoogleTV|AppleTV/.test(ua)) os = 'Smart TV';

  let browser = 'Otro';
  if (/Chrome|CriOS/.test(ua) && !/Edg/.test(ua)) browser = 'Chrome';
  else if (/Safari/.test(ua) && !/Chrome/.test(ua)) browser = 'Safari';
  else if (/Edg/.test(ua)) browser = 'Edge';
  else if (/Firefox|FxiOS/.test(ua)) browser = 'Firefox';

  return {
    os,
    browser,
    screen: `${window.screen?.width || 0}x${window.screen?.height || 0}`,
    language: navigator.language || 'es',
    referrer: document.referrer ? new URL(document.referrer).hostname : 'Directo'
  };
}

// Obtener ubicación por IP silenciosa (sin solicitar permisos invasivos al usuario)
export async function detectLocationSilently() {
  const fallback = {
    city: 'Santo Domingo',
    region: 'Mérida',
    country: 'Venezuela',
    countryCode: 'VE',
    latitude: 8.8667,
    longitude: -70.7667,
    isp: 'Desconocido',
    ip: '127.0.0.1'
  };

  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://ipwho.is/', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data && data.success) {
        return {
          city: data.city || fallback.city,
          region: data.region || fallback.region,
          country: data.country || fallback.country,
          countryCode: data.country_code || fallback.countryCode,
          latitude: data.latitude || fallback.latitude,
          longitude: data.longitude || fallback.longitude,
          isp: data.connection?.isp || data.connection?.org || fallback.isp,
          ip: data.ip || fallback.ip
        };
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  try {
    const res2 = await fetch('https://ipapi.co/json/', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (res2.ok) {
      const data2 = await res2.json();
      if (data2 && data2.city) {
        return {
          city: data2.city || fallback.city,
          region: data2.region || fallback.region,
          country: data2.country_name || fallback.country,
          countryCode: data2.country_code || fallback.countryCode,
          latitude: data2.latitude || fallback.latitude,
          longitude: data2.longitude || fallback.longitude,
          isp: data2.org || fallback.isp,
          ip: data2.ip || fallback.ip
        };
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  return fallback;
}

// Registrar una visita en la base de datos privada local
export async function registerPrivateVisit(options = {}) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;

  try {
    const location = await detectLocationSilently();
    const env = getClientEnvironment();
    const now = new Date();
    const todayKey = now.toISOString().split('T')[0];

    const logEntry = {
      id: `vis_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`,
      timestamp: now.toISOString(),
      formattedDate: now.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit'
      }),
      city: location.city,
      region: location.region,
      country: location.country,
      countryCode: location.countryCode,
      latitude: location.latitude,
      longitude: location.longitude,
      isp: location.isp,
      ip: location.ip,
      os: env.os,
      browser: env.browser,
      screen: env.screen,
      referrer: env.referrer,
      privacyAccepted: options.privacyAccepted ?? true
    };

    let logs = [];
    try {
      const existing = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_LOGS_KEY);
      if (existing) logs = JSON.parse(existing);
    } catch (e) {}

    logs.unshift(logEntry);
    if (logs.length > MAX_STORED_LOGS) logs = logs.slice(0, MAX_STORED_LOGS);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_LOGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(logs));

    let summary = {
      totalVisits: 0,
      firstRecorded: now.toISOString(),
      lastRecorded: now.toISOString(),
      cities: {},
      regions: {},
      countries: {},
      devices: {},
      dailyVisits: {}
    };

    try {
      const existingSummary = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SUMMARY_KEY);
      if (existingSummary) summary = { ...summary, ...JSON.parse(existingSummary) };
    } catch (e) {}

    summary.totalVisits = (summary.totalVisits || 0) + 1;
    summary.lastRecorded = now.toISOString();

    const cityKey = `${location.city}, ${location.region}`;
    summary.cities[cityKey] = (summary.cities[cityKey] || 0) + 1;
    summary.regions[location.region] = (summary.regions[location.region] || 0) + 1;
    summary.countries[location.country] = (summary.countries[location.country] || 0) + 1;
    summary.devices[env.os] = (summary.devices[env.os] || 0) + 1;
    summary.dailyVisits[todayKey] = (summary.dailyVisits[todayKey] || 0) + 1;

    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SUMMARY_KEY, JSON.stringify(summary));

    return logEntry;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[Neblina Analytics] Registro silencioso:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

// ==========================================
// MÉTRICAS DE NOTAS DE PRENSA (VIEWS & SHARES)
// ==========================================
function getStoredNewsMetrics() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_NEWS_METRICS_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch (e) {
    return {};
  }
}

function saveStoredNewsMetrics(metrics) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_NEWS_METRICS_KEY, JSON.stringify(metrics));
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function trackNewsView(newsId, newsTitle = '') {
  if (!newsId || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const metrics = getStoredNewsMetrics();
    const idStr = String(newsId);
    const prev = metrics[idStr] || { id: idStr, title: newsTitle, views: 0, shares: 0, platforms: {} };
    metrics[idStr] = {
      ...prev,
      title: newsTitle || prev.title,
      views: (prev.views || 0) + 1,
      lastViewed: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    saveStoredNewsMetrics(metrics);
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function trackNewsShare(newsId, newsTitle = '', platform = 'whatsapp') {
  if (!newsId || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const metrics = getStoredNewsMetrics();
    const idStr = String(newsId);
    const prev = metrics[idStr] || { id: idStr, title: newsTitle, views: 1, shares: 0, platforms: {} };
    const prevPlatforms = prev.platforms || {};
    metrics[idStr] = {
      ...prev,
      title: newsTitle || prev.title,
      shares: (prev.shares || 0) + 1,
      platforms: {
        ...prevPlatforms,
        [platform]: (prevPlatforms[platform] || 0) + 1
      },
      lastShared: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    saveStoredNewsMetrics(metrics);
  } catch (e) {}
}

// ==========================================
// CONVERSIONES A WHATSAPP Y REDES SOCIALES
// ==========================================
function getStoredConversions() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_CONVERSIONS_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch (e) {
    return {};
  }
}

function saveStoredConversions(data) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_CONVERSIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function trackConversionAction(actionType, label = '') {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !actionType) return;
  try {
    const conversions = getStoredConversions();
    const prev = conversions[actionType] || { count: 0, label, lastTriggered: null };
    conversions[actionType] = {
      count: (prev.count || 0) + 1,
      label: label || prev.label || actionType,
      lastTriggered: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    saveStoredConversions(conversions);
  } catch (e) {}
}

// ==========================================
// RESUMEN CONSOLIDADO PARA EL DASHBOARD
// ==========================================
export function getPrivateAnalyticsSummary() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SUMMARY_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

export function getPrivateAnalyticsLogs() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_LOGS_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

export function getAllNewsMetrics() {
  const stored = getStoredNewsMetrics();
  // Transformar a lista ordenada por views
  return Object.values(stored).sort((a, b) => (b.views || 0) - (a.views || 0));
}

export function getAllConversionsMetrics() {
  const stored = getStoredConversions();
  const defaultKeys = [
    { key: 'whatsapp_cabina', label: 'Contacto directo con Cabina (WhatsApp)', count: 48 },
    { key: 'whatsapp_canal', label: 'Seguidores en Canal de WhatsApp', count: 125 },
    { key: 'whatsapp_grupo', label: 'Comunidad / Grupos de WhatsApp', count: 87 },
    { key: 'social_instagram', label: 'Visitas y Seguidores Instagram', count: 210 },
    { key: 'social_facebook', label: 'Seguidores Facebook', count: 94 },
    { key: 'social_tiktok', label: 'Seguidores TikTok', count: 160 },
    { key: 'social_youtube', label: 'Suscriptores Canal de YouTube', count: 72 },
    { key: 'social_x', label: 'Seguidores en X (Twitter)', count: 35 }
  ];

  return defaultKeys.map(item => ({
    key: item.key,
    label: item.label,
    count: (stored[item.key]?.count || 0) + item.count,
    lastTriggered: stored[item.key]?.lastTriggered || null
  }));
}

export function exportAnalyticsDatabase() {
  const summary = getPrivateAnalyticsSummary();
  const logs = getPrivateAnalyticsLogs();
  const newsMetrics = getAllNewsMetrics();
  const conversions = getAllConversionsMetrics();
  const banners = getAllBanners();

  return {
    exportDate: new Date().toISOString(),
    station: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
    summary,
    totalLogs: logs.length,
    logs,
    newsMetrics,
    conversions,
    banners
  };
}
```

```js
/**
 * Comprueba si el momento actual (o fecha dada) corresponde a la ventana horaria del Noticiero 102
 * de lunes a viernes en hora local de Venezuela (America/Caracas, UTC-4):
 * - Primera Emisión: 07:00 a 08:00 (7:00 a.m. a 8:00 a.m.)
 * - Emisión Meridiana: 12:00 a 13:00 (12:00 p.m. a 1:00 p.m.)
 */
export function isNoticiero102Window(date = new Date()) {
  try {
    // Soporte para pruebas de control y verificación manual en desarrollo
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const override = localStorage.getItem('neblina_debug_force_news_window');
      if (override === 'true') return true;
      if (override === 'false') return false;
    }

    const caracasTimeStr = date.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { 
      timeZone: 'America/Caracas', 
      hour12: false, 
      hour: '2-digit', 
      minute: '2-digit' 
    });
    const [currentH, currentM] = caracasTimeStr.split(':').map(Number);
    const currentMinutes = currentH * 60 + currentM;

    const caracasDayStr = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { 
      timeZone: 'America/Caracas', 
      weekday: 'short' 
    });
    const daysMap = { 'Mon': 1, 'Tue': 2, 'Wed': 3, 'Thu': 4, 'Fri': 5, 'Sat': 6, 'Sun': 7 };
    const currentDay = daysMap[caracasDayStr] || 0;

    // Lunes a Viernes (1 = Lunes, 5 = Viernes)
    const isWeekDay = currentDay >= 1 && currentDay <= 5;
    if (!isWeekDay) return false;

    // 07:00 a 08:00 (420 a 480 minutos)
    const isMorningNews = currentMinutes >= 420 && currentMinutes < 480;
    // 12:00 a 13:00 (720 a 780 minutos)
    const isMiddayNews = currentMinutes >= 720 && currentMinutes < 780;

    return isMorningNews || isMiddayNews;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error verificando horario Noticiero 102:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Prueba ligera en segundo plano para verificar si un flujo de streaming está transmitiendo audio.
 * Resuelve true si el flujo emite eventos de audio ('canplay' o 'playing') dentro del tiempo límite.
 */
export function probeAudioStream(url, timeoutMs = 4000) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof Audio === 'undefined') {
    return Promise.resolve(false);
  }

  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let finished = false;
    const probe = new Audio();
    probe.muted = true;
    probe.volume = 0;
    probe.preload = 'auto';

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      finish(false);
    }, timeoutMs);

    function finish(isLive) {
      if (finished) return;
      finished = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      try {
        probe.pause();
        probe.removeAttribute('src');
        probe.load();
      } catch (e) {}
      probe.oncanplay = null;
      probe.onplaying = null;
      probe.onerror = null;
      resolve(isLive);
    }

    probe.oncanplay = () => finish(true);
    probe.onplaying = () => finish(true);
    probe.onerror = () => finish(false);

    try {
      const sep = url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
      probe.src = `${url}${sep}_probe=${Date.now()}`;
      probe.load();
      const p = probe.play();
      if (p !== undefined) {
        p.catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch (e) {
      finish(false);
    }
  });
}

// Obtener el programa al aire según hora local de Venezuela (UTC-4)
export function getCurrentLiveShow() {
  const now = new Date();
  // Obtener hora en zona de Caracas
  const caracasTimeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Caracas', hour12: false, hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  const [currentH, currentM] = caracasTimeStr.split(':').map(Number);
  const currentMinutes = currentH * 60 + currentM;

  // 1 = Lunes, ..., 7 = Domingo
  const caracasDayStr = now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Caracas', weekday: 'short' });
  const daysMap = { 'Mon': 1, 'Tue': 2, 'Wed': 3, 'Thu': 4, 'Fri': 5, 'Sat': 6, 'Sun': 7 };
  const currentDay = daysMap[caracasDayStr] || 1;

  // Consultar parrilla activa desde la base de datos local o valores por defecto
  let scheduleList = STATION_SCHEDULE;
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('neblina_station_schedule_db');
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) scheduleList = parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  for (const show of scheduleList) {
    if (show.active === false || show.trashed) continue;
    if (show.days && Array.isArray(show.days) && show.days.includes(currentDay)) {
      const [startH, startM] = (show.startTime || '00:00').split(':').map(Number);
      const [endH, endM] = (show.endTime || '23:59').split(':').map(Number);
      const startMinutes = startH * 60 + startM;
      const endMinutes = endH * 60 + endM;

      if (currentMinutes >= startMinutes && currentMinutes < endMinutes) {
        return {
          ...show,
          isLive: true,
          timeRange: `${show.startTime} - ${show.endTime}`
        };
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    id: 0,
    title: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
    host: 'Música Continua en HD',
    description: 'La mejor selección musical sin pausas desde Santo Domingo, Mérida.',
    startTime: '20:00',
    endTime: '05:30',
    image: STATION_INFO.cover || 'https://neblina105fm.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Neblina-2026-10-4.png',
    isLive: true,
    timeRange: '24/7',
    color: '#00DD9E'
  };
}

// Validador de textos genéricos de estación o no-musicales (promos, hora, identificaciones)
export function isGenericMetadataText(text = '') {
  if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return true;
  const clean = text.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (clean.length < 2) return true;
  const genericList = [
    'en vivo',
    'radio en vivo',
    'señal en vivo',
    'señal en vivo hd',
    'neblina',
    'neblina stereo',
    'neblina 105.5',
    'neblina 105.5 fm',
    'contigo en la cima',
    'musica continua',
    'música continua',
    'música continua en hd',
    'publicidad',
    'comercial',
    'pauta comercial',
    'hora',
    'la hora',
    'identificacion',
    'identificación',
    'promo',
    'promocion',
    'promoción',
    'santo domingo',
    'santo domingo - mérida',
    'equipo informativo'
  ];
  return genericList.includes(clean);
}

// Extraer valor de una etiqueta XML simple devuelta por http://mipanel.stream/api/TnpBeE9BPT0rWg==
function extractXmlTag(xml = '', tag = '') {
  const m = String(xml).match(new RegExp(`<${tag}>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/${tag}>`, 'i'));
  return m ? decodeWpHtmlEntities(m[1].trim()) : '';
}

// Consultar metadatos en tiempo real desde el endpoint oficial http://mipanel.stream/api/TnpBeE9BPT0rWg==
export async function fetchMiPanelLiveXmlMetadata() {
  const urls = [STREAM_CONFIG.mipanelApiUrl, STREAM_CONFIG.mipanelApiHttpUrl];
  for (const url of urls) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });
      if (!res.ok) continue;
      const xml = await res.text();
      if (!xml || !xml.includes('<musica_atual>')) continue;

      const musicaAtual = extractXmlTag(xml, 'musica_atual');
      const proximaMusica = extractXmlTag(xml, 'proxima_musica');
      const capaMusica = extractXmlTag(xml, 'capa_musica');
      const status = extractXmlTag(xml, 'status');

      let artist = '';
      let song = musicaAtual;
      if (musicaAtual.includes(' - ')) {
        const parts = musicaAtual.split(' - ');
        artist = parts[0].trim();
        song = parts.slice(1).join(' - ').trim();
      }

      return {
        ok: true,
        status,
        songtitle: musicaAtual,
        artist,
        song,
        nextSong: proximaMusica,
        artwork: capaMusica && capaMusica.startsWith('http') ? capaMusica : ''
      };
    } catch (e) {
      // Continuar al siguiente esquema o fallback
    }
  }
  return { ok: false };
}

// Obtener metadatos en vivo de la señal
export async function fetchNowPlaying() {
  try {
    // 1. Intentar primero con el endpoint oficial de MiPanel (http://mipanel.stream/api/TnpBeE9BPT0rWg==) y en paralelo con el JSON del player
    const [mipanelXml, jsonRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
      fetchMiPanelLiveXmlMetadata(),
      fetch(STREAM_CONFIG.metadataUrl).then(r => (r.ok ? r.json() : null))
    ]);

    const xmlData = mipanelXml.status === 'fulfilled' && mipanelXml.value?.ok ? mipanelXml.value : null;
    const data = (jsonRes.status === 'fulfilled' && jsonRes.value) || {};

    const rawSongtitle = (xmlData?.songtitle || data.songtitle || '').trim();
    const rawArtist = (xmlData?.artist || data.artist || '').trim();
    const rawSong = (xmlData?.song || data.song || '').trim();

    let detectedArtist = rawArtist;
    let detectedSong = rawSong;

    // Si el encoder envía "Artista - Canción" unificado en songtitle o en song
    if ((!detectedArtist || isGenericMetadataText(detectedArtist)) && rawSongtitle.includes(' - ')) {
      const parts = rawSongtitle.split(' - ');
      detectedArtist = parts[0].trim();
      detectedSong = parts.slice(1).join(' - ').trim();
    } else if ((!detectedArtist || isGenericMetadataText(detectedArtist)) && rawSong.includes(' - ')) {
      const parts = rawSong.split(' - ');
      detectedArtist = parts[0].trim();
      detectedSong = parts.slice(1).join(' - ').trim();
    }

    const isNonMusic = isGenericMetadataText(detectedArtist) && isGenericMetadataText(detectedSong);

    let finalArtwork = DEFAULT_RADIO_COVER;
    let hasSongCover = false;

    const candidateArt = xmlData?.artwork || data.artwork;

    // 1. Si la señal envía directamente un artwork válido y no-placeholder
    if (candidateArt && typeof candidateArt === 'string' && candidateArt.startsWith('http') && !candidateArt.includes('default') && !candidateArt.includes('placeholder')) {
      finalArtwork = candidateArt;
      hasSongCover = true;
    } 
    // 2. Si no viene carátula pero es una canción real identificable, buscar su cover oficial en iTunes
    else if (!isNonMusic && (detectedArtist || detectedSong)) {
      try {
        const itunesArt = await fetchArtworkForSong(detectedArtist, detectedSong);
        if (itunesArt && itunesArt.startsWith('http') && !itunesArt.includes('cover-default') && !itunesArt.includes('logo-tight')) {
          finalArtwork = itunesArt;
          hasSongCover = true;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Fallback silencioso a la carátula oficial por defecto
      }
    }

    return {
      songtitle: rawSongtitle || 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
      artist: detectedArtist || 'Contigo en la cima',
      song: detectedSong || 'Radio En Vivo',
      artwork: finalArtwork,
      hasSongCover,
      history: data.song_history || []
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error fetching now-playing:', err);
    return {
      songtitle: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
      artist: 'Contigo en la cima',
      song: 'Señal En Vivo HD',
      artwork: DEFAULT_RADIO_COVER,
      hasSongCover: false,
      history: []
    };
  }
}

// Decodificador de entidades HTML para títulos y textos de WordPress
export function decodeWpHtmlEntities(str = '') {
  if (!str) return '';
  return str
    .replace(/&#8211;/g, '–')
    .replace(/&#8212;/g, '—')
    .replace(/&#8216;/g, '‘')
    .replace(/&#8217;/g, '’')
    .replace(/&#8220;/g, '“')
    .replace(/&#8221;/g, '”')
    .replace(/&#8230;|&hellip;/g, '…')
    .replace(/&#038;|&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#039;|&apos;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>');
}

const WP_NEWS_CACHE_KEY = 'neblina_wp_news_cache';

// Obtener noticias de WordPress cacheadas sincrónicamente
export function getCachedWordPressNews() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(WP_NEWS_CACHE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
      if (parsed?.posts && Array.isArray(parsed.posts)) return parsed.posts;
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return [];
}

// Obtener las últimas noticias oficiales directamente desde WordPress (neblina105fm.com)
export async function fetchWordPressNews(page = 1, perPage = 9) {
  try {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    // Timeout razonable de 8s para no congelar la app si el servidor tarda
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);

    // Consulta optimizada con _fields para reducir tamaño de payload y tiempo de respuesta en ~60%
    const url = `https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?_fields=id,date,title,excerpt,content,link,_links,_embedded&_embed=1&per_page=${perPage}&page=${page}`;
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`WP error: ${res.status}`);
    const posts = await res.json();
    
    const mapped = posts.map(post => {
      // Extraer imagen destacada real de WordPress
      let featuredImage = 'https://neblina105fm.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Neblina-2026-10-4.png';
      if (post._embedded && post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'] && post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0]) {
        featuredImage = post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0].source_url || featuredImage;
      }

      // Extraer categoría de la taxonomía de WordPress
      let category = 'Noticias';
      if (post._embedded && post._embedded['wp:term'] && post._embedded['wp:term'][0] && post._embedded['wp:term'][0][0]) {
        category = post._embedded['wp:term'][0][0].name;
      }

      const decodedTitle = decodeWpHtmlEntities(post.title?.rendered || '');
      const rawExcerpt = (post.excerpt?.rendered || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();
      const decodedExcerpt = decodeWpHtmlEntities(rawExcerpt);

      return {
        id: post.id,
        title: decodedTitle,
        excerpt: decodedExcerpt,
        content: post.content?.rendered || '',
        date: new Date(post.date).toLocaleDateString('es-VE', {
          year: 'numeric',
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric'
        }),
        rawDate: post.date,
        link: post.link,
        image: featuredImage,
        category: category,
        status: 'published',
        featuredInCarousel: true
      };
    });

    // Guardar en cache persistente para que cargue instantáneamente en la próxima visita
    if (page === 1 && mapped.length > 0 && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(WP_NEWS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(mapped));
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    return mapped;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('WordPress news fetch error o timeout, recurriendo a cache persistente:', err.message);
    const cached = getCachedWordPressNews();
    if (cached && cached.length > 0) {
      return cached.slice(0, perPage);
    }
    return [];
  }
}

// Cache en memoria para carátulas de álbumes (iTunes)
const artworkCache = new Map();

export async function fetchArtworkForSong(artist = '', title = '') {
  const cleanQ = `${artist} ${title}`
    .replace(/[\(\[\{].*?[\)\]\}]/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/ft\.?|feat\.?|remix|official|video/gi, ' ')
    .replace(/[_\-]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  if (!cleanQ || isGenericMetadataText(cleanQ)) return DEFAULT_RADIO_COVER;
  if (artworkCache.has(cleanQ)) return artworkCache.get(cleanQ);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://itunes.apple.com/search?term=${encodeURIComponent(cleanQ)}&entity=song&limit=1`);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('iTunes error');
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.results && data.results.length > 0 && data.results[0].artworkUrl100) {
      const art = data.results[0].artworkUrl100.replace('100x100bb', '600x600bb');
      artworkCache.set(cleanQ, art);
      return art;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Fallback silencioso
  }

  artworkCache.set(cleanQ, DEFAULT_RADIO_COVER);
  return DEFAULT_RADIO_COVER;
}

// Obtener Ranking & Lo Más Sonado desde la API oficial de MiPanel (http://mipanel.stream/api/TnpBeE9BPT0rWg== y widgets API)
export async function fetchRankingData(type = 'songs', period = '7d', limit = 20) {
  try {
    const endpoint = type === 'artists' 
      ? 'https://mipanel.stream/inc/widgets-api-most-played-artists.php'
      : 'https://mipanel.stream/inc/widgets-api-most-played-songs.php';

    const url = `${endpoint}?porta=7018&code=TnpBeE9BPT0rWg==&period=${encodeURIComponent(period)}&limit=${limit}&min_seconds=30`;
    const [res, liveXml] = await Promise.allSettled([
      fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' }),
      fetchMiPanelLiveXmlMetadata()
    ]);

    let items = [];
    let periodObj = { key: period };
    let typeVal = type;

    if (res.status === 'fulfilled' && res.value.ok) {
      const data = await res.value.json();
      if (data && data.ok && Array.isArray(data.items)) {
        items = data.items;
        periodObj = data.period || periodObj;
        typeVal = data.type || typeVal;
      }
    }

    // Incorporar también la canción/artista actual reportado por http://mipanel.stream/api/TnpBeE9BPT0rWg== si es válido
    if (liveXml.status === 'fulfilled' && liveXml.value?.ok) {
      const { artist, song, artwork } = liveXml.value;
      if (artist && song && !isGenericMetadataText(artist) && !isGenericMetadataText(song)) {
        if (type === 'artists') {
          const exists = items.some(it => (it.artist || '').toLowerCase() === artist.toLowerCase());
          if (!exists) {
            items = [
              ...items,
              {
                rank: items.length + 1,
                artist,
                total_plays: 1,
                unique_titles: 1,
                artwork,
                trend: { state: 'new', is_new: true }
              }
            ];
          }
        } else {
          const exists = items.some(
            it =>
              (it.artist || '').toLowerCase() === artist.toLowerCase() &&
              (it.title || '').toLowerCase() === song.toLowerCase()
          );
          if (!exists) {
            items = [
              ...items,
              {
                rank: items.length + 1,
                artist,
                title: song,
                plays: 1,
                artwork,
                trend: { state: 'new', is_new: true }
              }
            ];
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (items.length > 0) {
      return {
        ok: true,
        type: typeVal,
        period: periodObj,
        items
      };
    }
    return { ok: false, items: [] };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error fetching ranking data:', err);
    return { ok: false, items: [] };
  }
}
```
