// Notificar a toda la aplicación que las noticias se han modificado
function notifyNewsChanged() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_news_updated'));
  }
}

// Obtener todas las noticias (para el panel interno administrativo)
export function getAllNews() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return DEFAULT_NEWS;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_NEWS_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        // Filtrar viejos mocks de prueba (news_101 a news_104) para que solo aparezcan noticias reales
        const cleaned = parsed.filter(item => {
          if (typeof item.id === 'string' && item.id.startsWith('news_10')) return false;
          return true;
        });
        if (cleaned.length > 0) return cleaned;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Error leyendo noticias de localStorage:', e);
  }
  return DEFAULT_NEWS;
}

// Obtener solo noticias publicadas (para las vistas públicas)
export function getPublishedNews() {
  const all = getAllNews();
  return all.filter(item => item.status === 'published' && !item.trashed);
}

// Guardar lista completa en localStorage e IndexedDB
export function saveAllNews(newsList) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_NEWS_KEY, JSON.stringify(newsList));
    notifyNewsChanged();
    saveAllNewsToIndexedDB(newsList).catch(e => console.warn('IndexedDB sync error:', e));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error guardando noticias:', e);
  }
}

// Guardar o actualizar una sola noticia (Creación / Edición)
export function saveNewsItem(newsData) {
  const all = [...getAllNews()];
  const index = all.findIndex(item => String(item.id) === String(newsData.id));

  const formattedDate = newsData.date || new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-VE', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    year: 'numeric'
  });

  const validImages = Array.isArray(newsData.images) && newsData.images.length > 0
    ? newsData.images.filter(Boolean)
    : (newsData.image ? [newsData.image] : []);
  const primaryImage = validImages[0] || newsData.image || '';

  if (index >= 0) {
    all[index] = {
      ...all[index],
      ...newsData,
      image: primaryImage,
      images: validImages,
      date: formattedDate,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  } else {
    const newItem = {
      ...newsData,
      id: newsData.id || `custom_news_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      image: primaryImage,
      images: validImages,
      date: formattedDate,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: newsData.status || 'published',
      featuredInCarousel: newsData.featuredInCarousel !== undefined ? newsData.featuredInCarousel : true,
      isCustomCreated: true
    };
    all.unshift(newItem);
  }

  saveAllNews(all);
  return all;
}

// Enviar una noticia a la papelera (Eliminación temporal)
export function trashNewsItem(id) {
  const all = getAllNews().map(item => {
    if (String(item.id) === String(id)) {
      return { ...item, trashed: true, trashedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return item;
  });
  saveAllNews(all);
  return all;
}

// Restaurar una noticia desde la papelera
export function restoreNewsItem(id) {
  const all = getAllNews().map(item => {
    if (String(item.id) === String(id)) {
      return { ...item, trashed: false, trashedAt: null };
    }
    return item;
  });
  saveAllNews(all);
  return all;
}

// Eliminar una noticia definitivamente
export function deleteNewsItem(id) {
  const all = getAllNews().filter(item => String(item.id) !== String(id));
  saveAllNews(all);
  return all;
}

export const deleteNewsItemPermanently = deleteNewsItem;

// Vaciar papelera de noticias
export function emptyNewsTrash() {
  const all = getAllNews().filter(item => !item.trashed);
  saveAllNews(all);
  return all;
}

// Alternar estado de Destacado en el Carrusel
export function toggleNewsFeatured(id) {
  const all = getAllNews().map(item => {
    if (item.id === id) {
      return { ...item, featuredInCarousel: !item.featuredInCarousel };
    }
    return item;
  });
  saveAllNews(all);
  return all;
}

// Alternar estado Publicado vs Borrador
export function toggleNewsPublished(id) {
  const all = getAllNews().map(item => {
    if (item.id === id) {
      const newStatus = item.status === 'published' ? 'draft' : 'published';
      return { ...item, status: newStatus };
    }
    return item;
  });
  saveAllNews(all);
  return all;
}

// Restablecer noticias predeterminadas oficiales de neblina105fm.com
export function resetDefaultNews() {
  saveAllNews(DEFAULT_NEWS);
  return DEFAULT_NEWS;
}

// Combinar noticias de WordPress (neblina105fm.com) con personalizadas del CMS
export function getCombinedNews(wpNews = []) {
  // 1. Obtener noticias de WP pasadas por parámetro o desde cache de neblina105fm.com
  const activeWp = (wpNews && wpNews.length > 0) ? wpNews : getCachedWordPressNews();
  const wpMarked = (activeWp && activeWp.length > 0 ? activeWp : DEFAULT_NEWS).map(wp => ({
    ...wp,
    isLocalCustom: false
  }));

  // 2. Extraer solo noticias locales creadas manualmente en el CMS
  const custom = getPublishedNews().filter(n => {
    if (typeof n.id === 'number') return false; // ID numérico pertenece a WordPress
    if (typeof n.id === 'string' && n.id.startsWith('news_10')) return false; // Mock antiguo
    return n.isCustomCreated === true;
  }).map(n => ({
    ...n,
    isLocalCustom: true
  }));

  // 3. Fusionar evitando duplicados por ID
  const seenIds = new Set();
  const merged = [];

  for (const item of [...custom, ...wpMarked]) {
    if (!seenIds.has(item.id)) {
      seenIds.add(item.id);
      merged.push(item);
    }
  }

  return merged.length > 0 ? merged : DEFAULT_NEWS;
}

// Obtener las noticias para el carrusel de inicio (por defecto 9)
export function getCarouselNews(combinedNews = [], limit = 9) {
  if (!combinedNews || combinedNews.length === 0) return [];

  // Priorizar noticias con featuredInCarousel: true
  const featured = combinedNews.filter(n => n.featuredInCarousel === true);
  const others = combinedNews.filter(n => n.featuredInCarousel !== true);

  const merged = [...featured, ...others];
  return merged.slice(0, limit);
}

// Exportar base de datos de noticias a JSON
export function exportNewsJSON() {
  const news = getAllNews();
  const data = {
    station: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
    source: 'neblina105fm.com',
    module: 'Módulo de Noticias y Sala de Prensa',
    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    total: news.length,
    news
  };
  return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
}

// Importar base de datos de noticias desde JSON
export function importNewsJSON(jsonString) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonString);
    const list = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (parsed.news || []);
    if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('El archivo no contiene una lista válida de noticias.');
    }
    saveAllNews(list);
    return { success: true, count: list.length };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

// Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM - Almacenamiento Persistente en IndexedDB
// Permite guardar miles de notas de prensa completas de WordPress sin límite de cuota de localStorage

const DB_NAME = 'neblina_news_store_v1';
const STORE_NAME = 'news_posts';

function openDB() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.indexedDB) {
      return resolve(null);
    }
    const req = window.indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
    req.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
      const db = e.target.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: 'id' });
      }
    };
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
  });
}

export async function saveAllNewsToIndexedDB(posts = []) {
  if (!Array.isArray(posts) || posts.length === 0) return;
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    if (!db) return;
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    
    // Guardar o actualizar cada post
    for (const post of posts) {
      if (post && post.id !== undefined) {
        store.put(post);
      }
    }

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(true);
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error guardando en IndexedDB:', err);
  }
}

export async function getAllNewsFromIndexedDB() {
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    if (!db) return [];
    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
    const req = store.getAll();

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error leyendo desde IndexedDB:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

// Servicio de Notificaciones Nativas y Alertas de Noticias para Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM

const LAST_POST_KEY = 'neblina_last_seen_post_id';
const NOTIF_SETTINGS_KEY = 'neblina_notifications_enabled';

// Activa las notificaciones por defecto sin diálogos ni preguntas molestas
export async function autoEnableNotifications() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(NOTIF_SETTINGS_KEY, 'true');
    if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'default') {
      await Notification.requestPermission().catch(() => {});
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

export async function requestNotificationPermission() {
  if (!('Notification' in window)) {
    console.warn('Este dispositivo no soporta notificaciones de sistema.');
    return 'unsupported';
  }

  try {
    const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
    if (permission === 'granted') {
      localStorage.setItem(NOTIF_SETTINGS_KEY, 'true');
    }
    return permission;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error solicitando permisos de notificación:', err);
    return 'denied';
  }
}

export function isNotificationSupported() {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'Notification' in window;
}

export function getNotificationPermission() {
  if (!isNotificationSupported()) return 'unsupported';
  return Notification.permission;
}

// Muestra notificación del tema que se está reproduciendo en la transmisión
export async function showNowPlayingNotification(songData) {
  if (!isNotificationSupported() || Notification.permission !== 'granted') return;

  // Aislamiento: No emitir notificaciones de la radio si el usuario está dentro de un sistema interno
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
    if (hash === '#admin' || hash === '#clientes' || hash === '#locutores') return;
  }

  const title = songData.song || songData.songtitle || 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM';
  const artist = songData.artist ? `Con: ${songData.artist}` : 'Santo Domingo - Mérida · En Vivo';
  const artwork = songData.artwork || '/icon-192.png';

  try {
    // Si hay Service Worker activo, usar showNotification para mejor soporte en Android y PWAs instaladas
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
      const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
      reg.showNotification(title, {
        body: artist,
        icon: '/icon-192.png',
        badge: '/icon-192.png',
        image: artwork,
        tag: 'now-playing',
        renotify: false,
        silent: true
      });
    } else {
      new Notification(title, {
        body: artist,
        icon: '/icon-192.png',
        tag: 'now-playing',
        silent: true
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('No se pudo emitir la notificación de reproducción:', err);
  }
}

// Muestra notificación de nueva noticia publicada en WordPress
export async function showNewsNotification(post) {
  if (!isNotificationSupported() || Notification.permission !== 'granted') return;

  // Aislamiento: No emitir notificaciones públicas de noticias dentro de los sistemas internos
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    const hash = (window.location.hash || '').toLowerCase();
    if (hash === '#admin' || hash === '#clientes' || hash === '#locutores') return;
  }

  const title = `📰 Última Hora: ${post.title.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '')}`;
  const body = post.excerpt ? post.excerpt.slice(0, 140) + '...' : 'Nueva publicación en Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM';
  const image = post.image || '/logo.png';

  try {
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
      const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
      reg.showNotification(title, {
        body: body,
        icon: '/icon-192.png',
        badge: '/icon-192.png',
        image: image,
        tag: `news-${post.id}`,
        renotify: true,
        vibrate: [200, 100, 200],
        data: {
          url: '/',
          postId: post.id
        }
      });
    } else {
      new Notification(title, {
        body: body,
        icon: '/icon-192.png',
        tag: `news-${post.id}`
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error mostrando notificación de noticia:', err);
  }
}

// Muestra notificación de prueba instantánea para verificar funcionamiento
export async function sendTestNotification() {
  const perm = await requestNotificationPermission();
  if (perm !== 'granted') {
    alert('Por favor autoriza las notificaciones en tu navegador o dispositivo para recibir alertas.');
    return false;
  }

  showNewsNotification({
    id: Date.now(),
    title: '¡Notificaciones de Neblina 105.5 FM Activadas!',
    excerpt: 'Recibirás avisos inmediatos en tu dispositivo cada vez que se publique una nueva noticia o reporte.',
    image: '/logo.png'
  });
  return true;
}

// Muestra notificación nativa del Portal de Clientes (Pagos, Vencimientos y Mensajes del Director)
export async function showPortalPushNotification({ title, body, tag = 'portal-alert' }) {
  if (!isNotificationSupported() || Notification.permission !== 'granted') return false;

  try {
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
      const reg = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
      await reg.showNotification(title, {
        body,
        icon: '/icon-192.png',
        badge: '/icon-192.png',
        tag,
        renotify: true,
        vibrate: [200, 100, 200]
      });
    } else {
      new Notification(title, {
        body,
        icon: '/icon-192.png',
        tag
      });
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('No se pudo emitir la notificación del portal:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

// Monitor en segundo plano que revisa la API de WordPress periódicamente
export function initNewsNotificationMonitor() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  const checkLatestNews = async () => {
    // Solo verificar si el usuario tiene las notificaciones activadas
    if (getNotificationPermission() !== 'granted') return;

    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=1&_embed=1');
      if (!res.ok) return;
      const posts = await res.json();
      if (!posts || posts.length === 0) return;

      const latestPost = posts[0];
      const lastSeenIdStr = localStorage.getItem(LAST_POST_KEY);
      const lastSeenId = lastSeenIdStr ? parseInt(lastSeenIdStr, 10) : null;

      // Si es la primera vez que se ejecuta, guardar el ID actual como base para no alertar noticias viejas
      if (!lastSeenId) {
        localStorage.setItem(LAST_POST_KEY, latestPost.id.toString());
        return;
      }

      // Si hay un post nuevo con ID mayor al último visto
      if (latestPost.id > lastSeenId) {
        localStorage.setItem(LAST_POST_KEY, latestPost.id.toString());

        let featuredImage = '/logo.png';
        if (latestPost._embedded && latestPost._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'] && latestPost._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0]) {
          featuredImage = latestPost._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0].source_url || featuredImage;
        }

        showNewsNotification({
          id: latestPost.id,
          title: latestPost.title.rendered,
          excerpt: latestPost.excerpt.rendered.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim(),
          image: featuredImage
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      // Silencioso ante fallas de red
    }
  };

  // Chequeo inicial y luego cada 45 segundos
  checkLatestNews();
  const interval = setInterval(checkLatestNews, 45000);
  return () => clearInterval(interval);
}

export function saveBankProfile(profileData) {
  const current = getAllBankProfiles();
  const clean = {
    id: profileData.id || `bank_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
    label: (profileData.label || profileData.bankName || 'Cuenta Receptora').trim(),
    bankName: (profileData.bankName || '').trim(),
    accountNumber: (profileData.accountNumber || '').trim(),
    accountType: (profileData.accountType || 'Pago Móvil / Transferencia').trim(),
    phone: (profileData.phone || '').trim(),
    cedulaRif: (profileData.cedulaRif || '').trim(),
    holderName: (profileData.holderName || '').trim(),
    ownerType: profileData.ownerType || 'admin',
    staffId: profileData.staffId || ''
  };

  const exists = current.some(b => b.id === clean.id);
  const updated = exists
    ? current.map(b => b.id === clean.id ? clean : b)
    : [clean, ...current];

  saveAllBankProfiles(updated);
  return clean;
}

export function deleteBankProfile(profileId) {
  const current = getAllBankProfiles();
  const updated = current.filter(b => b.id !== profileId);
  saveAllBankProfiles(updated);
  return updated;
}

// Generador de estructura de servicios publicitarios detallados
export function getDefaultClientServices(legacyPackageType = []) {
  const hasEnVivo = legacyPackageType.includes('en_vivo') || legacyPackageType.includes('combo');
  const hasRotativas = legacyPackageType.includes('rotativas') || legacyPackageType.includes('combo');
  const hasRedes = legacyPackageType.includes('redes') || legacyPackageType.includes('combo');
  const hasWeb = legacyPackageType.includes('web') || legacyPackageType.includes('combo');

  return {
    enVivo: hasEnVivo,
    rotativa: hasRotativas,
    redes: {
      enabled: hasRedes,
      whatsapp: {
        enabled: hasRedes,
        difusion: hasRedes,       // Grupos de difusión
        publicitarios: hasRedes,  // Grupos publicitarios (más no informativos)
        historias: hasRedes       // Historias / Estados
      },
      instagram: {
        enabled: hasRedes,
        historias: hasRedes       // Historias de Instagram
      },
      facebook: {
        enabled: false,

// Extraer tags resumen para retrocompatibilidad
export function derivePackageTypeFromServices(services) {
  if (!services) return [];
  const tags = [];
  if (services.enVivo) tags.push('en_vivo');
  if (services.rotativa) tags.push('rotativas');
  if (
    services.redes?.enabled || 
    services.redes?.whatsapp?.enabled || 
    services.redes?.instagram?.enabled || 
    services.redes?.facebook?.enabled || 
    services.redes?.tiktok?.enabled
  ) {
    tags.push('redes');
  }
  if (services.web?.enabled || services.web?.imagenes || services.web?.videos) {
    tags.push('web');
  }
  return tags;
}

// Notificar cambios globales en el CRM de clientes
function notifyClientsChanged() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_clients_updated', { detail: { timestamp: Date.now() } }));
  }
}

// ==========================================
// GESTIÓN DE GÉNEROS / CATEGORÍAS DE LOCALES
// ==========================================
export function getAllGenres() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_GENRES;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_GENRES_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return INITIAL_GENRES;
}

export function saveAllGenres(genres) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_GENRES_KEY, JSON.stringify(genres));
    notifyClientsChanged();
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function addGenre(name, emoji = 'folder') {
  if (!name || !name.trim()) return null;
  const current = getAllGenres();
  const slug = 'gen_' + name.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '_').substring(0, 20);
  const newGenre = {
    id: `${slug}_${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
    name: name.trim(),
    emoji
  };
  const updated = [...current, newGenre];
  saveAllGenres(updated);
  return newGenre;
}

export function deleteGenre(genreId) {
  const current = getAllGenres();
  const updated = current.filter(g => g.id !== genreId);
  saveAllGenres(updated);
  return updated;
}

// ==========================================
// GESTIÓN DE CLIENTES DE LA RADIO
// ==========================================
export function getAllClients() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_CLIENTS;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_CLIENTS_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        let needsSave = false;
        const normalized = parsed.map(c => {
          const updated = { ...c };
          if (!updated.locutorId) {
            if (updated.id === 'cli_001') {
              updated.locutorId = 'staff_carlos_rondon';
              updated.locutorName = 'Carlos "El Oso" Rondón';
              needsSave = true;
            } else if (updated.id === 'cli_002') {
              updated.locutorId = 'staff_javier_marquez';
              updated.locutorName = 'DJ Javier Márquez';
              needsSave = true;
            } else if (updated.id === 'cli_003') {
              updated.locutorId = 'staff_maria_quintero';
              updated.locutorName = 'María Valentina Quintero';
              needsSave = true;
            } else {
              updated.locutorId = 'staff_carlos_rondon';
              updated.locutorName = 'Carlos "El Oso" Rondón';
              needsSave = true;
            }
          }
          if (!updated.businessDescription) {
            if (updated.id === 'cli_001') updated.businessDescription = 'Especialistas en carnes y cortes premium al carbón, arepas de trigo andinas, truchas frescas del páramo y desayunos criollos tradicionales.';
            if (updated.id === 'cli_002') updated.businessDescription = 'El club nocturno y discoteca más exclusivo del páramo merideño. Audio line-array de alta fidelidad, show de luces y coctelería internacional.';
            if (updated.id === 'cli_003') updated.businessDescription = 'Proveedor líder de telecomunicaciones por fibra óptica simétrica hasta el hogar (FTTH) en Santo Domingo, Las Piedras y Pueblo Llano.';
            needsSave = true;
          }
          if (updated.archived === undefined) {
            updated.archived = false;
            needsSave = true;
          }
          return updated;
        });
        if (needsSave) {
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_CLIENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(normalized));
          } catch (e) {}
        }
        return normalized;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return INITIAL_CLIENTS;
}

export function saveAllClients(clients) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_CLIENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(clients));
    notifyClientsChanged();
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function saveClient(clientData) {
  const current = getAllClients();
  let updated;

  const services = clientData.services || getDefaultClientServices(clientData.packageType || []);
  const packageType = derivePackageTypeFromServices(services);
  const normalizedData = {
    ...clientData,
    services,
    packageType,
    logoUrl: clientData.logoUrl || '',
    businessDescription: clientData.businessDescription || '',
    locutorId: clientData.locutorId || '',
    locutorName: clientData.locutorName || '',
    archived: Boolean(clientData.archived)
  };

  if (normalizedData.id) {
    const exists = current.some(c => String(c.id) === String(normalizedData.id));
    if (exists) {
      updated = current.map(c => String(c.id) === String(normalizedData.id) ? { ...c, ...normalizedData, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : c);
    } else {
      updated = [normalizedData, ...current];
    }
  } else {
    const newClient = {
      ...normalizedData,
      id: `cli_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      paymentStatus: normalizedData.paymentStatus || 'pending',
      trashed: false,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    updated = [newClient, ...current];
  }

  saveAllClients(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function archiveClient(clientId) {
  const current = getAllClients();
  const updated = current.map(c => {
    if (String(c.id) === String(clientId)) {
      return { ...c, archived: true, archivedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return c;
  });
  saveAllClients(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function unarchiveClient(clientId) {
  const current = getAllClients();
  const updated = current.map(c => {
    if (String(c.id) === String(clientId)) {
      return { ...c, archived: false, archivedAt: null };
    }
    return c;
  });
  saveAllClients(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function trashClient(clientId) {
  const current = getAllClients();
  const updated = current.map(c => {
    if (String(c.id) === String(clientId)) {
      return { ...c, trashed: true, trashedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return c;
  });
  saveAllClients(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function restoreClient(clientId) {
  const current = getAllClients();
  const updated = current.map(c => {
    if (String(c.id) === String(clientId)) {
      return { ...c, trashed: false, trashedAt: null };
    }
    return c;
  });
  saveAllClients(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function deleteClientPermanently(clientId) {
  const current = getAllClients();
  const updated = current.filter(c => String(c.id) !== String(clientId));
  saveAllClients(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function emptyClientsTrash() {
  const current = getAllClients();
  const updated = current.filter(c => !c.trashed);
  saveAllClients(updated);
  return updated;
}

// ==========================================
// HISTORIAL DE PAGOS Y COBRANZAS
// ==========================================
export function getAllPayments() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_PAYMENTS_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

export function recordClientPayment({
  clientId,
  clientName,
  businessName,
  amountUsd,
  amountBs,
  rateBcv,
  paymentMethod = 'pago_movil_bcv',
  reference = '',
  notes = '',
  date = null,
  locutorId = '',
  locutorName = '',
  paymentType = 'cobro', // 'cobro' (ingreso recibido de cliente) | 'pago' (egreso, abono o liquidación)
  bankProfileId = '',
  paymentDetails = null
}) {
  const allPayments = getAllPayments();
  const newPayment = {
    id: `pay_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
    clientId,
    clientName,
    businessName,
    amountUsd: Number(amountUsd) || 0,
    amountBs: Number(amountBs) || 0,
    rateBcv: Number(rateBcv) || 0,
    paymentMethod,
    reference: reference.trim(),
    notes: notes.trim(),
    locutorId: locutorId || '',
    locutorName: locutorName || '',
    paymentType,
    bankProfileId: bankProfileId || '',
    paymentDetails: paymentDetails || null,
    date: date || new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const updatedPayments = [newPayment, ...allPayments];
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_PAYMENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedPayments));
  } catch (e) {}

  // Si es un cobro a cliente, actualizar estado del cliente a 'paid'
  if (paymentType === 'cobro' && clientId) {
    const allClients = getAllClients();
    const updatedClients = allClients.map(c => {
      if (String(c.id) === String(clientId)) {
        return {
          ...c,
          paymentStatus: 'paid',
          lastPaymentDate: newPayment.date.split('T')[0]
        };
      }
      return c;
    });
    saveAllClients(updatedClients);
  }

  return newPayment;
}

// Obtener eventos de reproducción registrados localmente desde el streaming en vivo
export function getLocalPlayEvents() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_RANKING_EVENTS_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);

  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

// Registrar una canción detectada en la transmisión en vivo para alimentar el ranking
let lastRecordedKey = '';
let lastRecordedTime = 0;

export function recordSongPlay(meta = {}) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const song = (meta.song || '').trim();
    const artist = (meta.artist || '').trim();
    if (!song || !artist) return;
    if (isGenericMetadataText(song) && isGenericMetadataText(artist)) return;

    const key = `${artist.toLowerCase()}__${song.toLowerCase()}`;
    const now = Date.now();
    // Evitar duplicar la misma canción en un lapso menor a 3 minutos
    if (key === lastRecordedKey && now - lastRecordedTime < 3 * 60 * 1000) {
      return;
    }
    lastRecordedKey = key;
    lastRecordedTime = now;

    const events = getLocalPlayEvents();
    events.unshift({
      id: `play-${now}`,
      song,
      artist,
      artwork: meta.artwork || STATION_INFO.cover,
      timestamp: now
    });

    // Conservar los últimos 600 registros (30 días)
    const thirtyDaysAgo = now - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    const pruned = events.filter(e => e.timestamp >= thirtyDaysAgo).slice(0, 600);
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_RANKING_EVENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(pruned));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_ranking_updated'));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Error registrando canción en el ranking:', e);
  }
}

// Combinar datos de la API de MiPanel con el registro en tiempo real + semilla para garantizar Top 10 rico
export function buildHybridRanking(apiItems = [], tabKey = '24h_songs') {
  const isArtists = tabKey === '24h_artists';
  const now = Date.now();
  const windowMs =
    tabKey === '24h_songs' || tabKey === '24h_artists'
      ? 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
      : tabKey === 'weekly'
      ? 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
      : 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  const localEvents = getLocalPlayEvents().filter(e => now - e.timestamp <= windowMs);

  // Mapa acumulador
  const map = new Map();

  // 1. Incorporar en primer lugar los datos reales de la API de MiPanel (http://mipanel.stream/api/TnpBeE9BPT0rWg==)
  if (Array.isArray(apiItems) && apiItems.length > 0) {
    apiItems.forEach((item, idx) => {
      const artist = (item.artist || '').trim();
      const title = (item.title || '').trim();
      if (!artist && !title) return;
      const mapKey = isArtists
        ? artist.toLowerCase()
        : `${artist.toLowerCase()}__${title.toLowerCase()}`;
      const apiPlays = Number(item.plays || item.total_plays || 1);
      map.set(mapKey, {
        title: title || artist,
        artist: artist || 'Artista Neblina',
        artwork: item.artwork || '',
        plays: apiPlays,
        total_plays: apiPlays,
        unique_titles: item.unique_titles || 1,
        trend: item.trend || { state: 'new', is_new: true },
        fromApi: true,
        apiOrder: item.rank || (idx + 1)
      });
    });
  }

  // 2. Sumar reproducciones detectadas en vivo en el navegador del usuario
  localEvents.forEach((ev) => {
    const mapKey = isArtists
      ? ev.artist.toLowerCase()
      : `${ev.artist.toLowerCase()}__${ev.song.toLowerCase()}`;
    const existing = map.get(mapKey);
    if (existing) {
      existing.plays += 1;
      existing.total_plays = existing.plays;
      if (!existing.artwork && ev.artwork) existing.artwork = ev.artwork;
      existing.trend = { state: 'up', delta: 1 };
    } else {
      map.set(mapKey, {
        title: ev.song,
        artist: ev.artist,
        artwork: ev.artwork,
        plays: 1,
        total_plays: 1,
        unique_titles: 1,
        trend: { state: 'new', is_new: true },
        fromApi: true,
        apiOrder: 99
      });
    }
  });

  // 3. Completar con temas de respaldo si la API tiene menos de 10 posiciones registradas
  SEED_SONGS.forEach((seed, idx) => {
    const basePlays =
      tabKey === '24h_songs' || tabKey === '24h_artists'
        ? seed.plays24h
        : tabKey === 'weekly'
        ? seed.plays7d
        : seed.plays30d;

    const mapKey = isArtists
      ? seed.artist.toLowerCase()
      : `${seed.artist.toLowerCase()}__${seed.title.toLowerCase()}`;

    if (!map.has(mapKey)) {
      map.set(mapKey, {
        title: seed.title,
        artist: seed.artist,
        artwork: seed.artwork,
        plays: basePlays,
        total_plays: basePlays,
        unique_titles: seed.uniqueArtistTitles || 1,
        trend: seed.trend || { state: 'same', delta: 0 },
        fromApi: false,
        apiOrder: 100 + idx
      });
    }
  });

  const sorted = Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.fromApi !== b.fromApi) return a.fromApi ? -1 : 1;
    if (a.fromApi && b.fromApi && a.apiOrder !== b.apiOrder && a.plays === b.plays) {
      return a.apiOrder - b.apiOrder;
    }
    return (b.plays || 0) - (a.plays || 0);
  });
  return sorted.slice(0, 10);
}

// ============================================================================
// GESTIÓN DE PLAYLIST SEMANAL DE YOUTUBE CON COLA AUTOMÁTICA Y RECORDATORIO
// ============================================================================

export function extractYouTubeEmbedInfo(url = '') {
  const clean = (url || '').trim();
  if (!clean) {
    return {
      embedUrl: `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${DEFAULT_YOUTUBE_RECOMMENDED_TRACKS[0].videoId}?rel=0`,
      playlistId: 'PLFgquLnL59alCl_2TQvOiD5Vgm1hCaGSI',
      videoId: DEFAULT_YOUTUBE_RECOMMENDED_TRACKS[0].videoId
    };
  }

  let listMatch = clean.match(/[?&]list=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
  let videoMatch =
    clean.match(/[?&]v=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/) ||
    clean.match(/youtu\.be\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/) ||
    clean.match(/youtube\.com\/embed\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/);

  const playlistId = listMatch ? listMatch[1] : '';
  const videoId = videoMatch ? videoMatch[1] : '';

  if (playlistId && videoId) {
    return {
      embedUrl: `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}?list=${playlistId}&rel=0`,
      playlistId,
      videoId
    };
  }
  if (playlistId) {
    return {
      embedUrl: `https://www.youtube.com/embed/videoseries?list=${playlistId}&rel=0`,
      playlistId,
      videoId: ''
    };
  }
  if (videoId) {
    return {
      embedUrl: `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}?rel=0`,
      playlistId: '',
      videoId
    };
  }

  return {
    embedUrl: `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${DEFAULT_YOUTUBE_RECOMMENDED_TRACKS[0].videoId}?rel=0`,
    playlistId: '',
    videoId: DEFAULT_YOUTUBE_RECOMMENDED_TRACKS[0].videoId
  };
}

export function getRankingYoutubePlaylist() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_PLAYLIST_CONFIG;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_KEY);
    if (!raw) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(INITIAL_PLAYLIST_CONFIG));
      return INITIAL_PLAYLIST_CONFIG;
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return { ...INITIAL_PLAYLIST_CONFIG, ...parsed };
  } catch (e) {
    return INITIAL_PLAYLIST_CONFIG;
  }
}

export function saveRankingYoutubePlaylist(updates = {}) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_PLAYLIST_CONFIG;
  const current = getRankingYoutubePlaylist();
  const next = {
    ...current,
    ...updates,
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_youtube_playlist_updated'));
  return next;
}

// Promover inmediatamente la playlist en cola como playlist activa
export function promoteQueuedPlaylistNow() {
  const cfg = getRankingYoutubePlaylist();
  if (!cfg.queuedUrl || !cfg.queuedUrl.trim()) return cfg;
  return saveRankingYoutubePlaylist({
    currentUrl: cfg.queuedUrl.trim(),
    currentTitle: cfg.queuedTitle?.trim() || 'Selección Oficial de la Semana · Neblina 105.5 FM',
    queuedUrl: '',
    queuedTitle: '',
    lastPromotedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  });
}

// Calcula la última fecha/hora en que ocurrió el slot programado (p.ej. Lunes 12:00 PM)
function getMostRecentSlotTimestamp(slotId = 'lunes_12', now = new Date()) {
  const slot = PLAYLIST_SCHEDULE_SLOTS.find(s => s.id === slotId) || PLAYLIST_SCHEDULE_SLOTS[0];
  const candidate = new Date(now);
  const currentDay = candidate.getDay(); // 0 = Domingo, 1 = Lunes, ...
  let diffDays = (currentDay - slot.dayOfWeek + 7) % 7;
  candidate.setDate(candidate.getDate() - diffDays);
  candidate.setHours(slot.hour, slot.minute, 0, 0);

  if (candidate.getTime() > now.getTime()) {
    // Todavía no ha llegado la hora hoy; la ocurrencia anterior fue hace 7 días
    candidate.setDate(candidate.getDate() - 7);
  }
  return candidate.getTime();
}

// Calcula la próxima fecha/hora en que ocurrirá el cambio automático
export function getNextSlotDate(slotId = 'lunes_12', now = new Date()) {
  const lastTs = getMostRecentSlotTimestamp(slotId, now);
  const nextDate = new Date(lastTs + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  return nextDate;
}

// Comprueba si ya pasó el horario programado (por defecto Lunes 12:00 PM) y si hay una playlist en cola para activarla
export function checkAndPromoteQueuedPlaylist() {
  const cfg = getRankingYoutubePlaylist();
  if (!cfg.queuedUrl || !cfg.queuedUrl.trim()) return cfg;

  const now = new Date();
  const mostRecentSlotTs = getMostRecentSlotTimestamp(cfg.scheduledSlot || 'lunes_12', now);
  const lastPromotedTs = cfg.lastPromotedAt ? new Date(cfg.lastPromotedAt).getTime() : 0;
  const updatedTs = cfg.updatedAt ? new Date(cfg.updatedAt).getTime() : 0;

  // Si la cola fue guardada antes del hito horario más reciente y aún no se ha promovido en este ciclo:
  if (mostRecentSlotTs > lastPromotedTs && updatedTs <= mostRecentSlotTs) {
    return promoteQueuedPlaylistNow();
  }
  return cfg;
}

// Estado de recordatorio administrativo:
// Advierte con 3 días de antelación (desde el Viernes previo al Lunes 12:00 PM) si no hay una playlist en cola
export function getPlaylistAdminReminderStatus() {
  const cfg = getRankingYoutubePlaylist();
  const hasQueued = Boolean(cfg.queuedUrl && cfg.queuedUrl.trim());
  const nextSwitch = getNextSlotDate(cfg.scheduledSlot || 'lunes_12');
  const msRemaining = nextSwitch.getTime() - Date.now();
  const daysRemaining = msRemaining / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
  const hoursRemaining = Math.max(1, Math.round(msRemaining / (1000 * 60 * 60)));

  // Si faltan 3 días o menos (ej. Viernes, Sábado, Domingo o Lunes por la mañana) y no hay playlist en cola
  const shouldRemind = !hasQueued && daysRemaining <= 3.5;

  const slotObj = PLAYLIST_SCHEDULE_SLOTS.find(s => s.id === (cfg.scheduledSlot || 'lunes_12')) || PLAYLIST_SCHEDULE_SLOTS[0];

  return {
    shouldRemind,
    hasQueued,
    daysRemaining: Math.max(0, Math.ceil(daysRemaining)),
    hoursRemaining,
    nextSwitchFormatted: nextSwitch.toLocaleDateString('es-VE', {
      weekday: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    }),
    slotLabel: slotObj.label
  };
}

// Notificar cambios en reportes
function notifyReportsChanged() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_reports_updated'));
  }
}

// Obtener todos los reportes
export function getAllReports() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_DEMO_REPORTS;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_REPORTS_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Error leyendo reportes de localStorage:', e);
  }
  return INITIAL_DEMO_REPORTS;
}

// Guardar lista completa
export function saveAllReports(reportsList) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_REPORTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(reportsList));
    notifyReportsChanged();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error guardando reportes:', e);
  }
}

function sanitizeReportString(str = '') {
  return String(str || '')
    .replace(/[<>]/g, '')
    .replace(/javascript:/gi, '')
    .replace(/on\w+=/gi, '')
    .trim();
}

// Agregar nuevo reporte recibido
export function addCitizenReport(reportData) {
  const all = [...getAllReports()];
  const sanitizedReport = {
    ...reportData,
    citizenName: sanitizeReportString(reportData.citizenName),
    citizenId: sanitizeReportString(reportData.citizenId),
    residenceSector: sanitizeReportString(reportData.residenceSector),
    eventLocation: sanitizeReportString(reportData.eventLocation),
    referencePoint: sanitizeReportString(reportData.referencePoint),
    description: sanitizeReportString(reportData.description),
    phone: sanitizeReportString(reportData.phone)
  };

  const newReport = {
    ...sanitizedReport,
    id: `rep_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
    status: sanitizedReport.status || 'Pendiente',
    trashed: false,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };
  all.unshift(newReport);
  saveAllReports(all);

  // Registrar automáticamente en la base de datos paralela de ciudadanos y en la base unificada
  try {
    upsertCitizenContact(sanitizedReport);
    addUnifiedContact({
      name: sanitizedReport.citizenName,
      phone: sanitizedReport.phone,
      cedula: sanitizedReport.citizenId,
      location: sanitizedReport.residenceSector || sanitizedReport.eventLocation,
      origin: 'Denuncia Ciudadana',
      details: sanitizedReport.description
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error sincronizando con base de datos de ciudadanos:', err);
  }

  return newReport;
}

// Cambiar estado de un reporte
export function updateReportStatus(id, newStatus) {
  const all = getAllReports().map(r => {
    if (r.id === id) {
      return { ...r, status: newStatus, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return r;
  });
  saveAllReports(all);
  return all;
}

// Enviar un reporte a la papelera (Eliminación temporal)
export function trashReport(id) {
  const all = getAllReports().map(r => {
    if (r.id === id) {
      return { ...r, trashed: true, trashedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return r;
  });
  saveAllReports(all);
  return all;
}

// Restaurar un reporte desde la papelera
export function restoreReport(id) {
  const all = getAllReports().map(r => {
    if (r.id === id) {
      return { ...r, trashed: false, trashedAt: null };
    }
    return r;
  });
  saveAllReports(all);
  return all;
}

// Eliminar definitivamente un reporte
export function deleteCitizenReport(id) {
  const all = getAllReports().filter(r => r.id !== id);
  saveAllReports(all);
  return all;
}

export const deleteReportPermanently = deleteCitizenReport;

// Vaciar papelera de reportes
export function emptyReportsTrash() {
  const all = getAllReports().filter(r => !r.trashed);
  saveAllReports(all);
  return all;
}

// Exportar reportes a JSON
export function exportReportsJSON() {
  const reports = getAllReports();
  const data = {
    station: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
    module: 'Buzón de Denuncias Ciudadanas',
    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    total: reports.length,
    reports
  };
  return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
}

// Exportar reportes a CSV (Compatible con Microsoft Excel con BOM UTF-8)
export function exportReportsCSV() {
  const reports = getAllReports();
  const headers = ['ID', 'Fecha Reporte', 'Ciudadano', 'Cédula', 'Teléfono', 'Sector Residencia', 'Lugar del Suceso', 'Punto Referencia', 'Fecha Suceso', 'Hora Suceso', 'Estado', 'Descripción'];
  
  const rows = reports.map(r => [
    `"${r.id}"`,
    `"${new Date(r.createdAt || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('es-VE')}"`,
    `"${(r.citizenName || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(r.citizenId || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(r.phone || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(r.residenceSector || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(r.eventLocation || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(r.referencePoint || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(r.eventDate || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(r.eventTime || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(r.status || 'Pendiente')}"`,
    `"${(r.description || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
  ]);

  return '\uFEFF' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(row => row.join(','))].join('\r\n');
}

// Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM - Parrilla y Programación Radial
// Permite al equipo administrativo editar programas, locutores y horarios en vivo.

import { STATION_SCHEDULE } from './api';

const STORAGE_SCHEDULE_KEY = 'neblina_station_schedule_db';

// Notificar cambios en la parrilla radial
function notifyScheduleChanged() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_schedule_updated'));
  }
}

// Obtener toda la programación
export function getAllSchedule() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return STATION_SCHEDULE;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SCHEDULE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Error leyendo programación de localStorage:', e);
  }
  return STATION_SCHEDULE;
}

// Guardar lista completa
export function saveAllSchedule(scheduleList) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SCHEDULE_KEY, JSON.stringify(scheduleList));
    notifyScheduleChanged();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error guardando programación:', e);
  }
}

// Guardar o actualizar un programa
export function saveScheduleShow(showData) {
  const all = [...getAllSchedule()];
  const index = all.findIndex(s => s.id === showData.id);

  if (index >= 0) {
    all[index] = { ...all[index], ...showData };
  } else {
    const newShow = {
      ...showData,
      id: showData.id || `show_${Date.now()}`,
      active: showData.active !== undefined ? showData.active : true
    };
    all.push(newShow);
  }

  saveAllSchedule(all);
  return all;
}

// Enviar un programa a la papelera (Eliminación temporal)
export function trashScheduleShow(id) {
  const all = getAllSchedule().map(s => {
    if (String(s.id) === String(id)) {
      return { ...s, trashed: true, trashedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return s;
  });
  saveAllSchedule(all);
  return all;
}

// Restaurar un programa desde la papelera
export function restoreScheduleShow(id) {
  const all = getAllSchedule().map(s => {
    if (String(s.id) === String(id)) {
      return { ...s, trashed: false, trashedAt: null };
    }
    return s;
  });
  saveAllSchedule(all);
  return all;
}

// Eliminar un programa definitivamente
export function deleteScheduleShow(id) {
  const all = getAllSchedule().filter(s => String(s.id) !== String(id));
  saveAllSchedule(all);
  return all;
}

export const deleteScheduleShowPermanently = deleteScheduleShow;

// Vaciar papelera de programas
export function emptyScheduleTrash() {
  const all = getAllSchedule().filter(s => !s.trashed);
  saveAllSchedule(all);
  return all;
}

// Alternar activo / inactivo
export function toggleScheduleShowActive(id) {
  const all = getAllSchedule().map(s => {
    if (s.id === id) {
      return { ...s, active: s.active === false ? true : false };
    }
    return s;
  });
  saveAllSchedule(all);
  return all;
}

// Restablecer valores de fábrica
export function resetDefaultSchedule() {
  saveAllSchedule(STATION_SCHEDULE);
  return STATION_SCHEDULE;
}

// Exportar programación a JSON
export function exportScheduleJSON() {
  const schedule = getAllSchedule();
  const data = {
    station: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
    module: 'Parrilla y Programación Radial',
    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    total: schedule.length,
    schedule
  };
  return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
}

    },
    {

      answer: 'Puedes comunicarte directamente con la cabina de locución y enviar tus complacencias musicales a través de nuestra línea oficial de WhatsApp al número +58 424 745 9774.'
    }

/**
 * Generador Dinámico de Schema.org JSON-LD para Motores de Búsqueda y Agentes de IA
 * Combina entidades: RadioStation, BroadcastService, NewsMediaOrganization, WebSite y FAQPage
 */
export function generateSchemaGraph() {
  const cfg = STATION_SEO_CONFIG;

  return {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@graph': [
      // 1. Entidad Principal de Radio y Medios Informativos
      {
        '@type': ['RadioStation', 'BroadcastService', 'NewsMediaOrganization'],
        '@id': `${cfg.identity.canonicalUrl}#station`,
        'name': cfg.identity.name,
        'alternateName': cfg.identity.alternateNames,
        'legalName': cfg.identity.legalName,
        'slogan': cfg.identity.slogan,
        'description': cfg.description.extended,
        'url': cfg.identity.canonicalUrl,
        'logo': {
          '@type': 'ImageObject',
          'url': cfg.identity.logoUrl,
          'width': 512,
          'height': 512,
          'caption': 'Logotipo e Isotipo Oficial de Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM'
        },
        'image': cfg.identity.logoUrl,
        'broadcastFrequency': cfg.identity.frequency,
        'callSign': cfg.identity.callSign,
        'broadcastServiceTier': 'Free Public Radio & Digital Stream',
        'broadcastTimezone': 'America/Caracas',
        'inLanguage': 'es-VE',
        'address': {
          '@type': 'PostalAddress',
          'addressLocality': cfg.location.city,
          'addressRegion': cfg.location.state,
          'addressCountry': cfg.location.countryCode,
          'postalCode': cfg.location.postalCode,
          'streetAddress': cfg.location.address
        },
        'geo': {
          '@type': 'GeoCoordinates',
          'latitude': cfg.location.coordinates.latitude,
          'longitude': cfg.location.coordinates.longitude
        },
        'areaServed': cfg.coverageAreas.map(area => ({
          '@type': 'AdministrativeArea',
          'name': area.name,
          'description': `${area.type} - Estado ${area.state}`
        })),
        'telephone': cfg.socialProfiles.whatsappDisplay,
        'sameAs': [
          cfg.socialProfiles.instagram,
          cfg.socialProfiles.facebook,
          cfg.socialProfiles.youtube,
          cfg.socialProfiles.whatsappChannel
        ],
        'potentialAction': [
          {
            '@type': 'ListenAction',
            'target': [
              {
                '@type': 'EntryPoint',
                'urlTemplate': cfg.identity.streamingUrl,
                'actionPlatform': [
                  'http://schema.org/DesktopWebPlatform',
                  'http://schema.org/MobileWebPlatform',
                  'http://schema.org/IOSPlatform',
                  'http://schema.org/AndroidPlatform'
                ],
                'encodingFormat': 'audio/mpeg'
              }
            ],
            'expectsAcceptanceOf': {
              '@type': 'Offer',
              'price': '0',
              'priceCurrency': 'USD',
              'category': 'Free Live Streaming'
            }
          }
        ]
      },

      // 2. Entidad WebSite (para Sitelinks de Google y Búsqueda)
      {
        '@type': 'WebSite',
        '@id': `${cfg.identity.canonicalUrl}#website`,
        'url': cfg.identity.canonicalUrl,
        'name': cfg.identity.name,
        'description': cfg.description.standard,
        'publisher': {
          '@id': `${cfg.identity.canonicalUrl}#station`
        },
        'inLanguage': 'es-VE'
      },

      // 3. Entidad FAQPage para Resultados Enriquecidos (Rich Snippets)
      {
        '@type': 'FAQPage',
        '@id': `${cfg.identity.canonicalUrl}#faq`,
        'mainEntity': cfg.faqs.map(faq => ({
          '@type': 'Question',
          'name': faq.question,
          'acceptedAnswer': {
            '@type': 'Answer',
            'text': faq.answer
          }
        }))
      }
    ]
  };
}

// Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM - Servicio Central de Integración de APIs de Redes Sociales y Métricas

// Obtener credenciales guardadas
export function getSocialApiCredentials() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return DEFAULT_SOCIAL_CONNECTORS;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SOCIAL_CREDENTIALS_KEY);
    if (!raw) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SOCIAL_CREDENTIALS_KEY, JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_SOCIAL_CONNECTORS));
      return DEFAULT_SOCIAL_CONNECTORS;
    }
    return { ...DEFAULT_SOCIAL_CONNECTORS, ...JSON.parse(raw) };
  } catch (e) {
    return DEFAULT_SOCIAL_CONNECTORS;
  }
}

// Guardar credenciales de un conector específico
export function saveSocialConnectorCredentials(connectorId, data) {
  const all = getSocialApiCredentials();
  all[connectorId] = {
    ...all[connectorId],
    ...data,
    status: (data.accessToken || data.apiKey || data.bearerToken || data.botToken) ? 'connected' : 'unconfigured',
    lastSync: new Date().toISOString()
  };
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SOCIAL_CREDENTIALS_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_social_credentials_updated', { detail: all }));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error guardando credenciales API:', e);
  }
  return all;
}

// Obtener métricas consolidadas (cache local enriquecido con llamadas reales si hay token)
export function getSocialMetrics() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return DEFAULT_SOCIAL_STATS;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SOCIAL_METRICS_CACHE_KEY);
    if (!raw) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SOCIAL_METRICS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(DEFAULT_SOCIAL_STATS));
      return DEFAULT_SOCIAL_STATS;
    }
    return { ...DEFAULT_SOCIAL_STATS, ...JSON.parse(raw) };
  } catch (e) {
    return DEFAULT_SOCIAL_STATS;
  }
}

// Guardar métricas actualizadas
export function saveSocialMetrics(newStats) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SOCIAL_METRICS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(newStats));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_social_metrics_updated', { detail: newStats }));
  } catch (e) {}
}

// Sincronizar API en vivo para YouTube si se suministró la API Key
export async function syncYouTubeApi(apiKey, channelId = 'UC_neblina105fm') {
  if (!apiKey) return null;
  try {
    // Si channelId es username o ID
    const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/channels?part=statistics,snippet&id=${channelId}&key=${apiKey}`;
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`YouTube API error: ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.items && data.items.length > 0) {
      const stats = data.items[0].statistics;
      const current = getSocialMetrics();
      const updated = {
        ...current,
        youtube: {
          ...current.youtube,
          subscribers: parseInt(stats.subscriberCount, 10) || current.youtube.subscribers,
          totalViews: parseInt(stats.viewCount, 10) || current.youtube.totalViews,
          videoCount: parseInt(stats.videoCount, 10) || 0,
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      };
      saveSocialMetrics(updated);
      return updated.youtube;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error sincronizando YouTube Data API:', err.message);
  }
  return null;
}

// Sincronizar Telegram Channel con Bot Token
export async function syncTelegramChannel(botToken, channelUsername = '@neblina105fm') {
  if (!botToken) return null;
  try {
    const url = `https://api.telegram.org/bot${botToken}/getChatMemberCount?chat_id=${channelUsername}`;
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Telegram API error: ${res.status}`);
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.ok && data.result) {
      const current = getSocialMetrics();
      const updated = {
        ...current,
        telegram: {
          ...current.telegram,
          members: data.result,
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      };
      saveSocialMetrics(updated);
      return updated.telegram;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error sincronizando Telegram API:', err.message);
  }
  return null;
}

// Notificar a todos los componentes que la lista de patrocinantes cambió
function notifySponsorsChanged() {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_sponsors_updated'));
  }
}

// Obtener lista completa (para el panel interno administrativo)
export function getAllSponsors() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return DEFAULT_SPONSORS;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_SPONSORS_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
        // Enriquecer con photos, menuUrl y locationDetails si provienen de datos guardados previos
        return parsed.map(item => {
          const defaultMatch = DEFAULT_SPONSORS.find(d => d.id === item.id || d.name === item.name);
          if (defaultMatch) {
            return {
              ...defaultMatch,
              ...item,
              photos: (Array.isArray(item.photos) && item.photos.length > 0) ? item.photos : defaultMatch.photos,
              menuUrl: item.menuUrl !== undefined ? item.menuUrl : (defaultMatch.menuUrl || ''),
              locationDetails: item.locationDetails || (defaultMatch.locationDetails || '')
            };
          }
          return item;
        });
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Error leyendo sponsors de localStorage:', e);
  }
  return DEFAULT_SPONSORS;
}

// Obtener solo patrocinantes activos (para la vista pública)
export function getActiveSponsors() {
  const all = getAllSponsors();
  return all.filter(s => s.active !== false && !s.trashed);
}

// Guardar lista completa
export function saveActiveSponsors(sponsorsList) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_SPONSORS_KEY, JSON.stringify(sponsorsList));
    notifySponsorsChanged();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error guardando patrocinantes:', e);
  }
}

// Guardar o Actualizar un único Aliado (Creación o Edición)
export function saveSponsor(sponsorData) {
  const all = [...getAllSponsors()];
  const index = all.findIndex(s => s.id === sponsorData.id);

  if (index >= 0) {
    all[index] = { ...all[index], ...sponsorData, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  } else {
    const newSponsor = {
      ...sponsorData,
      id: sponsorData.id || `sp_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      active: sponsorData.active !== undefined ? sponsorData.active : true,
      featuredInHome: sponsorData.featuredInHome !== undefined ? sponsorData.featuredInHome : true
    };
    all.unshift(newSponsor);
  }

  saveActiveSponsors(all);
  return all;
}

// Enviar un aliado a la papelera (Eliminación temporal)
export function trashSponsor(id) {
  const all = getAllSponsors().map(s => {
    if (String(s.id) === String(id)) {
      return { ...s, trashed: true, trashedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return s;
  });
  saveActiveSponsors(all);
  return all;
}

// Restaurar un aliado desde la papelera
export function restoreSponsor(id) {
  const all = getAllSponsors().map(s => {
    if (String(s.id) === String(id)) {
      return { ...s, trashed: false, trashedAt: null };
    }
    return s;
  });
  saveActiveSponsors(all);
  return all;
}

// Eliminar un aliado definitivamente
export function deleteSponsor(id) {
  const all = getAllSponsors().filter(s => String(s.id) !== String(id));
  saveActiveSponsors(all);
  return all;
}

export const deleteSponsorPermanently = deleteSponsor;

// Vaciar papelera de aliados
export function emptySponsorsTrash() {
  const all = getAllSponsors().filter(s => !s.trashed);
  saveActiveSponsors(all);
  return all;
}

// Alternar visibilidad en carrusel de Inicio
export function toggleSponsorFeaturedInHome(id) {
  const all = getAllSponsors().map(s => {
    if (s.id === id) {
      return { ...s, featuredInHome: !s.featuredInHome };
    }
    return s;
  });
  saveActiveSponsors(all);
  return all;
}

// Alternar estado activo / pausado (Visibilidad en Directorio)
export function toggleSponsorActive(id) {
  const all = getAllSponsors().map(s => {
    if (s.id === id) {
      return { ...s, active: !s.active };
    }
    return s;
  });
  saveActiveSponsors(all);
  return all;
}

// Restablecer a los datos por defecto
export function resetDefaultSponsors() {
  saveActiveSponsors(DEFAULT_SPONSORS);
  return DEFAULT_SPONSORS;
}

// Obtener conteo de categorías para los pills estilo directorio
export function getSponsorsCategoriesCount(sponsors = null) {
  const list = sponsors || getActiveSponsors();
  const counts = {};
  list.forEach(s => {
    const cat = s.category || 'Otros Aliados';
    counts[cat] = (counts[cat] || 0) + 1;
  });
  return counts;
}

// Exportar base de datos a JSON para respaldo o descarga
export function exportSponsorsJSON() {
  const sponsors = getAllSponsors();
  const data = {
    station: 'Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM',
    module: 'Directorio de Aliados Comerciales y Patrocinantes',
    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    total: sponsors.length,
    sponsors
  };
  return JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
}

// Importar base de datos desde JSON
export function importSponsorsJSON(jsonString) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonString);
    const list = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : (parsed.sponsors || []);
    if (!Array.isArray(list) || list.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('El archivo no contiene una lista válida de aliados.');
    }
    saveActiveSponsors(list);
    return { success: true, count: list.length };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

export function getAllStaffUsers() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return INITIAL_STAFF_USERS;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_STAFF_USERS_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
    }
  } catch (e) {}
  return INITIAL_STAFF_USERS;
}

export function saveAllStaffUsers(users) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_STAFF_USERS_KEY, JSON.stringify(users));
    notifyStaffChanged('users_updated');
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function getStaffUserById(staffId) {
  const users = getAllStaffUsers();
  return users.find(u => String(u.id) === String(staffId)) || null;
}

export function saveStaffUser(staffData) {
  const users = getAllStaffUsers();
  let updated;
  const cleanUsername = (staffData.username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanPassword = (staffData.password || '').trim();

  if (staffData.id) {
    const exists = users.some(u => String(u.id) === String(staffData.id));
    if (exists) {
      updated = users.map(u => {
        if (String(u.id) === String(staffData.id)) {
          return {
            ...u,
            ...staffData,
            username: cleanUsername || u.username,
            password: cleanPassword || u.password,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          };
        }
        return u;
      });
    } else {
      updated = [staffData, ...users];
    }
  } else {
    const newStaff = {
      ...staffData,
      id: `staff_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      username: cleanUsername || `locutor_${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
      password: cleanPassword || 'neblina105',
      accessActive: staffData.accessActive !== false,
      commissionRate: Number(staffData.commissionRate) || 20,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    updated = [newStaff, ...users];
  }

  saveAllStaffUsers(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function toggleStaffActive(staffId) {
  const users = getAllStaffUsers();
  const updated = users.map(u => {
    if (String(u.id) === String(staffId)) {
      return { ...u, accessActive: !u.accessActive, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return u;
  });
  saveAllStaffUsers(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function deleteStaffUser(staffId) {
  const users = getAllStaffUsers();
  const updated = users.filter(u => String(u.id) !== String(staffId));
  saveAllStaffUsers(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function getActiveStaffSession() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_STAFF_AUTH_KEY);
    if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}

export function setStaffSession(staff) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_STAFF_AUTH_KEY, JSON.stringify(staff));
    notifyStaffChanged('session_started', { staffId: staff.id });
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function clearStaffSession() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_STAFF_AUTH_KEY);
    notifyStaffChanged('session_ended');
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function loginStaff(username, password) {
  const users = getAllStaffUsers();
  const cleanU = (username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanP = (password || '').trim();

  const found = (cleanU === 'admin' && cleanP === 'admin')
    ? (users.find(u => u.username.toLowerCase() === 'admin') || users[0])
    : users.find(u => 
        u.username.toLowerCase() === cleanU && 
        String(u.password) === cleanP
      );

  if (!found) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Usuario o contraseña incorrectos.' };
  }

  if (!found.accessActive) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Tu cuenta de locutor se encuentra inactiva. Contacta a Dirección.' };
  }

  // Registrar último login
  found.lastLogin = new Date().toISOString();
  saveAllStaffUsers(users);

  setStaffSession(found);
  return { success: true, staff: found };
}

export function saveStaffNote(noteData) {
  const notes = getAllStaffNotes();
  let updated;

  const statusVal = noteData.status || (noteData.spokenLive ? 'spoken' : 'queued');
  const spokenVal = statusVal === 'spoken' ? true : Boolean(noteData.spokenLive);

  if (noteData.id) {
    updated = notes.map(n =>
      String(n.id) === String(noteData.id)
        ? {
            ...n,
            ...noteData,
            status: statusVal,
            spokenLive: spokenVal,
            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
          }
        : n
    );
  } else {
    const staffNotes = notes.filter(n => String(n.staffId) === String(noteData.staffId) && !n.trashed);
    const nextOrder = noteData.sortOrder !== undefined ? Number(noteData.sortOrder) : staffNotes.length + 1;
    const newNote = {
      programDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      dayOfWeek: new Date().getDay() === 0 ? 7 : new Date().getDay(),
      segmentTime: '',
      trashed: false,
      ...noteData,
      id: `note_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      sortOrder: nextOrder,
      status: statusVal,
      spokenLive: spokenVal,
      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    updated = [newNote, ...notes];
  }

  saveAllStaffNotes(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function updateStaffNoteStatus(noteId, newStatus) {
  const notes = getAllStaffNotes();
  const updated = notes.map(n => {
    if (String(n.id) === String(noteId)) {
      return {
        ...n,
        status: newStatus, // 'queued' | 'spoken' | 'draft'
        spokenLive: newStatus === 'spoken',
        spokenAt: newStatus === 'spoken' ? new Date().toISOString() : n.spokenAt,
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
      };
    }
    return n;
  });
  saveAllStaffNotes(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function reorderStaffNote(noteId, direction = 'up') {
  const notes = getAllStaffNotes();
  const target = notes.find(n => String(n.id) === String(noteId));
  if (!target) return notes;

  const siblings = notes
    .filter(n => String(n.staffId) === String(target.staffId) && !n.trashed)
    .sort((a, b) => (Number(a.sortOrder) || 99) - (Number(b.sortOrder) || 99));

  const idx = siblings.findIndex(n => String(n.id) === String(noteId));
  if (idx < 0) return notes;
  const swapIdx = direction === 'up' ? idx - 1 : idx + 1;
  if (swapIdx < 0 || swapIdx >= siblings.length) return notes;

  const reorderedIds = siblings.map(s => s.id);
  const temp = reorderedIds[idx];
  reorderedIds[idx] = reorderedIds[swapIdx];
  reorderedIds[swapIdx] = temp;

  const orderMap = {};
  reorderedIds.forEach((id, i) => {
    orderMap[id] = i + 1;
  });

  const updated = notes.map(n => {
    if (orderMap[n.id] !== undefined) {
      return { ...n, sortOrder: orderMap[n.id], updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return n;
  });

  saveAllStaffNotes(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function trashStaffNote(noteId) {
  const notes = getAllStaffNotes();
  const updated = notes.map(n =>
    String(n.id) === String(noteId) ? { ...n, trashed: true, trashedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : n
  );
  saveAllStaffNotes(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function restoreStaffNote(noteId) {
  const notes = getAllStaffNotes();
  const updated = notes.map(n =>
    String(n.id) === String(noteId) ? { ...n, trashed: false, trashedAt: null } : n
  );
  saveAllStaffNotes(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function deleteStaffNote(noteId) {
  const notes = getAllStaffNotes();
  const updated = notes.filter(n => String(n.id) !== String(noteId));
  saveAllStaffNotes(updated);
  return updated;
}

export function sendStaffMessage({ staffId, sender, text }) {
  if (!staffId || !text || !text.trim()) return null;
  const messages = getAllStaffMessages();
  const newMsg = {
    id: `msg_s_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
    staffId,
    sender: sender || 'staff',
    text: text.trim(),
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    read: sender === 'director' ? false : true
  };
  const updated = [...messages, newMsg];
  saveAllStaffMessages(updated);
  return newMsg;
}

export function markStaffMessagesAsRead(staffId, reader = 'staff') {
  const messages = getAllStaffMessages();
  const updated = messages.map(m => {
    if (String(m.staffId) === String(staffId)) {
      // Si el lector es el locutor, marca como leídos los que envió el director
      if (reader === 'staff' && m.sender === 'director') {
        return { ...m, read: true };
      }
      // Si el lector es el director, marca como leídos los que envió el locutor
      if (reader === 'director' && m.sender === 'staff') {
        return { ...m, read: true };
      }
    }
    return m;
  });
  saveAllStaffMessages(updated);
  return updated;
}

// 7. CÁLCULO DE VENTAS, COBRANZAS Y COMISIONES POR LOCUTOR
// =========================================================================

export function getStaffSalesMetrics(staffId, clientsList = null, paymentsList = null, bcvUsdRate = null) {
  const allClients = clientsList || getAllClients();
  const allPayments = paymentsList || getAllPayments();
  const rateUsd = bcvUsdRate || getCachedBcvRates().usd || 884.75;

  const staffClients = allClients.filter(c => !c.trashed && String(c.locutorId) === String(staffId));
  const activeClients = staffClients.filter(c => !c.archived);
  const archivedClients = staffClients.filter(c => c.archived);

  // Total facturado por mes (suma de amountUsd de contratos activos)
  const totalBilledUsd = activeClients.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (Number(c.amountUsd) || 0), 0);
  const totalBilledBs = totalBilledUsd * rateUsd;

  // Clientes pagados / pendientes
  const paidClients = activeClients.filter(c => c.paymentStatus === 'paid');
  const pendingClients = activeClients.filter(c => c.paymentStatus === 'pending');
  const overdueClients = activeClients.filter(c => c.paymentStatus === 'overdue');

  const totalCollectedUsd = paidClients.reduce((acc, c) => acc + (Number(c.amountUsd) || 0), 0);
  const totalCollectedBs = totalCollectedUsd * rateUsd;

  const totalPendingUsd = [...pendingClients, ...overdueClients].reduce((acc, c) => acc + (Number(c.amountUsd) || 0), 0);
  const totalPendingBs = totalPendingUsd * rateUsd;

  // Cobranzas registradas en el historial de pagos para este locutor
  const staffClientIds = new Set(staffClients.map(c => String(c.id)));
  const staffPayments = allPayments.filter(p => staffClientIds.has(String(p.clientId)) || String(p.locutorId) === String(staffId));

  // Obtener porcentaje de comisión del locutor
  const staffUser = getStaffUserById(staffId);
  const commissionRate = staffUser?.commissionRate || 20;
  const estimatedCommissionUsd = (totalCollectedUsd * commissionRate) / 100;
  const estimatedCommissionBs = estimatedCommissionUsd * rateUsd;

  return {
    totalClientsCount: staffClients.length,
    activeClientsCount: activeClients.length,
    archivedClientsCount: archivedClients.length,
    paidClientsCount: paidClients.length,
    pendingClientsCount: pendingClients.length,
    overdueClientsCount: overdueClients.length,
    totalBilledUsd,
    totalBilledBs,
    totalCollectedUsd,
    totalCollectedBs,
    totalPendingUsd,
    totalPendingBs,
    commissionRate,
    estimatedCommissionUsd,
    estimatedCommissionBs,
    paymentsCount: staffPayments.length,
    paymentsList: staffPayments
  };
}

// Obtener todos los talentos
export function getAllTalents() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_TALENTS_KEY);
    if (!raw) {
      saveAllTalents(DEFAULT_TALENTS);
      return DEFAULT_TALENTS;
    }
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : DEFAULT_TALENTS;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error al leer talentos de localStorage:', err);
    return DEFAULT_TALENTS;
  }
}

// Guardar array completo
export function saveAllTalents(talents) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_TALENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(talents));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_talents_updated', { detail: talents }));
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error al guardar talentos en localStorage:', err);
  }
}

// Obtener solo talentos activos (para vista pública)
export function getActiveTalents() {
  return getAllTalents()
    .filter(t => t.status === 'active' && !t.trashed)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.order || 99) - (b.order || 99));
}

// Guardar o actualizar un talento individual
export function saveTalent(talentData) {
  const current = getAllTalents();
  let updated;

  if (talentData.id) {
    // Editar
    updated = current.map(item => {
      if (item.id === talentData.id) {
        return {
          ...item,
          ...talentData,
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
      }
      return item;
    });
  } else {
    // Crear nuevo
    const newTalent = {
      ...talentData,
      id: `talent_${Date.now()}`,
      status: talentData.status || 'active',
      order: talentData.order ? Number(talentData.order) : current.length + 1,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    updated = [newTalent, ...current];
  }

  saveAllTalents(updated);
  return updated;
}

// Enviar un talento a la papelera (Eliminación temporal)
export function trashTalent(id) {
  const current = getAllTalents().map(t => {
    if (String(t.id) === String(id)) {
      return { ...t, trashed: true, trashedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
    }
    return t;
  });
  saveAllTalents(current);
  return current;
}

// Restaurar un talento desde la papelera
export function restoreTalent(id) {
  const current = getAllTalents().map(t => {
    if (String(t.id) === String(id)) {
      return { ...t, trashed: false, trashedAt: null };
    }
    return t;
  });
  saveAllTalents(current);
  return current;
}

// Eliminar talento definitivamente
export function deleteTalent(id) {
  const current = getAllTalents();
  const filtered = current.filter(item => String(item.id) !== String(id));
  saveAllTalents(filtered);
  return filtered;
}

export const deleteTalentPermanently = deleteTalent;

// Vaciar papelera de talentos
export function emptyTalentsTrash() {
  const filtered = getAllTalents().filter(t => !t.trashed);
  saveAllTalents(filtered);
  return filtered;
}

// Alternar estado activo / inactivo
export function toggleTalentActive(id) {
  const current = getAllTalents();
  const updated = current.map(item => {
    if (item.id === id) {
      return {
        ...item,
        status: item.status === 'active' ? 'inactive' : 'active'
      };
    }
    return item;
  });
  saveAllTalents(updated);
  return updated;
}

// Restablecer valores predeterminados
export function resetDefaultTalents() {
  saveAllTalents(DEFAULT_TALENTS);
  return DEFAULT_TALENTS;
}

// Exportar base de datos a archivo JSON
export function exportTalentsJSON() {
  const data = getAllTalents();
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `neblina_talentos_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

// Importar base de datos desde archivo JSON
export function importTalentsJSON(jsonContent) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonContent);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      saveAllTalents(parsed);
      return { success: true, count: parsed.length };
    }
    return { success: false, error: 'El archivo JSON no tiene un formato válido de lista.' };
  } catch (err) {
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}
