// Agregar o actualizar un contacto de forma unificada desde cualquier punto de la web
export function addUnifiedContact({
  name = '',
  phone = '',
  cedula = '',
  location = '',
  origin = 'Mensaje Web',
  details = '',
  notes = ''
}) {
  const cleanName = (name || '').trim();
  const cleanPhone = (phone || '').trim();
  const cleanCedula = (cedula || '').trim();
  const cleanLocation = (location || '').trim();
  const cleanDetails = (details || '').trim();

  // Si no hay datos mínimos para identificar a la persona, omitir
  if (!cleanName && !cleanPhone && !cleanLocation) return null;

  const all = [...getAllUnifiedContacts()];
  const digitsPhone = cleanPhone.replace(/\D/g, '');
  const digitsCedula = cleanCedula.replace(/\D/g, '');

  // Buscar coincidencia previa por teléfono (mín 7 dígitos) o cédula (mín 5 dígitos) o nombre exacto
  const existingIdx = all.findIndex(c => {
    if (digitsPhone.length >= 7) {
      const existingDigits = (c.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (existingDigits && existingDigits === digitsPhone) return true;
    }
    if (digitsCedula.length >= 5) {
      const existingCedulaDigits = (c.cedula || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (existingCedulaDigits && existingCedulaDigits === digitsCedula) return true;
    }
    if (cleanName.length >= 4) {
      if ((c.name || '').trim().toLowerCase() === cleanName.toLowerCase()) return true;
    }
    return false;
  });

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const historyEntry = {
    date: now,
    origin,
    details: cleanDetails || 'Interacción registrada en la plataforma web'
  };

  if (existingIdx !== -1) {
    // Actualizar registro existente y enriquecer datos
    const current = all[existingIdx];
    const updatedHistory = Array.isArray(current.history) ? [...current.history, historyEntry] : [historyEntry];

    all[existingIdx] = {
      ...current,
      name: cleanName || current.name,
      phone: cleanPhone || current.phone,
      cedula: cleanCedula || current.cedula,
      location: cleanLocation || current.location,
      origin: origin || current.origin,
      details: cleanDetails || current.details,
      interactionCount: (current.interactionCount || 1) + 1,
      lastContactDate: now,
      trashed: false, // Si interactúa de nuevo, se reactiva automáticamente
      trashedAt: null,
      history: updatedHistory
    };

    saveAllUnifiedContacts(all);
    return all[existingIdx];
  } else {
    // Crear nuevo registro
    const newContact = {
      id: `cont_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      name: cleanName || 'Oyente Anónimo',
      phone: cleanPhone || 'No indicado',
      cedula: cleanCedula || 'No especificada',
      location: cleanLocation || 'Santo Domingo / Mérida',
      origin: origin || 'Interacción Web',
      details: cleanDetails || 'Primer contacto registrado desde la web app',
      interactionCount: 1,
      firstContactDate: now,
      lastContactDate: now,
      notes: notes || '',
      trashed: false,
      trashedAt: null,
      history: [historyEntry]
    };

    all.unshift(newContact);
    saveAllUnifiedContacts(all);
    return newContact;
  }
}

// Enviar un contacto a la papelera (eliminación temporal)
export function trashContact(id) {
  const all = getAllUnifiedContacts().map(c => {
    if (c.id === id) {

// Exportar Base de Datos a CSV (Compatible directo con Microsoft Excel con BOM UTF-8)
export function exportContactsCSV() {
  const list = getAllUnifiedContacts();
  const headers = [
    'ID',
    'Nombre y Apellido',
    'Cédula de Identidad',
    'Teléfono / WhatsApp',
    'Ubicación / Sector / Municipio',
    'Canal de Entrada',
    'Último Detalle / Mensaje',
    'Total Interacciones',
    'Primer Contacto',
    'Último Contacto',
    'Estado',
    'Notas Internas'
  ];

  const rows = list.map(c => [
    `"${c.id}"`,
    `"${(c.name || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(c.cedula || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(c.phone || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(c.location || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(c.origin || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    `"${(c.details || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
    c.interactionCount || 1,
    `"${new Date(c.firstContactDate).toLocaleDateString('es-VE')}"`,
    `"${new Date(c.lastContactDate).toLocaleDateString('es-VE')}"`,
    c.trashed ? '"En Papelera"' : '"Activo"',
    `"${(c.notes || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
  ]);

  const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\r\n');
  return csvContent;
}

// Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM - Servicio de Integración Oficial con WordPress REST API
// Conexión bi-direccional con la web oficial: https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2

import { getAllNews, saveAllNews } from './newsData';
import { getAllNewsComments, saveAllNewsComments } from './newsCommentsService';
import { addUnifiedContact } from './unifiedContactsService';
import { getAllCategories, saveAllCategories, recalculateCategoryCounts } from './newsCategoriesService';
import { saveAllNewsToIndexedDB } from './newsStorageDB';

const WP_CONFIG_STORAGE_KEY = 'neblina_wp_credentials_v1';
const WP_CATEGORIES_CACHE_KEY = 'neblina_wp_categories_cache';

export const DEFAULT_WP_CONFIG = {
  apiUrl: 'https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2',
  username: 'neblina105fm@gmail.com',
  appPassword: 'RGHO eVMV FGfC E69V ypC9 OVf9', // Contraseña de aplicación oficial
  status: 'connected', // 'unconfigured' | 'connected' | 'error'
  lastTestedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  userNameDisplay: 'Neblina 105.5 FM',
  userRole: 'Administrator'
};

// Conversión segura UTF-8 a Base64 para Basic Auth
function toBase64(str) {
  try {
    return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(str)));
  } catch (e) {
    if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined') {
      return Buffer.from(str, 'utf-8').toString('base64');
    }
    return btoa(str);
  }
}

// Decodificar entidades HTML comunes de WordPress
export function decodeWpHtmlEntities(text = '') {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    .replace(/&#8211;/g, '–')
    .replace(/&#8212;/g, '—')
    .replace(/&#8216;/g, '‘')
    .replace(/&#8217;/g, '’')
    .replace(/&#8220;/g, '“')
    .replace(/&#8221;/g, '”')
    .replace(/&#8230;/g, '…')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, '&')
    .replace(/&lt;/g, '<')
    .replace(/&gt;/g, '>')
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&#039;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&nbsp;/g, ' ');
}

// Obtener configuración guardada de WordPress
export function getWordPressConfig() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return DEFAULT_WP_CONFIG;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(WP_CONFIG_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      return { ...DEFAULT_WP_CONFIG, ...JSON.parse(raw) };
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error leyendo configuración WP:', e);
  }
  return DEFAULT_WP_CONFIG;
}

// Guardar configuración de WordPress
export function saveWordPressConfig(config) {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    const merged = { ...getWordPressConfig(), ...config };
    localStorage.setItem(WP_CONFIG_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('neblina_wp_config_changed', { detail: merged }));
    return merged;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error guardando configuración WP:', e);
  }
}

// Probar conexión en vivo con WordPress REST API (/users/me)
export async function testWordPressConnection(credentials = null) {
  const config = credentials || getWordPressConfig();
  const cleanApiUrl = (config.apiUrl || 'https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const username = (config.username || '').trim();
  // Limpiar espacios intermedios o mantener contraseña intacta
  const appPassword = (config.appPassword || '').trim();

  if (!username || !appPassword) {
    const result = {
      ok: false,
      status: 'unconfigured',
      message: 'Debe ingresar el Usuario y la Contraseña de Aplicación de WordPress.'
    };
    saveWordPressConfig({ status: 'unconfigured' });
    return result;
  }

  try {
    const authHeader = `Basic ${toBase64(`${username}:${appPassword}`)}`;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000);

    const res = await fetch(`${cleanApiUrl}/users/me`, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': authHeader,
        'Accept': 'application/json'
      },
      signal: controller.signal
    });
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

    const data = await res.json();

    if (res.ok && data && data.id) {
      const successData = {
        ok: true,
        status: 'connected',
        userId: data.id,
        userNameDisplay: data.name || data.slug || username,
        userRole: Array.isArray(data.roles) && data.roles[0] ? data.roles[0] : 'Editor / Admin',
        lastTestedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        message: `¡Conexión exitosa! Conectado a neblina105fm.com como ${data.name || username}.`
      };
      saveWordPressConfig(successData);
      return successData;
    } else {
      const errorMsg = data?.message ? decodeWpHtmlEntities(data.message) : `Error HTTP ${res.status}: Credenciales no autorizadas.`;
      const failureData = {
        ok: false,
        status: 'error',
        lastTestedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        message: errorMsg
      };
      saveWordPressConfig({ status: 'error', lastTestedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
      return failureData;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    const isTimeout = err.name === 'AbortError';
    const failureData = {
      ok: false,
      status: 'error',
      lastTestedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      message: isTimeout 
        ? 'Tiempo de espera agotado al conectar con neblina105fm.com (Timeout).'
        : `Error de red al conectar con WordPress: ${err.message}`
    };
    saveWordPressConfig({ status: 'error', lastTestedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
    return failureData;
  }
}

// Publicar una nueva nota de prensa directamente en WordPress (neblina105fm.com)
export async function publishPostToWordPress({
  title,
  content,
  excerpt = '',
  status = 'publish', // 'publish' | 'draft' | 'pending'
  categoryId = null
}) {
  const config = getWordPressConfig();
  const cleanApiUrl = (config.apiUrl || 'https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const username = (config.username || '').trim();
  const appPassword = (config.appPassword || '').trim();

  if (!username || !appPassword) {
    throw new Error('No se han configurado credenciales de WordPress. Configure su Usuario y Contraseña de Aplicación en la pestaña "WordPress API".');
  }

  const authHeader = `Basic ${toBase64(`${username}:${appPassword}`)}`;
  
  const payload = {
    title: title.trim(),
    content: content || `<p>${excerpt || title}</p>`,
    excerpt: excerpt.trim(),
    status: status
  };

  if (categoryId) {
    payload.categories = [Number(categoryId)];
  }

  const res = await fetch(`${cleanApiUrl}/posts`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': authHeader,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Accept': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
  });

  const data = await res.json();

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(data?.message ? decodeWpHtmlEntities(data.message) : `Error ${res.status} al publicar en WordPress`);
  }

  return {
    ok: true,
    post: data,
    id: data.id,
    link: data.link,
    title: decodeWpHtmlEntities(data.title?.rendered || title),
    message: 'Nota de prensa publicada exitosamente en neblina105fm.com'
  };
}

// Obtener categorías oficiales de WordPress con conteo
export async function fetchWordPressCategories() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2/categories?per_page=50&_fields=id,name,count,slug');
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error al obtener categorías');
    const categories = await res.json();
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(categories)) {
      localStorage.setItem(WP_CATEGORIES_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(categories));
    }
    return categories;
  } catch (e) {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem(WP_CATEGORIES_CACHE_KEY);
        if (cached) return JSON.parse(cached);
      } catch (err) {}
    }
    // Fallback con categorías conocidas de neblina105fm.com
    return [
      { id: 1, name: 'Noticias', count: 486 },
      { id: 5, name: 'Mundo Stereo', count: 255 },
      { id: 9, name: 'Titulares Neblina', count: 127 },
      { id: 3, name: 'Zona Stereo', count: 61 },
      { id: 4, name: 'Estrenos', count: 43 },
      { id: 21, name: 'Es Viral', count: 4 }
    ];
  }
}

// Helper para extraer de 1 a 3 imágenes de una nota de prensa (destacada + contenido)
export function extractImagesFromPost(post) {
  const images = [];
  
  // 1. Imagen destacada oficial de WordPress
  if (post._embedded && post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'] && post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0]) {
    const feat = post._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0].source_url;
    if (feat && typeof feat === 'string') images.push(feat.trim());
  } else if (post.featured_media_url) {
    images.push(post.featured_media_url.trim());
  }

  // 2. Extraer imágenes complementarias desde las etiquetas <img> del cuerpo HTML
  const content = post.content?.rendered || post.content || '';
  if (content && typeof content === 'string') {
    const imgRegex = /<img[^>]+src=["']([^"']+)["']/gi;
    let match;
    while ((match = imgRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {
      const src = match[1]?.trim();
      // Filtrar tracking pixels, avatares o iconos de sistema
      if (
        src && 
        !images.includes(src) && 
        !src.includes('s.w.org') && 
        !src.includes('gravatar') && 
        !src.includes('emoji') &&
        !src.includes('data:image')
      ) {
        images.push(src);
      }
      if (images.length >= 3) break;
    }
  }

  // Fallback con imagen de prensa institucional de Neblina 105.5 FM si no posee ninguna
  if (images.length === 0) {
    images.push('https://neblina105fm.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Neblina-2026-10-4.png');
  }

  return images.slice(0, 3);
}

// Obtener noticias paginadas y filtradas directamente de WordPress (Lotes por defecto de 10)
export async function fetchWordPressNewsPaginated({
  page = 1,
  perPage = 10,
  search = '',
  categoryId = null
} = {}) {
  try {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 10000);

    let queryParams = `_fields=id,date,title,excerpt,content,link,_links,_embedded&_embed=1&per_page=${perPage}&page=${page}`;
    
    if (search && search.trim()) {
      queryParams += `&search=${encodeURIComponent(search.trim())}`;
    }
    
    if (categoryId && categoryId !== 'all' && categoryId !== 'Todas') {
      queryParams += `&categories=${categoryId}`;
    }

    const url = `https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?${queryParams}`;
    const res = await fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal });
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`WordPress HTTP Error: ${res.status}`);
    }

    const totalPosts = parseInt(res.headers.get('x-wp-total') || '0', 10);
    const totalPages = parseInt(res.headers.get('x-wp-totalpages') || '1', 10);
    const posts = await res.json();

    const mapped = posts.map(post => {
      const extractedImages = extractImagesFromPost(post);
      const featuredImage = extractedImages[0];

      let category = 'Noticias';
      if (post._embedded && post._embedded['wp:term'] && post._embedded['wp:term'][0] && post._embedded['wp:term'][0][0]) {
        category = post._embedded['wp:term'][0][0].name;
      }

      const decodedTitle = decodeWpHtmlEntities(post.title?.rendered || '');
      const rawExcerpt = (post.excerpt?.rendered || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();
      const decodedExcerpt = decodeWpHtmlEntities(rawExcerpt);

      return {
        id: post.id,
        title: decodedTitle,
        excerpt: decodedExcerpt,
        content: post.content?.rendered || '',
        date: new Date(post.date).toLocaleDateString('es-VE', {
          year: 'numeric',
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric'
        }),
        rawDate: post.date,
        link: post.link,
        image: featuredImage,
        images: extractedImages,
        category: category,
        status: 'published',
        featuredInCarousel: true
      };
    });

    return {
      posts: mapped,
      totalPosts: totalPosts || mapped.length,
      totalPages: totalPages || 1,
      currentPage: page
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error fetching paginated WordPress news:', err.message);
    return {
      posts: [],
      totalPosts: 0,
      totalPages: 1,
      currentPage: page,
      error: err.message
    };
  }
}

// Migración completa de todos los datos desde WordPress:
// 1. Categorías oficiales
// 2. Comentarios y estadísticas
// 3. Todas las 901 notas de prensa (en lotes de 100 hasta completar todas las páginas)
// 4. Extracción de 1 a 3 fotos por nota para carrusel
// 5. Almacenamiento dual persistente (IndexedDB sin límite de cuota + Top en localStorage)
export async function migrateWordPressAllData({ onProgress = null } = {}) {
  const config = getWordPressConfig();
  const cleanApiUrl = (config.apiUrl || 'https://neblina105fm.com/wp-json/wp/v2').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const username = (config.username || 'neblina105fm@gmail.com').trim();
  const appPassword = (config.appPassword || 'RGHO eVMV FGfC E69V ypC9 OVf9').trim();

  const authHeader = `Basic ${toBase64(`${username}:${appPassword}`)}`;
  const headers = {
    'Authorization': authHeader,
    'Accept': 'application/json'
  };

  const results = {
    ok: true,
    postsMigrated: 0,
    categoriesMigrated: 0,
    commentsMigrated: 0,
    contactsMigrated: 0,
    totalPagesFetched: 0,
    errors: []
  };

  if (onProgress) onProgress('Iniciando conexión bi-direccional con WordPress neblina105fm.com...');

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. MIGRAR CATEGORÍAS DE WORDPRESS Y SINCRONIZAR
  // =========================================================================
  try {
    if (onProgress) onProgress('Sincronizando categorías oficiales de neblina105fm.com...');
    const catRes = await fetch(`${cleanApiUrl}/categories?per_page=100`, { headers });
    if (catRes.ok) {
      const wpCats = await catRes.json();
      if (Array.isArray(wpCats) && wpCats.length > 0) {
        const existingCats = getAllCategories();
        const existingNames = new Set(existingCats.map(c => c.name.toLowerCase()));
        
        const mappedCats = wpCats.map(c => ({
          id: c.id,
          name: decodeWpHtmlEntities(c.name),
          slug: c.slug,
          count: c.count || 0
        }));

        // Combinar manteniendo también categorías locales personalizadas
        const combinedCats = [...mappedCats];
        for (const localCat of existingCats) {
          if (!existingNames.has(localCat.name.toLowerCase())) {
            combinedCats.push(localCat);
          }
        }

        saveAllCategories(combinedCats);
        results.categoriesMigrated = mappedCats.length;
      }
    }
  } catch (catErr) {
    console.warn('Error migrando categorías:', catErr);
    results.errors.push(`Categorías: ${catErr.message}`);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 2. MIGRAR COMENTARIOS Y REGISTRAR CONTACTOS CIUDADANOS
  // =========================================================================
  try {
    if (onProgress) onProgress('Descargando comentarios de oyentes y lectores en notas de prensa...');
    const commentsRes = await fetch(`${cleanApiUrl}/comments?per_page=100`, { headers });
    
    if (commentsRes.ok) {
      const wpComments = await commentsRes.json();
      const currentComments = getAllNewsComments();
      const importedComments = [];
      
      for (const item of wpComments) {
        const commId = `wp_comm_${item.id}`;
        const rawText = (item.content?.rendered || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();
        const cleanComment = decodeWpHtmlEntities(rawText);
        const authorName = decodeWpHtmlEntities(item.author_name || 'Lector Verificado');
        const authorEmail = item.author_email || '';

        const newComment = {
          id: commId,
          newsId: item.post,
          newsTitle: `Nota de Prensa #${item.post}`,
          newsUrl: item.link || '',
          authorName: authorName,
          authorCedula: 'V-Verificada',
          authorPhone: '+58 414-0000000',
          authorLocation: 'Comunidad Santo Domingo / Páramo',
          comment: cleanComment,
          status: item.status === 'approved' ? 'approved' : 'pending',
          createdAt: item.date || new Date().toISOString(),
          formattedDate: new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString('es-VE', {
            year: 'numeric',
            month: 'short',
            day: 'numeric',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit'
          }),
          trashed: false
        };

        importedComments.push(newComment);

        // Registrar en directorio unificado
        addUnifiedContact({
          fullName: authorName,
          email: authorEmail,
          location: 'Comunidad / Lector Web',
          source: 'Comentario en Nota de Prensa',
          sourceDetail: `Comentario en noticia #${item.post}`
        });
        results.contactsMigrated++;
      }

      // Fusionar comentarios existentes
      const mergedCommMap = new Map();
      importedComments.forEach(c => mergedCommMap.set(String(c.id), c));
      currentComments.forEach(c => {
        if (!mergedCommMap.has(String(c.id))) {
          mergedCommMap.set(String(c.id), c);
        }
      });

      const finalCommentsList = Array.from(mergedCommMap.values());
      saveAllNewsComments(finalCommentsList);
      results.commentsMigrated = importedComments.length;
    }
  } catch (commErr) {
    console.warn('Error migrando comentarios:', commErr);
    results.errors.push(`Comentarios: ${commErr.message}`);
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 3. MIGRACIÓN COMPLETA DE TODAS LAS NOTAS DE PRENSA (901 POSTS EN LOTES DE 100)
  // =========================================================================
  try {
    if (onProgress) onProgress('Consultando total de notas de prensa en el servidor de WordPress...');
    
    // Primera petición para descubrir total de páginas
    const firstPageRes = await fetch(`${cleanApiUrl}/posts?per_page=100&page=1&_embed=1`, { headers });
    
    if (!firstPageRes.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Error en el servidor de WordPress: HTTP ${firstPageRes.status}`);
    }

    const totalPosts = parseInt(firstPageRes.headers.get('x-wp-total') || '901', 10);
    const totalPages = parseInt(firstPageRes.headers.get('x-wp-totalpages') || '10', 10);
    results.totalPagesFetched = totalPages;

    const allWpPosts = [];
    const firstBatch = await firstPageRes.json();
    allWpPosts.push(...firstBatch);

    if (onProgress) {
      onProgress(`Descargadas 100 de ${totalPosts} notas (Página 1 de ${totalPages})...`);
    }

    // Iterar por las páginas restantes (de la 2 hasta totalPages)
    for (let page = 2; page <= totalPages; page++) {
      try {
        if (onProgress) {
          onProgress(`Descargando lote ${page} de ${totalPages} (${allWpPosts.length}/${totalPosts} notas)...`);
        }
        const pageRes = await fetch(`${cleanApiUrl}/posts?per_page=100&page=${page}&_embed=1`, { headers });
        if (pageRes.ok) {
          const batch = await pageRes.json();
          if (Array.isArray(batch) && batch.length > 0) {
            allWpPosts.push(...batch);
          }
        } else {
          results.errors.push(`Página ${page}: HTTP ${pageRes.status}`);
        }
      } catch (pageErr) {
        results.errors.push(`Página ${page}: ${pageErr.message}`);
      }
    }

    // Mapear y enriquecer todos los posts con 1 a 3 fotos para el carrusel
    const formattedPosts = allWpPosts.map(post => {
      const extractedImages = extractImagesFromPost(post);
      const featuredImage = extractedImages[0];

      let category = 'Noticias';
      if (post._embedded && post._embedded['wp:term'] && post._embedded['wp:term'][0] && post._embedded['wp:term'][0][0]) {
        category = post._embedded['wp:term'][0][0].name;
      }

      const decodedTitle = decodeWpHtmlEntities(post.title?.rendered || '');
      const rawExcerpt = (post.excerpt?.rendered || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim();

      return {
        id: post.id,
        title: decodedTitle,
        excerpt: decodeWpHtmlEntities(rawExcerpt),
        content: post.content?.rendered || '',
        date: new Date(post.date).toLocaleDateString('es-VE', {
          year: 'numeric',
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric'
        }),
        rawDate: post.date,
        link: post.link,
        image: featuredImage,
        images: extractedImages, // Carrusel de 1 a 3 imágenes
        category: category,
        author: 'Sala de Redacción Neblina 105.5 FM',
        featuredInCarousel: true,
        status: 'published',
        trashed: false
      };
    });

    // Preservar noticias creadas localmente en el CMS
    const currentLocalNews = getAllNews().filter(n => n.isCustomCreated === true);
    const combinedNewsMap = new Map();
    
    // Primero agregamos las locales personalizadas
    currentLocalNews.forEach(p => combinedNewsMap.set(String(p.id), p));
    // Luego agregamos las 901 de WordPress
    formattedPosts.forEach(p => combinedNewsMap.set(String(p.id), p));

    const finalNewsList = Array.from(combinedNewsMap.values());

    // 1. Guardar la totalidad (901+ notas) en IndexedDB para no saturar los 5MB de localStorage
    await saveAllNewsToIndexedDB(finalNewsList);

    // 2. Guardar las 100 notas más recientes en localStorage para carga síncrona instantánea
    saveAllNews(finalNewsList.slice(0, 100));

    // 3. Recalcular conteos de categorías con la lista global
    recalculateCategoryCounts(finalNewsList);

    results.postsMigrated = finalNewsList.length;

  } catch (postsErr) {
    console.error('Error migrando notas de WordPress:', postsErr);
    results.errors.push(`Notas de prensa: ${postsErr.message}`);
    results.ok = false;
  }

  if (onProgress) {
    onProgress(`¡Migración finalizada! ${results.postsMigrated} notas, ${results.categoriesMigrated} categorías y ${results.commentsMigrated} comentarios.`);
  }

  return results;
}

const CACHE_KEY = 'neblina_youtube_shorts_cache_v3';
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 25 * 60 * 1000; // 25 minutos

/**
 * Parsea el XML de YouTube y extrae los shorts con sus IDs, títulos e imágenes
 */
function parseYouTubeXml(xmlString) {
  if (!xmlString || typeof xmlString !== 'string') return [];

  const items = [];
  const entryRegex = /<entry>([\s\S]*?)<\/entry>/gi;
  let match;

  while ((match = entryRegex.exec(xmlString)) !== null) {
    const entry = match[1];
    const idMatch = entry.match(/<yt:videoId>([^<]+)<\/yt:videoId>/i);
    const titleMatch = entry.match(/<title>([^<]+)<\/title>/i);
    const linkMatch = entry.match(/<link[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>/i);

    if (idMatch && idMatch[1]) {
      const id = idMatch[1].trim();
      let title = titleMatch ? titleMatch[1].trim() : 'Short de Neblina 105.5 FM';
      title = title.replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/&amp;/g, '&').replace(/&#39;/g, "'").replace(/&lt;/g, '<').replace(/&gt;/g, '>');

      const url = linkMatch ? linkMatch[1].trim() : `https://www.youtube.com/shorts/${id}`;
      const isShort = url.includes('/shorts/') || entry.includes('/shorts/');

      items.push({
        id,
        title,
        url,
        isShort,
        channel: '@neblina105fm'
      });
    }
  }

  return items;
}

/**
 * Obtiene los últimos shorts de YouTube del canal oficial @neblina105fm
 * Con estrategia Stale-While-Revalidate: Devuelve instantáneamente la caché y actualiza en segundo plano.
 */
export async function fetchLatestYouTubeShorts() {
  // 1. Verificar caché existente para velocidad instantánea (0ms)
  let cachedList = null;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed.items) && parsed.items.length > 0) {
        cachedList = parsed.items;
        // Si la caché es reciente, devolverla directamente
        if (Date.now() - (parsed.timestamp || 0) < CACHE_TTL_MS) {
          return cachedList;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error leyendo cache de YouTube shorts:', err);
  }

  // 2. Consultar el feed RSS oficial de YouTube vía proxy CORS seguro
  try {
    const proxyUrl = `https://api.allorigins.win/get?url=${encodeURIComponent(YOUTUBE_FEED_URL)}`;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 7000);

    const response = await fetch(proxyUrl, { signal: controller.signal });
    clearTimeout(timeout);

    if (response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json();
      const xmlContents = data.contents;
      const parsedEntries = parseYouTubeXml(xmlContents);

      if (parsedEntries.length > 0) {
        // Preferir los que son Shorts o los más recientes del canal
        const shortsOnly = parsedEntries.filter(e => e.isShort);
        const finalSelection = (shortsOnly.length >= 6 ? shortsOnly : parsedEntries).slice(0, 12);

        // Guardar en caché persistente
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
            timestamp: Date.now(),
            items: finalSelection
          }));
        } catch {
          // localStorage full / blocked
        }

        return finalSelection;
      }
    }
  } catch (fetchErr) {
    // Si falla la red o el proxy, no romper la experiencia
  }

  // 3. Fallback: Devolver caché previa o lista por defecto garantizada
  return cachedList || DEFAULT_SHORTS;
}

// Utilidad de detección de dispositivo para PWA Neblina Stereo 105.5 FM

export function detectDevice() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return { type: 'desktop', os: 'Desktop', isApple: false, isAndroid: false, isWindows: false, isMac: false, isIOS: false, isSmartTV: false };
  }

  const ua = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera || '';
  const platform = navigator.platform || '';

  // 1. Detección de Smart TV (Tizen, webOS, Android TV, Apple TV, Roku, etc.)
  const isSmartTV = /SmartTV|Tizen|webOS|AppleTV|Android.*TV|BRAVIA|NetCast|Roku|HbbTV|GoogleTV/i.test(ua);
  if (isSmartTV) {
    const isAppleTV = /AppleTV/i.test(ua);
    const isAndroidTV = /Android.*TV|GoogleTV|BRAVIA/i.test(ua) || (!isAppleTV && /Android/i.test(ua));
    return {
      type: 'tv',
      os: isAppleTV ? 'Apple TV' : isAndroidTV ? 'Android TV' : 'Smart TV',
      isApple: isAppleTV,
      isAndroid: !isAppleTV,
      isWindows: false,
      isMac: false,
      isIOS: false,
      isSmartTV: true,
      isAppleTV,
      isAndroidTV: isAndroidTV || !isAppleTV
    };
  }

  // 2. Detección de Apple (iOS / iPadOS / macOS)
  const isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua) || (platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1);
  const isMac = /Macintosh|Mac OS X/.test(ua) && !isIOS;
  if (isIOS || isMac) {
    return {
      type: isIOS ? 'mobile' : 'desktop',
      os: isIOS ? 'Apple iOS' : 'Apple macOS',
      isApple: true,
      isAndroid: false,
      isWindows: false,
      isMac,
      isIOS,
      isSmartTV: false
    };
  }

  // 3. Detección de Android
  const isAndroid = /Android/i.test(ua);
  if (isAndroid) {
    return {
      type: 'mobile',
      os: 'Android',
      isApple: false,
      isAndroid: true,
      isWindows: false,
      isMac: false,
      isIOS: false,
      isSmartTV: false
    };
  }

  // 4. Otros Sistemas de Escritorio (Windows / Linux)
  const isWindows = /Windows|Win32|Win64/i.test(ua) || /Win/i.test(platform);
  return {
    type: 'desktop',
    os: isWindows ? 'Windows' : 'PC',
    isApple: false,
    isAndroid: false,
    isWindows,
    isMac: false,
    isIOS: false,
    isSmartTV: false
  };
}

// Verifica si la aplicación ya se encuentra ejecutándose como app instalada (standalone)
export function isAppInstalled() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  return (
    window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
    window.navigator.standalone === true ||
    document.referrer.includes('android-app://')
  );
}

## src/utils/socialEmbedParser.js

```js
// Utilidad para procesar y optimizar contenido HTML con incrustaciones y enlaces de Redes Sociales
// Soporta con máxima compatibilidad y alta fidelidad:
// - Instagram (Posts, Reels, Carousels y Blockquotes oficiales)
// - Facebook (Posts, Videos, Reels y Links directos)
// - YouTube (Videos estándar, Enlaces cortos y Shorts)
// - Twitter / X (Tweets, Hilos y Blockquotes)
// - TikTok (Videos, Enlaces cortos y Blockquotes)
// - Threads (Publicaciones y Blockquotes)
// - Enlaces externos generales (seguridad _blank y alto contraste)

export function processSocialContent(html) {
  if (!html || typeof html !== 'string') return '';

  let processed = html;
  const placeholders = [];

  // Aislamiento por tokens para evitar que expresiones regulares posteriores
  // re-procesen los atributos href o src de los embeds generados (evitando fugas de código o bucles en iframes).
  const storeEmbed = (embedHtml) => {
    const token = `<!--__NEBLINA_EMBED_SLOT_${placeholders.length}__-->`;
    placeholders.push({ token, embedHtml });
    return token;
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. INSTAGRAM: BLOCKQUOTES EXISTENTES Y ENLACES DIRECTOS (POSTS & REELS)
  // =========================================================================
  
  // 1A. Transformar Blockquotes de Instagram existentes (incluyendo el envoltorio <figure> de WordPress si existe)
  // en iframes responsivos oficiales directos para que NUNCA se queden en estado de texto estático / carga rota.
  processed = processed.replace(
    /(?:<figure[^>]*class="[^"]*wp-block-embed-instagram[^"]*"[^>]*>\s*<div[^>]*class="[^"]*wp-block-embed__wrapper[^"]*"[^>]*>\s*)?<blockquote([^>]*)class="([^"]*instagram-media[^"]*)"([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/blockquote>(?:\s*<script[^>]*><\/script>)?(?:\s*<\/div>\s*<\/figure>)?/gi,
    (match, p1, p2, p3, inner) => {
      const full = `${p1 || ''} ${p3 || ''} ${inner || ''}`;
      // Buscar código permalink (ej: /p/DBU_xyz/ o /reel/DBU_xyz/)
      const matchCode = full.match(/instagram\.com\/(p|reel|tv)\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
      
      let type = 'p';
      let code = '';
      if (matchCode) {
        type = matchCode[1].toLowerCase();
        code = matchCode[2];
      }

      // Si pudimos extraer el código de Instagram, renderizar el reproductor iframe oficial + barra de acceso directo
      if (code) {
        const cleanUrl = `https://www.instagram.com/${type}/${code}/`;
        const embedUrl = `https://www.instagram.com/${type}/${code}/embed/captioned/`;
        const isReel = type === 'reel';

        return storeEmbed(`
          <div class="my-6 not-prose flex flex-col items-center w-full">

                <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-pink-600 dark:text-pink-400">
                  <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2.163c3.204 0 3.584.012 4.85.07 3.252.148 4.771 1.691 4.919 4.919.058 1.265.069 1.645.069 4.849 0 3.205-.012 3.584-.069 4.849-.149 3.225-1.664 4.771-4.919 4.919-1.266.058-1.644.07-4.85.07-3.204 0-3.584-.012-4.849-.07-3.26-.149-4.771-1.699-4.919-4.92-.058-1.265-.07-1.644-.07-4.849 0-3.204.013-3.583.07-4.849.149-3.227 1.664-4.771 4.919-4.919 1.266-.057 1.645-.069 4.849-.069zm0-2.163c-3.259 0-3.667.014-4.947.072-4.358.2-6.78 2.618-6.98 6.98-.059 1.281-.073 1.689-.073 4.948 0 3.259.014 3.668.072 4.948.2 4.358 2.618 6.78 6.98 6.98 1.281.058 1.689.072 4.948.072 3.259 0 3.668-.014 4.948-.072 4.354-.2 6.782-2.618 6.979-6.98.059-1.28.073-1.689.073-4.948 0-3.259-.014-3.667-.072-4.947-.196-4.354-2.617-6.78-6.979-6.98-1.281-.059-1.69-.073-4.949-.073zm0 5.838c-3.403 0-6.162 2.759-6.162 6.162s2.759 6.163 6.162 6.163 6.162-2.759 6.162-6.163c0-3.403-2.759-6.162-6.162-6.162zm0 10.162c-2.209 0-4-1.79-4-4 0-2.209 1.791-4 4-4s4 1.791 4 4c0 2.21-1.791 4-4 4zm6.406-11.845c-.796 0-1.441.645-1.441 1.44s.645 1.44 1.441 1.44c.795 0 1.439-.645 1.439-1.44s-.644-1.44-1.439-1.44z"/></svg>

  processed = processed.replace(

    (match, typeMatch, code) => {

            <div class="tiktok-embed-header mb-2.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-black/10 dark:bg-white/5 border border-pink-500/25 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 shadow-sm">
              <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12.525.02c1.31-.02 2.61-.01 3.91-.02.08 1.53.63 3.09 1.75 4.17 1.12 1.11 2.7 1.62 4.24 1.79v4.03c-1.44-.05-2.89-.35-4.2-.97-.57-.26-1.1-.59-1.62-.93-.01 2.92.01 5.84-.02 8.75-.08 1.4-.54 2.79-1.35 3.94-1.31 1.92-3.58 3.17-5.91 3.21-1.43.08-2.86-.31-4.08-1.03-2.02-1.19-3.44-3.37-3.65-5.71-.02-.5-.03-1-.01-1.49.18-1.9 1.12-3.72 2.58-4.96 1.66-1.44 3.98-2.13 6.15-1.72.02 1.48-.04 2.96-.04 4.44-.99-.32-2.15-.23-3.02.37-.63.41-1.11 1.04-1.36 1.75-.21.51-.24 1.07-.14 1.61.24 1.64 1.82 2.89 3.5 2.73 1.34-.03 2.53-.92 2.93-2.21.13-.42.18-.86.18-1.3V0z"/></svg>
                <span>Video de TikTok (@${username})</span>
              </div>
              <a href="${fullUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-black hover:bg-neutral-800 text-white text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm transition border border-white/20">
                <span>Abrir en TikTok ↗</span>
              </a>
            </div>
            <div class="w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-black">
              <iframe 
                src="https://www.tiktok.com/embed/v2/${videoId}" 
                class="w-full border-0 rounded-2xl" 
                style="height: 580px; width: 100%; border: none;" 
                allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" 
                allowfullscreen
                loading="lazy"
              ></iframe>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `);
    }
  );

  // =========================================================================
  // 4. TWITTER / X: BLOCKQUOTES Y ENLACES DIRECTOS A TWEETS / POSTS
  // =========================================================================

  // 4A. Blockquotes de Twitter / X (incluyendo envoltorio wp-block-embed-twitter si existe)
  processed = processed.replace(
    /(?:<figure[^>]*class="[^"]*wp-block-embed-twitter[^"]*"[^>]*>\s*<div[^>]*class="[^"]*wp-block-embed__wrapper[^"]*"[^>]*>\s*)?<blockquote([^>]*)class="([^"]*twitter-tweet[^"]*)"([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/blockquote>(?:\s*<script[^>]*><\/script>)?(?:\s*<\/div>\s*<\/figure>)?/gi,
    (match, p1, p2, p3, inner) => {
      const linkMatch = inner.match(/href="([^"]+)"/i);
      const tweetUrl = linkMatch ? linkMatch[1] : 'https://x.com';

      return storeEmbed(`
        <div class="my-6 not-prose flex flex-col items-center w-full">
          <div class="w-full max-w-[500px]">
            <div class="twitter-embed-header mb-2.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 shadow-sm">
              <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18.244 2.25h3.308l-7.227 8.26 8.502 11.24H16.17l-5.214-6.817L4.99 21.75H1.68l7.73-8.835L1.254 2.25H8.08l4.713 6.231zm-1.161 17.52h1.833L7.084 4.126H5.117z"/></svg>
                <span>Publicación en X (Twitter)</span>
              </div>
              <a href="${tweetUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-black hover:bg-neutral-800 text-white text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm transition border border-white/20">
                <span>Ver en X ↗</span>
              </a>
            </div>
            <div class="twitter-embed-wrapper w-full flex justify-center">
              <blockquote class="twitter-tweet" data-dnt="true" data-theme="dark">
                <a href="${tweetUrl}"></a>
              </blockquote>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `);
    }
  );

  // 4B. Enlaces directos a Twitter / X pegados en párrafos standalone
  processed = processed.replace(
    /<p[^>]*>\s*(?:<a[^>]*>\s*)?(https?:\/\/(?:twitter\.com|x\.com)\/([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\/status\/(\d+)[^\s<"']*)(?:\s*<\/a>)?\s*<\/p>/gi,
    (match, tweetUrl, username, statusId) => {
      return storeEmbed(`
        <div class="my-6 not-prose flex flex-col items-center w-full">
          <div class="w-full max-w-[500px]">
            <div class="twitter-embed-header mb-2.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 shadow-sm">
              <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18.244 2.25h3.308l-7.227 8.26 8.502 11.24H16.17l-5.214-6.817L4.99 21.75H1.68l7.73-8.835L1.254 2.25H8.08l4.713 6.231zm-1.161 17.52h1.833L7.084 4.126H5.117z"/></svg>
                <span>Publicación en X (@${username})</span>
              </div>
              <a href="${tweetUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-black hover:bg-neutral-800 text-white text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm transition border border-white/20">
                <span>Ver en X ↗</span>
              </a>
            </div>
            <div class="twitter-embed-wrapper w-full flex justify-center">
              <blockquote class="twitter-tweet" data-dnt="true" data-theme="dark">
                <a href="${tweetUrl}"></a>
              </blockquote>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `);
    }
  );

  // =========================================================================
  // 5. YOUTUBE: VIDEOS, SHORTS Y ENLACES CORTOS (YOU.TU.BE)
  // =========================================================================
  processed = processed.replace(
    /(?:<figure[^>]*class="[^"]*wp-block-embed-youtube[^"]*"[^>]*>\s*<div[^>]*class="[^"]*wp-block-embed__wrapper[^"]*"[^>]*>\s*)?<p[^>]*>\s*(?:<a[^>]*>\s*)?(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:www\.)?(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})(?:[^\s<"']*)?(?:\s*<\/a>)?\s*<\/p>(?:\s*<\/div>\s*<\/figure>)?/gi,
    (match, videoId) => {
      const ytUrl = `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${videoId}`;
      return storeEmbed(`
        <div class="my-6 not-prose w-full">
          <div class="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/25 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 mb-2.5">
            <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">
              <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M23.498 6.186a3.016 3.016 0 0 0-2.122-2.136C19.505 3.545 12 3.545 12 3.545s-7.505 0-9.377.505A3.017 3.017 0 0 0 .502 6.186C0 8.07 0 12 0 12s0 3.93.502 5.814a3.016 3.016 0 0 0 2.122 2.136c1.871.505 9.376.505 9.376.505s7.505 0 9.377-.505a3.015 3.015 0 0 0 2.122-2.136C24 15.93 24 12 24 12s0-3.93-.502-5.814zM9.545 15.568V8.432L15.818 12l-6.273 3.568z"/></svg>
              <span>Video de YouTube</span>
            </div>
            <a href="${ytUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm transition cursor-pointer">
              <span>Abrir en YouTube ↗</span>
            </a>
          </div>
          <div class="relative w-full aspect-video rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-black">
            <iframe 
              src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${videoId}" 
              title="Reproductor de YouTube" 
              class="w-full h-full border-0" 
              allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" 
              allowfullscreen 
              loading="lazy"
            ></iframe>
          </div>
        </div>
      `);
    }
  );

  // =========================================================================
  // 6. THREADS: BLOCKQUOTES Y ENLACES DIRECTOS
  // =========================================================================
  processed = processed.replace(
    /<blockquote([^>]*)class="([^"]*text-post-media[^"]*)"([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/blockquote>(?:\s*<script[^>]*><\/script>)?/gi,
    (match, p1, p2, p3, inner) => {
      const fullAttrs = `${p1} ${p3}`;
      const permalinkMatch = fullAttrs.match(/data-text-post-permalink="([^"]+)"/i) || inner.match(/href="([^"]+threads\.net[^"]+)"/i);
      const threadsUrl = permalinkMatch ? permalinkMatch[1] : 'https://www.threads.net';

      return storeEmbed(`
        <div class="my-6 not-prose flex flex-col items-center w-full">
          <div class="w-full max-w-[500px]">
            <div class="threads-embed-header mb-2.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/10 dark:bg-white/5 border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 shadow-sm">
              <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12.001 2c-5.523 0-10 4.477-10 10 0 5.093 3.807 9.297 8.742 9.907v-3.774a3.1 3.1 0 0 1-1.742-.716 3.4 3.4 0 0 1-1.096-2.527c0-2.074 1.62-3.73 3.935-3.73 2.133 0 3.722 1.48 3.722 3.484 0 2.45-1.637 4.09-4.298 4.09-.914 0-1.776-.23-2.493-.66l-.72 2.68c1.03.49 2.22.77 3.48.77 4.148 0 7.031-2.735 7.031-6.88 0-3.528-2.756-6.196-6.722-6.196-4.32 0-7.24 3.092-7.24 6.953 0 4.237 3.328 7.378 7.64 7.378 1.464 0 2.827-.374 4.02-1.03l-.75-2.61c-.96.48-2.07.75-3.27.75-2.9 0-5.01-1.99-5.01-4.738 0-2.45 1.76-4.37 4.38-4.37 2.37 0 3.9 1.6 3.9 3.65 0 1.25-.8 2.05-1.78 2.05-.72 0-1.2-.42-1.2-1.08v-1.92h-1.5v1.92c0 1.62 1.15 2.68 2.7 2.68 1.95 0 3.28-1.5 3.28-3.65 0-2.8-2.18-4.85-5.4-4.85-3.5 0-5.87 2.4-5.87 5.56 0 3.35 2.48 5.75 5.87 5.75.96 0 1.88-.2 2.72-.58v3.45C18.67 20.89 22 16.84 22 12c0-5.523-4.477-10-10-10z"/></svg>
                <span>Publicación en Threads</span>
              </div>
              <a href="${threadsUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#1c1c1e] hover:bg-[#2c2c2e] text-white text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm transition border border-white/10 cursor-pointer">
                <span>Ver en Threads ↗</span>
              </a>
            </div>
            <div class="threads-embed-wrapper w-full flex justify-center">
              <blockquote class="text-post-media" data-text-post-permalink="${threadsUrl}">
                <a href="${threadsUrl}"></a>
              </blockquote>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `);
    }
  );

  // 6B. Enlaces directos a Threads pegados en párrafos standalone
  processed = processed.replace(
    /<p[^>]*>\s*(?:<a[^>]*>\s*)?(https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?threads\.net\/@[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+\/post\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+[^\s<"']*)(?:\s*<\/a>)?\s*<\/p>/gi,
    (match, threadsUrl) => {
      return storeEmbed(`
        <div class="my-6 not-prose flex flex-col items-center w-full">
          <div class="w-full max-w-[500px]">
            <div class="threads-embed-header mb-2.5 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/10 dark:bg-white/5 border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 shadow-sm">
              <div class="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-neutral-800 dark:text-neutral-200">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4 fill-current flex-shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12.001 2c-5.523 0-10 4.477-10 10 0 5.093 3.807 9.297 8.742 9.907v-3.774a3.1 3.1 0 0 1-1.742-.716 3.4 3.4 0 0 1-1.096-2.527c0-2.074 1.62-3.73 3.935-3.73 2.133 0 3.722 1.48 3.722 3.484 0 2.45-1.637 4.09-4.298 4.09-.914 0-1.776-.23-2.493-.66l-.72 2.68c1.03.49 2.22.77 3.48.77 4.148 0 7.031-2.735 7.031-6.88 0-3.528-2.756-6.196-6.722-6.196-4.32 0-7.24 3.092-7.24 6.953 0 4.237 3.328 7.378 7.64 7.378 1.464 0 2.827-.374 4.02-1.03l-.75-2.61c-.96.48-2.07.75-3.27.75-2.9 0-5.01-1.99-5.01-4.738 0-2.45 1.76-4.37 4.38-4.37 2.37 0 3.9 1.6 3.9 3.65 0 1.25-.8 2.05-1.78 2.05-.72 0-1.2-.42-1.2-1.08v-1.92h-1.5v1.92c0 1.62 1.15 2.68 2.7 2.68 1.95 0 3.28-1.5 3.28-3.65 0-2.8-2.18-4.85-5.4-4.85-3.5 0-5.87 2.4-5.87 5.56 0 3.35 2.48 5.75 5.87 5.75.96 0 1.88-.2 2.72-.58v3.45C18.67 20.89 22 16.84 22 12c0-5.523-4.477-10-10-10z"/></svg>
                <span>Publicación en Threads</span>
              </div>
              <a href="${threadsUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#1c1c1e] hover:bg-[#2c2c2e] text-white text-[11px] font-bold shadow-sm transition border border-white/10 cursor-pointer">
                <span>Ver en Threads ↗</span>
              </a>
            </div>
            <div class="threads-embed-wrapper w-full flex justify-center">
              <blockquote class="text-post-media" data-text-post-permalink="${threadsUrl}">
                <a href="${threadsUrl}"></a>
              </blockquote>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `);
    }
  );

  // =========================================================================
  // 7. ENLACES EXTERNOS GENERALES <a>
  // Asegurar que abran en nueva pestaña (_blank) con alto contraste para no cortar la radio.
  // Nota: Al ejecutarse antes de restaurar los placeholders, NUNCA alterará las clases
  // ni los botones de los widgets sociales embebidos.
  // =========================================================================
  processed = processed.replace(/<a\b([^>]*)>/gi, (match, attrs) => {
    let cleanAttrs = attrs;

    // Si ya tiene target, asegurar que sea _blank
    if (/target=["'][^"']*["']/i.test(cleanAttrs)) {
      cleanAttrs = cleanAttrs.replace(/target=["'][^"']*["']/i, 'target="_blank"');
    } else {
      cleanAttrs += ' target="_blank"';
    }

    // Asegurar rel="noopener noreferrer"
    if (/rel=["'][^"']*["']/i.test(cleanAttrs)) {
      cleanAttrs = cleanAttrs.replace(/rel=["'][^"']*["']/i, 'rel="noopener noreferrer"');
    } else {
      cleanAttrs += ' rel="noopener noreferrer"';
    }

    // Asegurar clases de alto contraste y estilo Apple
    if (/class=["']([^"']*)["']/i.test(cleanAttrs)) {
      cleanAttrs = cleanAttrs.replace(/class=["']([^"']*)["']/i, (cMatch, existingClasses) => {
        if (!existingClasses.includes('text-[#001E4D]') && !existingClasses.includes('dark:text-[#00DD9E]')) {
          return `class="${existingClasses} text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] hover:underline font-bold transition-colors"`;
        }
        return cMatch;
      });
    } else {
      cleanAttrs += ' class="text-[#001E4D] dark:text-[#00DD9E] hover:underline font-bold transition-colors"';
    }

    return `<a${cleanAttrs}>`;
  });

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. RESTAURACIÓN DE SLOTS DE EMBEDS
  // Inyectar de vuelta los componentes HTML limpios y aislados en sus posiciones
  // =========================================================================
  for (const { token, embedHtml } of placeholders) {
    processed = processed.replace(token, embedHtml);
  }

  return processed;
}

```
